series.title: A Bona Fide Killer
series.tagline: The perfect housewife. The perfect double life.
series.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A legendary vigilante must balance her job with her role as a mother – can she hide from her journalist husband and a detective hunting her?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bo-na, Tae-sung, and their four-year-old daughter Yul are a typical happy and harmonious family. After a three-year parental leave, Bo-na returns to work and successfully completes her duties from day one, defying concerns. Meanwhile, Tae-sung, covering a drug case, learns a serial killer who disappeared four years ago has returned.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tae-sung and the police are surprised by Kingfisher's return and resolve to finally apprehend Kingfisher for good this time. Tae-sung seeks information from Detective Dong-jin, who previously pursued Kingfisher. Meanwhile, a new employee appears at Bo-na's company, seemingly harboring an unknown secret.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hyun-nam tells Bo-na why she came to Durumi Electronics to find her. A Sales Team workshop takes place, and Bo-na spends time away from Tae-sung and Yul for the first time since her marriage. While enjoying an unexpectedly pleasant time, an unforeseen incident occurs at the accommodation.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Bo-na keeps working, Yul starts whining, and Bo-na struggles with balancing childcare and work. Meanwhile, people are enraged by child sex offender Pyo Gyu-cheol's release after serving his sentence. Tae-sung meets Dong-jin who is tracking Pyo Gyu-cheol. Dong-jin believes Pyo Gyu-cheol could be Kingfisher's new target.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Bo-na, knowing today is Tae-sung's family's memorial day, takes a half-day off and leaves early. She does her best, but her mother-in-law's berating continues. Misunderstandings build as Tae-sung helps her after work, leading to an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Tae-sung begins investigating the suspicious death of a construction worker.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Bo-na and her team travel to a Gangwon Province casino to prepare for a Client Meeting. When their plans hit a snag, Bo-na must step in for the Meeting herself. Tae-sung, investigating a construction worker's death, heads to the casino where Bo-na is, while probing the construction company's Chairman. Meanwhile, suspicious individuals appear around Bo-na's Meeting target.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eight years ago, in World Cup-feverish Seoul, Bo-na's team holds a Meeting hidden. In the same building, chasing a pickpocket, Tae-sung attacked, collapsing. Bo-na finds him, calls 119. Four months later, Tae-sung awakens, meets Bo-na, falls for her. Bo-na, exhausted by her 16-year mission, plans to quit.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After discharge, Tae-sung retreats to a secluded mountain lodge, where he coincidentally reunites with Bo-na. Heavy snow isolates them, and only the two stay at the lodge for a while. Sharing food and enduring the cold, they open their hearts and start to love. Meanwhile, released vicious criminals, fearing Kingfisher, try to return to prison.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Sergei, Bo-na's childhood friend and a mercenary from Russia, reappears, and the truth of The Gosiwon Case in Haegong-dong from four years ago begins to surface. Bo-na investigates Sergei's return to Korea. Meanwhile, Dong-jin learns that Jang Eun-hak, the culprit who murdered his parents, has been paroled.

series.title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
series.overview: A poor and ordinary boy from a village joins a minor sect in Jiang Hu and becomes an Unofficial Disciple by chance. How will Han Li, a commoner by birth, establish a foothold for himself in his sect? With his mediocre aptitude, he must successfully traverse the treacherous path of cultivation and avoid the notice of those who may do him harm. This is a story of an ordinary mortal who, against all odds, clashes with devilish demons and ancient celestials in order to find his own path towards immortality.

episodes.title: Least Expected Night
episodes.overview: Hugo leads a strike by the workers' union at Ecomoda, while Betty, Marcela, Mario, and Esteban visit Pascual to convince him to sell them the warehouses. Also, Mila has new proposals to help Ecomoda. Hermes finds Betty's diary and deciphers the past. After a night out with her friends, Betty ends the night in an unexpected way.

episodes.title: Blanked Out Cassette
episodes.overview: Betty wakes up with no memory of the night before and is surprised that she is not at home. Mila discovers Nacho's true colors. Will he take the opportunity to confess his identity to everyone? Armando decides to visit his daughter and Betty, but he meets Hermes, who stops him in his tracks, requesting for explanations about what he read in Betty's old diary.

episodes.title: Don't Blame It On The Beach
episodes.overview: Mila reads Betty's diary and completely breaks down. Full of resentment towards her father, she demands him to sign the divorce papers. Will this mean the end of their relationship? Time later, Betty enjoys in Cartagena with a mysterious man... Who could it be?

episodes.title: Shuffle and Start Over
episodes.overview: Love affairs in Cartagena, pregnancy announcements, and longed-for reunions. Which former member of the squad will return to the company? The "Nachos" plan to keep all the shares. Will they succeed? Betty's new romance becomes the most desired gossip among employees.

episodes.title: Eco-Wedding
episodes.overview: Unexpected marriage, celebrations, and new surprises. Freddy returns renewed and transformed. What tensions will his return generate? Amid the celebration, the employees learn that the company is practically bankrupt. A particular investor comes into the picture. Will he be their salvation?

episodes.title: Don't Blame It On The Rain

seasons.name: Uglier Than Ever
seasons.overview: Season 3 finds Betty back in Bogotá for Hugo Lombardi's farewell fashion show, where old emotions reignite and her path crosses once again with Armando's. This time, Betty dares like never before: she starts therapy, gets her own apartment, and faces a crisis at Ecomoda after a plagiarism scandal, all while navigating an unexpected love triangle between Armando and Michel, her French ex who reappears to shake things up.

series.title: BLACK TORCH
series.overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago’s powers.

episodes.title: The Future Is in Our Hands
episodes.overview: When high school animal whisperer and ninja Jiro finds an injured cat, the supernatural unleashes.

episodes.title: The Choice Is Yours
episodes.overview: Jiro awakens in hospital only to learn he is now under the surveillance of the Bureau of Espionage.

episodes.title: WHAT'S MY NAME?
episodes.overview: Jiro is cuffed in a van, and the tension could be cut with a katana thanks to Jiro’s escort, Ichika.

episodes.title: Two Is Not Enough
episodes.overview: Jiro is pitted against the newest recruit, Reiji, and each challenger’s fist has a tale to tell.

episodes.title: Young Gunz
episodes.overview: In a subterranean hold, an imposing monolith towers over Jiro and Reiji-- Rago’s former prison.

episodes.title: Turn Up
episodes.overview: Jiro, Ichika, and Reiji have been handed a new trial, this time from the “friendly” mononoke Fuyo.

episodes.title: 3 ON THREE
episodes.overview: Mononoke have just committed mass murder, but it's more than just all-you-can-eat human meat.

episodes.title: Underdog
episodes.overview: The dueler who confronted Reiji is his own kin and Shinji’s inner turmoil is about to finally erupt.

episodes.title: ONE
episodes.overview: Finally Jiro has gained consciousness, in a vast warehouse, behind the stone-cold stare of Kusumi.

series.title: Bleach
series.overview: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

episodes.title: The Day I Became a Shinigami
episodes.overview: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

episodes.title: A Shinigami's Work
episodes.overview: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

episodes.title: The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
episodes.overview: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

episodes.title: Cursed Parakeet
episodes.overview: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

episodes.title: Beat the Invisible Enemy!
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

episodes.title: Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
episodes.overview: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

episodes.title: Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

episodes.title: June 17, Memories in the Rain
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

episodes.title: Unbeatable Enemy
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

episodes.title: Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
episodes.overview: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

episodes.title: The Legendary Quincy
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

episodes.title: A Gentle Right Arm
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

episodes.title: Flower and Hollow
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

episodes.title: Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

episodes.title: Kon's Great Plan
episodes.overview: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
episodes.overview: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

episodes.title: Ichigo Dies!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

episodes.title: Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
episodes.overview: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

episodes.title: Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
episodes.overview: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Enter! The World of the Shinigami
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter Soul Society.

episodes.title: The Man who Hates Shinigami
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are forced to find another way into Seireitei due to 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru's intervention.

episodes.title: 14 Days Before Rukia's Execution
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the household of the Shiba Clan.

episodes.title: Assemble! The 13 Divisions
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin their preparations to get into the Seireitei, the Gotei 13 captains assemble for a meeting.

episodes.title: Penetrate the Center with an Enormous Bombshell?
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends enter the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Formation! The Worst Tag
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends are scattered throughout the Seireitei, where they encounter new enemies.

episodes.title: Release the Death Blow!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki completes his battle with 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame while his friends continue to progress through the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Orihime Targeted
episodes.overview: Ganju Shiba wins his battle against 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa while Uryū Ishida begins his own.

episodes.title: Breakthrough! The Shinigami's Encompassing Net
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida defeats 7th Division 4th Seat Jirōbō Ikkanzaka while Ichigo Kurosaki and Ganju Shiba encounter 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada, who personally knows Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Renji's Confrontation
episodes.overview: Having been led to the base of Senzaikyū, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his rematch with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai.

episodes.title: The Resolution to Kill
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai conclude their rematch.

episodes.title: Stars and the Stray
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai remembers his past with Rukia Kuchiki and begs Ichigo Kurosaki to save her in his stead.

episodes.title: Miracle! The Mysterious New Hero
episodes.overview: In the Human World, Yuzu Kurosaki finds a cat named Raku and is drawn into an adventure with Don Kanonji and his Karakura-Raizer Team.

episodes.title: Tragedy of Dawn
episodes.overview: As the Gotei 13 reacts to 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai's defeat, Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto declares war against the Ryoka.

episodes.title: Aizen Assassinated! The Darkness which Approaches
episodes.overview: While the Gotei 13 deals with the death of 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen, Ichigo Kurosaki and his group attempt to enter Senzaikyū once again.

episodes.title: Zaraki Kenpachi Approaches!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: Motive of the Fist
episodes.overview: Yasutora Sado battles with 8th Division captain, Shunsui Kyōraku.

episodes.title: Desperation! The Broken Zangetsu
episodes.overview: As the high-ranking members of the Gotei 13 continue to react to 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen's murder, Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: The Immortal Man
episodes.overview: After learning to access the power of Zangetsu in addition to his own, Ichigo Kurosaki concludes his battle with 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki.

episodes.title: The Shinigami whom Ganju Met
episodes.overview: While 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi reminisces about her history with her captain, Kenpachi Zaraki, Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada reach Rukia Kuchiki's cell in Senzaikyū.

episodes.title: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the White Tower and reunites with Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Yoruichi, Goddess of Flash, Dances!
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin saves Ichigo Kurosaki and decides to help him attain Bankai.

episodes.title: The Despicable Shinigami
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida and Orihime Inoue are confronted by 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.title: Ishida Ultimate Power!
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida removes his Sanrei Glove to defeat 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi.

episodes.title: Overcome Your Limits!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his Bankai Training.

episodes.title: Authentic Records! School of Shinigami
episodes.overview: 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori recalls her past at the Shin'ō Academy.

episodes.title: The Avengers
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki continues his Bankai Training, 5th Division Lieutenant Momo Hinamori confronts 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya over the contents of the letter left by her captain, Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Roars!
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles 3rd Division Captain Gin Ichimaru.

episodes.title: Rukia's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki recalls her past with Kaien Shiba.

episodes.title: The Reviving Lion
episodes.overview: The Karakura Superheroes come together once more and fight a Hollow.

episodes.title: Morning of the Sentence
episodes.overview: As the day of Rukia Kuchiki's execution arrives, various groups around the Seireitei move out and clash with one another.

episodes.title: Renji, Oath of the Soul! Death Match with Byakuya
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai battles his captain, Byakuya Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Ichimaru Gin's Temptation, Resolution Shattered
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his subordinates battle the 7th and 9th Division captains and lieutenants.

episodes.title: An Accomplished Oath! Get back Rukia!
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki's execution ceremony commences, but does not proceed as planned.

episodes.title: The Strongest Shinigami! Ultimate Confrontation Between Teacher and Students
episodes.overview: After the interruption of Rukia Kuchiki's execution, battles commence all across the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Supersonic Battle! Determine the Goddess of Battle
episodes.overview: Yoruichi Shihōin battles 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng.

episodes.title: Senbonzakura, Crushed! Zangetsu Thrusts through the Sky
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue their battle.

episodes.title: Unseal! The Black Blade, the Miraculous Power
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki activate their Bankai.

episodes.title: Conclusion of the Death Match! White Pride and Black Desire
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's battle reaches its conclusion.

episodes.title: Reality of the Despair, the Assassin's Dagger is Swung
episodes.overview: A conspiracy connecting several recent events in Soul Society is revealed.

episodes.title: Aizen Stands! Horrible Ambitions
episodes.overview: 4th Division Lieutenant Isane Kotetsu informs the Gotei 13 that Sōsuke Aizen is alive as the latter reveals his machinations.

episodes.title: Gather Together! Group of the Strongest Shinigami!
episodes.overview: 5th Division Captain Sōsuke Aizen removes the Hōgyoku from Rukia Kuchiki's Soul and retreats to Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Rukia's Resolution, Ichigo's Feelings
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends say their goodbyes in Soul Society before heading back home through the Dangai.

episodes.title: New School Term, Renji Has Come to the Material World?!
episodes.overview: As the lives of Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends begin to return to normal, three mysterious figures appear and abduct Orihime Inoue.

episodes.title: Creeping Terror, the Second Victim
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado, and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai are forced to play a game in order to find Orihime Inoue.

episodes.title: Breakthrough! The Trap Hidden in the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Lieutenant Renji Abarai, and Uryū Ishida must navigate a labyrinth in order to free their friends.

episodes.title: Death Game! The Missing Classmate
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends must deduce the identity of an impostor in their midst.

episodes.title: True Identity of the Devil, the Secret which Is Revealed
episodes.overview: The truth about the Mod-Souls is revealed as a new enemy appears.

episodes.title: Bount! The Ones Who Hunt Souls
episodes.overview: The Mod-Souls receive new bodies as Ichigo Kurosaki encounters a Bount for the first time.

episodes.title: Rukia's Return! Revival of the Substitute Team!
episodes.overview: Two new Bount appear as one takes an interest in Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: The Moment of Collision! An Evil Hand Draws Near to the Quincy
episodes.overview: With Ryō Utagawa attempting to devour his Soul, Uryū Ishida finds himself abducted and saved by Yoshino Sōma.

episodes.title: Water Attack! Escape from the Shutdown Hospital
episodes.overview: While Uryū Ishida is in the hospital, his friends must fight two Bount who can control water.

episodes.title: Gathering Bounts! The Man Who Makes His Move
episodes.overview: Ganju Shiba and 4th Division 7th Seat Hanatarō Yamada help conclude the fight against Hō and Ban.

episodes.title: Memories of an Eternally Living Clan
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida gets to know Yoshino Sōma while 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and his lieutenant, Yachiru Kusajishi, discover that a former member of their division is in Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Earth-Shattering Event at 11th Squad! The Shinigami Who Rises Again
episodes.overview: 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi informs the Gotei 13 of his missing data on the Bount while Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends break into the Bount Mansion to save Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: Crashing Force! Fried vs. Zangetsu
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki faces off against Ryō Utagawa, who ends up betraying Jin Kariya with the intention of dethroning him.

episodes.title: Unfading Grudge! The Shinigami whom Kenpachi Killed
episodes.overview: Maki Ichinose remembers his past as he and Jin Kariya battle Ichigo Kurosaki.

episodes.title: Shocking Revelations for the 13 Divisions!! The Truth Buried in History
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida tries to understand more about Yoshino Sōma as Ichigo Kurosaki spars with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ganju Shiba in order to regain his fighting spirit.

episodes.title: Yoshino's Decision of Death
episodes.overview: Yoshino Sōma makes a final stand against Jin Kariya in order to redeem herself.

episodes.title: Assault from a Formidable Enemy! A Tiny Final Line of Defense?!
episodes.overview: At Kisuke Urahara's request, Ririn, Kurōdo, and Noba prepare anti-Bount traps around the Kurosaki Clinic, but are angered when Ichigo Kurosaki brushes them off as pointless and unhelpful.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Moves! The Attacked City
episodes.overview: The Bitto' attack Karakura Town, allowing the Bount to grow stronger, while 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya briefs his strike force on their mission in Soul Society.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Dalk! Appearance of the Faded Darkness
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai fights off the Bitto, who are quickly recalled, while Ichigo Kurosaki battles Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, in her new form.

episodes.title: Grey Shadow, the Secret of the Dolls
episodes.overview: Gō Koga tells Ichigo Kurosaki that he reminds him of a boy from his past, Cain, whom Koga was assigned to train by Jin Kariya until tragedy struck.

episodes.title: Dissension in the Substitute Team? Rukia's Betrayal
episodes.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira fends off Gō Koga's Doll, Dalk, while Mabashi arrives to take over for a struggling Yoshi.

episodes.title: Deadly Battle of Tears! Rukia vs. Orihime
episodes.overview: Mabashi uses his Doll, Ritz, to take control of Rukia Kuchiki's body and force her to fight her friends.

episodes.title: Rangiku Dances! Slice the Invisible Enemy!
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Rangiku Matsumoto, Yasutora Sado, Noba, and Ururu Tsumugiya face off against the old Bount, Sawatari, and his Doll, Baura.

episodes.title: Byakuya is summoned! The Gotei 13 start to move!
episodes.overview: Sawatari retreats while an invisible intruder enters Soul Society. Uryū Ishida remembers training to become a Quincy.

episodes.title: Annihilation of the Lieutenants!? Trap in the Underground Cave
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and company head off to the Bounts' cave, only to encounter Ugaki's Doll, Gesell.

episodes.title: Rematch?! Ishida vs. Nemu
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and friends continue to fight Gesell as Lieutenant Nemu Kurotsuchi presents Uryū Ishida with a battle accessory.

episodes.title: Renji Abarai, Bankai of the Soul!
episodes.overview: Gesell turns on its master. Ichigo Kurosaki attempts to fight Jin Kariya with little success.

episodes.title: Shinigami and Quincy, the Reviving Power
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki initiates Bankai, but Uryū Ishida completes the Bounts' portal, allowing them to enter Soul Society.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Shinigami World, Again
episodes.overview: The Bounts arrive in Soul Society. Rukia Kuchiki meets up with Yoshi once more.

episodes.title: The Bount Assault! The Gotei 13 of Destructive Earthquake
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki squares off against Yoshi. Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto informs the other captains of the Bounts' origins.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya's Decision! The Clash Approaches
episodes.overview: Jin Kariya recruits men from Kusajishi as Ichigo Kurosaki and friends finally arrive at Kūkaku Shiba's house.

episodes.title: Byakuya Takes the Field! Dance of the Wind-Splitting Cherry Blossoms
episodes.overview: Captain Byakuya Kuchiki battles Jin Kariya when Ichigo Kurosaki shows up to help.

episodes.title: Ichigo, Byakuya, Kariya, The Battle of the Three Extremes!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki continue to fight a continuously healing Jin Kariya, Ran'Tao shows up, prompting Kariya to leave.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Strikes! Slice the Enemy in the Middle of the Forest
episodes.overview: Ran'Tao reveals the reason for her resemblance to Yoshino Sōma as Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya faces off against Maki Ichinose.

episodes.title: Clash! Kenpachi Zaraki vs. Maki Ichinose
episodes.overview: Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives to stop Maki Ichinose.

episodes.title: Shinigami vs. Shinigami! The Uncontrollable Power
episodes.overview: The Bounts break into Seireitei and Captain Suì-Fēng encounters Mabashi.

episodes.title: Suì-Fēng Dies? The Last of the Special Forces
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng survives her poisoning by using her own poison to nullify Mabashi's, and kills Mabashi.

episodes.title: Mayuri's Bankai!! Sawatari: Clash of the Demon
episodes.overview: Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi, of the 12th Division, battles against the Bount, Sawatari.

episodes.title: The Last Quincy! The Exploding Power
episodes.overview: As Jin Kariya looks for the Jokai Crest, Uryū Ishida battles the Bount, Yoshi.

episodes.title: Ishida, Exceeding the Limits to Attack!
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida defeats the Bount, Yoshi, Jin Kariya prepares to destroy the Soul Society.

episodes.title: 10th Division's Death Struggle! The Release of Hyōrinmaru
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles against the Bount, Gō Koga.

episodes.title: Kariya! Countdown to the Detonation
episodes.overview: As the Shinigami learn more about the Jōkaishō, Ran'Tao confronts Jin Kariya.

episodes.title: Life and Revenge! Ishida, the Ultimate Choice
episodes.overview: Uryū Ishida confronts the Bount, Jin Kariya.

episodes.title: The Swung-Down Edge! The Moment of Ruin
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya battle each other, the Shinigami look for the other Jōkaishō to re-seal them.

episodes.title: The Wailing Bount! The Last Clash
episodes.overview: The battle between Ichigo Kurosaki and Jin Kariya concludes.

episodes.title: Ichigo and Rukia, Thoughts in the Revolving Around Heaven
episodes.overview: Following the battle with the Bounts, things slowly return to normal.

episodes.title: Reopening of the Substitute Business! The Terrifying Transfer Student
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes back to slaying Hollows in the Human World, but he is soon confronted by Shinji Hirako - a Visored.

episodes.title: Shock! The Father's True Identity
episodes.overview: Isshin Kurosaki reveals himself as a Shinigami and fights Grand Fisher.

episodes.title: The Commencement of War, Vizards and the Arrancars
episodes.overview: Information on the Visored and Arrancar is revealed.

episodes.title: Prelude to the Apocalypse, The Arrancar's Offensive
episodes.overview: Arrancar arrive in the Human World.

episodes.title: Reunion, Ichigo and Rukia and Soul Reapers
episodes.overview: The Arrancar leave the Human World while the Gotei 13 send help to protect the Human World.

episodes.title: Mission! The Soul Reapers Have Come
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki regains his confidence to fight again. Later, more facts about the Arrancar are revealed.

episodes.title: The Evil Eye, Aizen Returns
episodes.overview: The Arrancar arrive in the Human World, again.

episodes.title: Rukia's Battle Commences! The Freezing White Blade
episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki battles against the Arrancar, Di Roy Rinker.

episodes.title: Ikkaku's Bankai! The Power That Breaks Everything
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame battles against the Arrancar, Edrad Liones.

episodes.title: Zaraki Division's Secret Story! The Lucky Men
episodes.overview: 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame recalls when he joined the 11th Division.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya Scatters! The Broken Hyōrinmaru
episodes.overview: The battles with the Arrancar continue.

episodes.title: Clash! The Protector vs. The Bearer
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez battle each other.

episodes.title: Vizard! The Power of the Awakened
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to where the Visored are in hopes of learning how to control his Hollowfication.

episodes.title: Ichigo, Complete Hollowification!?
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins training to control his Hollowfication.

episodes.title: Collision! Black Bankai and the White Bankai
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his battle with his inner Hollow.

episodes.title: Urgent Report! Aizen's Terrifying Plan!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki successfully controls his Hollow, Sōsuke Aizen's plans are revealed.

episodes.title: Uryū vs. Ryūken! Clash of the Parent-Child Quincys
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki is informed of Sōsuke Aizen's plans, Uryū Ishida finishes his training.

episodes.title: Urahara's Decision, Orihime's Thoughts
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue is told that she won't be allowed to fight in the upcoming battles.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Arrancar! Team Hitsugaya Moves Out

episodes.title: The Appearance of the Great Evil! The Darkness in the House of Kasumiōji
episodes.overview: Rurichiyo Kasumiōji is targeted by more assassins after secretly returning to the Soul Society.

episodes.title: Break the Mirror's Boundary! Ichigo's Captivity

episodes.title: The Princess's Decision, the Sorrowful Bride

episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain Shūsuke Amagai battle each other.

episodes.title: The Fallen Shinigami's Pride

episodes.title: Hueco Mundo Chapter, Restart!

episodes.title: Irresistible, Puppet Show of Terror
episodes.overview: Szayelaporro Granz demonstrates a new technique, whilst Nnoitra Gilga is taken aback by Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck's onslaught.

episodes.title: Neliel's Past

episodes.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Who's the Strongest?

episodes.overview: The characters take a break on the beach.

episodes.overview: Ikkaku and Yumichika are forced to stay with Mizuho again while on a mission in the Human World.

episodes.overview: A mysterious Zanpakutō Spirit named Muramasa releases the spirits of many Zanpakutō from their swords and attacks Soul Society.

episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against the manifested Zanpakutō Spirit of Sode no Shirayuki, who arrives in the Human World while chasing Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.overview: Rukia Kuchiki and Ichigo Kurosaki battle Sode no Shirayuki, and Muramasa reveals he is a Zanpakutō Spirit.

episodes.overview: Muramasa releases Zangetsu, and Ichigo Kurosaki fights him as his inner Hollow begins to take control.

episodes.title: Renji Surprised?! The Two Zabimarus
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai is confronted by the spirit of his Zanpakutō, and Muramasa enters Ichigo Kurosaki's inner world.

episodes.title: Clash! Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes.overview: 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi fights his Zanpakutō spirit while Hollow Ichigo fights Muramasa and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai regains the ability to release his Shikai, Zabimaru.

episodes.title: Release! The New Getsuga Tenshō
episodes.overview: 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira aids 9th Division Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi, who is fighting Kazeshini, while 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Ichigo Kurosaki conclude their battles.

episodes.title: Suì-Fēng, Surrounding the Zanpakutō

episodes.title: Friendship? Hatred? Haineko & Tobiume

episodes.title: The Awakening Hyōrinmaru! Hitsugaya's Fierce Fight

episodes.title: Byakuya's Betrayal
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki attacks Muramasa, but Senbonzakura, and later 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, shows up to protect him.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Pride! Byakuya vs. Renji
episodes.overview: Muramasa has 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki perform a test of loyalty. Afterwards, Byakuya invades the 6th Division barracks and is forced to fight his lieutenant, Renji Abarai.

episodes.title: Shinigami and Zanpakutō, Total Sortie
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki, 2nd Division Captain Suì-Fēng, and 3rd Division Lieutenant Izuru Kira begin their battles, 11th Division 3rd Seat Ikkaku Madarame fights and defeats his Zanpakutō Spirit, Hōzukimaru.

episodes.title: One-to-One Fight! Ichigo vs. Senbonzakura

episodes.title: The Long Awaited... Kenpachi Appears!
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki arrives and defeats Wabisuke before moving on to 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki. Meanwhile, 11th Division 5th Seat Yumichika Ayasegawa defeats his manifested Zanpakutō Spirit, Ruri'iro Kujaku.

episodes.title: Pursue Byakuya! The Confused Gotei Divisions
episodes.overview: As 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki and 6th Division Byakuya Kuchiki fight, 11th Division Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi chases Ashisogi Jizō before 12th Division Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi forces his Zanpakutō Spirit to self-destruct and tells others to not interfere. Muramasa takes Byakuya to see Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, who is inside of a barrier guarded by a dark-haired woman, two white-haired boys, and a cloaked figure.

episodes.title: Special Mission! Rescue Captain Commander Yamamoto!
episodes.overview: A group of Shinigami attempt to rescue Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto, but they are held back by several Zanpakutō Spirits. Meanwhile, Ichigo Kurosaki arrives at the barrier surrounding Yamamoto and prepares to destroy it.

episodes.title: Deceived Shinigami! The World Collapse Crisis

episodes.title: Dragon of Ice and Dragon of Flame! The Strongest Showdown!
episodes.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto and the others are held back by Ryūjin Jakka's flames as Muramasa attempts to free Kōga Kuchiki.

episodes.title: Senbonzakura's Bankai! Offense and Defense of the Living World
episodes.overview: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki faces off against Tenken's Bankai, Kokujō Tengen Myō'ō, as Muramasa frees his master, Kōga.

episodes.title: That Man, for the Sake of the Kuchiki
episodes.overview: Kōga Kuchiki's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Dark History! The Worst Shinigami Is Born
episodes.overview: 6th Division Captain Ginrei Kuchiki and Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto are forced to seal Kōga Kuchiki away. In the present, 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki stops Kōga from killing Muramasa.

episodes.title: Byakuya, the Truth Behind His Betrayal
episodes.overview: As Senbonzakura reveals the truth about 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki's betrayal, Byakuya fights against Kōga Kuchiki. Meanwhile, Muramasa loses controls and unleashes hundreds of Gillians.

episodes.title: Muramasa's True Identity Revealed
episodes.overview: 6th Division Captain Byakuya Kuchiki defeats Kōga Kuchiki as Muramasa loses control and transforms into a Hollow version of himself. As Ichigo Kurosaki battles Muramasa, several Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits arrive to help.

episodes.title: Byakuya and Renji, the 6th Division Returns
episodes.overview: The Shinigami and their Zanpakutō Spirits try to deal with the Gillians.

episodes.title: Final Chapter - Zanpakutō The Alternate Tale
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki defeats Muramasa, and the Zanpakutō Spirits return to their original forms.

episodes.title: The Angered Byakuya! The Collapse of the Kuchiki House
episodes.overview: A party is being held at the Kuchiki Manor when two rogue Zanpakutō Spirits, called Tōjū, attack and disrupt the party.

episodes.title: A New Enemy! The True Nature of the Sword Beasts
episodes.overview: 10th Division Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya battles a Tōjū which has been absorbed by a Hollow.

episodes.title: Stray Snake, Tortured Monkey
episodes.overview: 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and his Zanpakutō Spirit, Zabimaru, must defeat a Tōjū, but Hebi wants freedom.

episodes.title: Terror! The Monster That Lurks Underground
episodes.overview: A group of Shinigami must go into the sewers to fight a Tōjū. They are aided by a Zanpakutō Spirit who has been living in the sewers.

episodes.title: Conclusion!? Hisagi vs. Kazeshini
episodes.overview: Kazeshini has a change of heart when he is forced to look after a baby.

episodes.title: The Person with the Unknown Ability! Orihime Is Targeted
episodes.overview: Orihime Inoue must help a transfer student who is being controlled by a Tōjū.

episodes.title: Haineko Cries! The Tragic Sword Beast!
episodes.overview: Haineko falls for a Tōjū who is fully aware. However, when he loses control, Haineko decides to defeat him herself.

episodes.title: Imprisonment?! Senbonzakura & Zabimaru
episodes.overview: Zabimaru and Senbonzakura are trapped in the Shinigami Research and Development Institute.

episodes.title: Battle of the Females? Katen Kyōkotsu vs. Nanao!
episodes.overview: 8th Division Lieutenant Nanao Ise tries to relate to the violet-haired girl while they battle a Tōjū.

episodes.title: Evolution?! The Menace of the Final Sword Beast
episodes.overview: The Zanpakutō Spirits struggle with the final Tōjū until their wielders arrive to help.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ulquiorra, Resume
episodes.overview: Prior events are recalled.

episodes.title: Connected Hearts! The Left Fist of Certain Death
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki struggles against Ulquiorra Cifer as Renji Abarai and Yasutora Sado fight Battikaroa.

episodes.title: Hatred and Jealousy, Orihime's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Loly Aivirrne and Menoly Mallia take Orihime Inoue up to where Ichigo Kurosaki is fighting. Yammy Llargo shows up and, after disposing of Loly, is ambushed by Uryū Ishida.

episodes.title: Ichigo and Uryū, Bonded Back to Back
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida deals with Yammy Llargo, Ulquiorra Cifer shows Ichigo Kurosaki his Resurrección.

episodes.title: Beginning of Despair... Ichigo, the Unreachable Blade
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki greatly struggles with Ulquiorra Cifer in his released form and to further drive it in, Ulquiorra shows Ichigo his second release.

episodes.title: Ichigo Dies! Orihime, the Cry of Sorrow!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki's Hollow form completely takes him over, he begins battling Ulquiorra Cifer again.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ulquiorra, Conclusion!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Ulquiorra Cifer conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Fury of the Shark! Halibel's Release
episodes.overview: As Rukia Kuchiki, Yasutora Sado, and Lieutenant Renji Abarai battle Yammy Llargo, the captains in the Fake Karakura Town continue battling the Espada.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya, the Desperate Hyōten Hyakkasō!
episodes.overview: The battle between Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya and Tier Harribel continues.

episodes.title: The Approaching Breath of Death, the King Who Rules Over Death!
episodes.overview: Captain Suì-Fēng and Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda struggle against Baraggan Louisenbairn.

episodes.title: One Hit Kill, Suì-Fēng, Bankai!
episodes.overview: As Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda distracts Baraggan Luisenbarn for Captain Suì-Fēng, Captain Shunsui Kyōraku and Coyote Starrk continue their battle.

episodes.title: Climax! Kyōraku vs. Stark!
episodes.overview: Captain Shunsui Kyōraku and Coyote Starrk decide to get serious in their battle.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Returns... Revival of the Espada
episodes.overview: The Espada are shown to still be alive, Sōsuke Aizen, Gin Ichimaru, and Kaname Tōsen are freed, and the Visored arrive on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Hirako and Aizen...the Reunion of Fate!
episodes.overview: The Visored join the fight.

episodes.title: Hisagi and Tōsen, the Moment of Parting
episodes.overview: Hachigen Ushōda helps Captain Suì-Fēng battle Baraggan Luisenbarn.

episodes.title: Crown of Lies, Baraggan's Grudge
episodes.overview: Baraggan Luisenbarn recalls his past as the King of Hueco Mundo before dying.

episodes.title: Power of the Soul! Los Lobos, Attack!
episodes.overview: Love Aikawa and Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi battle against Coyote Starrk.

episodes.title: Stark, the Lone Battle
episodes.overview: Coyote Starrk and Captain Shunsui Kyōraku conclude their battle.

episodes.title: Chain of Sacrifice, Halibel's Past
episodes.overview: As Tier Harribel falls unconscious from her wounds, she recalls her past.

episodes.title: The Hundred-Year Grudge! Hiyori's Revenge
episodes.overview: As the situation begins to get desperate in the Fake Karakura Town, the battle with Yammy Llargo continues in Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: Ichigo's Return! Protect Karakura Town
episodes.overview: The captains in Hueco Mundo decide to send Ichigo Kurosaki back to Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Side Story! Ichigo and the Magic Lamp
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki has a dream and tries to escape from it.

episodes.title: The Final Trump Card! Ichigo, Towards the Decisive Battle
episodes.overview: As the battle with Yammy Llargo continues, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his return to Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Byakuya vs. Kenpachi?! The Melee Commences
episodes.overview: As Captains Byakuya Kuchiki and Kenpachi Zaraki prepare to battle with each other, Yammy Llargo's anger makes him even stronger than before. Meanwhile, Kaname Tōsen reveals he has Hollowfication to Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi and Captain Sajin Komamura.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Justice?! The Man Who Deserted the Shinigami
episodes.overview: Kaname Tōsen reveals his true reasons for betraying Soul Society.

episodes.title: Desperate Struggle with Aizen! Hirako, Shikai!
episodes.overview: As Captain Sajin Komamura continues his battle with Kaname Tōsen, Shinji Hirako releases his Zanpakutō against Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: All Out War! Aizen vs. Shinigami
episodes.overview: The Shinigami and Visored vow to protect Ichigo Kurosaki and defeat Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: Hitsugaya, Enraged! Blade of Hatred!
episodes.overview: The Shinigami and Visored, attacking Sōsuke Aizen, are unable to defeat the treacherous captain.

episodes.title: Impossible to Attack? The Sealed Genryūsai!
episodes.overview: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto joins the battle against Sōsuke Aizen, only for his Zanpakutō's abilities to be sealed by Wonderweiss Margela.

episodes.title: It's All a Trap... Engineered Bonds!
episodes.overview: Sōsuke Aizen reveals to Ichigo Kurosaki that all of his battles have taken place exactly as he desired.

episodes.title: The Shocking Truth...The Mysterious Power Within Ichigo!
episodes.overview: As Sōsuke Aizen reveals more facts to Ichigo Kurosaki, Isshin Kurosaki joins the battle.

episodes.title: The Extending Blade?! Ichigo vs. Gin!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Gin Ichimaru battle, Sōsuke Aizen explains to Isshin Kurosaki about the true power of the Hōgyoku.

episodes.title: Film! Festival! Shinigami Film Festival!
episodes.overview: The Shinigami in the Gotei 13 make a movie for the "Seireitei International Film Festival."

episodes.title: Theatre Opening Commemoration! The Hell Verse: Prologue
episodes.overview: While visiting the World of the Living, Kuchiki Rukia comes across Kurumadani Zennosuke, the current Soul Reaper stationed in Karakura Town, being attacked by a mysterious masked man.

episodes.title: Urahara Appears! Stop Aizen!
episodes.overview: The battle with Sōsuke Aizen continues as Aizen is transformed by the Hōgyoku.

episodes.title: Ichigo Loses His Fighting Spirit!? Gin's Expectation!
episodes.overview: As his transformation progresses, Sōsuke Aizen proves more and more resilient. Ichigo Kurosaki's strength fails to defeat Gin Ichimaru.

episodes.title: The Final Getsuga Tenshō!? Ichigo's Training!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki begins training to learn the Final Getsuga Tenshō. Sōsuke Aizen and Gin Ichimaru arrive in Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Real World and Shinigami! The New Year Special!
episodes.overview: The Soul Reaper Association hosts a New Year’s party in the Soul Society.

episodes.title: Another Side Story! This Time's Enemy Is a Monster!?
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki has another dream and tries to escape from it again.

episodes.title: Delusion Roars! Hisagi, Towards the Hot Springs Inn!
episodes.overview: Lieutenants Shūhei Hisagi and Rangiku Matsumoto go on a mission, and Hisagi deludes himself into thinking that Rangiku likes him.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Protecting! Ichigo vs. Tensa Zangetsu!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki stands his ground against Tensa Zangetsu, who fuses with Ichigo's inner Hollow.

episodes.title: Emergency Situation! Aizen, New Evolution!
episodes.overview: As the Humans run away, Gin Ichimaru betrays Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: Goodbye...Rangiku
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki emerges from his training and forces Sōsuke Aizen into battle away from Karakura Town.

episodes.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Release, the Final Getsuga Tenshō!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki uses the Final Getsuga Tenshō against Sōsuke Aizen.

episodes.title: Ichigo's Resolution! The Price of the Fierce Battle
episodes.overview: The aftermath of the battle with Sōsuke Aizen is shown.

episodes.title: The Soul Detective: Karakuraizer Takes Off Again!
episodes.overview: The continued adventures of Karakura-Raizer.

episodes.title: Inauguration! The Brand New 2nd Division Captain!
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda pretends to be the captain of the Second Division.

episodes.title: The Man Who Risks His Life in the 11th Division!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki meets a member of the 11th Division named Seizo Harugasaki.

episodes.title: Kon Saw It! The Secret of a Beautiful Office Lady
episodes.overview: Kon chases after a beautiful girl, while the rest of Karakura Town is threatened by a Hollow.

episodes.title: Yachiru's Friend! The Shinigami of Justice Appears!
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi encounters her old Shinigami friend and catches up with him.

episodes.title: Toshirō Hitsugaya's Holiday!
episodes.overview: Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya visits the Human World and visits Haru, an old lady he knew from his first assignment in the Human World.

episodes.title: Unusual Incident in Seireitei?! Gotei 13 Invading Army Arc!
episodes.overview: One month after Sōsuke Aizen's defeat, as things are returning to normal, people begin to disappear in the Dangai.

episodes.title: Renji vs. Rukia?! Battle With Comrades!
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki escapes from his detention, Kagerōza Inaba comes to collect Nozomi Kujō.

episodes.title: Ichigo's Capture Net! Escape From Soul Society!
episodes.overview: As Uryū Ishida battles Kagerōza Inaba, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki attempt to escape from Seireitei.

episodes.title: Gotei 13, Gathering in the Real World!
episodes.overview: While the real Gotei 13 have a meeting about the Reigai, Kon is tasked with looking after Nozomi Kujō.

episodes.title: Showdown of Mutual Self, Ikkaku vs. Ikkaku!
episodes.overview: Captains Jūshirō Ukitake and Shunsui Kyōraku investigate the SRDI's records, while the real Gotei 13 officers encounter their Reigai counterparts.

episodes.title: Clash! Rukia vs. Rukia!
episodes.overview: As the Reigai continue their attack, Nozomi Kujō wanders around Karakura in search of something.

episodes.title: Protect Ichigo! Nozomi's Determination
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki defeats many Reigai while protecting Nozomi Kujō.

episodes.title: Recapture Seireitei! The Captains Move!
episodes.overview: The captains return to Soul Society to confront Kagerōza Inaba.

episodes.title: For the Sake of the Believers! Byakuya vs. Hitsugaya!
episodes.overview: As Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto fights the Reigai, Captain Byakuya Kuchiki encounters a Reigai of Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.

episodes.title: The Two Hinamori, Hitsugaya's Resolution
episodes.overview: As the captains advance through Seireitei, Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya encounters a Reigai of Lieutenant Momo Hinamori.

episodes.title: Pride of the Kuchiki Family! Byakuya vs. Byakuya!
episodes.overview: Captains Sajin Komamura, Byakuya Kuchiki, and Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto continue their battles with the Reigai.

episodes.title: Defeat Kageroza! Shinigami, All-Out War!
episodes.overview: The real members of the Gotei 13 arrive at Kagerōza Inaba's lair to challenge him.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Research...Nozomi's Hidden Secret!
episodes.overview: Kagerōza Inaba struggles to recover from Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi's attack, while his motives and Nozomi Kujō's identity are revealed.

episodes.title: I Want to Live...! Nozomi's Zanpakutō
episodes.overview: As the remaining members of the Gotei 13 try to recover, Nozomi Kujō decides she wants to help the others.

episodes.title: For the Sake of Fighting! The Awakened Nozomi!
episodes.overview: Nozomi Kujō trains with Ichigo Kurosaki and the others while the Reigai assault the Human World once again.

episodes.title: The Most Evil Reigai, Appearing in the Real World!
episodes.overview: Kujou Nozomi tries to join Ichigo and the others to fight the Reigai captains, but the other Soul Reapers tell her not to interfere.

episodes.title: Destroy Nozomi!? Genryusai's Decision!
episodes.overview: Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto steps in to battle against the Reigai. Kurosaki Ichigo and Kujou Nozomi join the fight.

episodes.title: The Depleting Reiatsu! Ichigo, Death Struggle of the Soul!
episodes.overview: Kujou Nozomi’s Zanpakuto breaks in the midst of trying to protect Yamamoto-Genryuusai Shigekuni from Inaba Kagerouza’s attack.

episodes.title: Hiding in the Dangai? Another Ichigo?!
episodes.overview: After being brought back to the Urahara Shop by Kisuke Urahara, Ichigo Kurosaki heads into the Dangai to retrieve his Reishi.

episodes.title: Pursue Kageroza! Technological Development Department, Infiltration!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki, Kon, and Kisuke Urahara infiltrate Soul Society as Inaba begins to fuse with Nozomi Kujō.

episodes.title: The Developer of the Modified Souls
episodes.overview: As Yoruichi Shihōin and the captains battle the Reigai, Ichigo Kurosaki, Kon, and Kisuke Urahara go in search of Kagerōza Inaba's lab.

episodes.title: Kon's Thoughts, Nozomi's Thoughts
episodes.overview: Urahara Kisuke and Kon find Ouko Yushima, the man behind Kageroza’s invasion. Finding traces of Kageroza’s blood nearby, the two follow the trail.

episodes.title: Protect Ichigo! The Bonds of Friends!
episodes.overview: The Gotei 13 battle the Reigai, while the combined form of Inaba and Nozomi Kujō fights off a Hollowfied Ichigo and his friends.

episodes.title: Reigai vs. Original, The Fierce Fighting for Gambled Pride!
episodes.overview: As the merged Inaba Nozomi Kujō is confronted, the captains and lieutenants battle the Reigai.

episodes.title: Invading Army Arc, Final Conclusion!
episodes.overview: As the captains and lieutenants fight against the Reigai, Ichigo Kurosaki uses his restored powers to fight the fused form of Kagerōza Inaba and Nozomi Kujō.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki gradually loses his remaining powers and bids farewell to Rukia Kuchiki.

episodes.title: 3rd Year High School Student! Dressed Up, and a New Chapter Begins!
episodes.overview: Seventeen months later, Ichigo Kurosaki continues living life as a normal teenage high school student in Karakura Town.

episodes.title: A Dispute in School!? Ichigo and Uryū, Fight Together!
episodes.overview: Kurosaki Ichigo’s boss Unagiya Ikumi shows up and drags him back to the office, where he meets a man called Kugo Ginjo.

episodes.title: Uryū is Attacked, A Threat Draws Near the Friends!
episodes.overview: After Ichigo Kurosaki and Orihime Inoue visit Uryū Ishida in the hospital, Keigo Asano is attacked.

episodes.title: The Man with the Fullbring Ability: Kūgo Ginjō
episodes.overview: Ginjou Kuugo tells Kurosaki Ichigo of his goal to restore his lost Soul Reaper powers, as well as demonstrating his own unique power.

episodes.title: A Crisis Sneaking up on the Kurosaki Family!? Ichigo's Confusion!
episodes.overview: Kurosaki Ichigo has a day to decide whether to regain his lost Soul Reaper powers or not.

episodes.title: Power of the Substitute Badge, Ichigo's 'Pride'!
episodes.overview: Kurosaki Ichigo begins training, his first session is to fight and win against Mr. Pork

episodes.title: Next Target, The Devil's Hand Aims at Orihime!
episodes.overview: Inoue Orihime is suddenly stopped and asked to die by a man named Shishigawara Moe.

episodes.title: The Man Who Killed the Shinigami Substitute!? Tsukishima Makes His Move
episodes.overview: Tsuskishima pretends to impale Orihime's chest and leaves her. Although Orihime suffered no cuts, she starts having a vague idea that Tsukishima was her friend. Unwilling to worry Ichigo about what happened, she only tells Chad about Tsukishima. Aware that Orihime is hiding information from, Ichigo goes back to to Xcution headquarters to continue his training to help his friends.

episodes.title: Fullbring, The Detested Power!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his training with Xcution, as they struggle to convince Jackie Tristan to help.

episodes.title: Tsukishima Attacks! The Training Has Been Thwarted
episodes.overview: As Jackie Tristan and Ichigo Kurosaki train in the fish tank, Shūkurō Tsukishima arrives in Xcution's hideout.

episodes.title: Ichigo, Mastering the Fullbring!
episodes.overview: As Shūkurō Tsukishima arrives at Xcution, a battle ensues.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjō! To the Game's Space
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki fights Kūgo Ginjō in the Game Space.

episodes.title: Shinigami at War! New Year in Seireitei Special!
episodes.overview: New year celebrations in Soul Society include a kite-flying contest and Rukia performing a celebration dance.

episodes.title: Friend or Foe!? Ginjō's True Intentions!
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his training with Kūgo Ginjō, resulting in him completing his Fullbring.

episodes.title: Tsukishima's Ability, the Danger is Drawing Near!
episodes.overview: Ichigo trains with his Fullbring. Chad and Orihime investigate Tsukishima and engage in battle.

episodes.title: Clash!? Xcution attacks Ginjō
episodes.overview: Uryū leaves the hospital to investigate a Reiatsu that is appearing everywhere. Ichigo's friends and family, as well as the members of Xcution except for Ginjō, have been cut by Tsukishima.

episodes.title: The Sorrowful Battle! Ichigo vs. Sado & Orihime
episodes.overview: Ichigo and Kūgo catch their breath at a secret hideout and formulate a plan. They go to Tsukishima's mansion and engage in battle.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs Uryū!? Who is the Traitor!?
episodes.overview: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with Shūkurō Tsukishima, Uryū Ishida arrives, and Kūgo Ginjō is cut by Tsukishima.

episodes.title: A New Appearance! The Gotei 13, Arrives!
episodes.overview: Stripped of his Fullbring, the powerless Ichigo Kurosaki is stabbed by Rukia Kuchiki and has his Shinigami powers returned to him.

episodes.title: Revival! Substitute Shinigami: Ichigo Kurosaki!
episodes.overview: The 13 Court Guard Squad Soul Reapers share their Spirit Energy to restore Ichigo Kurosaki’s lost powers.

episodes.title: Fierce Fight! Shinigami vs. XCUTION!
episodes.overview: The Soul Reapers take on the Xcution members in one-on-one battles.

episodes.title: Desperate Struggle!? Byakuya's Troubled Memories
episodes.overview: The battle between Kuchiki Byakuya and Tsukishima Shuukurou escalates as they both push their powers to the limit.

episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjō! Secret of the Substitute Badge
episodes.overview: As the battle between Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, and Kūgo Ginjō intensifies, the truth behind the Substitute Shinigami Badge surfaces.

episodes.title: Changing History, Unchanging Heart
episodes.overview: Ichigo Kurosaki and Ginjo Kugo both release their Bankai to settle the score.

seasons.name: Thousand-Year Blood War
seasons.overview: The final arc of the Bleach series, where Ichigo Kurosaki and the Soul Reapers face off against the powerful Quincy army, led by Yhwach, in a battle that threatens the balance of all worlds.

episodes.title: The Blood Warfare
episodes.overview: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

episodes.title: Foundation Stones
episodes.overview: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: March of the Starcross
episodes.overview: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

episodes.title: Kill the Shadow
episodes.overview: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

episodes.title: Wrath as a Lightning
episodes.overview: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

episodes.title: The Fire
episodes.overview: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

episodes.title: Born in the Dark
episodes.overview: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

episodes.title: The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
episodes.overview: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

episodes.title: The Drop
episodes.overview: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

episodes.title: The Battle
episodes.overview: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

episodes.title: Everything but the Rain
episodes.overview: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

episodes.title: Everything but the Rain: June Truth
episodes.overview: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

episodes.title: The Blade Is Me
episodes.overview: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

episodes.title: The Last 9 Days
episodes.overview: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims that Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

episodes.title: PEACE FROM SHADOWS
episodes.overview: Yhwach sets his plan to end the world in nine days in motion.

episodes.title: THE FUNDAMENTAL VIRULENCE
episodes.overview: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo.

episodes.title: HEART OF WOLF
episodes.overview: The Stern Ritters drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

episodes.title: RAGES AT RINGSIDE
episodes.overview: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine.

episodes.title: THE WHITE HAZE
episodes.overview: A fearless Rukia takes on Äs Nödt.

episodes.title: I AM THE EDGE
episodes.overview: Isane and Yachiru are attacked by Gwenael.

episodes.title: THE HEADLESS STAR
episodes.overview: Candice, Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto try to take down Kenpachi.

episodes.title: MARCHING OUT THE ZOMBIES
episodes.overview: Ichigo tries to stop Yhwach upon learning that his real target lies within the Royal Palace.

episodes.title: MARCHING OUT THE ZOMBIES 2
episodes.overview: Ikkaku, Yumichika, and the Arrancars work together to fight off Giselle’s zombies.

episodes.title: TOO EARLY TO WIN TOO LATE TO KNOW
episodes.overview: Yhwach finally enters the Royal Palace.

episodes.title: THE MASTER
episodes.overview: Yhwach confronts Hyosube, who is protecting the real Royal Palace.

episodes.title: BLACK
episodes.overview: Yhwach performs Auswählen to bestow power to his fallen Royal Guards.

episodes.title: A
episodes.overview: The battle between Squad Zero and Yhwach's Royal Guards for the Soul King rages on.

episodes.title: KILL THE KING
episodes.overview: Ichigo and his friends hurry to the Reio Greater Palace to stop Yhwach.

episodes.title: THE DARK ARM
episodes.overview: Ichigo tries to remove the impaled sword from the Soul King and save his life.

episodes.title: THE BETRAYER
episodes.overview: Ukitake takes the place of the slain Soul King by releasing the power of Mimihagi.

episodes.title: AGAINST THE JUDGEMENT
episodes.overview: Yhwach is overflowing with power from having absorbed the Soul King.

episodes.title: THE HOLY NEWBORN
episodes.overview: The Soul Reapers regroup to prepare their counterattack against the Quincies.

episodes.title: GATE OF THE SUN
episodes.overview: Yhwach builds his new castle, Wahr Welt.

episodes.title: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND
episodes.overview: Kenpachi and Mayuri's group advance through Vier Ast.

episodes.title: DON'T CHASE A SHADOW
episodes.overview: The change in Mayuri's Spiritual Pressure is also felt elsewhere by Urahara and Kyoraku.

episodes.title: BABY, HOLD YOUR HAND 2 [NEVER ENDING MY DREAM]
episodes.overview: Nemu ignores Mayuri's orders by intervening in his battle against Pernida.

episodes.title: SHADOWS GONE
episodes.overview: Lille undergoes further transformation to hunt down and pass judgment on Kyoraku.

episodes.title: FRIEND
episodes.overview: As the battle between the soul reapers and the quincies rages, Haschwalt finds himself confronted by Bazz-B inside Wahrwelt

episodes.title: THE VISIBLE ANSWER

episodes.title: Why Would I Want to Hurt You?

episodes.title: Phantom Sensations

episodes.title: Los tiempos de Dios son Perfectos

episodes.title: The Executioners

series.title: Chicago Fire
series.overview: An edge-of-your-seat view into the lives of everyday heroes committed to one of America's noblest professions. For the firefighters, rescue squad and paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51, no occupation is more stressful or dangerous, yet so rewarding and exhilarating. These courageous men and women are among the elite who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Meet the firefighters and paramedics of Firehouse 51 as they face the intense demands of the job while dealing with personal losses, rivalries, and the weight of life-or-death decisions. Brotherhood and loyalty are forged in fire.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: When a fire claims one of their own, there's plenty of guilt and blame to go around. Lt. Matthew Casey, in charge of the Truck, tries to carry on, but butts heads with the brash Lt. Kelly Severide of the Rescue Squad - and each blames the other for their fallen team member. The firehouse also includes: Battalion Chief Wallace Boden, a fireman's fireman who is confronted by important personal decisions; paramedics Gabriela Dawson and Leslie Shay, who share a close bond and team together to face some of the most harrowing situations imaginable; Peter Mills, an academy graduate who is the latest generation in a family of firefighters; and Christopher Herrmann, a seasoned veteran who loses his home to foreclosure and now must uproot his family to move in with his in-laws.

episodes.title: Mon Amour
episodes.overview: Severide is hiding a serious shoulder injury sustained in the fire that killed Andy Darden, and grapples with his guilt as he fights to rescue a construction worker trapped in a building collapse. Adding to the burden, Darden's wife Heather turns on Severide at the annual firefighters' barbecue, blaming him for her husband's death. A call is made to an accident site at Hancock Tower, where two teenagers are pinned in a vehicle trapped beneath the falling debris of a broken window washer's cart. Meanwhile, Casey and Hallie work to figure out their future together.

episodes.title: Professional Courtesy
episodes.overview: Casey faces pressure to cover for a cop's son, who was responsible for a drunken-driving accident that left a teenager paralyzed. Meanwhile, Severide ignores his doctor's warnings that his neck injury may never heal if he doesn't seek treatment; and Mills must choose between working at the fire department full-time or helping his mom with her restaurant.

episodes.title: One Minute
episodes.overview: Chief Boden is accused of leaving a homeless man to die in a warehouse fire after ordering his men to evacuate the scene, creating negative press and bad feeling within the department. Meanwhile, Lieutenant Severide helps an elderly woman facing some neighborhood problems. Detective Voight ramps up his intimidation tactics aimed at Casey in an attempt to discourage him from testifying against his son. Shay is forced to revisit her heartbreak over her ex-girlfriend Clarice, when she finds herself face-to-face with the ex and her husband during a call. Hermann’s temper flares during a rescue call at a Halloween block party.

episodes.title: Hanging On
episodes.overview: Casey confronts Detective Voight about his harassing tactics, vowing never to back down, and ends up paying the price for his decision. Dawson faces disciplinary action for her on-the-job conduct. Meanwhile, Severide finds his arm failing him during a rescue at a construction accident, and reaches out to Anna, an old flame and pharmaceutical rep, hoping she might be able to help alleviate his injury problems.

episodes.title: Rear View Mirror
episodes.overview: Facing suspension, Dawson gets a hand from the same girl she saved through the procedures that landed her in front of the disciplinary board. Lieutenant Casey finds his fuse shortening as Detective Voight stops at nothing to get him to retract his statement. However, when Casey lays his life on the line during an apartment fire, he may have unknowingly caught the break he was needing.

episodes.title: Two Families
episodes.overview: Everyone in the firehouse is ordered to take a drug test after a call to a daycare center exposes them to a makeshift meth lab, and Severide stalls, not wanting his injury, or the painkillers he takes, to be discovered. Meanwhile, Truck and Squad find themselves pinned down by gunfire while trying to help the victim of a gang shooting, and a deep-fried turkey fire grows from small to explosive when a garage catches fire. Elsewhere, Dawson saves a bleeding man and Casey delivers a baby on the scene of a massive car pileup on the freeway.

episodes.title: Leaving the Station
episodes.overview: At the site of a train accident, Peter Mills becomes deeply upset when he observes the dead body of a young victim. Unable to shake his emotional distress about the event, he questions his future as a firefighter. Dawson and Shay save a 6-year-old girl whose mother is abusing her – but their confrontation leads the woman to resort to dire actions. Meanwhile, Severide aggravates his injury while rescuing a heart attack victim and Shay sends Clarice, her married, pregnant ex-girlfriend, back home to her husband.

episodes.title: It Ain't Easy
episodes.overview: After he's injured in a terrible fire at an auto machine shop, Jose Vargas is forced to go on disability and leave his life as a firefighter behind - a task he finds incredibly difficult. Chief Boden tries to help a suspected teenage firebug. Also, Severide receives an enticing invitation from Renee, a woman who he saved from a car crash incident involving live electrical wires. Meanwhile, Cruz tries to save his younger brother Leon from the gang he is involved with.

episodes.title: Merry Christmas, Etc.
episodes.overview: After putting out a kitchen fire in an upscale townhouse, Casey, Herrmann, Mouch, Cruz, Otis and Mills find themselves accused of stealing a $50,000 diamond necklace from the home, touching off an internal investigation. Cruz’s brother Leon is caught in the middle of an escalating gang war, leaving Cruz to make a desperate choice to save him. Meanwhile, Dawson invites Casey to her cousin’s fancy Christmas party, and a frustrated Shay has reached her limit with Severide.

episodes.title: God Has Spoken
episodes.overview: Eaten up by his guilt over Flaco’s death in the fire, Cruz goes to Casey to confess. While Shay recovers from a head injury sustained in the ambulance crash, Severide asks Dawson for her help in dealing with his own injury. Casey is caught in the middle of a family conflict between his mother and sister. Elsewhere, Herrmann finds a business deal hard to stomach.

episodes.title: Under the Knife
episodes.overview: Severide finally addresses Chief Boden about his injury and makes some important personal decisions about his future. Meanwhile, Casey struggles with family matters and Dawson takes matters into her own hands when she discovers a young girl who is the sole survivor at the scene of a rescue call.

episodes.title: Warm and Dead
episodes.overview: A troubled Chief Boden goes to the police when a man dies in a hardware store fire set by Ernie, the troubled teenage firebug he’s been trying to help, and his Uncle Ray. Meanwhile, Severide decides on his future and reaches out to his father. Elsewhere, Otis finds camaraderie when he fills in for a few shifts at the slowest firehouse in the city, and makes a decision of his own, while Dawson and Shay find themselves in a bad predicament during a call to a tenement.

episodes.title: A Little Taste
episodes.overview: Severide finds that he shares a familiar past with Eric Whaley, the Lieutenant who was brought into the firehouse to help out. Dawson lets Shay in on her secret, while Casey deals with family issues. Meanwhile, a bad batch of heroin on the streets has Boden and the team scrambling, while Clarice and Shay find they have a new problem to overcome.

episodes.title: Nazdarovya!
episodes.overview: Dawson attempts to help her brother Antonio unravel the details of his drugs-and-gang investigation, and goes behind his back in turning to an unlikely source for assistance. Casey and his mother, Nancy struggle with their new relationship. Meanwhile, as a favor to Lieutenant Whaley, Severide visits someone important from his past, while Herrmann and Otis learn some hard truths about their "silent partner" in the bar.

episodes.title: Viral
episodes.overview: The anguish that haunts Cruz over his previous actions boils over, as he puts himself and his fellow firefighters in jeopardy. Casey and his sister Christie try to solve their issues with their mother and each other. Meanwhile, Severide reaches out again to an important person from his past as a favor to Lieutenant Whaley and the squad gains new perspective after assisting the bomb squad on an extremely dangerous call.

episodes.title: Better to Lie
episodes.overview: Old emotional wounds are opened when Lieutenant Severide’s father Bennie comes to town and clashes with Chief Boden over the death of their former colleague. Mills helps a distraught driver who caused an accident and Shay makes a decision about her future with Clarice. Meanwhile, Herrmann, Otis and Dawson get to the bottom of a mystery about their bar.

episodes.title: Fireworks
episodes.overview: With tensions still running high between Chief Boden and Bennie Severide, things boil over when Mills confronts Bennie about the fire that killed his father. Meanwhile, Severide, Casey and Bennie uncover the truth behind two mysterious diner fires and Shay takes a new direction with her plan to have a baby.

episodes.title: A Coffin That Small
episodes.overview: Tragedy strikes when a rescue attempt at a tenement building proves unsuccessful, leaving the men and women of firehouse 51 affected by the loss of the victim. Severide's decision to put Mills on the fast track to move from Truck to Squad doesn't sit well with some of the others and tension mounts between Severide and Casey over Heather Darden. Shay and Dawson are forced to deal with a junkie's crazy behavior while on a call and Shay considers a different way to have a family. Meanwhile, the team draws the ire of local drug dealers who threaten the peace and safety of the neighborhood and firehouse.

episodes.title: Ambition
episodes.overview: Mills finds himself the target of resentment from some colleagues when Severide supports his desire to join Squad. Tara, a paramedic candidate, joins Dawson and Shay on the job for a few shifts. Meanwhile, Shay comes to the aid of Cindy Herrmann, who suffers from pregnancy complications while her husband Christopher is out of town. Elsewhere, Dawson and Casey draw closer as the grand opening of Molly’s draws near, and Casey receives a surprise visit.

episodes.title: Retaliation Hit
episodes.overview: Accused of sexual misconduct by a former paramedic candidate, Severide faces potentially dire consequences and fights for his survival both within the Chicago Fire Department and the legal system. Detective Voight returns, looking to collect on the favor that Dawson owes him for helping her brother, Antonio. Casey falls back into old patterns in his personal life, while Dawson, Herrmann and Otis become the proud owners of a real neighborhood bar as Molly's prepares for its grand opening.

episodes.title: Leaders Lead
episodes.overview: A frustrated Severide, turns to an unlikely ally to resolve his current dilemma. Casey begins to find satisfaction in his personal life, while Mills and Dawson face personal challenges. Meanwhile, the squad is called to the scene of a harrowing apartment building collapse.

episodes.title: Let Her Go
episodes.overview: Events force Lieutenant Casey to team up with the Intelligence Unit, now run by Voight, who doesn’t appear to have changed his crooked ways after his stint in prison. Shay's excitement at the prospect of becoming a parent grows, while Mills and Dawson face some personal challenges. Meanwhile, the house comes together to support the opening of Molly's.

episodes.title: A Hell of a Ride
episodes.overview: When a call comes in from the Cook County jail, the squad steps into a volatile predicament and are tasked with trying to defuse an escalating situation. Shay remains hopeful about her baby dreams and Hermann's wife Cindy goes into labor with their fifth child. Meanwhile, Mills and Dawson face key decisions in their personal lives.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As the team recovers from past trauma, new threats and leadership changes test their unity. Relationships grow more complicated, and loyalties are pushed to the brink both inside and outside the firehouse.

episodes.title: A Problem House
episodes.overview: An arsonist targets Lt. Severide. Meanwhile, Station 51 is under scrutiny by Gail McLeod, a financial consultant for the city who is deciding if any firehouses should be closed. Mouch receives a visit from his Japanese girlfriend, Lt. Casey "celebrates the one-year anniversary of Andy's death, and Shay suspects Severide's paternity.

episodes.title: Prove It
episodes.overview: In the wake of Heather's incident, Lt. Casey is having a hard time handling his newfound responsibilities. Lt. Severide is on edge dreading the next attack from the firehouse's arsonist. Meanwhile, with Renee back from her mother's, Severide knows he has to confront her about his paternity suspicions. Elsewhere, Mouch begins his campaign for union president and Shay and Dawson feel that they need to get out more.

episodes.title: Defcon 1
episodes.overview: Lt. Severide has his strong ideas on who the serial arsonist is, but first needs to find proof to back up his suspicions. Meanwhile, Lt. Casey adjusts to his new lifestyle in the wake of recent events and Molly's bar is failing, much to the dismay of owners Hermann, Dawson and Otis. Elsewhere, Dawson goes out on a date with Jay Halstead, one of the bar regulars, and Mouch's campaign trail starts to get on track with the aid of Isabella, an old friend of Dawson's.

episodes.title: A Nuisance Call
episodes.overview: Lieutenant Severide is anxious to implicate the serial arsonist, while Dawson and Shay get a shock on a routine call. Meanwhile, suspicions continue to point to Clarke as the mole inside the firehouse and Molly's falls deeper into the red.
