episodes.overview: The BAU zeroes in on a sadistic UnSub in D.C. with a twisted M.O. Prentiss and Rossi dive into the BAU's history to find connections to Gold Star. Prentiss reaches out to someone from Rossi's past. Voit utilizes his lawyer to reach out to Damien.

episodes.title: North Star
episodes.overview: The BAU tries to get ahead of Jade and Damien who are on a killing spree. Rossi must confront an old flame to unpack the secrets behind the Gold Star program. Tyler and Rebecca attempt to gain leverage over Elias Voit's lawyer.

episodes.title: Stars & Stripes
episodes.overview: With Jade on the run, the BAU continues to assemble the pieces connecting Gold Star victims to Aida Limited. Jade and Dana follow Voit’s breadcrumbs to the heart of the “conspiracy.” A search warrant execution by the BAU has deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Save the Children
episodes.overview: When the identity of the last Gold Star member is revealed, the pieces of the puzzle click together. Prentiss, now in mortal danger, must confront Jade and her accomplice to expose the truth behind the “conspiracy” before time runs out for the BAU.

seasons.name: Season 18
seasons.overview: The new season picks up six months after fellow inmates attacked the notorious Sicarius Killer, Elias Voit, leading his restless followers on the dark web to begin wreaking havoc all over the country. In order to stop this nefarious group from killing more innocents, the BAU is forced to work alongside an increasingly unpredictable Voit, who of course has his own agenda.

episodes.title: Swimmer's Calculus
episodes.overview: When bodies wash up on the Maryland shoreline, the BAU races to find the UnSub. After surviving a prison attack, Elias Voit has been placed in a medically induced coma while Rossi is investigated for the incident.

episodes.title: The Zookeeper
episodes.overview: Voit awakens from his coma. The team finds videos from a dormant Sicarius Network killer called "The Zookeeper" indicating that the network has reactivated. With Voit still in recovery, the BAU must tackle this reawakened network on their own.

episodes.title: Time to Say Goodbye
episodes.overview: Rossi and Lewis enlist the help of Ramona, Voit's sole survivor, to help unlock Voit's memory. JJ and the team say goodbye to Will.

episodes.title: I'm Fine, It's Fine. Everything Is Fine
episodes.overview: While the team works an organ harvesting case, Voit's recovery process leads him to suspect he is more likely a prisoner than victim. JJ finds a cryptic video posted to the BAU-Gate website of a masked UnSub that could be connected to Voit's network.

episodes.title: The Brutal Man
episodes.overview: JJ works with Dr. Ochoa to help Voit process the truth about his violent past, and tells him that one of his followers has a message from a mysterious unsub who appears to be organizing the remaining members of Voit's serial killer network.

episodes.title: Hell Is Empty…
episodes.overview: The team investigates a network killer who buries his victims alive, and Tara confronts Rebecca's ex who has recently re-entered her life. Ronald Graber delivers a message from his Disciple to Voit.

episodes.title: …All the Devils are Here
episodes.overview: Network UnSubs torture and kill hostages as Voit works with the BAU to stop them. Rebecca's ex, Evan Delray, is appointed Voit's new liaison.

episodes.title: Tara
episodes.overview: When the team works to hunt down the person who shot Tara, they discover "The Disciple" deliberately had them chasing their tails. While undergoing critical surgery, Tara gets to the root of her relationship issues.

episodes.title: CollateRal
episodes.overview: The team inches closer to uncovering the identity of "The Disciple", someone they believe is linked to Voit's past, but Voit's unpredictable behavior puts their progress in jeopardy.

episodes.title: The Disciple
episodes.overview: After Voit and Ochoa are kidnapped by "The Disciple", the team races to find them. While in The Disciple's custody, Voit wrestles with keeping the monster inside him at bay.

seasons.name: Season 19
seasons.overview: As the BAU investigates a string of chilling new cases, Elias Voit embarks on a path to atone for his past. His newfound infamy inadvertently awakens their most formidable nemesis yet, The Fan. Precise, calculating, and relentlessly dangerous, this UnSub pushes the BAU to the brink and back under the shadow of Elias Voit. But how far will The Fan go to prove his superiority over his idol?

episodes.title: Now and Then
episodes.overview: The BAU hunts kidnappers targeting couples as Elias Voit faces a familiar darkness in prison

episodes.title: Cluster
episodes.overview: The BAU investigates a veteran's death as Prentiss and Voit move to shut down a podcast from conspiracy theorist Brian Garrity.

episodes.title: Body Count
episodes.overview: When new bodies are linked to Sicarius, the BAU takes Voit into the field to verify the killings.

episodes.title: The Witching Hour
episodes.overview: An UnSub terrorizes spouses before killing one and sparing the other. Meanwhile, Voit receives disturbing mail from The Fan, a mysterious admirer.

episodes.title: Friendly Fire
episodes.overview: Alvez and Tyler team up to investigate the murder of an FBI training instructor, while the rest of the BAU explore ways to lure out The Fan.

episodes.title: Proxy
episodes.overview: The team investigates The Fan, while Brian Garrity questions the damage caused by his podcast.

episodes.title: The Furies
episodes.overview: While the BAU investigates a cop killer, Voit receives an enigmatic new visitor.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.overview: Voit asks the BAU for help after he is threatened by The Fan, and the team must race to stop an UnSub before he can finish his chilling work with his latest victim.

episodes.title: Special Agent Garrity
episodes.overview: After The Fan sets his sights on Brian Garrity and Voit devises a strategy to deal with his nemesis, the BAU must use their profiling prowess to identify The Fan and save their ally.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: The Fan's twisted past and the ultimate showdown will be revealed in the climactic finale to Season Nineteen.

series.title: Dark Matter
series.overview: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In season one, physicist, professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life . Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the mind-bending landscape of lives he could have lived.

episodes.title: Are You Happy in Your Life?
episodes.overview: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

episodes.title: Trip of a Lifetime
episodes.overview: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense—he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.overview: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

episodes.title: The Corridor
episodes.overview: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

episodes.title: Worldless
episodes.overview: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

episodes.title: Superposition
episodes.overview: Daniela suspects something's not right with her husband. Jason and Amanda grow closer.

episodes.title: In the Fires of Dead Stars
episodes.overview: Jason and Amanda visit a breathtaking world. To hide the truth from Daniela, Jason2 takes desperate action.

episodes.title: Jupiter
episodes.overview: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

episodes.title: Entanglement
episodes.overview: The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, the Dessens settle into a quiet life in a world that finally seems safe, until the unimaginable forces them to run once again. As Jason's obsession with the Box deepens, Daniela's growing paranoia pushes her to the brink, threatening to tear their fragile stability apart. Elsewhere, Amanda and Ryan join forces in a desperate attempt to find their way home. With Blair determined to stop him, Leighton relentlessly chases his grand vision of creating a perfect world.

episodes.title: A Quiet Life
episodes.overview: The Dessens receive an unwelcome visitor. Ryan finds Amanda. Leighton finds himself.

episodes.title: A Perfect World
episodes.overview: The search for a new home starts again. Amanda and Ryan set off on a quest.

episodes.title: Everything Beautiful, Everything Terrible
episodes.overview: Jason’s fixation on the Box tests his marriage. Ryan and Amanda step into a world forever changed.

episodes.title: Stars, Hide Your Fires
episodes.overview: The Dessens reach their breaking point.

episodes.title: Love and Be Loved
episodes.overview: The story of a Jason who lost his family.

episodes.title: What the Universe Is Made Of
episodes.overview: Daniela meets someone from her past. Jason pursues his dream. Leighton unveils a new project.

episodes.title: The Pyramid
episodes.overview: Charlie meets a kind stranger. Blair gives Leighton a warning. Amanda and Ryan face an unknown horror.

episodes.title: The Basic Oneness of Everything
episodes.overview: As unexpected reunions unfold, Agent MacNamara sees for himself what the Box can do.

episodes.title: How to Build the Box
episodes.overview: Laurel discovers a new purpose after a shocking arrival shakes up her world.

episodes.title: No Quiet Life
episodes.overview: A high-stakes gambit leads to unintended consequences.

series.title: Death in Paradise
series.overview: A brilliant but idiosyncratic British detective and his resourceful local team solve baffling murder mysteries on the fictional Caribbean island of Saint Marie.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: DI Richard Poole hates the sun, sea, and sand, so he is less than pleased when he is sent to a tiny island on Caribbean to solve a mysterious murder. And awaiting him is a ramshackle station and a very different type of policing.

episodes.title: Arriving in Paradise
episodes.overview: When a British policeman is found murdered in a locked room on the tiny paradise island of Sainte-Marie, Detective Inspector Richard Poole is sent to investigate. He's the perfect man to solve the case. Unfortunately for Richard, he hates sun, sea and sand...

episodes.title: Wicked Wedding Night
episodes.overview: Detective drama series. As DI Richard Poole desperately searches for a decent cup of tea, a bride is murdered on her wedding day. Could the killer be one of her family?

episodes.title: Predicting Murder
episodes.overview: When a woman not only predicts her own murder but also gives a description of the murderer, it all feels too easy for DI Richard Poole. Can a case from the past help solve the present day murder? And more importantly, can Richard convince the team that it has nothing to do with voodoo spirits?

episodes.title: Missing a Body?
episodes.overview: A confession of murder proves problematic for DI Richard Poole and the team when a wife admits to killing her husband but the body is nowhere to be found. Can Richard solve the mystery? And could his feelings be clouding his judgment?

episodes.title: Spot the Difference
episodes.overview: A murder investigation becomes more than personal for Richard when the victim is murdered while handcuffed to him. With his job on the line, he needs all his British rigour and stoutest brogues to get to the heart of the Paradise Beach mystery.

episodes.title: An Unhelpful Aid
episodes.overview: Detective drama series. With Richard hit by a tropical disease and Camille in Paris, it is left to Dwayne and Fidel to solve the apparently impossible murder of a local diver.

episodes.title: Music of Murder
episodes.overview: Richard sees the dark side of show business when a comeback concert ends in the most public of murders. If sun, sea and sand were not bad enough, he now has to conquer his fear of snakes to find the elusive killer.

episodes.title: Amongst Us
episodes.overview: Dwayne ends up embroiled in a murder investigation when a piece of incriminating evidence is found at the scene of the crime. Can Richard solve the case and meet a deadline that means he will finally get what he wants - a return home?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Still trapped on the stunning Saint-Marie, DI Richard Poole and the unorthodox team are tasked to tackle a baffling array of unique murders on this otherwise Caribbean paradise.

episodes.title: Murder on the Plantation
episodes.overview: DI Richard Poole struggles to muster that loving feeling for the local voodoo festival celebrating romance and friendship. However, an understanding of the nature of love, friendship and the ties that bind, proves vital in solving a mysterious murder at a local sugar plantation.

episodes.title: An Unholy Death
episodes.overview: DI Richard Poole is perplexed by a fatal fire at the island convent. Will he and his team manage to unravel the many mysteries at the heart of this seemingly impossible murder? And will DS Bordey get to the root of the inspector's nun phobia?

episodes.title: Death in the Clinic
episodes.overview: DI Richard Poole and his colleagues are baffled by an apparent suicide at an exclusive plastic surgery clinic.

episodes.title: A Deadly Curse
episodes.overview: Camille attempts to persuade Richard to take an interest in the history and folklore of Saint Marie.

episodes.title: Murder Onboard
episodes.overview: The pressure is on for DI Richard Poole and his team to solve an audacious murder carried out in the presence of DS Bordey on a Caribbean party boat.

episodes.title: A Dash of Sunshine
episodes.overview: There is an unwelcome blast from the past for DI Richard Poole when a former colleague turns up in Saint Marie.

episodes.title: A Deadly Storm
episodes.overview: As the island prepares for a hurricane the corpse of Leo Downs, a researcher at the university's meteorological unit is found.

episodes.title: A Deadly Party
episodes.overview: When a philanthropist is murdered in broad daylight at a charity fundraiser, DI Poole and his colleagues find themselves up against a daring and elusive opponent.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A shocking murder may have the new detective Goodman stumped, but would his razor-sharp insight into crime solving win the team round and prove he's the man for the job?

episodes.title: Death of a Detective
episodes.overview: DI Poole attends a university reunion, but one of the group is murdered with an ice pick.

episodes.title: The Wrong Man
episodes.overview: DI Humphrey Goodman and his team are called to investigate a murder on a film set.

episodes.title: An Artistic Murder
episodes.overview: The murder of a gigolo brings the team into contact with the social elite of Saint Marie.

episodes.title: Ye of Little Faith
episodes.overview: The team are faced with the seemingly impossible murder of an air stewardess.

episodes.title: Political Suicide
episodes.overview: Saint Marie's commerce minister is discovered dead.

episodes.title: The Early Bird
episodes.overview: A birdwatcher is discovered murdered in the Saint Marie jungle.

episodes.title: The Man with the Golden Gun
episodes.overview: DI Goodman and the team spend the night locked in a house with a murderer.

episodes.title: Rue Morgue
episodes.overview: The team investigates the apparent suicide of an elderly resident at a retirement home.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The endearingly clumsy but brilliant DI Humphrey is here to stay as these testing murder cases are more mystifying than ever. But could he contain his feelings for DS Camille Bordey?

episodes.title: Stab in the Dark
episodes.overview: When the owner of a distillery is murdered during a seance, the prime suspect is a ghost.

episodes.title: Hidden Secrets
episodes.overview: DI Goodman thinks there is more to the murder of a surf instructor than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Damned If You Do...
episodes.overview: The President of The Saint Marie Heritage Society dies while re-enacting the French invasion of the island.

episodes.title: Until Death Do You Part
episodes.overview: DI Goodman investigates when a bride-to-be is killed on the last night of her hen party.

episodes.title: Swimming in Murder
episodes.overview: DI Goodman investigates when the lead singer of a band is murdered on Saint Marie.

episodes.title: The Perfect Murder
episodes.overview: DI Goodman and the team are under pressure to solve the murder of a volleyball player.

episodes.title: She Was Murdered Twice
episodes.overview: DI Goodman enters the world of corporate team building when an entrepreneur is killed.

episodes.title: Unlike Father, Unlike Son
episodes.overview: DI Goodman and the team are under pressure when a prisoner is killed in their custody.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: DI Goodman's love life might be lacking, but his considerable intellect and experience are tested to the full, as he faces some of Saint Marie's most perplexing murders yet.

episodes.title: The Complex Murder
episodes.overview: Detective Inspector Humphrey Goodman and his team are left stumped when millionaire environmentalist and scientist Dan Hagen is shot on his boat while out at sea. The evidence seems to point to a robbery gone wrong, but with no other boats reported in the area, Goodman suspects a member of Dan’s team, his wife of nine months, his ex-girlfriend, his scientist partner and a research graduate who were diving together in plain sight of one another at the time of the murder. A metal toy soldier with no fingerprints found at the scene is the only clue.

episodes.title: One for the Road
episodes.overview: The outgoing governor of Saint Marie is poisoned at her leaving party.

episodes.title: Posing in Murder
episodes.overview: DI Goodman finds himself embroiled in the highly strung world of modelling.

episodes.title: A Personal Murder
episodes.overview: The team must solve a deeply personal case when Dwayne's old mentor is found dead and a text message from beyond the grave says it was murder. DI Goodman tries to unleash his inner gourmand.

episodes.title: Lost Identity
episodes.overview: DI Goodman's aunt Mary comes to visit him, but things take an unexpected turn when she becomes the only witness to the murder of a tourist. Some unorthodox advice on love from Dwayne leaves JP in a spin.

episodes.title: Dishing Up Murder
episodes.overview: The team enter the high-pressure world of fine dining when a well-known chef is murdered in his own restaurant. Florence has one final lesson on love for DI Goodman and Dwayne gets a chance to repay an old debt.

episodes.title: The Blood Red Sea
episodes.overview: When a marine salvage hunter is killed, the evidence seems to point to one man. It would be an open-and-shut case for the team if it wasn't for the suspect's solid alibi. Meanwhile, it is JP's stag do - and with Dwayne as best man, what could possibly go wrong?

episodes.title: Flames of Love
episodes.overview: The team is faced with an impossible murder when a young backpacker is shot inside a sealed room. DI Goodman has a date, plus it is the day of JP's wedding - but will he make it to the altar?

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: DI Humphrey's new found romance is met with more untimely tropical murders and fiendishly difficult puzzles on the sun-soaked Saint Marie.

episodes.title: Erupting in Murder
episodes.overview: The death of a scientist on the side of a live volcano proves a difficult case to crack for Humphrey and his team when everything appears to point to a death from natural causes.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Flame Tree
episodes.overview: The Saint Marie Literary Festival is rocked by the death of young literature student and Florence’s childhood friend, Esther Monroe, when she is discovered at the bottom of a cliff on the opening day.

episodes.title: The Impossible Murder
episodes.overview: Humphrey and Martha’s romantic weekend retreat to a remote island is cut short when Charlie Taylor is found dead in his room at Hotel Cecile.

episodes.title: Stumped in Murder
episodes.overview: The president of the Saint Marie cricket club is found shot dead in the middle of the team's ground. As the sun rises over the island, suspicion falls on his teammates.

episodes.title: Man Overboard (1)
episodes.overview: A murder investigation propels the team to London in pursuit of their suspects.

episodes.title: Man Overboard (2)
episodes.overview: The team race against the clock in London to solve two murders, after their prime suspect is found dead. Meanwhile, Dwayne has an emotional encounter and Humphrey finds that some advice from an unexpected source helps him come to a big decision.

episodes.title: In the Footsteps of a Killer
episodes.overview: When a tourist claims to alibi a woman convicted for murder eight years ago, the team are forced to reopen the case.

episodes.title: Murder in the Polls
episodes.overview: Saint Marie's mayoral elections are thrown into disarray when a candidate is stabbed.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Joining the team at the stunning Saint Marie is DI Jack Mooney. He may be brilliant, but he'll need all his instinctive genius to solve all the impossible mysteries.

episodes.title: Murder from Above
episodes.overview: DI Mooney and his team are tested when a hotel billionaire's fiancee falls from a balcony the day before her lavish wedding and everything points to suicide... except for the fact that the victim only painted one fingernail.

episodes.title: The Stakes Are High
episodes.overview: DI Mooney and the team enter the high-stakes world of poker when a finalist is poisoned during the Caribbean Poker Masters tournament. With the only suspects sitting around the table and even a twitch of an eye can reveal a player's hand, just how did the killer commit murder?

episodes.title: Written in Murder
episodes.overview: When famous thriller author Frank O'Toole is found stabbed through the heart in the middle of the ocean, Jack and his team are baffled. But as the spotlight turns on Frank's closest friends and family and secrets are exposed, Jack uncovers a murder plot worthy of one of his novels...

episodes.title: The Healer
episodes.overview: Jack and the team find themselves embroiled in the mysterious world of faith healing when a woman is poisoned during a ceremony and all evidence points to the arrogant healer himself.

episodes.title: Murder on the Day of the Dead
episodes.overview: The island's Day of the Dead celebrations are cut short by a woman's death. DI Mooney and the team must navigate the waters of the elitist Yacht Club to catch the killer.

episodes.title: Meditated in Murder
episodes.overview: The leader of a spiritual retreat is strangled and Jack and his team are baffled by the fact that all their suspects were in a meditation circle at the time of the murder.

episodes.title: Dark Memories
episodes.overview: Long-buried memories are raked up for JP when someone from his past is caught red-handed at a murder scene and Jack must unravel a complex mystery to find the truth.

episodes.title: Melodies of Murder
episodes.overview: When Billy Springer, lead guitarist of a popular reggae band, is murdered, DI Mooney and his team must crack a cold case that has haunted the Commissioner for years, before they can arrest the killer. After performing on stage as part of Leon And The Ragers 30-year reunion gig, Billy is found dead moments later in his dressing room.

episodes.title: Murder on the Honore Express
episodes.overview: When a passenger is stabbed on the express bus to Honore, Jack and his team are baffled. No-one left their seat, so how did they commit murder?

episodes.title: Murder Most Animal
episodes.overview: Jack and the team uncover a nest of vipers when a zoo owner is killed with a tranquiliser dart and everyone has an alibi.

episodes.title: Wish You Weren't Here
episodes.overview: Jack and the team are mystified when the TV presenter of a holiday programme is found drowned. The spotlight falls on the crew.

episodes.title: Frappe Death Day
episodes.overview: Jack and the team must navigate the tempestuous waters of a family divided when a wealthy coffee magnate is shot, but can they find the truth beneath the lies?

episodes.title: Beyond the Shining Sea (1)
episodes.overview: A fishing community is excited about the arrival of their festival queen for an annual celebration, but when her boat arrives with only her dead body on board, DI Mooney is left, yet again, with a baffling mystery to solve. What could a missing loaf of bread have to do with the crime? Meanwhile, Florence and Patrice look forward to their wedding, which is only a week away, but a huge strain is put on their relationship when the groom is drawn into the murder case as a former employer and long-time friend of the victim.

episodes.title: Beyond the Shining Sea (2)
episodes.overview: The team are left stunned by another murder connected to the killing of festival queen Tiana. But there is a new lead—a phone call relating to their initial suspect—so DI Jack and his officers travel over to nearby Rosalie Island, where the owner and employees of a lucrative investment company all fall under suspicion as they are questioned about the mysterious call. Meanwhile, with emotions running high, Ruby encourages her uncle, Commissioner Patterson, to show his emotional side for once.

episodes.title: Murder on the Airwaves
episodes.overview: The people of Saint Marie go into mourning when Dezzie Dixon, the island's favourite radio presenter, is murdered live on air and Jack must unravel a challenging mystery to find the culprit. However, his task is made all the more difficult when Detective Sergeant Madeleine Dumas from internal affairs arrives to assess working practices following the recent shooting, and proceeds to question the inspector's every move.

episodes.title: Murder Begins at Home
episodes.overview: Old mates Jay, Gerald, Adam and David arrive on Saint Marie ready for the holiday of a lifetime at the Crystal Bay Horse Ranch. The occasion soon turns sour when the island is shaken by a torrential storm, and ranch owner Hannah advises the men to wait it out in their tents. By morning, Jack thinks he has seen the worst of it, until he opens up the locked police station and finds the body of a man lying in the middle of the floor. It's Adam, with scratches on his arms and laceration marks around his neck.

episodes.title: La Murder Le Diablé
episodes.overview: New Year's Eve celebrations are cut short when a masked man stabs a woman in her own home. Jack and the team must uncover the identity of the mystery murderer before they strike again.

episodes.title: A Murder in Portrait, L'enfant terrible
episodes.overview: DI Jack Mooney and the team are put to the test when a celebrated artist is poisoned in her studio in confounding circumstances.

episodes.title: Tour De Murder
episodes.overview: Jack’s romance with Anna blossoms while he and the rest of the team investigate the mysterious death of a cyclist during a race.

episodes.title: Pirates of the Murder Scene
episodes.overview: Jack faces a life-changing decision whilst investigating the murder of a man found dead in a boat off the Saint Marie coast.

episodes.title: Switcharoo
episodes.overview: The celebratory launch of a new luxury resort is cut short when a woman is found electrocuted in her hotel bathtub – with the door locked from the inside.

episodes.title: Murder on Mosquito Island
episodes.overview: A desert island survival course goes wrong when the leader – a trained survival expert and ex-SAS soldier – is found dead in the forest of a remote island near Saint Marie.

episodes.title: Death in the Salon
episodes.overview: The team are left stumped when the owner of a hair salon is killed in front of her family without anyone seeing what happened.

episodes.title: Now You See Him, Now You Don't
episodes.overview: A blind actress is the only witness to her husband’s murder. But with no evidence that there was anyone else there at the time, can her version of events be trusted? Meanwhile, Neville gets the all-clear to fly home, but is he ready to leave paradise?

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The smash-hit whodunit returns with DI Neville Parker solving a slew of mysterious murders under the sultry Caribbean sun. And some big surprises are in store.

episodes.title: Pilot of the Airwaves
episodes.overview: When a TV news presenter is found strangled in her pool, Neville is sure that her popular co-host is guilty. But given that he was live on air at the time of the murder, how could he have done it? Meanwhile, the team welcomes back an old colleague.

episodes.title: Steamy Confessions
episodes.overview: The team are baffled when an archaeologist is poisoned during a dig but there is no evidence to prove how it was done. Meanwhile, Neville tests his skills in an island crab-cooking competition.

episodes.title: Lucky in Love
episodes.overview: Neville is left perplexed when a lottery winner is found dead but her body then disappears. JP has an unruly new officer to train whilst preparing for the birth of his twins.

episodes.title: Chain Reaction
episodes.overview: Neville’s attempts to embrace island life backfire when, during a game of beach volleyball, a sandfly bite lands him in hospital. His time on the ward takes a shocking turn when a nurse takes her own life during a night shift. Meanwhile, Marlon gives JP some unusual advice to help his twins sleep.

episodes.title: Music To My Ears
episodes.overview: A celebrated concert pianist murdered one night in his studio. Catherine’s friendship with the victim’s family puts her in unexpected danger. The first of a two-part story.

episodes.title: Fake or Fortune
episodes.overview: The team have their work cut out in this dramatic conclusion to the two-parter. Neville must solve a mystery from the past that unlocks the truth of who murdered the concert pianist and why. Help is at hand, though, with the return of a former sergeant.

episodes.title: Somewhere in Time
episodes.overview: A stag do goes awry when the host of their fishing trip is found harpooned on a beach the next morning. But as their boat never moved, how could any of them have done it?

episodes.title: I'll Never Let You Go
episodes.overview: A man confesses to murdering his boss despite being unable to remember what happened. Convinced that things aren’t as simple as they seem, Neville determines to uncover the truth and unveil the real killer.

episodes.title: Last Call to Honoré
episodes.overview: When a seemingly simple kidnapping ends in murder, Neville and the team must work out what went wrong and how someone ended up dead.

episodes.title: A Double Bogey
episodes.overview: The arrival of a long-lost brother to a family-run golf club culminates in a body on the course. But a prime suspect with an alibi leaves the team with an impenetrable conundrum.

episodes.title: Death in Flight
episodes.overview: When a skydiver appears to have been murdered in mid-air, Neville and the team must explore the cut-throat world of social media.

episodes.title: Undercover and Out
episodes.overview: Florence’s undercover role takes a dangerous turn when she finds herself in familiar surroundings, amid a murder investigation. In a race against time, can Neville solve the murder?

episodes.title: Painkiller Thriller
episodes.overview: When a young popstar is found dead at a rehab clinic, it initially looks like a tragic accident. But Neville is convinced there’s more to her death than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Phone-In Murder
episodes.overview: When a woman reports a murder and is then found strangled, the team are left wondering whether she was reporting her own murder.

episodes.title: Murdering Lyrical
episodes.overview: A reggae rap artist is shot dead at a soundcheck for a concert. Things prove uncomfortable for Marlon when he discovers a personal connection to the crime.

episodes.title: Death of a Pawn
episodes.overview: When a prestigious chess match ends in murder, the team must work out how and why the killing was carried out. Meanwhile, the commissioner is confronted with his past by the very last person he was expecting to see.

episodes.title: Murder in the Stars
episodes.overview: The team investigate the mysterious death of an astronomer after he falls from a cliff during a rare planetary event. Meanwhile, is romance blossoming for Neville?

episodes.title: The Communal Death
episodes.overview: The team investigate a preppers commune when one of their members is poisoned inside a locked bunker. Meanwhile, Neville has a series of adventurous dates with Sophie.

episodes.title: Murder on the High Seas
episodes.overview: The team investigates the murder of an estate agent, who has been killed ahead of the potential sale of local beauty spot St Agatha's Cove. Marlon leads a counterfeit goods case to impress the Commissioner, while love in the air for Neville following an unexpected encounter.

episodes.title: An Unpleasant Homecoming
episodes.overview: The team join Naomi in Saint Barnabas when her best friend’s father is murdered at a wedding. Meanwhile, Marlon tries to prepare for his sergeant exams but is easily distracted.

episodes.title: On the Sanctity of Children
episodes.overview: The team investigate the murder of a former children’s home resident. Meanwhile, Marlon sits his sergeant’s exams, and Selwyn meets his daughter for the first time.

episodes.title: A Murder Forewarned (1)
episodes.overview: The team investigate the murder of a water taxi driver at the same time as Neville receives an anonymous letter warning them a murder is due to take place.

episodes.title: Sins of the Detective (2)
episodes.overview: The team must prove Neville’s innocence after Professor Cartwright is murdered. DI Karen Flitcroft from the Department of Policing Standards takes over the investigation. The investigation leads Naomi and Selwyn to Justin West at the preppers commune.

episodes.title: A Calypso Caramba
episodes.overview: The team investigate the murder of a renowned calypso singer’s husband. Meanwhile, Neville struggles with Sophie’s revelations and contemplates his future in Saint Marie.

episodes.title: Going Round in Circles
episodes.overview: Our team are rocked when commissioner Selwyn Patterson is shot at the Yacht Club, as he celebrates 50 years of police service.

episodes.title: Your Number's Up
episodes.overview: It’s murder in the bingo hall as a local care home resident is found stabbed with her own knitting needle, clutching a mysterious photo of a dead man.

episodes.title: Serving Up Murder
episodes.overview: The poisoning of a celebrity chef confounds the team as they question how and when the poison could possibly have been administered.

episodes.title: Murder Most Electric
episodes.overview: An electrocution at a substation causes an island-wide blackout and introduces the team to the baffling world of cryptocurrency.

episodes.title: As the Sun Sets...
episodes.overview: As Marlon faces a difficult decision about his future, he’s also forced to confront his past when his old boss is murdered, and the only witness is his pet parrot.

episodes.title: Murder Going Down
episodes.overview: The team are confounded when a tourist is stabbed whilst travelling down one floor, all alone, in a hotel lift.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Islands
episodes.overview: The team find themselves split up, working between two islands as they investigate the mysterious death of a tourist.

episodes.title: A Murder in the Skies
episodes.overview: It’s the team’s most confounding puzzle yet when a passenger disappears from a flight to Dominica, only to be found back in Saint Marie, murdered.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: We're transported back to the tropical island of Saint Marie, and this time with a new Detective Inspector in place - but will DI Mervin Wilson remain in the job for long? Following the recently cracked case of ‘who shot the Santas?’, along with the revelation that his estranged mother has passed away, Mervin is ready to get back home and leave the island for good. But when a case close to the hearts of those at the station presents itself, is he tempted to extend his stay?

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The team welcome a new recruit before they’re faced with a cryptic case in which the victim leaves them a mysterious message.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A mystery unravels in the jungle when a game show contestant is stabbed on a zip line. Meanwhile, the team butt heads with Mervin.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Mervin and the team investigate the suspicious death of a wellness business owner after she suffers an allergic reaction at the launch of her skincare product.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A distillery owner is poisoned during a group tasting of his premium rum. But the case is shrouded in mystery when it’s revealed that all the guests drank from the same bottle.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Mervin begrudgingly agrees to watch a local women’s football game with the team. But it’s cut short when the star player is discovered with a fatal bullet wound.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Mervin and the team investigate the dark side of online dating when a man is shot dead at his villa. A new colleague makes an impression for all the wrong reasons.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Mervin and the team pull together to pin down the prime suspect in his mother’s murder. But old wounds are reopened as Mervin is forced to confront his past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Mervin is about to fly home but finds himself at the centre of a murder investigation when a body is discovered in his shack.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Selwyn’s return to Saint Marie is disrupted by a dramatic death at his offices, where a man has fallen from the roof. Meanwhile, a new family connection arrives in Mervin’s life.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A couples therapist is found drowned at sea off the coast of her exclusive retreat, and Mervin gets more than he bargained for when he tracks down his wayward brother.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team are left baffled when a reclusive pensioner is shot dead in his home. And tensions rise as Mervin forgoes the commissioner’s new initiative.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Mervin and the team are called to a local church to investigate the death of an elderly parishioner in a case that hits close to home for Officer Rose.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The team is challenged by a perplexing poisoning during a performance of The Tempest. Meanwhile, Mervin must decide what to do about a difficult development involving his brother.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Mervin gets embroiled in a confounding case when he goes in search of his brother on Antigua. The team must uncover their detective’s whereabouts before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The team investigate the poisoning of a local newspaper’s notorious agony aunt. And after the case in Antigua, Mervin grapples with his feelings about his brother.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A death at sea with unexplained injuries stirs rumours about a legendary sea monster, the Lusca. Meanwhile, Mervin is blindsided by an unexpected young visitor.

series.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
series.overview: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

episodes.title: A Note From Your Pastor
episodes.overview: At age 13, Mica meets charismatic pastor John-Paul. Years later, their secret affair leads to marriage - but behind closed doors, he tightens control.

episodes.title: Helpmate
episodes.overview: As their marriage deteriorates, JP blurs the line between care and control. Torn between leaving and protecting the church, Mica fights to break free.

episodes.title: What Happened to Mica
episodes.overview: With hope on the horizon, Mica’s life ends in a sudden, mysterious tragedy. Systemic failures come to light as her family’s fight for truth unfolds.

series.title: Detective Conan
series.overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Kudo Shinichi is a seventeen year-old high school detective whom people call the "Modern Sherlock Holmes." However, one night after a date with his childhood sweetheart, Ran, Shinichi witnessed an illegal trade and, caught off his guard, was knocked unconscious and fed a drug that was supposed to kill him... but he woke up and found himself shrunken to a seven year-old. In order to track down the men who did this to him, Shinichi hid his identity and lived with Ran, whose father happened to be a hopeless detective, and with that came a series of murders and mysteries that he must solve.

episodes.title: The Big Shrink
episodes.overview: While on a date with Rachel, Kudo is attacked by two shady thugs who slip him an experimental drug. The effects of the poison will turn Jimmy’s life upside down!

episodes.title: The Kidnapped Debutante
episodes.overview: Conan sets out to discover the fate of a wealthy businessman’s kidnapped daughter. His new identity is a secret to everyone but his eccentric inventor friend, Dr. Agasa.

episodes.title: Beware of Idols
episodes.overview: Pop diva Yoko Okino is being stalked and she's come to star-struck Richard Moore's doorstep for help! Luckily for all involved, Conan is on the job, too.

episodes.title: Fish Marks the Spot
episodes.overview: Treasure hunt! When a mysterious coded map ends up in the hands of Conan and his new friends from school, the Junior Detective League is born!

episodes.title: The Time Bomb Express
episodes.overview: On a cross country train, Conan comes across two sketchy men that might be connected to the night of his big shrink! To make matters worse, the hoods are packing a bomb!

episodes.title: Tragic Valentine
episodes.overview: When Rachel and Serena attend a Valentine’s Day dinner party with some boys, Conan decides to tag along. It’s a good thing, too, because murder is on the menu!

episodes.title: The Case of Mysterious Gifts
episodes.overview: Dr. Woodman has been receiving children’s toys - and cash - once a month for the last two years, and he has no idea why. Conan and Richard take the case and find some interesting twists along the way.

episodes.title: The Art Museum Murder Case
episodes.overview: The owner of an art museum is killed by what appears to be someone wearing medieval body armor from the 15th century. Can Conan bring the killer to justice?

episodes.title: Festival Fiasco
episodes.overview: An author scripts the perfect murder of his ex-partner, complete with an airtight alibi. Can Conan see through the holes in his plot, or has this writer penned himself a perfect happy ending?

episodes.title: Deadly Game
episodes.overview: A star soccer player's been thrown off his game. A girl claiming to be Jimmy's girlfriend has surfaced, asking for help in finding a kidnapped boy. Are the events connected?

episodes.title: The Moonlight Sonata Murder Case (1/2)
episodes.overview: There is murder abound on Moonlight Island, and with every victim that is found, the haunting sounds of a classical composition are heard. Conan must solve the crime before all the suspects disappear!

episodes.title: Kidnapped: Ayumi
episodes.overview: An innocent game of hide-and-seek becomes a race through the city when two thugs kidnap Amy. With the clock running against them, can the Junior Detective League rescue her before it's too late?

episodes.title: Mystery Mastermind
episodes.overview: Richard finds the missing father of a girl named Michelle. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and Michelle has vanished. It’s up to Conan to find the girl before it’s too late!

episodes.title: The Shooter
episodes.overview: As Conan’s gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Meguire and Richard of its importance before it’s too late?

episodes.title: The Two Faced Brother
episodes.overview: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

episodes.title: A Loan Repaid
episodes.overview: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword. Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

episodes.title: The Case of the Hi-Jacked Department Store
episodes.overview: When Conan and his pals find themselves locked in a department store, they stumble right into the hands of a vicious ring of burglars. Will anyone come to their rescue?

episodes.title: Wedding Day Blues
episodes.overview: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride’s favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

episodes.title: Fashion Sense
episodes.overview: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Richard, and Rachel, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

episodes.title: The Disappearing Act
episodes.overview: Conan, George, Mitch, and Amy explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

episodes.title: Lights, Camera... Murder
episodes.overview: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

episodes.title: Smooth Sailing (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to relax aboard a cruise ship, but the gang soon ends up being cast into the middle of a dangerous family drama. Can Conan find the killer before he takes out the entire family?

episodes.title: Smooth Sailing (2)
episodes.overview: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it’s revealed that Theodore’s escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan’s on the case.

episodes.title: Better Off Forgotten
episodes.overview: During Richard’s day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

episodes.title: The Counterfeit Ransom Kidnapping
episodes.overview: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

episodes.title: Jack Attacks!
episodes.overview: A dog named Jack kills a college student, shocking the dog’s owner and Conan as well! Conan’s known the pooch forever, and if he doesn’t get to the bottom of the attack, Jack will be put to sleep!

episodes.title: Richard's Class Reunion (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and Rachel join Richard for the 15-year reunion of Moore’s state-winning Judo team. But when the knock-out Jamie Hummelford turns up dead in her room, reminiscing will have to wait.

episodes.title: Richard's Class Reunion (2)
episodes.overview: Richard’s class reunion continues, and the killer is still among them. Can Conan apprehend him in time? Everyone’s a suspect in this exciting episode of Case Closed!

episodes.title: The Computer Murder
episodes.overview: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

episodes.title: The Missing Melody
episodes.overview: When an attorney’s wife is murdered under strange circumstances, Conan steps in to make sense of it all. A music box, a telephone call, and a staple all point to a killer no one would expect.

episodes.title: Murder at the Television Studio
episodes.overview: Richard Moore stars on the popular television show Prime Time Mystery Hour, and while Conan and Rachel enjoy the broadcast from the audience, a vicious murder takes place at the studio.

episodes.title: Murder at the Local Diner
episodes.overview: Rachel has a date and Conan is determined to find out who this guy is. But when a brutal murder takes place at the diner he’s in, Conan steps into his detective shoes to solve the case.

episodes.title: A Hunting We Will Go
episodes.overview: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They’re lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

episodes.title: Mountain Villa Murder (1)
episodes.overview: When Rachel is invited to a friend’s villa, it seems like an ideal get-away from the city. But when one of the guests is murdered, the holiday turns into a nightmare - and Rachel’s the killer’s next target!

episodes.title: Mountain Villa Murder (2)
episodes.overview: A group of Rachel’s old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

episodes.title: Wrong Place at the Wrong Time
episodes.overview: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan’s investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

episodes.title: Prickly Past
episodes.overview: When a pretty girl hires Detective Moore to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé!

episodes.title: Flames of Confusion
episodes.overview: When a body is discovered in a bonfire, Moore finds out that the victim is the same man he’s been tailing for the past three days! Can Conan crack the case before the prime suspect leaves the country?

episodes.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues (1)
episodes.overview: A billionaire hosts a birthday gala for his daughter Reika and Detective Moore is the celebrity guest of honor. But when one of Reika’s suitors turns up dead, the remaining guests are suspects for murder.

episodes.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues (2)
episodes.overview: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin’s sinister game.

episodes.title: Left in Tatters
episodes.overview: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

episodes.title: Karaoke Killing
episodes.overview: Rachel and Serena find themselves in a Karaoke Bar with the hottest band in the land! It seems like a dream come true until the brash lead singer - Justin Moon - is poisoned right in front of their eyes.

episodes.title: Conan Is Kidnapped
episodes.overview: A lady who claims to be Conan’s mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

episodes.title: Unhappy Birthday
episodes.overview: A lazy drive through Chiyoda mountain, Tokyo, lands Kogoro, Ran, and Conan in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire industrialist, Kosaku Hotta. As Conan tries to unravel the clues before the killer can strike again, he faces one disturbing reality. The prime suspects are the victim's children. It's an explosive whodunit you won't want to miss.

episodes.title: Unexpected Visitors
episodes.overview: Another day, another case as Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Just why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she had been expecting company? It's just one of the many perplexing elements of a most unusual case.

episodes.title: A Game of Murder
episodes.overview: Conan and the gang's ski-trip turns deadly when a medical professor is murdered right under their noses. A secret message left by the victim points to one of his students as being the killer. However, unraveling the secret proves one of the greatest challenges the pint-sized sleuth has ever faced.

episodes.title: The Last Dive
episodes.overview: The bitter rivalry between two world-class high divers boils over as the reigning champion is found dead. Due to the nature of the injuries and eye witness testimony, it seems as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident. But nothing is ever as it seems as the brilliant mind of Conan soon reveals.

episodes.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Richard and Rachel are joined by Harley Hartwell, a teen detective from the west coast, in solving the sealed room murder of a diplomat.

episodes.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat (2)
episodes.overview: Jimmy Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Jimmy tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Harley Hartwell heats up!

episodes.title: The Book Without Pages
episodes.overview: A routine afternoon at the library turns into the hunt for a corpse after an attendant turns up missing. When Conan and the Detective Boys try to solve the mystery by staying after-hours, they find themselves trapped, in the dark, and not alone. Will they catch the killer before he catches them?

episodes.title: Driving a Bomb
episodes.overview: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end. With many suspects and few clues, will Conan unravel the mystery in time to catch a killer?

episodes.title: The Mist Goblin Murder (1/2)
episodes.overview: A baffling and seemingly impossible murder is committed at a secluded Mount Takao temple. Luckily Conan and Kogoro are on the scene. It is believed that the terrible Mist Goblin (Kiritengu), a creature with super strength, haunts the temple. Conan doesn't believe in goblins, but he may have to change his tune as the evidence suggests that the Mist Goblin may be more than just a legend.

episodes.title: Weapon of Choice
episodes.overview: After finding a wounded bird on the ground Conan, Kogoro, and Ran hear a loud scream coming from the building next to them. Once upon entering the building they find a terrified woman in the hall, screaming about how she has just found her husband dead. The murder victim on the balcony, believed to have been killed by a plant pot.

episodes.title: Game Gone Bad
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited to a party for the release of a game which stars himself. While there, Conan runs into a man who uses the alias Tequila and learns that he plans to meet with Gin and Vodka. Conan follows Tequila to the bathroom where an explosion occurs and kills the man. Conan investigates the explosion and realizes that it was a murder attempt but the wrong person was killed.

episodes.title: The Train Trick Murder Case
episodes.overview: As Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on their way home from a hot spring in Komono, Mie Prefecture, they boarded a train together with a pair of doctors. They arrived at a station where one may change trains to another line, but no one could possibly change trains since the two lines are scheduled differently by a mere five-minute difference. At the station where the trio are to change trains to one going to Tokyo, a murder is discovered. The only suspect rides in the train with Conan's group while the victim rides on a train from a different line.

episodes.title: The Sunfish Murder
episodes.overview: Conan's on the case when the manager of a cleaning company is crushed by a piece of steel, but he encounters only dead ends in the alleyway where the murder was committed.

episodes.title: Footsteps of the Hero (1)
episodes.overview: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest to win a rare first-edition book and persuades Ran Mouri and Kogoro to attend.

episodes.title: Footsteps of the Hero (2)
episodes.overview: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest to win a rare first-edition book and persuades Ran Mouri and Kogoro to attend.

episodes.title: Shopping Can Be Murder
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are back on the case when a young boy finds himself the unknowing target of a killer. Conan and his friends must use all their deductive powers to protect the tiny tot and bring a murderer to justice before he strikes again.

episodes.title: Illustrated Murder
episodes.overview: Kenjin Hanaoka is a popular painter who seems to have everything that a man could want: his own design firm, best selling books, and untold wealth. But when he decides to eat the forbidden fruit and have an affair with one of his pretty, young illustrators his life starts to come apart at the seams.

episodes.title: Ghost Ship Murder (1)
episodes.overview: Ran and Conan accompany Kogoro to Shiki Island, a very superstitious island, where many of the residents believe in local legends.

episodes.title: Ghost Ship Murder (2)
episodes.overview: Ran and Conan accompany Kogoro to Shiki Island, a very superstitious island, where many of the residents believe in local legends.

episodes.title: Gomera!
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys visit the film set of their favorite monster, Gomera, and stumble onto a real-life murder. The most puzzling aspect of the case is the prime suspect: Gomera. The kids must uncover the truth behind the grizzly killing before the death toll rises higher.

episodes.title: The Three Fingerprints
episodes.overview: Kogoro must choose between friendship and the law when an old friend is suspected of murder. It is up to Conan to find the clues and piece together the truth that will either condemn Kogoro's mentor, or set him free.

episodes.title: The Crab and Whale
episodes.overview: A relaxing night out turns into the search for a kidnapped little boy, as Kogoro Ran, and Conan come to the aide of a desperate father in his hour of need. As they search to find the truth, nothing is certain, except the kidnapper's deadly ultimatum: No police, no mercy, no time.

episodes.title: Moonless Murder
episodes.overview: How can blood from one victim, murdered on the street, wind up on the wall of an abandoned building, the railing of a rooftop, and broken glass of an upper apartment window? This is the question Conan must answer if he is to catch a crafty killer entrenched in a seemingly innocent mountain-climbing fraternity, which hides a deadly secret.

episodes.title: The Case of the Murdered Actress
episodes.overview: Kogoro is given a case to solve the sender of a threat note. His teacher Heihachiro Shiota appears at his house and decides to go to the theater, too. Conan and Ran tag along. Kogoro's case turns into a murder, but he soon breaks his backbone before Conan can solve it.

episodes.title: Knight Baron Mystery (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Mouris attend a mystery tour involving the Night Baron, a character from the books written by Shinichi's father, at a beach hotel.

episodes.title: Knight Baron Mystery (2)
episodes.overview: The tour takes a deadly turn when one of the guests falls from a room and is impaled on a statue.

episodes.title: Knight Baron Mystery (3)
episodes.overview: Conan closes in on the killer's identity when he realizes something he missed earlier. Meanwhile, Rachel suspects that an idol of her's, a karate champion staying at the hotel, is involved.

episodes.title: The Stalker
episodes.overview: Richard, Conan, and Rachel discover a corpse in the street. While the police believe the incident to be a random murder, the victim's past leads Conan to pin the blame on the most unassuming suspect of all!

episodes.title: Triple Terror
episodes.overview: Conan and Rachel find themselves embroiled in a murder at a private beach. However, even more disturbing than the brutal death is the list of prime suspects: the victim's triplet sons!

episodes.title: The Ship Wreck Murder
episodes.overview: An S.O.S. message in a bottle disrupts Conan's beachside vacation. Can he and his Junior Detective League friends find the young woman they believe to be the note's author?

episodes.title: Jinnai, King of Death
episodes.overview: When a killer claiming to be the King of Death sends a threat to movie star, Conan, Richard, and Rachel must stop the culprit from making good on his warning: At the stroke of Midnight, you will die!

episodes.title: Murder and Mahjong
episodes.overview: Mahjong: a game of strategy, skill, and luck - three things that a sinister murderer hopes he has on his side! Conan must stack the clues and place details in order if he is to win this terrifying game!

episodes.title: Phantom Thief 1412 (1/2)
episodes.overview: Conan enters a battle of wits with an elusive master thief known as Kaito Kid and has to stop him from stealing a precious pearl from Sonoko's family aboard a cruise ship.

episodes.title: Mysterious Masked Murder (1)
episodes.overview: When Richard is hired to find wealthy Gerard Dufour's childhood sweetheart, a murder takes place right under his nose - and the prime suspect turns up dead.

episodes.title: Mysterious Masked Murder (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and Harley Hartwell's covert investigation continues. But with precious few suspects, one big question haunts the brilliant duo: If Roland Dufour didn't commit the murder, then who did?

episodes.title: The Revengeful Robber
episodes.overview: Conan and Rachel become embroiled in a bank robbery that ends in murder. Just when Inspector Meguire thinks he's solved the crime, Conan discovers a hidden agenda that busts the case wide-open!

episodes.title: Dead Hobo
episodes.overview: When the Junior Detective League sets out to help an ailing homeless man, they end up involved in a new murder mystery. They know who did it - but can they get anyone to listen to them?

episodes.title: Two Times Trouble (1)
episodes.overview: Ran and Sonoko are getting ready to attend a huge concert by the very popular J-Pop band Two-Mix. Some hours before that, Conan and the Detective Boys go to a coffee parlor and meet a lady with sunglasses and a cap... who turns out to be the singer of the group, a woman named Minami Takayama whose voice is rather similar to Conan's.

episodes.title: Two Times Trouble (2)
episodes.overview: Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta tells Inspector Megure everything except how to find Conan. They decide to follow him and they learned who the kidnapper is and why the crime was committed.

episodes.title: The Set Up
episodes.overview: Richard witnesses a murder in the hospital, but his eyes may be playing tricks on him: he sees the same scene four nights in a row. Things get even stranger when he emerges as the prime suspect.

episodes.title: Massacre Night (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Rachel and Serena get stranded at a ski lodge with an old teacher while someone is hiding in the dark and strangling the residents in the night

episodes.title: Massacre Night (2)
episodes.overview: After Serena was attacked, the words MASSACRE NIGHT were found written on her hand. Conan leaps into action to uncover the truth, but sometimes the truth is too much to handle.

episodes.title: Find the Kidnap Site
episodes.overview: The Junior Detective League is after a kidnapper who has dubious intentions. There's more than one life at stake if Conan can't figure out where the captive child is hidden.

episodes.title: For the Birds
episodes.overview: Conan and Rachel take Richard on a crane-watching trip, but the man responsible for the birds' well being is found murdered. The victim's son turns himself in, but Conan suspects the guy is innocent.

episodes.title: Vampire Villa (1)
episodes.overview: Richard is hired by a horror novelist to find out with whom his wife is having an affair. Later the same evening, the man is killed in a ritualistic manner and all of the house guests turn out to have motives.

episodes.title: Vampire Villa (2)
episodes.overview: Horror novelist Stefan Van Croven has been pierced through the chest with a wooden stake. Richard is convinced that the answer is right under his nose, but he doesn't know that Conan's figured out the trick.

episodes.title: Deadly Art
episodes.overview: Richard is asked to investigate a murder threat against Rika Okano, a respected artist who is up for an award. The threat is simple: If Rika receives the award, she will be murdered.

episodes.title: Hospital Homicide
episodes.overview: After Richard breaks his leg, Conan's stops by to visit and senses all is not right with Moore's hospital roommates. His suspicions are justified when a high stakes game of kidnapping and murder begins.

episodes.title: Mountain Fox (1)
episodes.overview: Richard, Rachel and Conan join a client who has hired an assassin known as "the Fox" to kill him to a hike in the mountain to stop the assassin, who turns out to be a member of the party when a guide is killed

episodes.title: Mountain Fox (2)
episodes.overview: Conan is faced with the task of tracking the Fox, the world's most notorious assassin, after the mysterious death of two campers. Can Conan stop him from killing again?

episodes.title: The Other Girl
episodes.overview: A wonderland of wintertime fun becomes a stage for tragedy following the death of an actress at the peak of her career. But a suicide note and a history of poor health don't always add up to the obvious.

episodes.title: Richard's Deadly Date
episodes.overview: Richard's set to reunite with a childhood friend, but what happens is more than Richard ever could have imagined. What do an old ink pen, a security camera, and three children add up to? Murder.

episodes.title: Jimmy Kudo Revealed (1-4)
episodes.overview: Rachel becomes suspicious of Conan when she notices that he looks a lot like Jimmy when he was his age. Meanwhile, Conan becomes involved in the investigations of the murders of a magician and a friend of his mother's.

episodes.title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
episodes.overview: Richard is hired by a retiring billionaire to stop his daughters from killing him for the inheritance. When he is poisoned, Conan realizes that there is more to his death than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Potter's Gambit (1)
episodes.overview: While visiting a famous potter, Conan, Richard, and Rachel stumble upon what they believe to be a suicide - but was it? As the detectives soon learn, looks can often times be deceiving.

episodes.title: Potter's Gambit (2)
episodes.overview: Conan tries to unravel the mystery of Margery Taylor's apparent suicide, but how can he prove a murder took place when all of the suspects - including Richard, Rachel, and himself - share the same alibi?

episodes.title: The Memories of First Love (1)
episodes.overview: Rachel and Conan join Annette, one of Jimmy's old flames, on a weekend getaway. When the villa catches fire, Rachel risks her life to save her competition. Was the fire an accident? Or is something sinister afoot?

episodes.title: The Memories of First Love (2)
episodes.overview: Conan quickly figures out the complicated method the arsonist used to torch the house, as well as the motive behind it. But after the case is solved, Jimmy is in for an embarrassing surprise of his own.

episodes.title: Fame and Misfortune (1)
episodes.overview: A movie star hires Richard to advise him for a role as a detective. But the line between fact and fiction blurs when Richard, Rachel, and Conan discover they have front row seats to an act of murder.

episodes.title: Fame and Misfortune (2)
episodes.overview: As the media flocks to the high-profile murder case, the police prepare to charge a movie star with murder. Can Conan prove he knows who actually committed the crime?

episodes.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (1)
episodes.overview: When Conan and Rachel join Richard for a trip to Bludcraven Manor, they learn of a troubling secret that may link Morfius Bludcraven, the original lord of the estate, to a band of thieves known as The Goblins.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (2)
episodes.overview: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to decipher a secret code that promises to solve the strange mysteries of Bludcraven Manor. The unsuspecting sleuths have no clue that the goblins they hunt are very real.

episodes.title: Snapshots of Death
episodes.overview: When a photographer wins an award for capturing a fire on film, it seems like his career has been made - but when Richard accuses him of being a murderer on TV, one of their careers is about to go up in smoke.

episodes.title: The Mystery Moletian Case (1)
episodes.overview: A distraught man visits Richard about his murdered sister, but things just don't add up. A jewelry store heist and a car chase lead Conan back to the scene of the crime as another case unfolds.

episodes.title: The Mystery Moletian Case (2)
episodes.overview: A suspected murder, a jewel heist, and a missing body have Conan and the Junior Detective League working every angle to crack the case. Will Conan be able to put the clues together in time?

episodes.title: Hit and Run
episodes.overview: When a killer spies the Junior Detective League on TV, he decides to use them for his own evil purposes. Can Conan and his pals see through his plan or will they unwittingly help him get away with murder?

episodes.title: Recipe for Murder (1)
episodes.overview: When Rachel and Serena attend a cooking class and the teacher is stabbed in the back with a very thin weapon during a blackout, Conan realizes that the killer is one of her students and the weapon is hidden somewhere in the classroom.

episodes.title: Recipe for Murder (2)
episodes.overview: All four suspects had a reason to stab their cooking instructor in the back. But what was the murder weapon, where is it hidden, and how was the killer able to strike in a pitch-black kitchen?

episodes.title: School of Ghouls
episodes.overview: Intruders and disappearances lead to rumors that Teitan Elementary School is haunted. The Junior Detective League springs into action, and Conan senses that a few teachers are covering something up.

episodes.title: Prescription for Murder
episodes.overview: Rachel and Conan discover a woman's body, and the victim's best friend accuses the Medical Examiner of murder. The Doctor is definitely a heel, but is he really guilty of murder?

episodes.title: Scuba Dying (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the gang befriend a group of university students at an ocean resort. When a banded sea snake attacks, a life hangs in the balance! Can Conan uncover the truth behind an attempted murder?

episodes.title: Scuba Dying (2)
episodes.overview: A young woman is barely clinging to life and every individual in the group of college students is a suspect. Can Conan make sense of it in time? Or will a murderer escape without a trace?

episodes.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance (1)
episodes.overview: When a vanished mystery writer begins a new story series, his daughter seeks help from Kogoro to track him down. Conan realizes that time is running out when he finds hidden messages in his new texts.

episodes.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance (2)
episodes.overview: The codes hidden within the novel are more complex than Conan originally thought. But how can he lead the investigators toward answers without his voice-emulating tie?

episodes.title: License to Die (1/2)
episodes.overview: While visiting Harley's hometown on the west coast, Conan joins him in investigating a mysterious serial killer case.

episodes.title: The Masked Yaiba Murder Mystery
episodes.overview: Reality and fantasy collide! After the Junior Detective League meets a member of the Laser Police - and Masked Yaiba - a murder takes place right before their eyes!

episodes.title: The Big Sting
episodes.overview: Richard is invited to a mountain retreat by a former client, but his hopes of romance end when she jumps off of a balcony to her death. Did she commit suicide or was it murder?

episodes.title: The Forgotten Bond (1)
episodes.overview: Richard loses his Yoko concert ticket and finds Maya instead. The detective discovers the two share some common interests: music, Yoko Okino, and murder!

episodes.title: The Forgotten Bond (2)
episodes.overview: A blood stain leads Conan to revisit one of the most disturbing murder mysteries of his career. Unless he can get through to Meguire, a killer could walk free!

episodes.title: The Disappearing Weather Girl
episodes.overview: A popular anchorwoman disappears and the Junior Detective League is called into action! Coded messages, symbols, and wild weather send the gang on a frenzied game of cat and mouse!

episodes.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired by a company president to act as his bodyguard because of threats he's gotten. At a banquet, a politician is shot and killed by a sniper while Kogoro's client is grazed by the bullet.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (2)
episodes.overview: Seiji Ishimoto tells the police about the threat letters after he's approached by the minister's secretary, Tsuneaki Niikura. When everyone leaves the hotel room, Conan searches for clues.

episodes.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (1)
episodes.overview: Rachel, Serena, and the Junior Detective League are given backstage access by Tamanosuke Ito to his drama/acrobatics show that specializes in plays depicting “Edo Boy”, a feudal-themed thief responsible for crimes across Japan who has evaded arrest to the present day.

episodes.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (2)
episodes.overview: Tamanosuke is seen wandering around Tetsuo’s murder scene and is found attacked by Conan and Megumi.

episodes.title: The Black Organization: One Billion Yen Robbery Case
episodes.overview: A group ambushes a bank money transport vehicle and flees. Then two of the suspects are found dead.

episodes.title: The Girl from the Black Organization and the University Professor Murder Case
episodes.overview: A girl named Ai Haibara transfers into Conan's class. Ayumi invites her to solve a case with them.

episodes.title: The Indiscriminate Threatening Stadium Case (1)
episodes.overview: The Junior Detective League are at attending a soccer stadium match when Conan notices someone shot a ball with a handgun. The police arrive and Conan learns that a culprit called the TV director demanding a ransom or else he will begin shooting at people from inside the crowd.

episodes.title: The Indiscriminate Threatening Stadium Case (2)
episodes.overview: The caller demands 1¥ billion in exchange for calling the police. Conan, knowing that it is impossible to gather that amount of money in a short time, concludes the caller plans to murder someone regardless of the money.

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Murder)
episodes.overview: Serena invites Rachel, to attend a meeting full of avid magic fans she met online.

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Suspicion)
episodes.overview: The members of the lounge decide to leave the Hamano's body untouched to preserve the crime scene and retreat back into the lounge.

episodes.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: Conan recreates the crossbow attack on the top floor and lures everyone outside. Using a tranquilizer, Conan knocks Serena out and reveals the culprit.

episodes.title: The Disappearing Weapon Case
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys accompany Ayumi Yoshida to Mitsue Mika, her barber, for a haircut. They discover that Mika died after being strangled by an unknown culprit.

episodes.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are on a camping trip but Dr. Agasa forgot the tent. They wander to a castle owned by Masuyo Mamiya, meet Katsuo Tabata, Mitsuru Mamiya, Takahito Mamiya, and learn that there's a secret treasure somewhere inside.

episodes.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (2)
episodes.overview: Haibara leads the investigation and is accompanied by the Detective Boys.

episodes.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys, accompanied with Dr. Agasa, attend the final opening day of a theater as it is about to be demolished. They meet the theater owner, Akio Muramatsu, and his employees Minoru Furuhashi and Yuriko Tomosato. Seiji Haruta, a sadistic real estate agent, arrives and announces his plan to tear the theater down to make way for new business.

episodes.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (2)
episodes.overview: After gaining sufficient evidence and reviewing Toshiyuki's video, Conan uses Dr. Agasa's voice to shed light on the matter at hand and reveals the killer.

episodes.title: SOS! Message from Amy!
episodes.overview: There is a burglar on the loose! But Ayumi is sick so she stays home. When a burglar invades her house, she tries using the detective badge to call for help.

episodes.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (1)
episodes.overview: Heiji and Kazuha visit Tokyo accompanied by Kogoro, Ran, and Conan. They run into Heiji's father's friend and are invited to their mansion. There a murder occurs and his father's friend is found dead in a locked room.

episodes.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (2)
episodes.overview: Continuing the investigation, Heiji proclaims the butler was the murderer and he is taken away, screaming his innocence.

episodes.title: The Suspicious Astronomical Observation
episodes.overview: Ran, Serena, and Conan go to watch the stars. Serena is especially hoping that she will see a shooting star. Ran has a friend at the observatory that helps her use a telescope; he introduces his senpais that work at the observatory. One of them just won an award known as the "Star Pioneer". However, that same night, that same person falls from the higher level of the observatory. Conan knows that this isn't an accident - but how can he prove it?

episodes.title: The North Star No. 3 Express Leaving Ueno (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran take the overnight North Star Express to Hokkaido to meet a former client. Conan notices that the events is eerily similar to the plot of an unpublished novel written by his father, Yusaku, that had been stolen ten years prior.

episodes.title: The North Star No. 3 Express Leaving Ueno (2)
episodes.overview: Conan reveals the suspicious woman to be his mother, Yukiko Kudo. When Kogoro calls all the passengers to witness his inaccurate deduction, Conan figures out the trick.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys go to the police station trying to figure out who robbed a nearby bank.
