episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (2)
episodes.overview: Conan continues his investigation, closing in on Keizo, his prime suspect in the stabbing death of his wife, Kayo. With all pieces of the crime in place, Conan understands the hidden truth and drops hints for the officers.

episodes.title: The Sudden Street Car Stopping Case
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys wake up at 5:30 in the morning to go get in line for a roller coaster ride. There are only three other people on the train, all of them are trainspotters. One of the photographers waits outside so he can take pictures of the train coming towards him; suddenly, the ladder underneath him tips over and he falls onto the track. The train conductor quickly applies the emergency brakes, and everybody rushes out of the train to find him unhurt. However, when Conan comes back into the train to continue their journey, they find one of the other photographers dead. How can Conan make the officer in charge of the case see sense that this was a murder, not an accident?

episodes.title: The Amusement Park Bungee Jumping Case
episodes.overview: At an amusement park, an accident occurs during a Kamen Yaiba playing. As Yaiba jumped from a bungee cord, the cord burns and he falls into the water. 20 minutes later, he is found dead.

episodes.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro reveals that he tutored in his youth, and resolves to meet up with one of his students. However, when they go see her, her car suddenly explodes as her sister drives it out of the driveway. Kogoro is determined to solve the case and find the murderer as soon as possible.

episodes.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (2)
episodes.overview: With some prodding by Conan, Kogoro surprisingly finds the truth of the case himself. He confronts the criminal, and with some help from Conan, he overcomes his ideals and gets to the heart of the matter.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Old Man Disappearance Case
episodes.overview: While on the bus home, Ran meets an old man who later disappears.

episodes.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (1)
episodes.overview: In an attempt to find a man and fix her love life, Sonoko goes to the beach with Ran and Conan

episodes.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (2)
episodes.overview: After talking with Tadahiko, Sonoko falls asleep in the car, and someone puts it in drive.

episodes.title: The Key in the Water Locked Room Case
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan pay a visit to an old woman. She decides to take them to her grandson, but he's found dead when they get into the house. The bathroom door is locked however. How could this have happened?

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (1)
episodes.overview: Detective Sato is chasing a murderer through the school building where Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta happen to be in.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (2)
episodes.overview: With the help of Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta, the case is solved.

episodes.title: The Silent Ring Line
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are waiting for the train when they notice a group of people leaving work on a Sunday. Once they boarded the train the group finds their co-worker dead in an empty train car.

episodes.title: The Bizarre Legend of the Five Storied Pagoda (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are visitors at the 5 story pagoda. After running into the manager, they are invited out to dinner as guest of the temple on him, thanks to the Great Kogoro. The morning after hearing the legend of 5 story pagoda, the manager (who was planning on turning it into a tourist attraction) turns up dead, hanging from the top floor, in a fashion mimicking the legend.

episodes.title: The Bizarre Legend of the Five Storied Pagoda (2)
episodes.overview: More evidence presents itself as Conan notices there are burn marks on the rope used to hang him, and also a slip knot tied. In addition, there was not enough length in the rope meaning, he would have needed to jump into the noose to commit suicide. Right before the police detective was going to call it a suicide case, Conan stuns Kogoro and reveals the method in which the murder was committed, followed by the key piece of evidence to prove who the murderer was.

episodes.title: The Murder Floating in Ryusuitei
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are at a fancy traditional Japanese restaurant where food is delivered on a small computer controlled boat that navigates over a running stream around the restaurant. Later, a murder occurs and Conan realizes the only way it could have been possible was for a person to be alone, and to use the stream to access the room.

episodes.title: Locked Room in the Sky: Shinichi Kudo's First Case
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran and the Detective Boys board a plane to Okinawa. Ran dreams about Shinichi's first case, which took place on a flight one year earlier.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (1)
episodes.overview: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to his uncles house which has been abandoned fifty years ago for a treasure hunt he had set up.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (2)
episodes.overview: Conan matches the symbols to the Hiragana table and reveals that the symbols in the objects direct to other objects in the room.

episodes.title: The Disappearing Junior Detective League Case
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are in a puppeteer camping trip, where they are practicing for a school puppet play. At the same time, a serial killer has been spotted near the areas of the camp. While at the camp, the students disappear with their puppets, leaving the Detective Boys alone.

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Murder)
episodes.overview: Hattori Heiji, bringing along Kazuha, is hired by the rich Takeda family to investigate a series of suspicious suicides that has plagued their mansion in Tottori Prefecture.

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Suspicion)
episodes.overview: Conan and Heiji investigate further into the ghastly death of Nobukazu as well as the suicides of Misa, Kinuyo, and Negishi.

episodes.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: Conan tranquilizes Kogoro and cooperates with Heiji to shed light on the case.

episodes.title: Venus' Kiss
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited to an aquarium where an underwater play is to take place, A woman's dead body rises from the water when it's her cue to come out of a clam's shell in the play.

episodes.title: Blind Spot in the Darkness (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro's doctor invites him, Ran and Conan over for dinner, but the evening takes a shocking turn when their host dies during a power outage.

episodes.title: Blind Spot in the Darkness (2)
episodes.overview: Conan investigates a clinic director's electrocution and uncovers clues during a blackout reenactment that reveal the truth behind the accident.

episodes.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are at the Tropical Land ice rink where they meet a group of people: Yasuharu Misawa, Izumi Sano, Yoriko Komatsu, Chihiro Itami, and Kunitomo Oda. Chihiro goes to the women's bathroom where she is being followed by a cloaked figure.

episodes.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (2)
episodes.overview: Bloody marks are discovered at and near the crime scene. Conan puts Kogoro to sleep to reveal that the culprit.

episodes.title: The 20 Year Old Murder Case: The Symphony Serial Murders
episodes.overview: Saizo Kano, known as the Organizer of Shadows, is shot to death by his subordinates, Sadao Kujirai, Korehisa Kanie, and Teruyoshi Kameda. In the present day, while celebrating their last heist on a luxury cruise ship, Kano’s crew is picked off one by one by a mysterious killer. The stakes are raised when Heiji is thrown into the Pacific Ocean while investigating and a bomb is discovered to be hidden on the ship. Is there something more sinister afloat, or has Kano returned from the dead to enact his vengeance 20 years later?

episodes.title: The Man Who Was Killed Four Times
episodes.overview: Richard is called to investigate a suspicious murder where three people admit to killing a man for hitting him on the head.

episodes.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (Haibara's Part)
episodes.overview: Conan overhears the Black Organization's plans to assassinate a man. Can he stop their murder?

episodes.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (Conan's Part)
episodes.overview: The Black Organization kills a politician, and the assassin locks Ai in the hotel's wine cellar.

episodes.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: While hiding inside a fireplace, Ai tries to find a way to escape.

episodes.title: The Coffee Shop Truck's Wild Entrance Case
episodes.overview: Conan and the group go to a coffee shop. Nearby, two men are having a meeting. One of them gets up to go to the bathroom, and while he's gone, a truck slams into the coffee shop and smashes the other man who was still seated. Conan realizes it was a planned murder and finds evidence through the truck.

episodes.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited by Yoshinori Kana to his home to investigate an unknown stalker harassing his wife, Misaki, who leaves mysterious gifts and letters.

episodes.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (2)
episodes.overview: The case is solved, the mysterious man was figured out to be a statue hanged by a fishing rod.

episodes.title: The Big Investigation of the Nine Doors
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are walking home one day when they discover two s shaped hooks and a ring with the initials M to A, a wedding ring. They decide to investigate seeing it as an S.O.S.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Recipe
episodes.overview: One day, The Detective Boys were bored so they picked up receipts in a convenience store to guess what the people are buying for dinner. George picks up a weird receipt with food items, a dust bin, a container, a handler light, rechargeable batteries, thin lytax gloves, and chlorine.

episodes.title: A Cursed Mask Coldly Laughs
episodes.overview: Kogorou, Ran, and Conan are invited by the hostess of a car accident charity named Shou Beniko. While driving, they find a message from the Phantom of the Cursed Masks who tells them they should not go.

episodes.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are driving by when an arrow almost hits Kogoro. Afterwards, they stay at a hotel when an actor is found dead with a bullet in his head and all the evidence suggests it is the work of an outsider.

episodes.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (2)
episodes.overview: Conan later solves the case by showing how the culprit tried to place false evidence to lure the police to think it was an outsider.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Gun Rings in the Dark
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited to a house as to impress the client's mother who is a finance trader, simply a loaner. Later, loaner is murdered and with the clues, the suspects are her son, daughter, or maid.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Detective Boys in a Cave
episodes.overview: During a camping trip with Professor Agasa, the Detective Boys discover three men hiding a dead body in a cave. Conan is shot and seriously injured.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Wounded Great Detective
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys solve the riddle of the cave's exit, but the robbers spot them. Just when all hope seems lost, Inspector Megure appears.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Third Choice
episodes.overview: Ai points a gun at Conan and offers him three choices. Later, at the school festival, a doctor in the audience dies during Ran's performance.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Knight in Black
episodes.overview: Inspector Megure rules the doctor's death as a suicide, but the black knight insists it's a murder before removing his mask to reveal a familiar face.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: Shinichi Returns...
episodes.overview: Shinichi invites Ran to a fancy dinner, but as he struggles to find the right words, a piercing scream rings out through the restaurant.

episodes.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Promised Place
episodes.overview: With a suspect firmly in mind, Shinichi rushes to solve the murder case and tell Ran something important before Ai's antidote wears off.

episodes.title: The Significant Music Box (1)
episodes.overview: A girl named Yuuki Haruna asks Kogoro Mouri to search for a man named Shuugo whom she texts with on her pager.

episodes.title: The Significant Music Box (2)
episodes.overview: Conan investigates and realizes how the pranks were done and who is attempting to scare Haruna away.

episodes.title: The Invisible Weapon, Rachel's First Investigation
episodes.overview: Ran and Sonoko are on their way to a restaurant when Chie Yoshino allegedly falls asleep in her car but nearly misses them at the last moment. They soon meet Akio, Chie’s husband, but Ran finds his actions suspicious.

episodes.title: The Super Car's Trap (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro wins the city lottery for first place and the reward was an all-expense paid vacation in a hotel and Conan and Ran tag along. In the hotel, a car exhibition is about to do its grand opening.

episodes.title: The Super Car's Trap (2)
episodes.overview: After investigating, Conan reveals that a cover was used to direct the fume into the car. He reveals who the culprit is.

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is relaxing at a luxury hotel. After dinner, a drunken Kogoro goes missing, prompting the others to search for him. Eri calls his phone, hears it ringing from the inside of Ritsuko’s room, open the door with the chain lock in place, and find Ritsuko strangled to death. Worst of all, Kogoro emerges from the bed, much to everyone’s shock.

episodes.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (2)
episodes.overview: Eri continues to pretend Kogoro is the killer but only to fool real guilty party.

episodes.title: The Tenth Passenger (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are riding a bonnet bus, driven by bus operator Mamoru Kajita and guided by Touko Natsume, through the mountains. On the bus already is the president of the Kagekura youth club, Takurou Yabe. The bus stops to pick up other travelers including Souchiki Okumura, who forces Kogoro out of his seat. He argues with Yabe then drinks from his water bottle and collapses dead from poison.

episodes.title: The Tenth Passenger (2)
episodes.overview: Ran reveals that the person who ran past her after Funaki was killed was Yabe. Kogoro catches him but Yabe maintains his innocence.

episodes.title: The Black Wing of Icarus (1)
episodes.overview: Mouri, Ran, and Conan are staying at a hotel where they meet the twins from the case of the cursed mask. Later, an actress comes and causes trouble. The next day, she is found hanged in her room.

episodes.title: The Black Wing of Icarus (2)
episodes.overview: Conan notices that this is not a suicide but a murder. He later proves that the culprit hang-glided to the hotel and went back by stowing in the trunk of a car.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (1)
episodes.overview: A serial arsonist sets huge fires across the city and Takagi and Miwako with the Detective Boys are out to solve it.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (2)
episodes.overview: After Ai reveals the pattern of the arsonist attack, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko run into the arsonist who attempts to kill them.

episodes.title: The Deduction That Was Too Good
episodes.overview: Kogoro is carried by Ran and accompanied by Conan one night picking him up from a bar. While walking they witness a fight in an apartment. The next day a murder occurs. One of the man who's heard arguing comes to Moore for help to prove his innocence. The man has made good suggestions on where to find evidence which are in fact too good.

episodes.title: The Entrance to the Maze: The Anger of Colossus
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited for a ceremony for a ropeway which is built through a giant Goddess Statue on the mountains by Doumouto Guze. They learn that there is a rumour about a curse by the goddess' anger and Kogoro was invited to disprove it. After riding through the ropeway on the opening day, Doumouto, who has disappeared from the ropeway cart, is later found dead on the goddess' hand.

episodes.title: The Falling from Mt. Ryushin Case
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys excluding Ai, are traveling through a winding path on Mt Ryushin. There they witness a derailed car fall off the mountain. The man has died and through the evidence, Conan concludes another car rammed into that car.

episodes.title: The Water Palace of 5 Colors (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan came as the substitutes for Serena and her father, the Suzuki president, and decided to attend a tea meeting at the Aonogi house. At the backyard of the mansion, there was a pond that shined in five colors. And there was a bridge which led to the tea room. While they were enjoying the pond’s colors something unusual happened… The headmaster died in the tea room, the same way as the legend.

episodes.title: The Water Palace of 5 Colors (2)
episodes.overview: Conan searches for clues to who murdered the Headmaster busily and finally figures out the trick that was used.

episodes.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys decided to go mushroom picking in the mountains. And during it, Genta got lost in the hunting area.

episodes.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (2)
episodes.overview: Ai deduces that if they reveal themselves, the hunter trying to get rid of them will shoot them and say that he thought they were bears. So Ai and Mitsuhiko leave a clue for Conan in the form of different types of mushrooms that tells him who the killer is.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Retro Room Case
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are attending a dolphin show when a murder occurs in the hotel.

episodes.title: The Bay of Revenge (1)
episodes.overview: While Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are driving near the ocean, their car breaks down, prompting them to ask for help at a house which belongs to famous lawyer Kensuke Tachibana. There, they meet secretary Yuuichi Sakuraba, his caretaker Yaeko Kamei, his wife Yuki Tachibana, his office's accountant Noriko Sugimura, and lawyer Fumio Fujisawa. As the day progresses, Kensuke explains to Kogoro that he’s been receiving threatening letters from someone with the initials “T.K.”

episodes.title: The Bay of Revenge (2)
episodes.overview: Conan believes that Kumada was met with foul play. Conan puts Kogoro to sleep, deducing that the killer drugged Kensuke while he was out with Kumada.

episodes.title: Megure's Locked Away Secret (1)
episodes.overview: The police inform Kogoro about a serial offender attacking women wearing ganguro makeup. According to the victims’ testimony, their attacker stood at 150 centimeters tall. Kogoro mentions a similar case 20 years ago where female high school students were run over, shocking Megure.

episodes.title: Megure's Locked Away Secret (2)
episodes.overview: Megure reveals a case in the past which is why he was so anxious.

episodes.title: The Detectives Gathered Together! Shinichi Kudo vs. Kid the Phantom Thief
episodes.overview: Kogoro receives a strange invitation to join a gathering at a countryside manor. Five other detectives are also in attendance — until one is murdered.

episodes.title: The Client Full of Lies (1)
episodes.overview: Conan becomes suspicious of Kogoro's latest client, a woman looking for an old lover, even more so when a murdered man is found clutching a photo of her.

episodes.title: The Client Full of Lies (2)
episodes.overview: After a thorough investigation, Conan tranquilizes Kogoro and reveals the culprit.

episodes.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Murder)
episodes.overview: Conan, along with Heiji, Ran, and Kazuha travel the Isle of Mermaids looking for Saori Kadowaki, who had sent a letter to Heiji asking him to save her from being killed by a mermaid.

episodes.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Deduction)
episodes.overview: Conan and Heiji investigate Naoko's brutal murder and discover a trail of fish scales that suggest Naoko's killer came from the sea.

episodes.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: With Kogoro stunned, Conan clears the suspects who were accused of murder, then explains that each victim was called out by the person they trusted and was lured with the promise of a personal gain before being murdered, and reveals the killer.

episodes.title: The Secret of the High Sales
episodes.overview: A boy named Rintaro asks the Detective Boys to investigate on a strange man named Yuuji Kamekura. Rintaro explains that Yuuji appeared one day at his family restaurant claiming he owes Rintaro's grandfather a favor and would like to work at the restaurant. Yuuji soon after begins living with the family and helps them improve the restaurant to the point the family are constantly busy with the customers.

episodes.title: Battle Game Trap (1)
episodes.overview: While at an arcade, Ran, Sonoko and Conan run into their English teacher, who recommends a virtual fighting game. But one player’s fun ends in death.

episodes.title: Battle Game Trap (2)
episodes.overview: Forensics show that Bito was injected with poison, but the murder weapon is still missing. Conan identifies an odd sound crucial to solving the case.

episodes.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan attend Muneyuki Mino's pottery class to make pretty mugs. Muneyuki is pleased to see Ran as her father Kogoro solved a murder case at The Forgemaster's estate. Later on, Muneyuki displays a dark personality.

episodes.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (2)
episodes.overview: Conan finds something suspicious about the pendant on the necktie and figures out Muneyuki and his methods.

episodes.title: Mysterious Passenger (1)
episodes.overview: On the way on to a ski trip, Ai is terrified when she senses the Black Organization's presence.

episodes.title: Mysterious Passenger (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and his friends are on a hijacked bus. Conan suspects an accomplice among the passengers.

episodes.title: The Apartment Degradation Case
episodes.overview: Mouri Kogoro accepts a case to help to find out who has been sending threatening phone calls and letters to a man named Mitsuo Yoshimura. On the way to Yoshimura's apartment with his friend Joji Ueda, Kogoro and Conan witness Yoshimura fall to his death.

episodes.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (1)
episodes.overview: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to a neighbor named Teruya Kanou who is giving away his belongings before moving to England. While there Kanou's Papillon goes missing when the longcase clock strikes twelve and chimes twelve times.

episodes.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (2)
episodes.overview: Conan notices that there is glass wool, which muffles sound, in the incinerator and realizes who the culprit is.

episodes.title: The Locked Wine Cellar
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited to a private party by a President of a financial business, who is known for his expensive collection and various tastes in wine.

episodes.title: The Nanki Beach Mystery Tour (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, Kogoro, and Conan go to Shirahama on a vacation they won from a shopping district lottery, and there meet a group of college students named Maki Shinjou, Tatsuhiko Yura, Madoka Mitsui, Kanako Miyahara, and Kouta Fuji. They are all in the same art club, but don't seem to get along well.

episodes.title: The Nanki Beach Mystery Tour (2)
episodes.overview: Conan investigates and finds out that Madoka was cheating on her boyfriend with another student, Fuji, but that none of them committed the murder.

episodes.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (1)
episodes.overview: Heiji invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to a celebration of the opening of the 3K restaurant by three American celebrities, a heavyweight boxing champion named Ricardo Barreira, a Major League Baseball player named Mike Norwood, and the pro soccer player known named Ray Curtis who Conan admires.

episodes.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (2)
episodes.overview: As Heiji is investigating the rooms, Conan suddenly appears and talks to him about that all three sport celebrities are all innocent.

episodes.title: The Bullet Train Transport Case (1)
episodes.overview: While traveling home on the Shinkansen from Osaka, Conan, Ran and Kogoro ran into Officer Satou and Takagi, who were transporting a criminal. Later, a bomb was found on the train that Officer Satou went to investigate.

episodes.title: The Bullet Train Transport Case (2)
episodes.overview: From the crime scene, Conan found a suspicious thing that makes the scene as the place of homicide. During the investigation, Conan observes three suspects. Conan points out the suspects of who the murderer is. After investigating and finding clues, Conan reveals the culprit.

episodes.title: Boy George's Misfortune
episodes.overview: Genta has been acting weird at school lately. The Detective Boys learns that he is being targeted by a killer. Genta tries to remember where he sees the killer.

episodes.title: Richard Moore's Imposter (1)
episodes.overview: Tatsuo Mori, a Mori Kogoro impersonator, arrives at the Aoiya Hotel near a creepy forest where he is invited to investigate a case where a long-haired man is said to have committed suicide 4-5 years ago.

episodes.title: Richard Moore's Imposter (2)
episodes.overview: After analyzing the clues and facts, Conan is convinced that the long-haired man and Tatsuo were murdered.

episodes.title: The Gun Shot in the Sunflower Building
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro and Ran all go to an isolated mansion called the Sunflower building because every 12 hours it rotates. They are having a BBQ outside while the owner is inside when they hear a shot fired. They rush inside to find the owner shot through the forehead.

episodes.title: The Mystery in the Net (1)
episodes.overview: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys and Conan at the beach during school break while Ran and Sonoko also happen to be on the exact beach. At night, all of them ate dinner in a hotel together with the lifeguards they met that morning. The man the lifeguards were supposed to meet didn't show up so they tried calling him but the only sound that could be heard was the sound of the waves.

episodes.title: The Mystery in the Net (2)
episodes.overview: Conan figures out the culprit and decides to use Professor Agasa's voice to reveal the trick but remembers he forgot his voice changing bow tie at the hotel.

episodes.title: The Alibi of the Soothing Forest
episodes.overview: While Conan, Ran and Kogoro are going sightseeing, the village head is killed by the somebody who visited the village head before post office lady.

episodes.title: The Idol Stars' Secret (1)
episodes.overview: Ran and Kogoro get an invitation for an engagement party from his favorite idol Youko-chan. Kaoru the one who is getting engaged is another star and a former member of a group they all used to be in. She is a fan of Kogoro and wanted him to find out who was stalking her.

episodes.title: The Idol Stars' Secret (2)
episodes.overview: Megure searches everyone for the murder weapon but it isn't found. Though they discover a listening device and find drawers tampered with.

episodes.title: The Tragedy at the OK Corral
episodes.overview: Because of Kogoro's love of horses he takes Conan and Ran to an OK corral ranch. One of their prize winning horses gets spooked and they all go running after her. They reach the horse and Conan finds blood on her horseshoe. They then find the farrier; one who shoes the horses, murdered.

episodes.title: The Kidnapper in the Picture
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys find out about a kidnapping case and decide to investigate.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 4 (1)
episodes.overview: Satou is having an arranged marriage meeting with a man due to her mother's persistence. She arrives to find out it's Ninzaburo Shiratori. She proposes that if Takagi does not arrive to her before sunset, she will marry him whether she wants to or not. He accepts, but Takagi is busy with a store robbery.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 4 (2)
episodes.overview: Takagi solves the case and arrests the culprit when he tries to make a dash out of the police car. Takagi catches up and gives up on going to Simone in time to stop the marriage as the sun is almost set and the car is too far away.

episodes.title: The 14th Round of the Matsue Tamatsukuri Linked Verse Contest (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro wins a trip to Matsue from a lottery drawing, and while there they meet and join up with a Linked Verse group, which is a type of poetry. One of their members, a loan dealer, is killed, and Conan finds out that almost everyone has a motive to kill.

episodes.title: The 14th Round of the Matsue Tamatsukuri Linked Verse Contest (2)
episodes.overview: Conan hasn't figured out who the culprit is, so he gets Kogoro to participate in their Linked Verse Contest so he can have more time to observe the suspects.

episodes.title: The Extremely Strange Punishment from Heaven
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys are out walking around the town the morning after an earthquake when they hear a scream. They see a woman cradling a man bleeding, and they call an ambulance and the man is saved. He says he was robbed and 200,000 yen ($2,000) was stolen from. They have a suspect, but he has an alibi of committing another crime when the man was attacked.

episodes.title: The Man from Chicago (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys shield a man after reporters mistake him for a wealthy arts patron. He offers them a thank-you lunch — but then kidnappers grab him.

episodes.title: The Man from Chicago (2)
episodes.overview: As he tries to decipher a coded message James left at the crime scene, Conan realizes he can track him down using Ayumi's Detective Boys badge.

episodes.title: The Shaking Restaurant
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran go to a restaurant that is shaking because of construction next door. They go back the next day only to find that the man running the restaurant is dead. At first it looks like the construction made a vase fall over and hit him on the head, killing the owner, however, the construction wasn't happening at the estimated time of death.

episodes.title: The Fearful Legend of the Snowy Night (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran are driving to a hot spring when the road gets closed due to snow, and so they accept an offer of staying the night at a nearby house. The next day they discover the body of the company president dead and when they follow the footprints, they find his eldest son dressed up in armor and also dead in a locked room.

episodes.title: The Fearful Legend of the Snowy Night (2)
episodes.overview: During the informal investigation, Conan discovers that the footprints of the armor in the snow were used to cover up the culprit's footprints, and finds that the locked room the son died in was set up.

episodes.title: The Osaka Double Mystery - Naniwa Swordsman and Toyotomi's Castle
episodes.overview: Heiji invites Conan to his kendo tournament.

episodes.title: Courtroom Battle: Kisaki vs. Kogoro (1)
episodes.overview: Eri Kisaki is the attorney for a man named Shinji Usami who is convicted for the murder of Tsuyoshi Hirasawa while in a drunken state. On the prosecution side is her rival, Reiko Kujo, dubbed “The Madonna of Prosecutors. During the hearing, Reiko calls Kogoro to the witness stand, leaving Eri baffled and Conan concerned.

episodes.title: Courtroom Battle: Kisaki vs. Kogoro (2)
episodes.overview: Conan explains that Reiko is taking advantage of Eri’s history with Kogoro by using him on her side. Kameda confesses to changing the time on Kogoro’s phone, thus destroying Shinji’s alibi.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Murder)
episodes.overview: Sonoko invites Ran, bringing along Conan and Kogoro, to come to a house in the hills where their chocolates are blessed with good fortune for love.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Reasoning)
episodes.overview: Nigaki’s corpse is left to preserve evidence. Kogoro takes Nigaki’s recorder and camera to find leads but only discovers two completely black photos and one stained with blood. Apparently the murder takes place before the snowstorm but Conan feels like there's a trick to it.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind Valentine's (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is tranquilized, and Conan reveals the culprit.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Memento from the Crime (1)
episodes.overview: Hideo Morita has come forth to the agency asking Kogoro to find his late wife Mrs. Morita’s watch which he has lost in his house. Kogoro refuses the problem, but the Detective Boys and Dr. Agasa offer to help.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Memento from the Crime (2)
episodes.overview: Conan does not think that Idetsuki was attacked by an outsider. The kids detect the scent of flowers coming from the microwave and Conan gets how the crime was committed. Using Agasa‘s voice, Conan reveals the murderer.

episodes.title: Secret Rushed Omission (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, feeling she met the mysterious man before, attempts to remember why.

episodes.title: Secret Rushed Omission (2)
episodes.overview: Conan's investigation leads him to discover the meaning of the symbols. He drops hints for Joseph Meguire to deduce what the symbols are.

episodes.title: Old Lady's Quiz Disappearance Case
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys meet an old woman in the park who feeds and takes care of stray cats, and also likes to give the kids quizzes from a puzzle book she has. The next day she doesn't show up to feed the cats, but the cat Bruce comes with the old lady's scarf around his neck. The scarf has a code and blood on it, and to find and save the lady Conan and the gang must solve the puzzle.

episodes.title: Truth About the Haunted House (1)
episodes.overview: Ran catches a cold and visits the doctor. When there one of the doctor's patients mentions that his apartment is haunted by a girl who was burned to death four years ago. Conan and Kogoro decide to investigate.

episodes.title: Truth About the Haunted House (2)
episodes.overview: The three people excluding the old man are given more back story. One man does not believe in the ghost, one man is a horror movie filmer, and the other man just lives there.

episodes.title: Case of the Missing Policeman's Notebook
episodes.overview: Takagi loses his badge after breaking up a fight between a manager and his singer. He searches for it with the help of the Detective Boys.

episodes.title: English Teacher vs. Great Detective of the West (1)
episodes.overview: When Professor Agasa learns that records related to Kogoro were stolen from the police department, he asks Heiji to come and help Conan investigate.

episodes.title: English Teacher vs. Great Detective of the West (2)
episodes.overview: Unconvinced that Jodie’s neighbor willingly jumped to his death, Conan and Heiji are determined to find out what really happened in the apartment.

episodes.title: Hooligan in the Labyrinth (1)
episodes.overview: As the Detective Boys travel home from a soccer game on a crowded train, Conan witnesses a soccer fan suddenly collapse from a knife wound.

episodes.title: Hooligan in the Labyrinth (2)
episodes.overview: Despite the three suspects having been questioned, Conan still cannot deduce who is the culprit — until a televised soccer match gives him a clue.

episodes.title: The Small Eye-Witnesses
episodes.overview: The 3 Detective Boys are playing 'make-believe detectives' when they encounter a real case. A man is killed right in front of them, wrapped up in a sheet and thrown into a truck.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Water Flowing Stone Garden (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran are driving in the mountains when they run out of gas and are kindly picked up by Majima, the president of a furniture company. Most of the people that work for him and live with him seem to hate him, so it isn't a surprise when Majima turns up dead the next morning in the beautiful house rock garden.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Water Flowing Stone Garden (2)
episodes.overview: Kogoro accuses one of Majima's employees who was in debt, but is quickly proven wrong. He then accuses Endou, one of Majima's company managers.

episodes.title: Chinatown Deja Vu in the Rain (1)
episodes.overview: Arguing with receptionist for free dinner ticket, one of movie director's crew invited Ran and her crews. However, the director man dies at a restaurant by cyanide but they are unable to find the source poison.

episodes.title: Chinatown Deja Vu in the Rain (2)
episodes.overview: After the case is solved, Ran falls ill. To everyone's surprise, she falls from her chair and collapses on the floor, having memories of certain people she met a long time ago. These people include Sharon Vineyard and the mysterious man.

episodes.title: Shinichi Kudo in New York (The Case)
episodes.overview: Ran loses consciousness due to her illness and reminisces about her past with Shinichi in New York.

episodes.title: Shinichi Kudo in New York (The Deduction)
episodes.overview: The performance of The Golden Apple begins. During the climax of the musical, the actor Heath Flockhart, who is portraying Paris, is shot.

episodes.title: Shinichi Kudo in New York (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: Shinichi tells his mother his deductions on the case to have her solve the murder.

episodes.title: Mitsuhiko in a Forest of Indecision (1)
episodes.overview: Mitsuhiko is missing during the radio taiso day. The Detective Boys ask about his whereabouts from Mitsuhiko's sister and learn he had been going out to an unknown location for the past few Sundays.

episodes.title: Mitsuhiko in a Forest of Indecision (2)
episodes.overview: Conan's radar runs out of power forcing the group to search for Mitsuhiko in the forest.

episodes.title: Solitary Island of the Princess and the Dragon King's Palace (The Murder)
episodes.overview: Heiji and Kogoro are invited to Okinawa to solve the case of a body that was found on Onikame Island alongside a mysterious carved message by the body.

episodes.title: Solitary Island of the Princess and the Dragon King's Palace (The Investigation)
episodes.overview: Heiji tells them the Anchor he found was approximately four to five years old, the same time period on which the strange events have been occurring on Onikame.

episodes.title: Solitary Island of the Princess and the Dragon King's Palace (The Resolution)
episodes.overview: When Conan and Heiji find the name "Kaa" and "Chi" written by Miyako many years ago, they realize who the names are referring to. Conan and Heiji have an epiphany and realize the culprit faked Tiara's time of death.

episodes.title: Smash of Love and Determination (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys along with Kogoro, Ran, and Sonoko take a trip to Kumamoto, Kumamoto so the Detective Boys may participate in a Tennis Tournament. While Sonoko is in the bathroom, Ran overhears three men planning to murder someone. To hide their conversation, the men kidnap Ran.

episodes.title: Smash of Love and Determination (2)
episodes.overview: The police department receive a ransom demanding a large sum for Ran's life. The police send their men to search around town for Ran. Conan and Haibara soon deduce from Ran's description of her location.

episodes.title: Houseboat Fishing Shock
episodes.overview: Kazuyuki Kawai invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to his houseboat for dinner and to view the fireworks. During the fireworks, Kawai's guest, Tsuneo Yamasaki, is found dead from electrocution.

episodes.title: Courtroom Confrontation II: Kisaki vs. Kujo (1)
episodes.overview: Kisaki found herself defending a burglar being charged by the state prosecutor with murder instead of manslaughter

episodes.title: Courtroom Confrontation II: Kisaki vs. Kujo (2)
episodes.overview: Conan went along with Kogoro during the investigation.

episodes.title: Kanmon Strait of Friendship and Murderous Intent (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro has won another contest and so he, Conan and Ran go on vacation, where four friends recognize him as the famous detective Kogoro Mouri. He has dinner with them, which is interrupted by a rude man trying to buy one of the friends' businesses, but they refuse to sell.

episodes.title: Kanmon Strait of Friendship and Murderous Intent (2)
episodes.overview: The rude man is found dead, hit on the head with a rock. Kogoro immediately suspects the four friends who all had motives, but when he questions them they all have alibis.

episodes.title: Parade of Malice and Saints (1)
episodes.overview: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to watch a parade. They run into Sato, who explains that they received a bomb threat and believe it is related to a bomb case three years ago.

episodes.title: Parade of Malice and Saints (2)
episodes.overview: After a thorough investigation, Conan realizes that the mail truck never arrived and realizes the explosion was a distraction and what the true motives for the bombers are.

episodes.title: The Victim Who Came Back
episodes.overview: While walking around town the Detective Boys hear a woman in an apartment scream. They investigate the source of the screaming and find a dead old woman stuffed inside of a Sofa.

episodes.title: Trembling Metropolitan Police Headquarters and 12 Million Hostages
episodes.overview: Sato reminisces about the bomber case three years ago. Three years ago, a bomber sent a fax to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police containing the location of a bomb in the form of a riddle. Matsuda discovers the bombs location and realizes that the bomb contains a clue an even larger bomb and that the clue is only revealed during the last three seconds before detonation; Matsuda sacrifices his life and allowed the police to locate the second bomb.

episodes.title: Unseen Suspect (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro was invited to make an introduction in an episode of a popular detective TV serial.

episodes.title: Unseen Suspect (2)
episodes.overview: During a break in the filming, the star was discovered with his throat slit, with Ruri over the body and her hands bloody. No murder weapon could be found. The immediate suspects were members of the cast, including Ruri and the Nagumo father-son.

episodes.title: The Remains of a Voiceless Testimony (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the others search for a missing systems engineer after hearing he may have interacted with a man from the Black Organization.

episodes.title: The Remains of a Voiceless Testimony (2)
episodes.overview: Afraid the police will confiscate a disk that may contain clues about the Black Organization, Conan uses Kogoro to stall them while he makes a a copy.

episodes.title: Contact with the Black Organization (The Negociation)
episodes.overview: Conan is bothered by an encounter with a man connected to the FBI, but he prioritizes analyzing the contents of Itakura's disk at Agasa's place.

episodes.title: Contact with the Black Organization (The Pursuit)
episodes.overview: Conan impersonates Itakura over the phone and promises Vodka that he'll drop off the software at a train station. Agasa gets a flat tire on the way.

episodes.title: Contact with the Black Organization (The Last Resort)
episodes.overview: Once arriving at their destination point, Conan reveals that the two people are the jewelry robber. Conan reveals that they hijacked a car as evidenced by the man's inability to handle the foreign car and how coins were found in the ashtray yet the man is a smoker.

episodes.title: Festival Dolls Dyed in the Setting Sun (1)
episodes.overview: The Junior Detective Club accompanied Ayumi to an apartment where she was promised by the owners, to replace her own broken ningyō (traditional Japanese doll), a complete set of 7-tier Hinamatsuri dolls if she could correctly position the dolls.

episodes.title: Festival Dolls Dyed in the Setting Sun (2)
episodes.overview: The police was called into what appears to be a break-in that occurred while all occupants happened to be out.

episodes.title: Broken Fence of the Observatory
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a hiking trip. When they reach the observation deck, they witness a man jump off the edge to his death. The body was found at the bottom of the hill and is identified to be Takaya Hirai. Conan investigates the scene and realizes that it was a murder made to look like a suicide.

episodes.title: Place Exposed to the Sun
episodes.overview: Jiroo Kuroki calls Kogoro to help his artist sensei, Shizusan Hayakawa's, depression due to the fact he is unable to draw anymore due to his age. During a fishing trip, Hayakawa's maid finds that he had hanged himself on bamboo.

episodes.title: The Tarnished Masked Hero (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan attend a professional wrestling match where a wrestler challenges the legendary wrestler Wolf Face. Before the match begins, Wolf Face's challenger, Hyota Nagase is found dead in his room. A secret video camera reveals that a man wearing Wolf Face's mask murdered Hyota.

episodes.title: The Tarnished Masked Hero (2)
episodes.overview: After re-watching the murder on the camera, Conan realizes how they will find the murderer.

episodes.title: Cigar Case of Good Fortune (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran and Conan are in a rental car when it breaks down in a mountain pass in the middle of nowhere. They can't use their cellphones so they find a building and knock and ask to use a phone. It is a massage chair development lab and 3 developers have come up with new prototypes. There is obvious tension between the 3 developers and the President of the company, and things get even more tense when one of the developers stabs the President and drives away, only to crash his car and die.

episodes.title: Cigar Case of Good Fortune (2)
episodes.overview: With security cameras, Conan manages to have some more information. The analysis of the route taken by the alleged offender, allows the boy to understand the facts as they occurred. Conan finds the offender and reveals all through Kogoro.

episodes.title: Ninja Art: The Art of Alibi Construction
episodes.overview: Yuuichi Kusaka, a client of Kogoro's, is found dead in the park. Conan then sets up a meeting at Kogoro's office where the police and two suspects are gathered. After knocking Kogoro out with a tranquilizing and using his voice changing bow-tie to impersonate Kogoro, Conan reveals the culprit.

episodes.title: The Vanished Kidnapper's Getaway Car (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys go to visit Jun, one of their friend who is hospitalized. The boy wants to go to game room and asks his friends to help him sneak out. The children accept and Conan takes the place of Jun in the hospital. A man enters the room, however, believing that Conan is Jun kidnaps Conan and asks for a ransom from Jun's family.

episodes.title: The Vanished Kidnapper's Getaway Car (2)
episodes.overview: Jun and Detective Boys back to the hospital and so the police understood that Conan was abducted as a hostage instead of Jun. Conan manages to escape from the place where it is locked, go to the hospital and is questioned by the police.

episodes.title: Heiji Hattori's Desperate Situation! (1)
episodes.overview: Heiji, Kazuha and a man named Kasukawa are held hostage in an attic of someone's home. Meanwhile, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are tired of waiting for the two and begin searching for them based on clues from the last phone call.

episodes.title: Heiji Hattori's Desperate Situation! (2)
episodes.overview: While held at gunpoint, Heiji sends a modified version of the code to Kogoro and asks him to solve it. Conan manages to solve the code.

episodes.title: The Red Horse Among the Flames: The Incident
episodes.overview: Heiji is asked by Kasukawa to investigate a man who is lurking near the house of Ryoko Morozumi. An arsonist, dubbed the Red Horse after the red horse figurines he leaves behind at the fires, has been burning precincts in order.

episodes.title: The Red Horse Among the Flames: The Investigation
episodes.overview: Ran and Kazuha receive a red horse from Genda on the way home. Kogoro realizes that Genda plans to burn the Mouri Agency with Ran and Kazuha in it and rushes home to find out that Genda had been arrested.

episodes.title: The Red Horse Among the Flames: The Resolution
episodes.overview: After investigating Genda's home, they find out that there were covert listening devices in planted by Soga and Gondou and realize who the culprit is.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Birthday Wine
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited by Ran's friend to attend their small birthday party. There, a woman is poisoned from drinking wine, but her wine was given after someone else took a drink already. Conan figures out the trick and proves the culprit to be the murderer.

episodes.title: Friendship Can't Be Bought with Money (1)
episodes.overview: Ayumi decides that on the Detective Boys camping trip, she will attempt to address Ai Haibara by her first name and to call her "Ai-chan". During the camping trip, they run into four college students who offer them a ride in their campervan to the top mountain to watch fireworks. While driving down the mountain, one of the four college students, Yasumi Shirafuji, is found on the road dead.

episodes.title: Friendship Can't Be Bought with Money (2)
episodes.overview: After a thorough investigation, Conan finds out how the body was placed on the road and who the murderer is.

episodes.title: The Suspicious Spicy Curry (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Ran, Sonoko, and a sick Conan meet tennis instructor Hiroto Akashi while on a trip to play tennis. It starts to rain heavily and their van is washed away, forcing the group to take shelter at Hiroto’s house nearby. Hiroto introduces his adoptive father, Iwao, to everyone and has made spicy curry for dinner. When Ran goes to get Iwao’s plate, she hears a muffle sound and goes back to the living room. She goes back a second time, at Hiroto’s request, but finds Iwao hanging in his room, bleeding from his mouth.

episodes.title: The Suspicious Spicy Curry (2)
episodes.overview: Conan discovers the truth in Iwao Akashi’s death but loses his voice in the process.

episodes.title: Alike Princesses (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired by a rich man named Mikio Fujieda to find out who wants to kill him and had been promised ¥10 million after solving the case.

episodes.title: Alike Princesses (2)
episodes.overview: Conan investigates and realizes who the murderer is after receiving a hint from his father.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Tohto Laboratory (1)
episodes.overview: While waiting for a movie preview to start, Conan and the Detective Boys take a nap at a crew member's house — and discover a murder when they wake up.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Tohto Laboratory (2)
episodes.overview: Conan narrows the suspects down to three people with a reason to commit the crime. While he lacks evidence, he knows that a missing button is important.

episodes.title: Hidden Facts of the Accidental Fall
episodes.overview: Kogoro and Conan are on their way home when they witness a struggle between two men over a backpack. Later, one of the men fell off the building and died.

episodes.title: The Four Porsches (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and Professor Agasa take Ai to a department store to see a doctor. They encounter four Porsche owners, one of whom is killed shortly afterward.

episodes.title: The Four Porsches (2)
episodes.overview: Security footage gives the surviving three Porsche owners alibis, but Conan has an epiphany after seeing pictures of their cars' interiors.

episodes.title: The Secret Hidden in the Bathroom (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Agasa and Ai visit an old friend of Professor Miyano to ask about Ai’s parents. Unfortunately, the man dies while eating a hamburger.

episodes.title: The Secret Hidden in the Bathroom (2)
episodes.overview: Ai believes the Black Organization killed Dejima, but Conan says it was one of the designers — and that Akemi’s secret remains in the bathroom.

episodes.title: Bride of Huis Ten Bosch
episodes.overview: Sonoko invites Ran and Conan to attend a wedding between Shinya Ooga and Akane Katori at the Huis Ten Bosch.

episodes.title: The Convenience Store Trap (1)
episodes.overview: Jodie is planning to leave, and Ran and Sonoko, stunned by the news, decide to throw her a going away party.

episodes.title: The Convenience Store Trap (2)
episodes.overview: Aya's boss threatens to fire her and call the police if the case isn't solved, leaving Ran as her only hope.

episodes.title: Confrontation with the Black Organization: Night of the Full Moon Mystery
episodes.overview: Kogoro receives an invitation to a Halloween cruise; the Halloween cruise is famous for hiring guests to star in a horror film.

episodes.title: Look for the Mark on the Butt (1)
episodes.overview: While walking home from school, Ayumi collides with an unidentified man who has just attacked someone. Later, she notices a strange mark on her hand.

episodes.title: Look for the Mark on the Butt (2)
episodes.overview: When three suspects without alibis arrive at the police station for questioning, Ai insists Ayumi and her friends observe from a safe distance.

episodes.title: Love, a Ghost, and a World's Inheritance (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, Conan and Kogoro with the Detective Kids arrive at an inn. There they meet another tourist group and a very rude man (who eventually leaves to another inn). During dinner the owner gets angry reading an article which says the inn is haunted and that's why it's popular.

episodes.title: Love, a Ghost, and a World's Inheritance (2)
episodes.overview: The owner is taken to the hospital. Kogoro is requested to investigate the case. Even as Kogoro starts his wronog deductions, the kids continue investigating, and find that the road where the knife was leads to an end, meaning that the criminal is someone from the village or one of the tourists.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Cell Phone (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro takes Conan to a restaurant, where the waitress called Azusa, asks for his help to find the owner of a lost cell phone.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Cell Phone (2)
episodes.overview: Conan finds out that most of the numbers are very close to each other, suggesting they might be neighbours.

episodes.title: The Tragedy of The Fishing Tournament (1)
episodes.overview: Ran and Conan were invited to a fishing tournament that was being sponsored by Sonoko's father's company. After hearing that, Genta, Ayumi and Mitsuhiko wanted to come along as well. During the tournament, they met Ayukawa Saori and Masubuchi Takuya, both participants, and Funaki Toshihiko, a freelance writer. On the second day of the tournament, Funaki was found dead by Ran and Sonoko near the lake.

episodes.title: The Tragedy of The Fishing Tournament (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys continued their investigation.

episodes.title: A Small Client (1)
episodes.overview: A seven-year-old movie star by the name of Kazuki Kinukawa comes to the Mori office to try to find his mother who abandoned him at a church.

episodes.title: A Small Client (2)
episodes.overview: The forensic team reveals that Kamoshita was knocked on the head with a shower nozzle knocking him unconscious and was later strangled. While the police are watching a videotape found in Kamoshita's room, Conan notices that the movie ended two minutes earlier than the time indicated on the box and realizes how the murder is done.

episodes.title: Phantom Thief Kid's Miracle Midair Walk
episodes.overview: Sonoko's uncle wants to capture Kaito Kid to improve his fame. Kaito Kid arrives on the scene and seemingly walks on air to investigate the treasure he will steal. Conan investigates and finds out the trick Kaito Kid used.

episodes.title: Sweetheart Is an Illusion of Spring
episodes.overview: Ran and Conan run into Sachiko, an acquaintance of Ran's, while shopping. She says she is buying steak for dinner with her lover who's visiting. Later Ran and Conan find that Sachiko is murdered.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 5 (1)
episodes.overview: Takagi and Sato are on a date at the amusement park. Meanwhile, Shiratori along with several officers are at the amusement park investigating a rumored drug deal involving a dealer in hiding named Asakichi Yakura; At the same time, they intentionally interfere with Takagi's date.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 5 (2)
episodes.overview: They confront the golfer and discover he is not the owner of the backpack. Conan investigates the backpack's contents and upon sniffing oil from a rag, reveals the owner to the baseballer.

episodes.title: A Mysterious Spring Beetle
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys visit a pet shop and find the owner, Minoru Shirai, dead. They find a Rhinoceros beetle and pamphlets of an insect museum at Gunma Prefecture. Takagi drives the Detective Boys to the museum where they learn that a truck load of Rhinoceros beetles were stolen from the van.

episodes.title: Teitan High School's Ghost Story (1)
episodes.overview: Sonoko, Ran, and Conan go to the school where they discover the real Dr. Araide is back.

episodes.title: Teitan High School's Ghost Story (2)
episodes.overview: Conan solves the case and reveals the culprit was a close friend to the dead student.

episodes.title: The City's Crows
episodes.overview: An old lady is found dead after a pot falls on her from the top of a building. Officer Chiba is sent to investigate, and Conan helps him figure out who the culprit it really is. The news, of course, comes to a shock to Amy, who just happens to look up the culprit.

episodes.title: Synchronicity Case (1)
episodes.overview: Mouri is hired to stalk a man. He follows the man and finds out his attempted murder on a woman. He later flees but falls off a building. Later they find out his twin brother also died at the same time he did.

episodes.title: Synchronicity Case (2)
episodes.overview: After interrogating the woman, they learn her boyfriend was a gold digger and that he was spotted talking with the attacker from before. Conan figures out that the two exchanged murder targets so they would not be suspected of the murder.

episodes.title: The Tragedy of the Pier in Plain Sight (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are out fishing with Dr Agasa. Since the ship came to pick up the fishing members, one of crews calls their fellow, but the man is found to be poisoned. Remaining Three Crews of the poisoned man got involved to be suspect of the case by the circumstances of the Crime Scene.

episodes.title: The Tragedy of the Pier in Plain Sight (2)
episodes.overview: Conan investigates and with evidence proves who the culprit is.

episodes.title: The Candy House the Witch Lives In
episodes.overview: Sonoko takes Conan and Ran to the "Candy House", a Hansel and Gretel-themed store specializing in various sweets and candies. The trio then meets three masters who make pastries and puddings: Maeda Gou, Fujino Yasuo and Morimoto Tomomi. Behind the scenes of the shop is their boss, Sachiko Hashigaki, who has stern words for her employees about their performance. When things have cooled down, Sachiko is found bludgeoned to death, her employees are now suspects, but no murder weapon can be found.

episodes.title: Lucky Man's Suspense
episodes.overview: Doctor Yokoto Ōwada of the Beika Central Hospital wins the third place prize at a raffle. The raffle makes it his third winning of the week.

episodes.title: Running Away in a Game
episodes.overview: Conan and the gang visit a game company where they end up with a tape they believe to be a new edition of a video game. They end up being hunted down by the president of the gaming company, but they don't know why, until they actually put in the tape and see something that puts their lives in danger.

episodes.title: An Unspoken Route (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Conan and Ran's meeting with an Okinawa baseball star becomes a murder investigation when they find the player's body by the road.

episodes.title: An Unspoken Route (2)
episodes.overview: Suspicious of Motoyama despite his seemingly perfect alibi, Conan looks through Ran’s book of timetables and makes a startling discovery.

episodes.title: Poisonous Spider Trap
episodes.overview: Conan and the group meet spider researchers. One of them gets a call, and they rush to the facility on to find their Professor fallen deadly to a poisonous spider. Conan discovers that the spider was already dead before the Professor came into contact with it, and there's a needle on the ear piece, pointing to murder.

episodes.title: A Code of Stars and Tobacco (1)
episodes.overview: For an astronomical observation, Conan and the group went to this pension deep inside the mountain. Other than the pension owner, there were also other three people in the pension, the victim's fiancee and the two magazine staff. As they went to the nearby hill to see the stars, they saw a decayed bones and on top of it they found the dying message and then that night the other man from the magazine staff was killed and left another dying message.

episodes.title: A Code of Stars and Tobacco (2)
episodes.overview: The bones probably belong to a student who disappeared years before. During the night another guest is murdered, and also the telephone lines are interrupted.

episodes.title: Time Limit at 3 o'clock
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are on a camping trip accompanied by Ran. Later they witness an arguing couple who then leaves. They then set up the tent in the couple's area. Later, the couple returns demanding their place back and the girlfriend decides to let them have it. Later Ran is drugged and kidnapped.

episodes.title: Momotaro Mystery Solving Tour (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys along with Dr. Agasa went to the Okayama prefecture to visit the museum. Later, they found a group of guys, childhood friends, who gathered to celebrate the marriage of two of them. The Detective Boys noticed a container floating in the water and discover that inside is a secret message.

episodes.title: Momotaro Mystery Solving Tour (2)
episodes.overview: Conan discovers that the time capsules were created by the group when the children attended elementary school and that they each had buried a container of others, but a boy died shortly after due to an accident.

episodes.title: Case of the Long Sleeved Kimono at the Hidden Hot Spring on a Snowy Night (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro take a trip to a hot springs lodge. One of the guests, Harumi, asks Kogoro to investigate a case from five years ago.

episodes.title: Case of the Long Sleeved Kimono at the Hidden Hot Spring on a Snowy Night (2)
episodes.overview: Conan notices that the footprints outside the shrine are too shallow and sees that there is a crack in the ceiling in front of the hot spring; from these and other clues he is able to deduce how the culprit faked an alibi.

episodes.title: Whose Reasoning Show (1)
episodes.overview: Heiji and Kazuha make a surprise visit. Later at a restaurant, Heiji and Kazuha argue for what they should attend tomorrow, a theatre or a baseball game.

episodes.title: Whose Reasoning Show (2)
episodes.overview: Heiji and Conan figured out the trick of Culprit and also found that Kazuha and Ran got trouble with the case.

episodes.title: Miracle at Koshien Ball Park! The Defiants Face the Dark Demon
episodes.overview: Heiji won the bet in the previous episode to go see a baseball game and so it's decided that they're all going to the high school baseball finals in Koshien Stadium. But there is a mysterious guy willing to commit a suicide bombing there.

episodes.title: The Target Is Kogoro Mori!
episodes.overview: Mouri is targeted by a killer who is after Kimura. Mouri accidentally took his jacket at a bar and now the killer is trying to kill him. Conan finds out that Kimura is not who he seems to be.

episodes.title: Dissonance of the Stradivarius Violin (Overture)
episodes.overview: Mouri is invited by a granddaughter of a rich household to solve these mysterious accidents that happen whenever someone tries to play a Stradivarius for her grandfather on his birthday. Four incidents have happened on that day already and it is about to come up again.

episodes.title: Dissonance of the Stradivarius Violin (Interlude)
episodes.overview: It is revealed that the house hold are killed off one by one in the order of the C Concert scale.

episodes.title: Dissonance of the Stradivarius Violin (Last Tune)
episodes.overview: Conan figures out the object was the real Stradivarius that lured the grandmother to fall to her death.

episodes.title: Kogoro Gets Drunk in Satsuma (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited Kagoshima for a variety talk show to promote their local shochu and is later invited by Takakuma Shochu sample their handmade sake.

episodes.title: Kogoro Gets Drunk in Satsuma (2)
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and the police continue to search for clues to solving the case. Conan learns more about Tatsumura, the current owner, Satoshi, and the company's history from one of the employees.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 6 (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are walking home when they noticed a strange jogger. Takagi, Sato, and Chousuke are placed on the case of a murder. The Detective Boys come across them and identify the jogger as the suspect.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 6 (2)
episodes.overview: Conan discovers that the suspect tricked Chiba's sense of time.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Height Difference of 20 cm
episodes.overview: On a walk with Ran, Conan runs into Takagi who explains that Katsugoro Kitamura, the president of a construction company, is found dead from a stab wound. The suspect, Yuuichi Minamida, is in custody while the police attempt to figure out how the murder was done. The knife angle on the body suggests Kitamura was murdered by someone shorter than him; Minamida is 20 cm taller than Kitamura making it technically impossible.

episodes.title: A Kidnapping Case... So It Seems
episodes.overview: A motorcyclist crashes outside of Mouri's detective agency. The motorcyclist is dead, but they find a suitcase with 300,000 yen and a note suggesting the money is a ransom drop.

episodes.title: Big Adventure in the Eccentric Mansion: The Seal
episodes.overview: Agasa, Haibara, Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta go camping. While they're camping they find a lantern in a pond with some writing inside. They show the stone lantern to Conan who determines that it is a code to finding a large diamond. The lantern is also hiding another secret...a dead body at the bottom of the pond.

episodes.title: Big Adventure in the Eccentric Mansion: The Mechanism
episodes.overview: Conan, Haibara, and the kids decide to enter the house which belonged to Kichiemon a puppet maker and architect of the riddle.

episodes.title: Big Adventure in the Eccentric Mansion: The Resolution
episodes.overview: The sword contains the last clue, which leads everyone back to the pond.

episodes.title: Spicy, Bitter, Sweet Soup
episodes.overview: A woman, Fumie Ozawa, is found dead in her bathroom around 9 am, having appeared to have committed suicide by hanging herself with a thin wire, by her friend Etsuko Aikawa who claims it was murder.

episodes.title: The Weird Family's Commission (1)
episodes.overview: A woman named Tomoko Kiriya hires Kogoro to search for her cellphone which contains messages of her affair.

episodes.title: The Weird Family's Commission (2)
episodes.overview: Conan reveals that the person who has the cellphone is obviously inexperienced with one.

episodes.title: Ran's Suspicions
episodes.overview: Ran turns on Conan's cellphone only to find out there is a four digit lock. She reminisces about the time Shinichi was forming words through the Hiragana and numbers found on the license plates.

episodes.title: Red-Handed Jewel Robber (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys meet Takagi in a jewelry store, and soon after, they witness the store being robbed. They chase him to a nearby roof, which he jumps off of, killing himself. Conan notices several suspicious things about the incident, leading the police to believe that it wasn't as simple of a case as it first appeared to be.

episodes.title: Red-Handed Jewel Robber (2)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys and Conan solve the case and show the police that they were wrong about almost everything that happened.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Angel's Mansion (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys and Conan meet Yuriko an orphaned girl. She is a potential heiress to her great-grandfather's fortune, but she must first solve a riddle.

episodes.title: The Mysterious Angel's Mansion (2)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys parallel the legend of the Minotaur and Theseus by using the yarn from their clothes to navigate the labyrinth.

episodes.title: Man Who Went to Call For An Ambulance
episodes.overview: One day a man was jogging and finds a dead body. He calls the Ambulance but worried about the man's life, decides to run to the nearest bus station. Because of his actions he is considered the main suspect.

episodes.title: Conan and Heiji's Reasoning Magic: The Trick
episodes.overview: Conan, Heiji, Ran, and Kazuha are at Dogo Hoshikawa’s magic show.

episodes.title: Conan and Heiji's Reasoning Magic: The Mansion
episodes.overview: Tenko’s brutal murder is investigated. Conan and Heiji now realize how the murder was executed.

episodes.title: Conan and Heiji's Reasoning Magic: The Resolution
episodes.overview: Conan recreates the trick used by the killer, disappearing and reappearing in front of everyone in the creepy long hallway.

episodes.title: The Simultaneous Stage Advance and Kidnapping (1)
episodes.overview: Tamanosuke and his troupe are preparing a show but Renge Kataoka's father, the actress, forbids his daughter to attend the show. Tamanosuke is in trouble and asks Ran to replace the girl until it was able to convince her father to let her play.

episodes.title: The Simultaneous Stage Advance and Kidnapping (2)
episodes.overview: The time of show is getting closer, Tamanosuke decides to play the show without Renge Kataoka, the actress, by replacing Ran as the girl before the end of the show. Thus Conan manages to find out who has kidnapped the girl and free just in time to enable it to play its role in the show.

episodes.title: The Shinto Shrine Torii's Surprising Code (1)
episodes.overview: The detective boys are hiking on a trip to find stag beetles on a mountain forest. . Later Conan receives a phone call from Ran and Sonoko who tells "Shinichi" that a burglar tried to steal Sonoko's bag. Since it relates to a murder, Conan investigates the picture sent by Sonoko to learn about the dying message. While at it, he helps the Detective Boys solve one of Agasa's code.

episodes.title: The Shinto Shrine Torii's Surprising Code (2)
episodes.overview: Later Conan solves both codes and finds out that Ran and Sonoko are riding with the murderer.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Half-Completed Crime
episodes.overview: Kogoro is invited by TV producer Ryoko Inoue to share some of his case stories. He meets scriptwriters Joji Yagami, Morio Kouda, and Akira Sakuma. During negotiations, Joji drops dead from poison laced in his coffee.

episodes.title: The Detective Boys Blue Bird Chase
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys are invited by their classmate Yuka Konno to come to her house to investigate her pet budgerigar.

episodes.title: The Evil Spirit Appears on An Unlucky Day: The Case
episodes.overview: A man is being haunted by a ghost, since exorcisms did not work they want Kogorou to solve the case. The clue is a card that says the fifth ghost will kill them unless they repent their sins. Since the time that card was sent, the master installed a door that needs a pin code and fingerprint scan to access the top floor. The master, lady, and the installer of the door are friends who are hiding a secret about the sin.

episodes.title: The Evil Spirit Appears on An Unlucky Day: The Suspicion
episodes.overview: Afterwards, the master is found dead from a heart attack. Conan realizes he must've seen something that was impossible causing him that much of a fright.

episodes.title: The Evil Spirit Appears on An Unlucky Day: The Solution
episodes.overview: They decide to investigate the four workers of the mansion along with the accident that took place thirteen years ago.

episodes.title: Home of Beika's Grenier
episodes.overview: A small three-story house is put up for rent in the neighbourhood and the Detective Boys decide to pass by it on the way home from school. Haibara tricks the real estate agent into giving them a tour of the inside and Conan notices that he could see Mouri's detective agency from the third floor window. The next day, they discover the house has been sold to an old couple and Conan finds them suspicious.

episodes.title: Sword of the Eight-Headed Serpent (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogorou go to the mythical village of Izumo. there they meet Eiko Ezumi, an employee at the Grand Shrine, and learn that she is to marry a rotten businessman, Kouji Wanibuchi - founder and president of his own company. Later they meet her childhood friend, Ryousuke Fukuma and it comes to a rocky start when Kogorou yells at him. The next day, Eiko's fiancee is found dead with his Sword of the Eight-Headed Snake he was carrying goes missing.

episodes.title: Sword of the Eight-Headed Serpent (2)
episodes.overview: Conan proves that Eiko and Ryou's alibis were to protect the other.

episodes.title: Gingko-Colored First Love (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are at Agasa's house when they happen to find a letter from Agasa's first love. Apparently they are supposed to meet every decade but was unable to because Agasa could not solve the code from the letter.

episodes.title: Gingko-Colored First Love (2)
episodes.overview: After Conan re-examines the hint, he realizes that the sounds were animal noises pronounced by the English.

episodes.title: Detective Boys and the Four Aomushi Brothers
episodes.overview: Ayumi and other young detectives saw an olive tree on which lives a family of caterpillars. In the same area has been committed murder and a boy, despite having seen the face of the murderer, makes no witness to the police. Conan, talking with the boy, unable to understand why the boy do not want to talk with authorities.

episodes.title: The Photograph Mail From a Clown
episodes.overview: Mouri, and Conan are checking out costumes for Mouri's one day of being a chief firemen. Later they meet people attending a costume party. While walking home, they find a police car in front of the house and meet the people from the costume shop earlier, realizing the host has been murdered.

episodes.title: Black Impact! The Moment the Organization Reaches Out!
episodes.overview: Kogoro is asked to help News Reporter Rena Mizunashi who is experiencing persistent Knock, Knock, Ginger every Saturday for two months. Conan places a transmitter device outside the door and investigates.

episodes.title: Love Letter to Ran
episodes.overview: Ran receives an anonymous "love" letter that has Conan worried.

episodes.title: The Super Secret Road to School (1)
episodes.overview: Mitsuhiko tells the Detective Boys that Shouko Amemiya, a girl that strongly resembles Haibara, is missing. Conan considers the possibility that the Black Organization kidnapped her and investigates.

episodes.title: The Super Secret Road to School (2)
episodes.overview: From Amemiya's strange behavior the Detective Boys head to a garage where they find kittens Amemiya had been tending. Unable to find Amemiya, they investigate the area around the garage and realize there had been a recent car accident.

episodes.title: The Two Who Can't Return Anymore (1)
episodes.overview: A client named Atsushi Misumi asks Kogoro to search for his girlfriend, Ami. Deducing from her last words, they realize Ami is waiting for Misumi at the place where they first met. They are driven by Misumi to Gunma Prefecture where they find Ami in a sealed up car dead.

episodes.title: The Two Who Can't Return Anymore (2)
episodes.overview: After investigating, Conan realizes how the murder was done.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 7 (1)
episodes.overview: Mōri, Ran, and Conan are at a café when they run into Takagi who is aiming to pick up girls. Meanwhile, he finds Sato there doing the same. After a tense date with two strangers, Conan realizes from the conversation that a boy home alone is in danger. When they arrive at their house, the boy has been kidnapped. The kidnapper leaves an email demanding money.

episodes.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 7 (2)
episodes.overview: After solving clues Takagi leaves suddenly and Conan reveals who the kidnapper is.

episodes.title: Conan-A Strange Child
episodes.overview: Kogoro and Conan visits a famous author named Osamu Umezu in order to have his book signed. Later they spot Osamu's secretary, Mikami Touru, running to Osamu's house. They learn that Mikami that Osamu is not answering his phone calls and he was going to check up on him. They accompany him to Osamu's apartment and find Osamu dead. Evidence suggests it was suicide but Kogoro notices blood on the trash bin and reveals that it was a murder.

episodes.title: The Great Dog Coeur's Triumph
episodes.overview: Conan and Ran pass by a dog park and befriend two couples whom each own a dogs; one is named Musashi and the other is named Coeur. Yoriko Nakatani, the neighbor of the owner of Musashi, the Tsutsumi couple, asks Kogoro to investigate the dog Musashi who acts aggressively to her. Conan and Ran disclose they believe she did something to upset the dog, causing her to leave. The next day, Nakatani's mother in law is seemingly killed by Musashi when his teeth marks are found on her throat.

episodes.title: Information Gathered About the Detective Boys (1)
episodes.overview: A free-lance writer comes to do a story about the Detective Boys. They go along with their teacher to the writer's apartment, but when they arrive they find that he has been bludgeoned to death.

episodes.title: Information Gathered About the Detective Boys (2)
episodes.overview: Three out of the four messages on the answering machine are suspect, but in each one there is something going on which helps them verify the time and place of the call

episodes.title: Ueto Aya and Shinichi - The Promise from 4 Years Ago
