episodes.title: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, Genta, and Haibara are on the bus with Kobayashi-sensei and Wakasa-sensei to Hatoyama Ranch to collect the new chickens they'll be caring for at school. Also on the bus are Hitsuka Junya, Nanbu Takashi, and Kano Shogo, who are headed to the same ranch. They are apparently going there to gather information and conduct research. There's trouble on the bus, but Amuro saves the day. Amuro seems to have business at the ranch as well...

episodes.title: The Spark That Fell on the Ranch (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and his companions head to a ranch to pick up some chickens for their grade school and get dragged into a dangerous situation. A man claiming to be the ranch owner's younger brother takes Ayumi hostage and locks Conan, Amuro, Mitsuhiko, and Kobayashi in the basement beneath the office. There they find the body of the ranch owner and Kazami Yuya. Conan successfully gets in touch with Haibara and the others above ground, but... What are the objectives of the three men visiting the ranch and the owner's younger brother?

episodes.title: The Ghost's Revenge
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro meet a manager of an accounting firm at the hospital who's been told he has six months left to live. Also with him are his wife and secretary, and it seems as though he plans to make the most of his remaining time. However, several days later, he's found murdered in his home. That morning, his wife and secretary went out to run an errand at his request. When they returned that evening, they found him dead in the bathroom. Just then, the man's friend comes running in.

episodes.title: I Want My Husband Back
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro see a news story on TV about the disappearance of traffic accident victim Butsumaru Daijiro. Mori Fusae, the woman who witnessed the accident, handed over Butsumaru's driver's license to the police, but Inukai Hajime, the man who caused the accident, vanished after saying he would take Butsumaru to the hospital. Meanwhile, the Mori Detective Agency receives a phone call from Butsumaru's wife Emiko, who hires Kogoro to find her husband and bring him back safe...

episodes.title: Bad Guys
episodes.overview: Conan hears two women scream while on the way to the park with Genta and Mitsuhiko. They go to the house where they heard the screams, where they see Hirasawa Kaori and Hirasawa Seiko, who have fallen down some stairs. From their conversation with Hirasawa Ryoji, who arrives shortly afterwards, they learn the women are his wife and mother-in-law, and he is the family's son-in-law. It seems as though all they do is cause trouble for Ryoji. Later, Conan and his friends see Ryoji struggling near the park. According to Ayumi, her neighbors have been talking about the Hirasawa family...

episodes.title: The Man Who Camped Out at the Police Station
episodes.overview: Kogoro spots Inspector Megure walking in front of Cafe Poirot. He congratulates the police on recently solving a case in record time, but apparently they arrested the wrong man. Conan meets up with them and Inspector Megure explains the case to them. A man was found dead in his home. At the crime scene were a rope and metal pipe, and the police believe the culprit entered by opening a hole in a glass window, knocked the victim unconscious with the metal pipe, and then strangled him to death. The victim's girlfriend's testimony pointed to her ex-boyfriend as a possible suspect, but...

episodes.title: Okino Yoko and the Locked Attic (1)
episodes.overview: Okino Yoko comes to the Mori Detective Agency to ask him to solve a murder that happened at a villa. Several days earlier, Yoko headed to a villa where a Nichiuri TV producer's sister went missing after she got married to scout the location. His sister's husband and brother- and sister-in-law were there as well. But the night they decided to stay at the villa... Just as he was preparing to explain his deduction, Kogoro shuts himself inside the bathroom instead. Wakita Kanenori from Iroha Sushi shows up at the office, and then--?!

episodes.title: Okino Yoko and the Locked Attic (2)
episodes.overview: Okino Yoko comes to the detective agency, and Wakita Kanenori and Conan end up having to solve the case she describes that happened at a certain villa. The people present at the villa during the case had all kinds of relationships with the woman who went missing two years ago, giving all of them possible motives for killing the murder victim in the case. While attempting to solve the case based on things Yoko found strange, Conan receives a message from Kogoro, who is in the bathroom...?

episodes.title: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Morofushi Hiromitsu
episodes.overview: While Instructor Onizuka is reprimanding his police cadets, Morofushi spots the missing person report for a young girl who went missing the previous night. His friends ask him why he's so interested in the girl, but simply explains that she looks similar to a girl he used to play with as a child and refuses to elaborate. With coaxing from his friends, Morofushi eventually opens up and begins telling them about the murders he witnessed as a child...

episodes.title: The Spiral of Rain and Malice
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys discover an abandoned car by the river. Though they're interested in the car, they quickly head off to play because rain is forecasted for that evening. While playing soccer, Genta nearly runs into a nearby woman. She was speaking into a voice recorder, but their near collision leads to her playing soccer with the kids. After a while, they begin hearing thunder, so they leave behind the woman who seems to be waiting for someone. The next morning, Conan sees a certain story on the news...

episodes.title: The Targeted Chicken Sexer
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro arrive at a chicken egg factory. Kogoro is asked to investigate what's causing the strange things that have been happening to chicken sexer Nanba over the past few weeks and act as his bodyguard. They question the factory employees, but nobody can think of anyone who would want to harm him. However, one of his colleagues seems to have reservations about him. Furthermore, they learn about a chicken sexing legend from the reporter who has come to the factory to gather information. Later, when they attend Nanba's lecture, they witness an attack on him...

episodes.title: The Dreamy-Eyed Woman's Last Shot at Love
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko have come to the newest date spot. When they discover the elderly Kamogawa Haru anxiously sitting on a bench, they go to speak to her believing she may be lost. Just then, a man appears. Conan and his friends assume he is Haru's son based on his appearance, but he is apparently her boyfriend Kazama Joji. Noticing that Haru is fairly wealthy, Sonoko believes Kazama, who is young enough to be Haru's son, is a gold-digger and cautions her against the relationship, but the couple blows her off...

episodes.title: Detectives Don't Sleep
episodes.overview: A woman named Nishiwaki Kae arrives at the Mori Detective Agency where Conan and Kogoro are. She explains that someone has been breaking into her apartment while she's at work and asks Kogoro for help. The intruder, who began breaking in a month ago, apparently is not a thief, but leaves gifts for her. The three of them head to her apartment and discover a suitcase with a ribbon on it in the entryway. Believing it is a new gift from the intruder, Kogoro opens the suitcase and finds a dead body packed inside...

episodes.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro are attending a wedding. Kogoro met the groom's father at a bar where he's a regular and ended up receiving an invitation. Also attending the wedding are staff including the wedding planner and priest, as well as the couple's friends. The ceremony begins, and just as the bride enters the chapel, she begins choking and loses consciousness. Upon seeing her pain, the people in attendance say ominous things such as "she got what she deserved" and "this wedding was cursed."

episodes.title: The Shopping Center in Love
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro pass by a dreary shopping center. They attempt to purchase some things at a vegetable shop, but the owner, Yamazaki, seems listless. Just then, Madam Gaga, a producer who revitalizes run down shopping centers, and her assistant Rabbit Suzuki show up. Madam Gaga announces that a pro wrestling event will be held to revitalize the shopping center. The shop owners engage in various forms of exercise to train, and Kogoro agrees to participate in the event as a referee, but...

episodes.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes
episodes.overview: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko arrive at a takeout pizza restaurant. They participate in the store's campaign to guess the weight of a ball of pizza dough, and thanks to Genta, they win a free pizza. After splitting the pizza into fifths and placing their slices inside special boxes, they head home. On their way, all of them have their pizza stolen by someone. When the kids meet back up, each one has a torn pizza box. Conan and Mitsuhiko realize based on the damage that the culprit was after their boxes.

episodes.title: The Sweet Voice Heard Through the Phone
episodes.overview: The Mori Detective Agency receives a phone call from client Nagamine Mayako. Mayako has an appointment at the agency office, but she seems to have gotten lost. Though it's past her scheduled appointment time, Kogoro, who knows from her social media photos that Mayako is beautiful, seems excited. The client noticed her husband has been acting suspiciously and would like him to investigate the possibility that he is involved in criminal activity. Kogoro continues waiting for a while, but Mayako never shows up, and the agency receives another phone call...

episodes.title: The Surprise That Leads to Tragedy
episodes.overview: While on their way home from visiting Professor Agasa's friend's apartment, Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta hear a scream. They rush to the scene, where they discover a man bleeding from the head as well as a woman. The woman who lives at the apartment noticed something off about the place when she came home and grabbed the golf club she kept for self-defense. The lights wouldn't turn on, and as she entered the apartment, she heard a loud noise... The police confirm her story and believe it was an unfortunate accident. However, certain elements of the case catch Conan's attention...

episodes.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (1)
episodes.overview: Yusaku is approached by a TV reporter when he exits the Metropolitan Police Department. He's asked if he visited the police to confirm that the false charges against Kaito Kid had been dropped. However, Yusaku responds that his assistance was requested with the series of locked room murders that recently took place. He announces that he has solved the cases and will reveal the solution on a live broadcast over the weekend and even leaves a message for Kid before he departs. However, Yusaku runs into trouble on the day of the broadcast!

episodes.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (2)
episodes.overview: Three victims who seem to share nothing in common are discovered within locked rooms in the serial locked room murder case. Yusaku's advice was requested by the Metropolitan Police Department, and he was scheduled to solve the case on live TV, but he ends up sick in bed with food poisoning. Yukiko, who was going to disguise herself as him and appear in his place, gets sick as well. Conan hears the doorbell ring and goes to open the door to the Kudo family home to turn down the TV appearance but comes face to face with Yusaku, who should be sick in bed...?! Kudo Yusaku's unrehearsed and unprepared detective show begins!

episodes.title: The Detective Boys' Pursuit of the Purse-Snatcher
episodes.overview: Ayumi runs into a purse-snatcher and the man pursuing them, Kume Shosaku. The other Detective Boys arrive, and while they're being filled in, a body is discovered in the apartment complex the culprit fled into. Next to the body are the jacket the culprit was wearing and the bag they stole. However, the money is missing from inside the bag, and the dead man doesn't look like the culprit. Meanwhile, Inspector Megure receives a call that the body of a man who has Kume's wallet and 300,000 yen has been discovered.

episodes.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Mojiko & Kura Part) (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are invited to visit Shimonoseki by the lawyer Oi, who they previously met during the inheritance dispute case. The clients are the fourth generation owner Izumiya Makoto and his daughter Kaede, who run the long-established fugu restaurant Izumiya. A thief entered their house while the restaurant was busiest and no one was home and stole their family's treasured cooking pot. While the pot is valuable, to the family, its true worth is in the broth that's seeped into the pot since the restaurant's founding. Conan and his companions question the four suspects identified by Oi's investigation, but...

episodes.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Shimonoseki Part) (2)
episodes.overview: The lawyer Oi sends Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are sent to Izumiya, a long-established fugu restaurant in Shimonoseki, and are hired to find the family's stolen treasured cooking pot. During their investigation, Kogoro comes into contact with a suspicious person in the city at night. Once he's alone, they tell him to mind his own business and attack him. Is his attacker one of the four suspects they questioned during their investigation? Conan visits their restaurants to speak with them again and taste the dishes they pride themselves on.

episodes.title: The Charismatic CEO's Secret Plan
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro discover a body in a busy downtown area. The victim died instantly when he was struck on the head with a metal pipe, and there's a dying message in the street. They visit the victim's apartment, where the property manager tells them he said he'd pay all the rent he owed as early as the next day. The Utagawa Corporation CEO enters the picture when the manager describes how the victim reacted to the magazine he was reading the day of the murder, introducing the possibility that the victim was killed for attempting to blackmail the CEO...

episodes.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Hunt) (1)
episodes.overview: For several days, pairs of unidentified foreigners have been turning up dead. While discussing the case on their way home from school, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara come across a foreigner who has fallen off a building. When Conan sees Vodka on the roof, he instructs Haibara to take the three kids and leave the scene. Conan discovers an FBI ID and phone displaying a coded message on the fallen foreigner and heads to the Kudo family home, where he finds a gathering of FBI agents.

episodes.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Landing) (2)
episodes.overview: For several days, the Black Organization has been killing FBI agents. Conan and the FBI deduce that the Organization must be deciphering the FBI's coded messages, so they decide to use it against them by laying a trap for them. Supposedly dead Camel and Mark, the older brother of a killed agent, are chosen to go to the meeting location. However, no one arrives at the location indicated by the code, and shots are fired on the agents keeping watch. Will Camel be able to evade the Black Organization without them realizing he's still alive?!

episodes.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Identity) (3)
episodes.overview: Cornered by the Black Organization the FBI were trying to trap, Camel drives his car into the ocean. He manages to escape to Umizaru Island, where he warms up at the campsite. However, his location is given away when they spot his fire. The Black Organization arrives on the island in order to kill Camel and get a look at his face. In order to evade them, Camel acquires coffee bean bags and straws from the cafe on the island as instructed by Akai, but... How will the Black Organization's battle against the FBI over Agent Camel end?!

episodes.title: The Cameras Targeting Haibara
episodes.overview: Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko invite Conan and Haibara to the Beika department store. They have their sights set on the department store lottery's grand prize, a Hachijo-jima whale watching tour. The professor asks Haibara to withdraw some cash for him, so she heads to the bank's ATM. However, Kogoro arrived just before her, and his card has been swallowed by the machine. On their way to another branch, they spot a suspicious man in a black coat. He appears shocked when he sees Haibara, and then...

episodes.title: My Beloved Dog Pan-kun Is a Good Boy
episodes.overview: While playing at the park, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara hear a dog barking loudly and a woman screaming. They head to the location of the sound, where they find housewife Yamada Sachiko and her beloved dog Pan being attacked by a man wearing a ski mask. Rather than rescuing his owner, Pan flees during the commotion. With help from Conan and the kids, Sachiko escapes danger. Sachiko, who doesn't know why she was attacked, heads home with Pan once he returns, but Conan and the kids are curious about the masked man's goals and decide to investigate.

episodes.title: The Alley of Sad Betrayal
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro are enjoying a meal at an Italian bar in an alley while chatting with the owner Yamaura when the wall is suddenly demolished. The culprit is Kusumi, the owner of the alley, who has been harassing shop owners who refuse to vacate the alley. One shop owner even died from the stress. Sushi restaurant owner Fumio and creative cuisine restaurant owner Yonezawa arrive when they hear the commotion, and with their help, they successfully run off Kusumi. But when Kogoro visits the bathroom a while later, he discovers someone inside...

episodes.title: Behind the Scenes of the J League Finals
episodes.overview: Kawasaki Frontale takes on FC Tokyo in the J League 30th anniversary match. Conan and the Detective Boys have fun participating in the special event. However, once the event ends and they return to their seats, for some reason Haibara is in a bad mood. She wanted to enter the pitch holding hands with her favorite player Higo of Big Osaka, but she showed up on the wrong day. Haibara expresses her disappointment over her team's loss and Sanada's poor play... only to realize Sanada is standing right next to her! While watching the match together, Haibara notices something odd in the stands.

episodes.title: The Freezing Cold Men
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro encounter some men arguing at the hospital. They are Ryoichi and Reiji, the sons of Kenzo, president of Aizawa foods, and senior executive director Bando. Kenzo, who is inside the treatment room, is the cause of their argument. The three men begin telling Kogoro about the circumstances when Kenzo collapsed in the refrigerated warehouse when the doctor finishes treating Kenzo. Kenzo, who is now awake, tells the others that he simply fell asleep from exhaustion. However, Conan senses there is something off about Kenzo's words and behavior.

episodes.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (1)
episodes.overview: Kazuha is visiting Tokyo, and Conan and Ran join her on a trip to Haido Shrine, which is said to provide matchmaking benefits. Because today is a lucky day, the shrine grounds are crowded with people. Ran, who wasn't aware the shrine was a popular spot, asks Kazuha how she learned about it. She apparently learned about the shrine through Heiji when she happened to see him looking it up on his phone. Based on his recent behavior, Conan realizes Heiji must be here as well and goes after the suspicious man wearing a fox man he spots. Meanwhile, Kazuha notices someone in the crowd who doesn't seem interested in matchmaking...

episodes.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and Ran are invited to Haido Shrine by Kazuha, where they meet Heiji wearing a fox mask. The four of them get caught up in the murder that takes place there. The victim is Hidaka, an investigative police officer, who was looking at flashcards of mugshots of wanted criminals. Believing Hidaka was pursuing wanted criminals at the shrine, Conan and Heiji contact Detective Takagi, who finds three wanted criminals among the shrine visitors. Each criminal has a reason for remaining at the shrine and seems to have been aware of Hidaka's presence...

episodes.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 3
episodes.overview: While on their way to go shopping, Conan and the Detective Boys hear a man scream. They head towards the sound, which brings them to a tanning salon. Inside the building is salon employee Tsunoda Yasuo, who informs them that there is a dead body in the third room from the back. They head down the dark hallway and find the body of Nishitani Shin inside a tanning machine. He is a bodybuilder with tanning gel rubbed all over his body in order to achieve an even tan. The police arrive, and according to their investigation, the gel was poisoned...

episodes.title: The Unfortunate and Suspicious Victim
episodes.overview: While passing by Doterasu Shrine in Beika City, the Detective Boys hear a scream and rush to the scene. They find Jupita on the ground, who struck his head after falling down the stone steps. Jupita is taken to the hospital and is likely to survive.  Jupita's older sister and rising songwriter Juria and her mentor Saimon meet the Detective Boys at the hospital. Just before being attacked by a mugger, Jupita called Juria to tell her he was in another town. The Detective Boys begin investigating why Jupita lied about coming to Beika City.

episodes.title: The Genius Restaurant
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys arrive at a candy shop that's just reopened. A band is playing, and the kids are given plums to celebrate the grand opening. Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta are fascinated by their first traditional candy, but Conan doesn't seem interested. Genta calls Conan arrogant for acting all grown up. The two get into an argument, and Conan leaves alone. On his way home, an old man jumps out of an alleyway, declares he's seen an omurice corpse, and requests Conan's help...!

episodes.title: The Culprit Who Disappeared Into the Sleeping Town
episodes.overview: While walking down a deserted road after completing a job, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro hear the sound of an alarm whistle and a scream. The sound leads them to security guard Nezu Goro, who has been stabbed in the stomach with a knife. Nezu points towards the main avenue and says the words "white clothes" before he dies. Furthermore, at the top of the stairs Nezu is thought to have fallen down is the crying and screaming Yuki Keiko and the body of her husband Yuki Hideto, the IT company president. Conan heads towards the main avenue in pursuit of the culprit where he encounters a young man dressed in black.

episodes.title: Girls Day Mystery
episodes.overview: Even as the band rushes around to get ready, the day of their first live performance is upon them. None of them feel ready, but before they know it, it's time to go on. As Tomori stands on the stage, her legs trembling, the crowd grows restless.

episodes.title: Stakeout 2
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys discover Detectives Takagi and Chiba on a stakeout. Believing the children will leave once they realize there's nothing for them to do, they begin explaining the robbery that occurred that morning. The culprit has been identified as unemployed man Fujiki Kazuma, but he hasn't returned home. The police's investigation turned up Fujiki's ex-girlfriend, who he is likely to turn to for help if he's on the run. Though the children are told the culprit has been identified and there's no mystery to solve, something catches Conan's attention...

episodes.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko visit Teitan Elementary School to take care of the rabbits. The man they encounter there sees Haibara and asks if she's Miyano Akemi's younger sister Shiho. His question frightens Haibara, but he is Teitan Elementary School graduate Murata Sho. His former classmates Yanagimachi Gaku and Ichihashi Seiko join him, and Conan and the Detective Boys learn Akemi attended Teitan Elementary School. The graduates planned to dig up the time capsule they buried when they graduated, but only Akemi knew where it was buried...

episodes.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (2)
episodes.overview: While taking care of the rabbits at the animal shed, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko meet Teitan Elementary School graduates Murata Sho, Yanagimachi Gaku, and Ichihashi Seiko. They've been asked to dig up a time capsule while the rest of their class prepares for the class reunion. Akemi, the only person who knows the location of the buried time capsule, left behind a code, and the Detective Boys work with the graduates to find clues. But something strange happens during the search, and Conan believes someone may be interfering with their search for the time capsule.

episodes.title: The Missing Man's Dream
episodes.overview: Nakajima Takako visits the Mori Detective Agency and explains that her husband is missing. She lost contact with him three days ago, and the police aren't taking her concerns seriously. Conan and Kogoro begin examining the husband's personal effects they received from Takako. Among his belongings are photos from their honeymoon, of her husband diving with his coworker and a ship's captain, and her husband posing with his younger brother in front of their parents' home. They find nothing remarkable on the husband's computer, so they visit his workplace, but...

episodes.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 2
episodes.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara help out at the mini bird park of park administrator Kimishima Tomoshi. With the help almost over, Kimijima asks them to find the owner of the lost baseball cap. Conan and others found Katsumi Wang's home based on the clues left in the hat. The police officer there who was on patrol for burglaries warned Katsumi to pay attention. After hearing this, Conan and others decided to investigate the matter.

episodes.title: Did I Do It?
episodes.overview: Sako Manabu, a man with bloody clothes, arrives at the Mori Detective Agency. After a series of unfortunate events, yesterday Sako went out to drown his sorrows, but he can't remember what happened. When he woke up, his glasses were broken and his clothes were covered with blood. He only had a bump on his head, so he realized the blood belonged to someone else. Concerned that he might have done something terrible, he sought help. Though they initially believe there are no clues, Conan finds hints on Sako's body.

episodes.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (1)
episodes.overview: Ran, Kogoro, and Sonoko arrive at a popular restaurant. Conan and Professor Agasa join them inside after showing up late, where they are greeted by Nanjo, president of Suzuki Security, in disguise. He has been receiving threats since he provoked the thieves who stole a safe the other day, and is feeling constrained by the bodyguards assigned to him. Later, Nanjo steps away to visit the restroom. Conan realizes the professor has been in the restroom for a long time, and when he goes to check on him...!

episodes.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (2)
episodes.overview: While pursuing the culprits who mistakenly kidnapped the professor, Conan is rescued by Kanagawa police officer Hagiwara Chihaya. They pursue the yellow getaway vehicle on Chihaya's motorbike, but the detective badge they had been relying on is disposed of. The professor still has in his possession a listening device, and they use the sound heard through it alone to continue their pursuit...

episodes.title: The Troublesome 20 Million Yen
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran visit the home of client Nemoto Eriko. Three months ago, Eriko lost her husband, Nemoto Yutaka, in a traffic accident. While going through his things, she found 20 million yen in the back of the closet. Believing it could be dirty money, Eriko hired Kogoro to determine where the money came from. Kogoro considers the possibilities of savings or lottery winnings but eventually begins investigating armed robberies that took place recently. They narrow down the list of possible cases and visit the victims.

episodes.title: Pride of the Immortal Man
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro discover the body of Tsukuba Corporation president Tsukuba. He died after falling from the roof of a building, and a mysterious message was inside his pocket. When they visit his office to gather information, the employees respond to the message's words, "third time's the charm". Tsukuba was attacked twice over the span of several days. Just as the police decide to investigate the death as a successful attack by the culprit, Tsukuba's aunt shows up and says she received a call suggesting it might be a suicide. The police begin investigating the death as both a murder and suicide, but...

episodes.title: Akabeko and the Three Lucky Men
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the exhibition of up-and-coming artist Bekobe Motoko. Motoko has attracted international attention with her avant-garde works that combine the traditional akabeko with modern art. While viewing the exhibition, they hear a scream. They rush to the source, where they find Motoko strangled to death. In the body's left hand is an akabeko, and her right hand is pointing at a dying message that says "fuku"...

episodes.title: The Teen Novel That Smells Like Guilt
episodes.overview: This time, Kogoro took over an unusual affair, from a well-known novelist who specialises in teen novels particularly, named Chu Masamura. He requested Kogoro to investigate regarding a deceased, who is called Taizo Yasuki, who died recently during a car accident. He persistantly emphasised his need, to ascertain all of the late Yasuki's friends and acquaintances, especially those "questionable" ones.

episodes.title: The True Culprit Is on the Run
episodes.overview: While playing in the park, Conan and the Detective Boys find a man's body in the bushes. According to the police, the man is Takamatsu Jiro, who worked in a nearby building as a moneylender, leading them to believe the murder may have been an armed robbery or related to money troubles. The blood on the rock used to kill him suggests the culprit is covered in blood. The children, who were in the park the whole time, didn't see anyone suspicious, and the trail of bloody footprints they find ends abruptly.

episodes.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit. The highlight of the exhibition is a tiara set with the world's largest garnet passed down from queen to queen, known as the Queen's Bang. Because Kaito Kid has declared his intent to steal the tiara, a long line has formed at the exhibition. They find Amuro and Azusa in line, and they decide to wait in line together. While waiting, at Azusa's suggestion, Amuro performs a magic trick to kill time, but...

episodes.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (2)
episodes.overview: The Queen's Bang tiara, centerpiece of the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit, is stolen by Kaito Kid! The exhibition hall is suddenly enveloped in white smoke, and by the time it has cleared, the tiara inside the case has vanished. Because a gas mask would ruin his disguise, it's unlikely Kaito Kid was wearing one. The suspects are narrowed down to Amuro, Azusa, and Kazami, who were standing near the tiara without masks, so Conan decides to investigate.

episodes.title: I Was Set Up!
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro visit the home of real estate company manager Sanada on a job. However, Sanada says he no longer needs his help and offers him a cancellation fee. Sanada's eagerness for them to leave leads Kogoro to question him, and Sanada begins explaining that he never intended to kill anyone. Three days earlier, Sanada's real estate office was visited by a man named Inumaru. Blackmailed over wrongdoings he never committed, Sanada asked his friend Kawakatsu for advice, but then something happened.

episodes.title: The Secret Hidden by the Cards
episodes.overview: Mitsuhiko and Genta enjoy playing a trading card game against each other at a table set up in a used bookstore. Conan, Ayumi, Haibara, and Professor Agasa are with them. TCG tournament regulars Nitta, Masaki, Zaizen, and Kuno show up. As usual, Zaizen heads to the bathroom before the game. He instructs Kuno to watch his valuable rare cards, so Nitta, as well as Conan and his friends, move away from the table. Suddenly, the store enters a state of chaos...

episodes.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara visit Professor Agasa while he's sick in the hospital. On their way home, they happen upon Detective Takagi chasing down a robber. Detective Sato arrives from another direction to execute a pincer move on the robber, who is successfully apprehended. When Detective Takagi opens his police notebook to note the time of arrest, he notices the code written there by Detective Date, who passed away in a traffic accident one year ago. Thinking he may be able to decipher it, Conan reviews the code, which leads them to...

episodes.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (2)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Haibara, and Detectives Takagi and Sato decipher the code Detective Date left in his notebook and arrive at café Poirot. They deduce the ransom handoff method described by the kidnapper based on information left at Poirot and successfully rescue Alan, the son of the vice president of a French car maker. The case seems resolved until they learn Alan was being held captive along with his friend Inukai Yuji. They must deduce the location where he is being held based on Alan's time in the car.

episodes.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (1)
episodes.overview: A job brings Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to a resort area in Gunma Prefecture, where they run into Inspector Yamamura investigating a case. Inoue Kohei was murdered by Rube Goldberg Machine, a device made up of a chain reaction of many simple gimmicks.

episodes.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (2)
episodes.overview: When the contraption that was used to kill the victim is found, the falling chimney incident at the resort area Conan, Ran, and Kogoro were visiting is investigated as a homicide. Several of the victim's acquaintances are staying nearby, so they go to question them. The victim's wife, the company's president and CEO, an old friend and shareholder, an investor with whom the victim had a rocky relationship, and the victim's mistress are all suspects. They discover one of the suspects is rather knowledgeable about the type of device found at the villa and becomes the prime suspect, but...

episodes.title: Last Dinner for You
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come across an Italian restaurant on fire. A nearby man rushes inside the building. In an attempt to stop him, Kogoro follows him inside, where he discovers a body. The police investigation identifies the victim as Head Chef Marcello. The man who rushed into the building was Akiyama the waiter. Later, the owner Kurasaka, his daughter Mariko, and the victim's wife Arisa arrive. The police believe a burglar broke into the closed restaurant and ran into the victim while he was cooking, but...

episodes.title: The Holed-Up Sensation
episodes.overview: A man armed with a gun shows up in a residential neighborhood. He takes a woman hostage and holes up inside a nearby home. Conan and Kogoro rush to the scene after seeing the situation on TV. The police are confused by the culprit's nonsensical demands. The homeowner arrives and tells the police not to worry about breaking down doors or walls since the home is vacant and will be demolished the next day. While they're talking outside, two gunshots are heard from inside the house...

episodes.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (1)
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are refused entry to a restaurant, privatized that day to host a masked party for singles. Participating in this event, Inspector Yokomizo meets Chihaya, and both will be confronted with a murder...

episodes.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (2)
episodes.overview: Faced with a murder committed during a singles' masked party, the police try to find the culprit among three suspects. Nothing conclusive emerges from their interrogation, but Conan notices an important detail...

episodes.title: Karate Teacher Mori Ran
episodes.overview: Ran steps in as a temporary karate instructor when the dojo's regular instructor is injured. Just as the class is ending, a scream is heard from the second floor.

episodes.title: Girls Day Mystery 2
episodes.overview: While the boys relax at a hot spring, the girls happen to meet up at a snowy mountain resort. They are enjoying their day together when they discover that strange pranks have been happening at the resort.

episodes.title: The Four-Person Class Reunion
episodes.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to be the bodyguard of the owner of a high-end host club. On the first day of his duties, he finds the owner dead in his own pool. It looks like one of the members of his annual four-person class reunion may be responsible.

episodes.title: Mystery of the Lost Treasure
episodes.overview: Conan accompanies Sonoko to the studio of a famous potter. While there, Conan discovers that one of his pottery pieces has been broken, and worse, that the piece was already sold! It will take Conan's skills in deductive reasoning to figure out the culprit.

episodes.title: The Dangerous Melon Field
episodes.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to investigate the damages and theft of a melon farmer's crops. While at the farm, there are several mysteries they will have to solve...

episodes.title: Stakeout 3
episodes.overview: The kids assist Detective Takagi in trying to catch a murderer. They have to stakeout a bakery to try to find the culprit. Can they focus on solving the crime instead of focusing on pastries and sweets from the bakery?

episodes.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (1)
episodes.overview: Detective Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in Gunma after solving a missing persons case when Detective Mori calls Detective Yamamura. Detective Yamamura asks Detective Mori for help with a murder that took place directly on the border between Gunma and Nagano.

episodes.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (2)
episodes.overview: Detective Yamamura's past holds a key to solving the mystery of the murder on the border between Gunma and Nagano. With the best detectives on the scene, can they solve this murder mystery? Did the victim leave any clues behind?

episodes.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 4
episodes.overview: Ayumi is tired of so many peaceful days in a row and enlists the help of the Detective Boys to hunt for a case. Unfortunately, when one goes looking for trouble, that is exactly what they usually find.

episodes.title: The Detective Who Lost His Mind
episodes.overview: Detective Kogoro is called upon by a beautiful client. Fortunately, Ran sends Conan with her father, since she knows he has a penchant for being blinded by pretty women.

episodes.title: Interrogation Room 2
episodes.overview: A former grade school teacher confesses to committing a murder, but the more the police question him, the more questionable his testimony sounds.

episodes.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (1)
episodes.overview: While at a bookstore, Conan stumbles upon a note from a child named Kazuo who's been kidnapped. Conan is able to switch places with Kazuo, but will he be able to outwit the kidnappers and escape himself?

episodes.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (2)
episodes.overview: Conan helps the married couple that kidnapped Kazuo, doing his best to make sure that their child, Tetsuya, is safely reunited with them. But what fate lays in wait for Kazuo?

episodes.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (1)
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are having lunch and talking about their favorite band, when they spot Kobayashi-sensei, Det. Chiba and Shukichi Haneda. Ayumi assumes they are on a triple date, but...

episodes.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (2)
episodes.overview: A poisoning occurs at the restaurant where Conan and the Detective Boys are dining, but without knowing how to plant the poison, the investigation grinds to a halt. Detective Kobayashi looks to Conan for advice.

episodes.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 3
episodes.overview: At the venue for the "North American Flower Festival: Audition for the Role of the Lord," Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta encounter Makio Yuita and Kōzō Yuita, who are arguing. After Makio leaves, the remaining Kōzō explains that the two of them are brothers who happened to meet at the audition venue.

episodes.title: Best Husband
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit the home of politician Reiko Mutsu. They are guided by her secretary, Shinji Inui, and wait inside the mansion, but Reiko doesn't appear for some time. Suddenly, Reiko's scream echoes through the mansion.

episodes.title: Misfortune of the Positive Man
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys become acquainted with a kind man named Shojichi Aida. While heading to Aida's apartment, they encounter a quarrel between his neighbor, Nenji Kotakara, and the landlord, Teruyo Imaizumi.

episodes.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (1)
episodes.overview: A stage play modeled after Kogoro and Heiji is being planned, and Conan and the others have come to Kyoto for a meeting. When they visit the director's home, they find the producer, stage manager, and scriptwriter there.

episodes.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (2)
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Heiji are at the home of the director, Kabumoto, for a meeting about a stage play. Present are also Momiji Ooka, who claims to be Heiji's fiancée, and Hyoe Kuroda, an officer from the Metropolitan Police Department.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys are distressed to discover the flavor of popular ramen shop Ogataken's flavor has changed, so they head to the restaurant to investigate.

episodes.title: The Moving Police Box
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys help with the unveiling of a mobile police box car. While the vehicle is touring around, it is hijacked by some robbers, and everyone onboard is taken hostage.

episodes.title: The Sister Troubled by Her Naughty Brother
episodes.overview: Shigatsu Makabe comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request after malicious flyers were posted on his apartment condominium. Kogoro, who was conducting surveillance at the condominium, apprehends a suspicious young man, but... a few days later, a body is found in a unit of a luxury condominium.

episodes.title: Girls Day Mystery 3
episodes.overview: The "Five Female Detectives" aka Ran, Sonoko, Haibara, Ayumi and Detective Sato sense a suspicious high-paying part-time job advertisement that involves "dressing as ninjas and going to designated locations" to hint at a crime, and decide to go undercover to investigate.

episodes.title: The Mori Family House Sits
episodes.overview: Kogoro receives a request from literary critic Takahiko Kamiyu: "I am planning to go to the countryside, so I would like you to stay home and watch over my house for three days."

episodes.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys visit the Edogawa Rampo Residence under the guidance of Ms. Kobayashi. Professor Goto, who manages the residence, learns about the Detective Boys and offers to guide them through the storehouse, which is not usually open to the public.

episodes.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (2)
episodes.overview: While Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting the Edogawa Ranpo Residence with Kobayashi-sensei, a series of murders occur. Conan realizes the case isn't over yet and rushes to solve the crime before another victim can be killed, but the culprit is already closing in on their next target.

episodes.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (1)
episodes.overview: Conan visits Sera's hotel room at the Haido Hotel, lured in by the code used in the hotel serial bombing case. However, they realize the hotel they're at is the bomber's next target when they happen to be present when the next bomb threat is discovered.

episodes.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (2)
episodes.overview: With help from Haido Hotel's lawyer Kisaki Eri, Conan and Sera get their hands on the previous hotel bomber codes and narrow down the room with the bomb to six rooms. With the time limit approaching, will Conan and Sera be able to identify the culprit?

episodes.title: The Whistling Bookstore 4
episodes.overview: While reading at Tamaki Book Cafe, the Detective Boys meet Komachi Ami, who accidentally sold a precious book that was a keepsake from her father.

episodes.title: Stakeout 4
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys come to an amusement park that is closing today. There, they find Detectives Takagi and Chiba disguised as security guards and holding out a stakeout.

episodes.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya, go to a beach in Shizuoka that is collaborating with Kamen Yaiba. Wakasa and Okiya meet and negotiate! Furthermore, an incident occurs at the beach house.

episodes.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (2)
episodes.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, who are accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya to the beach, encounter a case. The victim is the manager of a beach house, and the suspects are the staff. Who is the culprit? And what is the relationship between Wakasa and Okiya?

episodes.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (1)
episodes.overview: Kaito Kid declares his intent to steal the Siren Splash, a crown embedded with one of the world's largest tourmalines. However, Suzuki Jirokichi is confident in his newest anti-Kid device, the Fujin Road. As the clock counts down to Kid's arrival, will Conan the Kid Killer once against be able to stop the Reiwa Wizard?

episodes.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (2)
episodes.overview: Kid makes the Siren Splash crown vanish from its display case at the Suzuki building, but the alarm was never triggered. Just how did he do it?

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are invited to a dance party. While changing into their dance shoes, a scream is heard.

episodes.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran visit Yakushima in Kagoshima Prefecture to investigate the case of a body being abandoned on Jomon cedar.

episodes.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (2)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is certain the culprit is Tsukada, but Conan and Ran aren't so sure.

episodes.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 2
episodes.overview: A woman is robbed at a shrine's jewel-washing festival.

episodes.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate a theft at a charity concert that took place three years ago.

episodes.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (2)
episodes.overview: The video evidence suggests that the band's guitarist stole the donations from the charity concert, but Conan suspects another member.

episodes.title: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House
episodes.overview: A couple discovers a body inside the walls of their new home.

episodes.title: The Whereabouts of the Goodbye
episodes.overview: Kogoro's client is found dead in her apartment. The police suspect suicide, but Conan isn't so sure.

episodes.title: When the Shishiodoshi Sounds
episodes.overview: Conan investigates Komada murder; a photo captures the killer’s strike but hides his face. Who is the culprit?

episodes.title: The Secret's Afterimage
episodes.overview: Megure suspects his subordinate of having an affair.

episodes.title: Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys film a documentary about Kogoro and the serial vandalism case he solved.

episodes.title: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark
episodes.overview: When a valuable old coin is found at an inn, a man is murdered and the coin goes missing.

episodes.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Bloodstained Knight
episodes.overview: Conan and his friends attend a chess tournament to show support for Inspector Shiratori.

episodes.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Perceptive Devil
episodes.overview: While watching Conan solve the murder, Kuroda recalls an unsolved case from 17 years ago.

episodes.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Far-Sighted Bishop
episodes.overview: At a chess event, a case echoes a 17-year-old murder. Conan is asked to uncover the shadow behind it.

episodes.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Queen's Gambit
episodes.overview: 17 years ago, Kuroda helped Asaka escape. Now, Rum sets his sights on a new target tied to the past.

episodes.title: Genta's Casebook of the Eel
episodes.overview: While Genta delivers food for an eel restaurant, the chef is stabbed in the chest.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (1)
episodes.overview: A rumor begins spreading at Teitan Elementary School about a man-eating classroom.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (2)
episodes.overview: Conan identifies the culprit who started the fire that could cancel the class visit.

episodes.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (1)
episodes.overview: Heiji and Kazuha happen to find themselves on the same bullet train bound for Tokyo as Momiji and Iori.

episodes.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (2)
episodes.overview: Momiji's butler Iori becomes involved in a murder on a train, and Momiji is taken hostage.

episodes.title: It's a Ghost!
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys investigate a ghost that appears on the roof of a building every Thursday night.

episodes.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (1)
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate the mysterious death of a fisherman in a small town famous for its boathouses.

episodes.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (2)
episodes.overview: One mysterious murder turns into two in a remote port town in Kyoto prefecture.

episodes.title: The Hero of Ishinomaki
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys go to Miyagi Prefecture to film an episode of Kamen Yaiba.

episodes.title: Find the Phantom Giant
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys encounter Takagi and Chiba, who are looking for a tall man to verify a suspect's alibi.

episodes.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (1)
episodes.overview: A sudden downpour forces Conan and his friends to seek shelter at a temple.

episodes.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (2)
episodes.overview: The missing monk turns up dead, but Kogoro is still missing. Could it be the curse of the Crimson Skeleton?

episodes.title: The Lucky Cat Saw Everything
episodes.overview: While birdwatching, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro spot a suspicious man driving away from house with a body inside.

episodes.title: Buchi Returns a Favor
episodes.overview: A man identifying himself as Buchi calls the police station with information for Detective Takagi.

episodes.title: Arrest That Face
episodes.overview: Ayumi sees a man with a face identical to one on a wanted poster.

episodes.title: The Interrogation Room 3
episodes.overview: A rising young actress admits to murdering her director but later recants her confession.

episodes.title: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (1)
episodes.overview: Detectives Takagi and Sato pursue a kidnapper to the historic red-brick warehouse in Yokohama.

episodes.title: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (2)
episodes.overview: The kids decipher the Dice Man's code while the police pursue the culprit at the red-brick warehouse.

episodes.title: Girls Day Mystery 4
episodes.overview: The ladies meet at an all-you-can-eat cake buffet, and the women at a nearby table suddenly collapse.

episodes.title: Episode "ZERO" Kudo Shinichi and the Aquarium Case
episodes.overview: Before he became Conan, Shinichi and Ran's trip to the aquarium is derailed by a murder.

episodes.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 3
episodes.overview: Kogoro and Conan are invited to attend an event in Furai City as special guests.

episodes.title: Double Alibi
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired by an up-and-coming clockmaker to investigate a threatening note.

episodes.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Tottori Tour)
episodes.overview: A waitress disappears from the ryokan where Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are staying at the Misasa Hot Springs.

episodes.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Misasa Arc)
episodes.overview: The missing lover's fake disappearance turns into a real kidnapping.

episodes.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 4
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys come across a case reminiscent of "The Adventure of the Abbey Grange".

episodes.title: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (1)
episodes.overview: Kaito Kid sneaks into the exhibition room to steal the Azure Throne only to discover a body sitting in it.

episodes.title: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (2)
episodes.overview: Hakuba, the disguised Kid, and Conan expose the murderer. But Hakuba harbors yet another suspicion…

episodes.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (1)
episodes.overview: A man is found dead at an art museum dedicated to spirals.

episodes.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (2)
episodes.overview: A vanishing culprit, a secret room, and a second murder. Conan closes in on the center of the mystery.

episodes.title: The Cosplay Rider of the Wind
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys and a Kamen Yaiba impostor chase a serial purse snatcher on a motorcycle.

episodes.title: Cinderalla's Shoe
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired to find the Cinderella of the son of a business conglomerate.

episodes.title: The Detective Boys VS the Silver Detectives 2
episodes.overview: A woman asks a group of senior detectives to find her missing husband.

episodes.title: The Porch Pirate Epidemic
episodes.overview: Kogoro is hired to catch a porch pirate.

episodes.title: I'm the Culprit
episodes.overview: Four people confess to committing the same murder, but none of them will explain how they did it.

episodes.title: I Cannot Lie to Archery
episodes.overview: Two brothers are suspected of murdering their father with a bow and arrow.

episodes.title: Sonoko and Conan's Spooky Story Night
episodes.overview: Conan and Sonoko are attacked by a Hannya and get lost in the woods.

episodes.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (1)
episodes.overview: Conan and Azusa vanish while being followed by some suspicious people.

episodes.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (2)
episodes.overview: Can the high school girl trio and Amuro rescue Conan and Azusa from their kidnappers?

episodes.title: The Man Who Came Falling Down
episodes.overview: A man comes tumbling down some steps while Kogoro and Conan are looking for a lost notebook.

episodes.title: The J.League Starting Whistle
episodes.overview: The Detective Boys go to watch the J.League opener, but there's a bomb somewhere inside the stadium.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Stone Age Village
episodes.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran go to a remote mountain to investigate the appearance of an alleged Stone Age man.

episodes.title: Who's the Target?
episodes.overview: Conan and Kogoro find themselves in a race against time to determine who or what the culprit poisoned.

series.title: Dream to You
series.tagline: Our greatest story has yet to be filmed.
series.overview: Two high school classmates bond over a shared love of filmmaking, turning a deep friendship into first love before an unexpected separation tears them apart. Years later, they reunite with their lives completely transformed—she’s lost her passion, while he’s become a celebrated director. Determined to reignite her dreams, he must first confront the hurt he left behind.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: High school exes reunite in their 30s with their life outlooks swapped – can they reconcile and heal from their pasts through the art of film?

episodes.title: Su-bin’s Return
episodes.overview: Woo Su-bin, a new director, wins an award at an international film festival. During his acceptance speech, he thanks his first love for giving him a dream. After the festival, he visits Korea to meet his first love, Joo Yi-jae, who wanted to become a director but works as a reporter.

episodes.title: Their Past And Present
episodes.overview: During their senior year of high school, Yi-jae is an aspiring amateur filmmaker. Su-bin also decides to become a director after helping Yi-jae and spending time with her. Although Yi-jae wins an award at a youth film festival, her family fails to show up.

episodes.title: A New Bond And A Broken Bond
episodes.overview: Yi-jae travels to her hometown to meet and cast Su-bin. As they spend time together, they share a deep conversation about their past. However, when Su-bin reveals his hidden history, Yi-jae responds with sarcasm, finding him pathetic.

episodes.title: The Contract
episodes.overview: After mulling it over, Yi-jae finally makes a contract with Su-bin, and they move to Bunam to write the script for Gyeongseong Love Song. Working together, Yi-jae’s feelings towards him begin to grow despite herself. Meanwhile, Ha-na protects Yu-geon from Sang-yeon.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.overview: After spending a night with Sa-rang, In-wook decides to appear on her show because he wants to keep the relationship with her. Yu-geon saves Ha-na from people putting her down, and they open up about their inner wounds and dreams. Meanwhile, Su-bin and Yi-jae’s relationship grows steadily as their work goes well.

episodes.title: The Pre-Production Of Gyeongseong Love Song
episodes.overview: Su-bin tries to help Yi-jae in every way after learning about her accident. Therefore, when pre-production for Gyeongseong Love Song begins, Su-bin goes on location scouting and Yi-jae stays indoors for the script meeting. However, it makes Yi-jae feel like she is not approved by the crew because of Su-bin’s overprotection.

episodes.title: Ha-na’s Decision
episodes.overview: Su-bin and Yi-jae reunite to work together on a new project. Upon learning that Yu-geon is now working alongside Soo-hee, Su-bin can't hide a hint of disappointment, while Yi-jae reacts in a way no one expects. Meanwhile, Ha-na is hurt when Yu-geon begins to distance himself from her.

episodes.title: Chaos During Filming On Set
episodes.overview: Filming for Su-bin and Yi-jae’s movie finally begins, but chaos erupts when Soo-hee suddenly shows up on set and causes a scene. The situation escalates to the point where replacing the male lead is even brought up. Meanwhile, Ha-na gives up her rebellion against Soo-hee and decides to renew her contract with her.

episodes.title: A Connection That Goes Way Back
episodes.overview: Su-bin gets extremely jealous when Seong-moo appears on set and shows how close he is to Yi-jae. The Gyeongseong Love Song crew decides to go on a retreat, and Seong-moo joins as well. From dodgeball to grilling meat, the competition between Su-bin and Seong-moo gets fierce.

episodes.title: Confronting The Truth
episodes.overview: News breaks that Su-bin is Ha-na's half-sibling, and reporters flock to the filming location. Due to the scandal, Yi-jae has to handle the movie shoot all by herself. However, the production comes to a halt due to investment issues.

episodes.title: Achieving One’s Dream
episodes.overview: Su-bin tells Yi-jae that he’ll drop out of the movie production so that it can proceed smoothly. Yi-jae convinces CEO Ahn to reconsider firing Su-bin. Yi-jae wants to study film abroad, but she struggles to tell Su-bin about it.

episodes.title: The End Of A Love Like War
episodes.overview: Yi-jae leaves for Montreal to study film in greater depth. Su-bin goes to the airport to stop her, but he misses her. Gyeongseong Love Song gets released successfully, but Su-bin can’t help but feel empty.

series.title: Fightland
series.overview: A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.

episodes.title: The Only Round That Matters Is the Next One
episodes.overview: After years in prison, a boxing champion returns home, intent on avenging his brother's death.

episodes.title: Brick by Brick
episodes.overview: Duke must improvise to keep his mission on track, but he finds that success comes at a cost.

episodes.title: No Innocents
episodes.overview: Turning up the heat on the Marshalls, Duke is drawn in deeper than he ever could have imagined.

episodes.title: Protect Yourself at All Times
episodes.overview: London's gangland is pushed to the brink of war, but for Duke, the consequences hit painfully close to home.

episodes.title: I Want This
episodes.overview: A dangerous rescue operation gives Duke a chance at redemption, but an unexpected betrayal reignites his all-consuming thirst for vengeance.

episodes.title: Without Me, There Is No You

series.title: Flex X Cop
series.tagline: Money vs. money. Power vs. power.
series.overview: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Jin Yi-soo, a privileged heir, joins a police force specializing in robbery cases, leveraging his wealth and connections, but clashes with his no-nonsense partner, Detective Lee Kang-hyun.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Jin Isoo, the naïve heir of Hansu Group, gets into a fight with a stranger and Ganghyun arrests him.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A model is found dead on a yacht. Isoo gets his first murder case and investigates with Ganghyun.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team finds the key suspect in the model murder case. However, other suspects come to light.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A famous painter has been murdered in an art gallery. Meanwhile, Yi Soo visits his childhood home.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yi Soo captures the prime suspect in the painter's case, and he learns something unexpected.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The death of an elderly is all but simple. Kang Hyun works to prove it, and Yi Soo seeks other methods.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A bizarre body is found in an office. Isoo and Ganghyun start investigating the mysterious death.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A man is caught at the suspect's house. Isoo investigates the link between the found item and death.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Isoo recovers memories with hypnosis and looks for Myeongchul. Meanwhile, an actress is found dead.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Isoo and Ganghyun discover the actress had a stalker and was harassed by him before her death.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The sudden death of two people affiliated with Oryunhoe. Ganghyun tries to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Isoo encounters Ganghyun at Oryunhoe, and they face a crisis of being exposed to the cult leader.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.overview: An unknown body is found in Myeongchul's backyard amidst the election. Isoo investigates the case.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The team arrests the suspect in the case. Meanwhile, Isoo discovers secrets within the household.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Truths start to unfold about his mother's death. Isoo is confronted with an unbearable reality.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Following a gruelling stint at the police academy, where his unruly nature frequently clashed with that of his hellish drill instructor, Isoo returns to work as a fully-fledged police officer, only to discover that his former instructor, Joo Hyera, is now the new leader of the violent crimes team. And as if that wasn't bad enough - the pair are now partners!

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While filming a documentary, Isoo receives an anonymous threat: "Detective Jin. Let the game begin."

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After a string of attacks, Isoo flees to a safe house. The bomber's final message: "FINAL ROUND."

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Isoo and Hyera investigate a haunted house tip. They're attacked and wake up bound inside the house.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Five bodies are found in the abandoned house. Violent Crime Investigation Team 1 begins the hunt.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A concierge is found dead in a hotel room on White Day. Could this be a crime of passion?

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While questioning the concierge's murder suspect, the hotel owner disappears. The team gives chase...

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A magician dies in a fire onstage. Isoo and Hyera are stunned to meet a man with his exact face.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The boss of the Hammurabi gang emerges as a new suspect. Isoo devises a plan to confront him.

series.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
series.tagline: Two geniuses, one piano - and dissonance that resonates.
series.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Pi-o is known around school as an unrivaled talent — until he meets the mysterious Choi Jeong-yo and realizes he may have finally met his match.

series.title: FROM
series.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Disoriented travelers find themselves trapped in a mysterious town with no exit, where malevolent forces toy with their minds and hunt them by night.

episodes.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
episodes.overview: The Matthews’ family road trip takes a horrifying turn when they are detoured to a small pastoral town from which they cannot leave. When their family RV crashes, Sheriff Boyd Stevens and other residents rush to save them before the sun goes down.

episodes.title: The Way Things Are Now
episodes.overview: At Colony House, Tabitha and Julie grapple with their new nightmarish reality. Out in the forest, Jim, Boyd and Kristi struggle to treat Ethan’s injuries. Tragedy strikes from an unexpected source as a new threat arises among the residents of the town.

episodes.title: Choosing Day
episodes.overview: The Matthews family must choose which of the two settlements they will join. Meanwhile, Jade comes to terms with his situation and Boyd is faced with an impossible decision that strikes at the very heart of life in the town.

episodes.title: A Rock and a Farway
episodes.overview: Julie finds comfort in her new friends. Jim and Tabitha deal with their struggling marriage. Ethan ventures off into the forest with Victor. Father Khatri urges Boyd to embrace his role as leader. Sara receives another horrifying directive.

episodes.title: Silhouettes
episodes.overview: Jim, Tabitha and Ethan begin asking questions about where they are in the hopes it may lead them home. Ellis and Fatima show Julie the lighter side of life in town. Jade struggles to make sense of their situation. Boyd seeks guidance.

episodes.title: Book 74
episodes.overview: Boyd’s plan to head off into the forest provokes an unexpected response from Kenny. Jade enlists Jim’s help with an experiment. Tabitha makes a chilling discovery that sends her down a unique path searching for answers.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.overview: Father Khatri tells Boyd why he believes Sara may be useful. Jim and Tabitha find comfort in each other. Colony House celebrates the one-year anniversary of Fatima’s arrival with a party that goes terribly wrong.

episodes.title: Broken Windows, Open Doors
episodes.overview: In the wake of another death, Boyd questions his decision to leave. Kenny steps up and embraces his new role. Jim rallies the town around his idea to build a radio tower. Fatima urges Ellis to make amends with his father before it’s too late.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.overview: Boyd and Sara journey deeper into the forest than Boyd has ever gone, encountering new and terrifying mysteries. Jim’s confidence in the radio tower begins to wane. An unexpected tragedy causes Donna to unravel. Kenny and Kristi share a moment.

episodes.title: Oh, the Places We'll Go
episodes.overview: Boyd draws strength from an unlikely source. Jim’s radio tower yields consequences which rock him to his very core. The hole that Tabitha has been digging leads her somewhere, and to someone, she could never have expected.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Hidden truths about the nature and terrifying origins of the town begin to emerge, even as life for its residents is plunged into chaos by the arrival of mysterious newcomers.

episodes.title: Strangers in a Strange Land
episodes.overview: In Sheriff Boyd’s absence, Donna and Kenny struggle to manage the chaos as a busload of unwitting newcomers arrives in town. Victor and Tabitha go on a chilling journey through the nightmarish labyrinth of tunnels beneath the town.

episodes.title: The Kindness of Strangers
episodes.overview: A tense night in the diner as the residents and newcomers wait for sunrise. Fear permeates the wreckage beneath the Matthews house, as Jim and Tom struggle to keep a panicked bus passenger quiet.

episodes.title: Tether
episodes.overview: Kenny and Ellis make a grisly discovery out in the forest. Boyd struggles with the reality of what’s happening to him.

episodes.title: This Way Gone
episodes.overview: As Boyd’s condition grows more alarming, Sara’s return to town puts him in a difficult position. Jim shares a troubling new theory about the town.

episodes.title: Lullaby
episodes.overview: Sara must face the music, as word of her return spreads through town. Victor and Jade strike an unlikely bargain.

episodes.title: Pas de Deux
episodes.overview: Tensions run high at Colony House when word of the coming food shortage leaks out. A night at the clinic takes a terrifying turn.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.overview: Boyd and Kristi seek to capitalize on the apparent death of the Nightmare Creature. Jim finds an unlikely ally in the volatile Randall.

episodes.title: Forest for the Trees
episodes.overview: In their pursuit of the truth about the town, Jim and Randall hatch a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, a new form of terror is brewing.

episodes.title: Ball of Magic Fire
episodes.overview: Panic spreads through town as the residents face a chilling new threat to their survival. Jim realizes the magnitude of the mistake he made by enlisting Randall in his cause.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.overview: Boyd fears he may have finally run out of answers, as the residents of town prepare for the end. Tabitha clings to the belief that the children could be the key to their salvation.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The weather grows colder, food is scarce, and every day is more difficult than the last. Will the fight for survival force the residents of town to sacrifice the very humanity that sets them apart from the monsters they fear?

episodes.title: Shatter
episodes.overview: Boyd feels the town slipping away from him as the weather grows colder and the residents more desperate.

episodes.title: When We Go
episodes.overview: Boyd struggles to find a path forward as the town bids farewell to one of their own; Fatima's health takes a turn for the worse; Tabitha finds help from an unlikely ally.

episodes.title: Mouse Trap
episodes.overview: Kenny leads a group into the forest in search of food; Donna and Ellis try to talk Boyd out of a dangerous plan; Tabitha makes a mind-bending discovery; Fatima questions the welfare of her unborn baby.

episodes.title: There and Back Again
episodes.overview: Boyd is forced to make a tough decision when newcomers arrive in town at nightfall; Victor unearths memories from the past in the hopes of finding answers.

episodes.title: The Light of Day
episodes.overview: Victor must face a painful reminder of his past; Julie looks for ways to cope with her trauma; Boyd struggles to keep the town safe as the residents begin to question his judgement; Tabitha tries to adjust to her new surroundings.

episodes.title: Scar Tissue
episodes.overview: Fatima and Ellis make a big decision about her pregnancy; Boyd fears for the future of his family; Tensions rise in the Matthews house; Randall opens up to Marielle about his fears.

episodes.title: These Fragile Lives
episodes.overview: The edges begin to fray as concerns about Fatima's pregnancy deepen; Jade follows a clue trail into the forest; Julie and Randall seek a bit of normalcy.

episodes.title: Thresholds
episodes.overview: Accusations start flying and truths come to light in the aftermath of a tragedy; Victor struggles to recover long-buried memories about the town's past; Julie and Ethan search for answers about the mysterious ruins in the woods.

episodes.title: Revelations: Chapter One
episodes.overview: Tensions are at an all time high as the residents of town learn that one of their own has gone missing.

episodes.title: Revelations: Chapter Two
episodes.overview: Boyd is pushed to his limit as time begins to run out for someone he loves; Randall is haunted by his trauma and Victor reveals a hard truth; Tabitha's unlikely journey takes a shocking turn.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The closer the town residents get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want? Will Jade and Tabitha’s revelation be the key to finally going home? How much longer can Boyd hold the town together, even as his body and mind are falling apart? And what role will the town’s most recent arrival play in the events to come? Season Four will open doors that some in town will end up wishing had remained closed.

episodes.title: The Arrival
episodes.overview: A new arrival throws the town into chaos. Jade and Tabitha struggle with their revelation at the Bottle Tree. Boyd grapples with the implications of Smiley’s return.

episodes.title: Fray
episodes.overview: A gruesome discovery sends shockwaves through the town as Jade and Tabitha struggle with the weight of their revelation.

episodes.title: Merrily We Go
episodes.overview: Boyd tries to save Acosta from herself as Julie digs deeper into her newfound abilities; Tabitha embarks on a desperate gamble and Victor joins Ethan in a quest for answers.

episodes.title: Of Myths and Monsters
episodes.overview: An ominous discovery puts Boyd and his trusted circle on high alert; Julie searches for a way to harness her newfound abilities and Sara is once again tortured by the voices in her head.

episodes.title: What a Long Strange Trip It's Been
episodes.overview: Boyd and Jade set off on a desperate, mind-bending search for answers, while a food run to the settlement takes a chilling turn.

episodes.title: The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter
episodes.overview: Boyd and Jade find themselves at odds over whether or not they can trust the knowledge in Jade's head; deeply troubling news from the settlement makes its way back to town.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.overview: As Tabitha and Jade’s troubling history is brought to light, things begin to unravel for another resident in town. Boyd wants to test a dangerous theory.

episodes.title: Heavy Is the Head
episodes.overview: A dangerous plan begins to take shape. How much is Boyd willing to risk for the chance to get everyone home?  Fatima and Henry find themselves at two very different and disturbing crossroads.  Victor helps Tabitha and Ethan prepare for the worst.

episodes.title: The Calm Before
episodes.overview: The residents of town stand at a crossroads unlike any they’ve faced before as Boyd sets a daring, and dangerous, plan in motion.

episodes.title: If a Tree Falls in the Forest…
episodes.overview: Boyd’s quest to lead the residents home reaches a terrifying crossroads, and nothing will ever be the same again.

series.title: Furious
series.tagline: There's a thin line between hunter and prey.
series.overview: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

episodes.title: The Gorgon
episodes.overview: Alice investigates a suspicious overdose as Catherine plots her next move.

episodes.title: My life had stood - a Loaded Gun
episodes.overview: Alice fixates on the case, leading to old habits. Catherine lays her trap.

episodes.title: Memory Distortion
episodes.overview: Alice’s work on the case forces her to face her past. Catherine heads home.

episodes.title: Flash Flood
episodes.overview: Alice and Danny pursue a lead out of town. Catherine assumes a new identity.

episodes.title: Pick a Sticker
episodes.overview: Alice and Catherine take extreme measures to get what they want.

episodes.title: They Make a Noise Like Feathers
episodes.overview: Alice has one hour to get Catherine to trust her.

episodes.title: Some Days It Don't Come Easy
episodes.overview: Alice spirals after Danny must decide what to do with sensitive information.

episodes.title: Hart Island
episodes.overview: Alice and Catherine converge.

series.title: Futurama
series.overview: The adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy, Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.

cast.name: Billy West
cast.character: Fry / Professor Farnsworth / Zoidberg / Zapp Brannigan (voice)

episodes.title: Space Pilot 3000
episodes.overview: On New Year's Eve 1999, Pizza Delivery boy Philip J. Fry accidentally falls into a cryogenic chamber and is frozen for 1,000 years. Finally unfrozen, he explores New New York, meets his new best friend (a kleptomaniacal robot named Bender) and goes to work for his great-great-great-great-grand-nephew's space delivery business.
