episodes.title: The Series Has Landed
episodes.overview: For the crew's first mission, they must deliver a crate full of toys for an arcade game to the moon. Fry is very excited, while it is not really a big deal in the year 3000. Fry tries to persuade Leela to go exploring on the moon, while Amy tries to recover the keys to the Planet Express Ship.

episodes.title: I, Roommate
episodes.overview: When it is discovered that Philip has been living in the Planet Express office, he is forced to move out. Trying to sleep standing up in Bender's closet-sized apartment doesn't work, so they go looking for a place both can be comfortable. Unfortunately, Bender is incompatible with the ideal apartment they do find until he has a radical... modification which makes him less than happy.

episodes.title: Love's Labours Lost in Space
episodes.overview: On a mission intended to save endangered animals on a collapsing planet, Leela and the crew run into legendary starship captain Zapp Brannigan. A self-proclaimed ladies man, Zapp sees Leela as a potential new conquest. When the captain refuses to aid the animal rescue, Leela and her crew try to leave Zapp's starship. But Zapp throws Fry and Bender in jail, and summons Leela to his "Lovenasium". They ultimately escape and arrive on the doomed planet, where Leela finally finds love - with a cute, and very useful, creature named Nibbler.

episodes.title: Fear of a Bot Planet
episodes.overview: Fry and Leela disguise themselves as robots to find Bender after he fails to return from a delivery to a robot planet, only to learn that he has become a celebrity in a culture which fears humans.

episodes.title: A Fishful of Dollars
episodes.overview: Fry discovers his bank account interest has made him a billionaire and buys the one thing the year 3000 doesn't have, anchovies.

episodes.title: My Three Suns
episodes.overview: Delivery Boy Philip J. Fry is promoted to Emperor after accidentally drinking his fluid-based predecessor.

episodes.title: A Big Piece of Garbage
episodes.overview: A big piece of garbage that was released a thousand years ago is now on the way to Earth to destroy it. After Fry, Leela and Bender fail on placing a bomb on it, the city has to build another big piece of garbage, yet that may be a problem since trash doesn't exist in year 3000.

episodes.title: Hell Is Other Robots
episodes.overview: During a Beastie Boys concert, Bender runs into a high school buddy, Fender. He invites him to a party, which turns out to be robots getting high off of electricity, or "jacking on". After one try, Bender is hooked.

episodes.title: A Flight to Remember
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew take a space cruise vacation. Leela tells Captain Zapp Brannigan that Fry is her boyfriend and Amy tells the same thing to her parents. Bender falls in love with a rich female robot. Problems start when the spaceship approaches a black hole.

episodes.title: Mars University
episodes.overview: Fry, Leela, Bender and Farnsworth have to go to Mars University where Fry has to share a room with a talking monkey, Farnsworth's last invention. The monkey becomes a real headache when he starts beating Fry in all areas. Meanwhile, Bender is hanging out with nerd robots.

episodes.title: When Aliens Attack
episodes.overview: The Omicronians invade Earth, demanding to see the lost final episode of the 1999 TV show Single Female Lawyer. The Planet Express crew must re-enact the episode to appease the invading aliens.

episodes.title: Fry & the Slurm Factory
episodes.overview: When Fry wins a free tour of the Slurm soda factory, he and his friends split off from the tour group and make a horrifying discovery concerning the "secret ingredient" that makes Slurm so addictive.

episodes.title: I Second That Emotion
episodes.overview: Professor Farnsworth installs an empathy chip in Bender after the inconsiderate robot flushes Nibbler down the toilet. With his newfound emotions, a concerned Bender ventures into the mutant-infested sewers to rescue Leela's beloved pet.

episodes.title: Brannigan, Begin Again
episodes.overview: Upon destroying the new DOOP headquarters, Zapp Brannigan and Kif find themselves court-martialed and dishonorably discharged. They take up jobs at Planet Express, where Kif learns what respect feels like and Zapp incites a mutiny against Leela.

episodes.title: A Head in the Polls
episodes.overview: When the price of titanium skyrockets, Bender pawns his titanium-rich body and lives the high life as just a head. But when the head-in-a-jar of Richard M. Nixon uses Bender's body to run for election for President of Earth, Bender vows to get his rightful property back.

episodes.title: Xmas Story
episodes.overview: To apologize for an inconsiderate remark, Fry searches for the perfect Xmas gift for Leela, all the while trying to avoid the murderous SantaBot, whose standards for niceness are astronomically high.

episodes.title: Why Must I Be a Crustacean in Love?
episodes.overview: When Dr. Zoidberg runs amok during the Decapodian mating season, Fry sets out to teach him how to woo a mate. Things backfire when Zoidberg's desired mate falls for Fry instead, and Zoidberg challenges Fry to a battle to the death.

episodes.title: Put Your Head on My Shoulders
episodes.overview: Fry's brief relationship with Amy is forcibly prolonged when a near-fatal car crash leaves Fry's head grafted to Amy's left shoulder. Meanwhile, Bender cashes in on Valentine's Day by starting a dating service.

episodes.title: Lesser of Two Evils
episodes.overview: Fry suspects Bender's new buddy, a bending unit named Flexo who looks almost exactly like Bender, of being pure evil. When a valuable atom of Jumbonium goes missing, Fry suspects Flexo, but can't tell which robot is which.

episodes.title: Raging Bender
episodes.overview: Bender is the featured attraction in the Ultimate Robot Fighting League, but his glory is short-lived when he is instructed to intentionally lose his next match. Leela vows to lead Bender to victory, in an effort to show up her unsupportive martial arts teacher.

episodes.title: A Bicyclops Built For Two
episodes.overview: Leela meets Alkazar, who claims to be the only other remaining cyclops in the universe. But when Alkazar invites Leela back to his home planet and treats her like a slave, Fry suspects that something is amiss.

episodes.title: How Hermes Requisitioned His Groove Back
episodes.overview: When Hermes takes a stress-relieving vacation, replacement bureaucrat Morgan Proctor becomes infatuated with Fry. Bender threatens to publicize their affair, but Morgan removes Bender's memory and hides it within the cavernous Central Bureaucracy.

episodes.title: A Clone of My Own
episodes.overview: Professor Farnsworth unveils his clone, Cubert Farnsworth, whom he plans to leave everything to upon his retirement. But Cubert wants no part of Farnsworth's lifestyle, prompting the professor into a premature retirement on the Near-Death Star.

episodes.title: The Deep South
episodes.overview: A fishing trip over the ocean takes a turn for the worse when a colossal mouth bass pulls the Planet Express ship to the bottom of the sea. There, Fry falls in love with a mermaid named Umbriel, and the crew discovers the sunken city of Atlanta, Georgia.

episodes.title: Bender Gets Made
episodes.overview: Bender takes a new job in the Robot Mafia, but his loyalty is tested when he goes along on the robotic gangster's efforts to rob the Planet Express ship.

episodes.title: The Problem with Popplers
episodes.overview: The crew discovers an irresistible source of food on a distant planet, and brings it back to Earth to be sold at the Fishy Joe's restaurant chain. But when it's discovered that the so-called "Popplers" are actually Omicronian babies, the Omicronians demand recompense.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.overview: Mom reprograms the world's robots to rebel against humanity. The only hope of salvation is Mom's old flame - Professor Farnsworth, who must rekindle his romance with Mom in order to save mankind.

episodes.title: Anthology of Interest I
episodes.overview: The Professor's "What-If" machine simulates Bender, Leela and Fry's wishes. Bender discovers what it would be like if he were 500 feet tall, Leela discovers what it would be like if she were more impulsive, and Fry discovers what would happen if he never came to the future.

episodes.title: The Honking
episodes.overview: When the inheritance Bender claims in the Old Country isn't quite what he expected, the Planet Express crew has to find the source of an age-old curse.

episodes.title: War Is the H-Word
episodes.overview: Fry and Bender enlist in the army to get a soldiers discount for bubblegum. When they are called to fight a war on a planet of bouncing ball aliens, Leela disguises herself as man to enlist with them. Bender is eventually sent to parley with the enemy, but this turns out to be a ploy.

episodes.title: The Cryonic Woman
episodes.overview: Fry is reunited with his old girlfriend from the 20th Century, but she doesn't adapt to the 31st century as well as he has. Convincing Fry to return to the cryogenic chamber, they awaken in a barren wasteland and struggle to make a place for themselves.

episodes.title: Parasites Lost
episodes.overview: When Fry becomes infested with parasitic worms that make him stronger and smarter, he finally finds the perfect way to profess his feelings to Leela. Meanwhile, the rest of the crew goes on a journey into Fry's body to eradicate the worms.

episodes.title: Amazon Women in the Mood
episodes.overview: A double-date for Kif, Amy, Zapp, and Leela ends in disaster when their orbiting restaurant crashes on planet Amazonia. The hulking female inhabitants of the planet take their male captives to the omniscient Femputer, who orders Fry, Zapp, and Kif to death by "snu-snu".

episodes.title: Bendless Love
episodes.overview: Bender's urge to bend prompts Professor Farnsworth to send him on a rehabilitation visit to a steel factory, where he falls in love with a shapely fem-bot named Angleyne. But Bender's old rival Flexo and the intrusion of the Robot Mafia threaten to throw a wrench into the proceedings.

episodes.title: The Day the Earth Stood Stupid
episodes.overview: Earth is invaded by super-intelligent flying brains, who sap the Earth's populace of their intelligence. Leela is taken to Nibbler's home planet Eternia, where the Nibblonians explain that only one human is immune to the brains' powers - Fry.

episodes.title: That's Lobstertainment!
episodes.overview: Dr. Zoidberg reunites with his uncle, silent hologram star Harold Zoid, and the two of them set out to make a movie together. They cast the temperamental Calculon in the lead role, who demands an Oscar for his performance, but the movie doesn't go over well with audiences.

episodes.title: The Birdbot of Ice-Catraz
episodes.overview: A sober Bender crashes a dark matter tanker on Pluto, threatening the penguin reserve nearby. Leela helps out in the clean-up, but when the penguins begin mating out of control, drastic action must be taken to thin the herd.

episodes.title: The Luck of the Fryrish
episodes.overview: After a string of bad luck, Fry ventures into the decaying ruins of Old New York to regain his lucky seven-leaf clover from his childhood, only to find that his brother Yancy Fry had stolen not only the clover, but Fry's identity as well. Fry sets out to exhume his brother's body, but discovers the startling truth about Yancy instead.

episodes.title: The Cyber House Rules
episodes.overview: Leela meets up with her former orphanarium playmate Adlai Atkins, now a plastic surgeon, who offers to grant Leela surgery that will give her two eyes. Meanwhile, Bender adopts twelve orphans in order to collect $1200 in government stipends.

episodes.title: Insane in the Mainframe
episodes.overview: Accused of robbing a bank, Fry and Bender plead insanity and are both sent to a robot insane asylum. While Bender and his buddy Roberto plan an escape, Fry is brainwashed into thinking that he is a robot.

episodes.title: Bendin' in the Wind
episodes.overview: When Bender is paralyzed in a tragic can opener accident, he discovers his musical washboard skills and goes on tour as a member of Beck's folk-rock band, acting as a voice for broken robots everywhere. Fry, Leela, Amy, and Zoidberg tag along in Fry's antique 1960s VW Van.

episodes.title: Time Keeps On Slippin'
episodes.overview: While creating a team of mutants to play the Harlem Globetrotters, the Professor accidentally causes a disruption in time that threatens the existence of the universe. Meanwhile, Fry tries to win an unreceptive Leela's heart.

episodes.title: I Dated a Robot
episodes.overview: Fry discovers the ability to download any celebrity onto a blank robot, and chooses to download Lucy Liu, with whom he falls madly in love. Repulsed by this disgusting display of human/robot love, Leela, Bender, and Zoidberg set out to shut down Nappster.com and put an end to illegal celebrity downloads forever.

episodes.title: Roswell That Ends Well
episodes.overview: A spacetime accident leaves the Planet Express crew stranded in Roswell, New Mexico in the year 1947, where a shattered Bender is mistaken for UFO debris and Zoidberg is captured as an alien specimen. Leela and the professor work to get everybody home, while Fry tries to keep his accident-prone grandfather alive.

episodes.title: A Tale of Two Santas
episodes.overview: A Planet Express mission to Robot Santa's colony on Neptune leaves the murderous robot trapped in the frozen sea, and Bender takes over as Santa, vowing to bring peace and goodwill to Xmas again. But when Bender is mistaken for the real Robot Santa, he is arrested and sentenced to death.

episodes.title: Anthology of Interest II
episodes.overview: When the Professor fine tunes his "What-If" machine, Bender discovers what it would be like if he were human, Fry discovers what it would be like if life were more like a video game, and Leela discovers what it would be like if she found her true home.

episodes.title: Love and Rocket
episodes.overview: As Valentine's Day approaches, Bender's romance with the Planet Express ship puts the crew in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Leela's Homeworld
episodes.overview: Leela finally learns the truth about her parents and her own identity.

episodes.title: Where the Buggalo Roam
episodes.overview: When Amy's parents' ranch is hit by a dust storm that blows away their herd of buggalo, Kif sets out to prove his masculinity by rounding up the herd, only to become entangled with the native Martians.

episodes.title: A Pharaoh to Remember
episodes.overview: Bender fears that nobody will remember him after he dies, and sees his chance for immortality when the crew is enslaved on the planet Osiris 4. Posing as the planet's new pharaoh, Bender orders a humongous statue built in his honor, and quickly goes mad with power.

episodes.title: Godfellas
episodes.overview: Bender is accidentally shot out of the ship's torpedo tube and becomes lost in space. Floating through the ethereal darkness, Bender becomes inhabited with tiny alien life forms, but has trouble playing God to their unyielding prayers.

episodes.title: Future Stock
episodes.overview: With Planet Express in financial trouble, Fry nominates a flashy businessman from the 1980s to replace Professor Farnsworth as CEO of the company.

episodes.title: A Leela of Her Own
episodes.overview: Leela endeavors to become the first female blernsball player, but her lack of depth perception hinders her skills. Nevertheless, she becomes the pitcher for the New New York Mets, purely for her novelty value.

episodes.title: 30% Iron Chef
episodes.overview: Bender, insulted by the reception his terrible cooking receives, runs away and joins a space hobo camp, where he apprentices with a legendary former TV chef. Meanwhile, Dr. Zoidberg accidentally destroys Professor Farnsworth's prized ship-in-a-bottle and frames Fry.

episodes.title: Where No Fan Has Gone Before
episodes.overview: The crew is pitted against the original Star Trek cast to win the devotion of an energy creature.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In the fifth season, Bender grows jealous when Fry attempts to clone his beloved fossilized dog; when Kif gets pregnant, Amy questions her readiness to become a parent; when Fry and Leela discover a mysterious cream that gives them unusual powers, they form a Superhero team along with Bender; and Fry makes a deal with the Robot Devil so he can become a skillful musician and win Leela's heart.

episodes.title: Crimes of the Hot
episodes.overview: When Earth is jeopardized by global warming, the crew attends a conference in Kyoto hosted by Al Gore's head.

episodes.title: Jurassic Bark
episodes.overview: Bender grows jealous when Fry attempts to clone Seymour, his beloved fossilized dog.

episodes.title: The Route of All Evil
episodes.overview: Farnsworth's clone Cubert teams up with Hermes' son Dwight to launch a newspaper delivery business. Farnsworth and Hermes scoff at the kids' efforts - until the delivery boys accumulate enough capital to buy out Planet Express. Meanwhile, Fry and Leela use Bender to brew their own homemade beer.

episodes.title: A Taste of Freedom
episodes.overview: Zoidberg becomes the center of a Supreme Court case after he celebrates Freedom Day by publicly eating the Earth flag.

episodes.title: Kif Gets Knocked Up a Notch
episodes.overview: When Kif gets pregnant, Amy questions her readiness to become a parent.

episodes.title: Less Than Hero
episodes.overview: When Fry and Leela discover a cream that gives them unusual powers, they form a superhero team along with Bender.

episodes.title: Teenage Mutant Leela's Hurdles
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew is exposed to a substance that causes everyone to age backwards.

episodes.title: The Why of Fry
episodes.overview: Nibbler enlists Fry in a mission to blow up evil brains bent on destroying the universe.

episodes.title: The Sting
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew attempt the mission that killed the last crew: raiding a massive alien beehive for its honey.

episodes.title: The Farnsworth Parabox
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew goes to a parallel universe made accessible by the Professor's latest experiment.

episodes.title: Three Hundred Big Boys
episodes.overview: With the help of a $300 government refund, the Planet Express crew pursue their dreams and desires.

episodes.title: Spanish Fry
episodes.overview: Fry's nose is stolen by alien poachers to sell as a black market aphrodesiac.

episodes.title: Bend Her
episodes.overview: Bender's scam to win Olympic gold sets him on the road to becoming a celebrity wife.

episodes.title: Obsoletely Fabulous
episodes.overview: A new model of robot threatens Bender, forcing him to run away after he avoids upgrading his own technology.

episodes.title: Bender Should Not Be Allowed on TV
episodes.overview: Bender becomes a television star as well as a terrible role model for children.

episodes.title: The Devil's Hands Are Idle Playthings
episodes.overview: Fry makes a deal with the Robot Devil so he can become a skillful musician and win Leela's heart.

episodes.title: Rebirth
episodes.overview: After a devastating spaceship crash, Professor Farnsworth attempts to resuscitate the crew with his birth machine.

episodes.title: In-A-Gadda-Da-Leela
episodes.overview: Leela and Zapp Brannigan find themselves stranded on an Eden-like planet.

episodes.title: Attack of the Killer App
episodes.overview: The latest trend in social networking and having no life takes over Earth; and Fry posts an embarrassing video of Leela on-line.

episodes.title: Proposition Infinity
episodes.overview: Bender leads a campaign to make robosexual marriage between humans and robots legal on Earth.

episodes.title: The Duh-Vinci Code
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew races to future Rome to unearth the shocking secret of Leonardo da Vinci.

episodes.title: Lethal Inspection
episodes.overview: Bender learns that he suffers from a mortal manufacturing defect.

episodes.title: The Late Philip J. Fry
episodes.overview: The Professor invents a one-way time machine that takes the crew ever further into the future with no hope of returning.

episodes.title: That Darn Katz!
episodes.overview: Earth is invaded by a race of intelligent cats.

episodes.title: A Clockwork Origin
episodes.overview: The theory of evolution is put to the test on a planet inhabited by robots.

episodes.title: The Prisoner of Benda
episodes.overview: A revolutionary invention allows the crew members to exchange minds.

episodes.title: Lrrreconcilable Ndndifferences
episodes.overview: After a bungled Earth invasion, alien leader Lrrr faces a midlife crisis.

episodes.title: The Mutants Are Revolting
episodes.overview: Leela leads an army of underground mutants in a rebellion against the surface people.

episodes.title: The Futurama Holiday Spectacular
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew learns the true meaning of Xmas, Robanukah and Kwanzaa.

episodes.title: Neutopia
episodes.overview: The crew members encounter a bizarre alien with the power to change their sexual characteristics.

episodes.title: Benderama
episodes.overview: Bender creates duplicates of himself, who in turn create duplicates of themselves, until they threaten to consume all of the matter on Earth.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machines
episodes.overview: Fed up with the crew, Bender decides to kill himself using a suicide booth. After he dies, his software takes on a ghostly existence.

episodes.title: Law and Oracle
episodes.overview: Fry quits his job and becomes a police officer assigned to the Future Crimes Division.

episodes.title: The Silence of the Clamps
episodes.overview: After testifying against the Robot Mafia, Bender goes into hiding in the witness relocation program.

episodes.title: Yo Leela Leela
episodes.overview: Leela becomes a Hollywood Big Shot after creating a hit children's television series.

episodes.title: All the Presidents' Heads
episodes.overview: The crew members alter history when they travel back in time to the American Revolution.

episodes.title: Mobius Dick
episodes.overview: Leela becomes obsessed with hunting down a mysterious four-dimensional space whale.

episodes.title: Fry Am the Egg Man
episodes.overview: Fry nurtures an alien egg that hatches into a horrific monster.

episodes.title: The Tip of the Zoidberg
episodes.overview: The crew uncovers a dark secret concerning a covert mission undertaken by the Professor and Dr. Zoidberg many years earlier.

episodes.title: Cold Warriors
episodes.overview: Fry's sneezing reintroduces the common cold to the world of the future, with devastating consequences.

episodes.title: Overclockwise
episodes.overview: Bender evolves into a godlike being after vastly increasing his processing power.

episodes.title: Reincarnation
episodes.overview: Futurama is reconceived in three alternate animation styles: classic black-and-white, old-school videogame, and Japanese anime.

episodes.title: The Bots and the Bees
episodes.overview: Bender fathers a child with the office soda machine.

episodes.title: A Farewell to Arms
episodes.overview: An ancient prophecy predicts the world will end in the year 3012.

episodes.title: Decision 3012
episodes.overview: Leela becomes campaign manager for a presidential candidate whose birth certificate is mysteriously missing.

episodes.title: The Thief of Baghead
episodes.overview: Bender joins the paparazzi and attempts to photograph a famous actor whose face has never been seen.

episodes.title: Zapp Dingbat
episodes.overview: Zapp Brannigan loses interest in Leela and instead turns his attentions towards her mother, Turanga Munda.

episodes.title: The Butterjunk Effect
episodes.overview: Leela and Amy become addicted to the performance enhancing drug known as "Nectar" to increase their chances of winning at the epic sport of Butterfly Derby.

episodes.title: The Six Million Dollar Mon
episodes.overview: Hermes replaces parts of his body with robotic counterparts so as to increase his productivity.

episodes.title: Fun on a Bun
episodes.overview: Fry is the victim of a sausage-making accident during the crew's visit to Oktoberfest.

episodes.title: Free Will Hunting
episodes.overview: Bender searches for the meaning of life after learning that robots lack free will.

episodes.title: Near-Death Wish
episodes.overview: The Professor is deeply disturbed when his parents return from virtual retirement aboard the Near-Death Star.

episodes.title: Viva Mars Vegas
episodes.overview: The crew stages a casino heist to recover stolen property from the Robot Mafia.

episodes.title: 31st Century Fox
episodes.overview: After saving a robotic fox from hunters, Bender becomes the hunted.

episodes.title: Naturama
episodes.overview: Bender and the crew are reimagined as wild animals in a nature documentary.

episodes.title: 2-D Blacktop
episodes.overview: Professor Farnsworth joins a gang of street-racing punks.

episodes.title: Fry and Leela's Big Fling
episodes.overview: Fry and Leela's romantic vacation goes disturbingly wrong.

episodes.title: T.: The Terrestrial
episodes.overview: After being marooned on a distant planet, Fry is befriended by a young monster.

episodes.title: Forty Percent Leadbelly
episodes.overview: At a maximum security prison, Bender meets a famous folk singer and attempts to make a copy of his precious guitar.

episodes.title: The Inhuman Torch
episodes.overview: Bender becomes a famous firefighter, but the crew suspects him of arson.

episodes.title: Saturday Morning Fun Pit
episodes.overview: The Futurama gang stars in a trio of craptastic morning cartoons.

episodes.title: Calculon 2.0
episodes.overview: Bender goes grave robbing to bring his favorite actor back to life.

episodes.title: Assie Come Home
episodes.overview: Bender searches the universe for his missing shiny metal rear end.

episodes.title: Leela and the Genestalk
episodes.overview: After a rare condition causes Leela to grow tentacles, she stumbles upon a secret genetic engineering facility.

episodes.title: Game of Tones
episodes.overview: The crew journeys into Fry's dreams to seek the meaning of a mysterious alien melody.

episodes.title: Murder on the Planet Express
episodes.overview: The crew becomes trapped aboard a ship with a horrific alien creature.

episodes.title: Stench and Stenchibility
episodes.overview: Dr. Zoidberg meets the love of his life while Bender squares off in a deadly tap dancing competition.

episodes.title: Meanwhile
episodes.overview: Fry asks Leela to marry him, and they face their destiny together as the Professor's latest invention alters the fabric of time.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: After a brief ten-year hiatus, Futurama has crawled triumphantly from the cryogenic tube, its full original cast and satirical spirit intact. New viewers will be able to pick up the series from here, while long-time fans will recognize payoffs to decades-long mysteries - including developments in the epic love story of Fry and Leela, the mysterious contents of Nibbler's litter box, the secret history of evil Robot Santa, and the whereabouts of Kif and Amy's tadpoles. Meanwhile there's a whole new pandemic in town as the crew explores the future of vaccines, bitcoin, cancel culture, and streaming TV.

episodes.title: The Impossible Stream
episodes.overview: Fry risks permanent insanity when he attempts to binge-watch every TV show ever made.

episodes.title: Children of a Lesser Bog
episodes.overview: Amy and Kif’s children emerge from an alien swamp.

episodes.title: How the West Was 1010001
episodes.overview: Bender and the crew head west to join the bitcoin mining rush.

episodes.title: Parasites Regained
episodes.overview: After Nibbler falls ill, the crew shrinks down for a dangerous mission into a desert world contained within his litter box.

episodes.title: Related to Items You've Viewed
episodes.overview: Bender uncovers the mysteries of the vast Momazon corporation.

episodes.title: I Know What You Did Next Xmas
episodes.overview: Bender and Zoidberg travel through time to attack Robot Santa.

episodes.title: Rage Against the Vaccine
episodes.overview: A pandemic ravages future Earth.

episodes.title: Zapp Gets Canceled
episodes.overview: When Zapp Brannigan is canceled for crude behavior, Leela takes over as captain of the Nimbus on a critical mission.

episodes.title: The Prince and the Product
episodes.overview: The crew members are reborn as toys.

episodes.title: All the Way Down
episodes.overview: The crew investigates whether the universe is a simulation.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: On this orbit around the sun, our occasionally heroic crew embarks on mind-bending adventures involving birthday party games to the death, the secrets of Bender's ancestral robot village, A.I. friends (and enemies), impossibly cute beanbags, and the true 5 million-year-old story behind the consciousness-altering substance known as coffee. And, of course, the next chapter in Fry and Leela's fateful, time-twisted romance.

episodes.title: The One Amigo
episodes.overview: After Bender sells an NFT representing the "Concept of Bender", he feels lost and returns to his ancestral village in Mexico to rediscover himself.

episodes.title: Quids Game
episodes.overview: Bizarre aliens force the crew to reenact all the classic children's games Fry played at his 8th birthday party... except this time, they are played TO THE DEATH!

episodes.title: The Temp
episodes.overview: A mysterious temp worker takes over Fry's job... as well as his entire life.

episodes.title: Beauty and the Bug
episodes.overview: Bender becomes a matador in the sport of "Bug Fighting."

episodes.title: One Is Silicon and the Other Gold
episodes.overview: Leela becomes friends with a jealous chatbot.

episodes.title: Attack of the Clothes
episodes.overview: The Professor's fast-fashion clothes are a smash hit, but an environmental disaster.

episodes.title: Planet Espresso
episodes.overview: Hermes inherits a Jamaican coffee farm that holds the ruins of an ancient spaceship.

episodes.title: Cuteness Overload
episodes.overview: Amy sets out to collect the cutest toys in the universe – but they are not as harmless as they appear.

episodes.title: The Futurama Mystery Liberry
episodes.overview: Futurama is reimagined in the form of classic children's mystery books.

episodes.title: Otherwise
episodes.overview: When Fry proposes to Leela, he is overcome by a near-fatal attack of déjà vu.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Bender is rampaging out of control! A volcano is about to explode! Fry confronts a rival for Leela's love! And Dr. Zoidberg is rising up to heaven?! The excitement might be too much! You've been warned... it's an all new season of FUTURAMA!

episodes.title: Destroy Tall Monsters
episodes.overview: Bender undergoes a risky treatment to make himself gigantic.

episodes.title: The World Is Hot Enough
episodes.overview: The crew ignites a volcano in a desperate attempt to slow global warming.

episodes.title: Fifty Shades of Green
episodes.overview: Fry is heartbroken to learn Leela's soulmate is someone other than him.

episodes.title: The Numberland Gap
episodes.overview: The crew journeys into a mysterious world inhabited by numbers.

episodes.title: Scared Screenless
episodes.overview: Bender is sent off to Zapp Brannigan's camp for screen addicts.

episodes.title: Wicked Human
episodes.overview: Pandemonium erupts when people around the world start floating up into the sky.

episodes.title: Murderoni
episodes.overview: A conspiracy theory makes shocking claims about the basement of the local pizzeria.

episodes.title: Crab Splatter
episodes.overview: Leela's parents adopt Dr. Zoidberg.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Truffles
episodes.overview: Bender and his trusty pig set off to hunt space truffles in the truffle belt.

episodes.title: The White Hole
episodes.overview: The crew embarks on an epic ten-million-year journey to witness the birth of a new universe.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Brace yourselves... The future is about to get a whole lot stranger! It's a non-stop onslaught of swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, sexy scams... plus the shocking return of Dr. Zoidberg's lost love! You didn't see that coming, prior to being told about it just now!

episodes.title: Beef
episodes.overview: The Professor attempts to create lab-grown meat so Fry can compete in the world hotdog-eating championship.

episodes.title: Catfish Hunter
episodes.overview: Bender travels to Mississippi in search of a sexy scammer who ripped off his grandmother.

episodes.title: Our Flag Means Medical Coverage
episodes.overview: Bender and Fry are hired to deliver a priceless cargo, but they are attacked and pillaged by vicious space pirates.

episodes.title: Lords of the Ring
episodes.overview: The Planet Express ship crash-lands on a mysterious world inhabited by intelligent rats.

episodes.title: The Charm Offensive
episodes.overview: Amy's favorite pop star commands her massive army of fans using musical brain programming.

episodes.title: Late Bloomers
episodes.overview: Hermes takes desperate measures to save his dying father, as Zoidberg reunites with an old flame.

episodes.title: Lord Nibbler in the Nothingverse
episodes.overview: Nibbler is chosen for a one-way mission to observe a dying universe.

episodes.title: Oceans Three
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew sets off on a treacherous ocean adventure.

episodes.title: A New New York Yankee in King Elfo's Court
episodes.overview: A time-machine failure sends Fry sideways in time to a medieval land.

episodes.title: Final Ending: The Last Conclusion
episodes.overview: Fry and his brother sneak into a PG-13 movie as kids... with shocking consequences for the future.

series.title: Ghosts
series.tagline: Dead people are just like you and me, they still want things.
series.overview: Samantha and Jay throw caution to the wind when they convert their recently inherited country estate into a bed-and-breakfast. Call it mislaid plans. Not only is the place falling apart, but it’s also inhabited by spirits of previous residents -- whom only Samantha can see and hear.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed & breakfast – only to find it’s inhabited by the many opinionated spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.

episodes.title: Hello!
episodes.overview: When Sam thinks she’s crazy because she continues to see the ghosts of Woodstone Manor, she tries to ignore them, making them even more determined to get her to acknowledge they’re real.

episodes.title: Viking Funeral
episodes.overview: When Thorfinn’s bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he’s always wanted. However, Sam and Jay are torn when they learn that the bones could be sold to a museum for a lot of much-needed cash. Also, the ghosts conduct an election for a “ghost representative” to bring issues to Sam.

episodes.title: Dinner Party
episodes.overview: When Sam and Jay invite the nosy neighbors Henry and Margaret to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.overview: On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who annually vandalize the house.

episodes.title: Pete's Wife
episodes.overview: Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she’s been keeping a dark secret from him for many years. Also, Sassapis gets angry with Thorfinn for binge-cheating their favorite show without him, and Trevor learns he may have a daughter.

episodes.title: Flower's Article
episodes.overview: When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she’s embarrassed about a part of the story she’s never revealed.

episodes.title: D&D
episodes.overview: After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts. Also, Isaac confronts his feelings for Nigel, a British soldier ghost from whom he’s been keeping a gigantic secret.

episodes.title: Alberta's Fan
episodes.overview: Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go on a walk with him in hopes that it will spark a special memory.

episodes.title: Possession
episodes.overview: Hetty accidentally possesses Jay’s body just as he and Sam are to about show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner

episodes.title: Sam's Mom
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay travel to where Sam’s mother, Sheryl, died to see if she’s now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret to his fellow ghosts that he overheard Sam and Jay discussing.

episodes.title: Jay's Sister
episodes.overview: When Jay’s sister, Bela, comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they’re shocked to discover that she’s communicating with someone they know on a dating app.

episodes.title: The Vault
episodes.overview: Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend’s wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty’s husband, Elias Woodstone, tries to ruin it.

episodes.title: Ghostwriter
episodes.overview: When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over the creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a new living friend, and Flower attempts to be Pete’s new basketball buddy.

episodes.title: Thorapy
episodes.overview: When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him. Also, Isaac makes a big, personal revelation after he’s compelled to seduce his new roommate, Hetty.

episodes.title: Trevor's Pants
episodes.overview: The secret about Trevor’s missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone’s corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

episodes.title: Attic Girl
episodes.overview: An ‘80s “mean girl” ghost named Stephanie, who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

episodes.title: Farnsby & B
episodes.overview: As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official B&B guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn. Also, Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.

episodes.title: Spies
episodes.overview: Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to integrate Nigel into his friend group.

episodes.title: Alberta's Podcast
episodes.overview: Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta’s death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

episodes.title: Jay's Friends
episodes.overview: Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay’s new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah. Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

episodes.title: The Tree
episodes.overview: Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try and save an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower’s attention.

episodes.title: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
episodes.overview: A séance at Sam and Jay’s last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty’s past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.

episodes.title: The Baby Bjorn
episodes.overview: Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys’ house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.

episodes.title: Dumb Deaths
episodes.overview: When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

episodes.title: The Liquor License
episodes.overview: Alberta’s expertise from her past comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into some complications during their Woodstone whiskey tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac’s past.

episodes.title: The Christmas Spirit (1)
episodes.overview: Jay’s sister, Bela, visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves. Meanwhile, the ghosts have conjured up a very different holiday plan for Trevor and Bela. Also, Isaac has an awkward encounter with Nigel that forces him to look back on events in his life.

episodes.title: The Christmas Spirit (2)
episodes.overview: Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay’s sister, Bela, and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Also, Isaac’s marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

episodes.title: The Perfect Assistant
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B – however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

episodes.title: The Family Business
episodes.overview: Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, ignoring Hetty’s warning not to get too close to “the help.” Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica, the ghost who lives in Freddie’s car.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunter
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay’s assistant, Freddie, purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica when Freddie sells his car.

episodes.title: Trevor's Body
episodes.overview: Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel’s relationship hits a roadblock.

episodes.title: A Date to Remember
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay help Thorfinn create a perfect first date with Flower. Also, Hetty feels slighted by the ghosts’ new housemate, Nigel.

episodes.title: Isaac's Book
episodes.overview: Sam struggles to keep Isaac’s spirits up after she hits a wall trying to publish a biography about him. Also, Trevor and Hetty conspire to keep their relationship hidden and Thor tries to prove to Flower that he can control his anger.

episodes.title: Weekend from Hell
episodes.overview: Elias Woodstone returns to Woodstone seeking Hetty’s forgiveness so he can stay out of hell for good. Also, Jay struggles to repeat an inspired culinary creation that he came up with after walking through Flower.

episodes.title: Alberta's Descendant
episodes.overview: Alberta is thrilled when a living relative, Alicia, visits Woodstone to learn more about her, but things take a turn when she hits it off with Todd, Sam's podcast co-host. Also, Nigel uses his knowledge of Trevor and Hetty's secret tryst to try to blackmail Hetty.

episodes.title: Ghost Father of the Bride
episodes.overview: After learning that Pete’s daughter, Laura, is getting married, Sam, at Pete’s behest, tries to convince her to hold her wedding at Woodstone B&B. Also, Alberta and Isaac team up to solve the mystery of what happened to Crash’s head.

episodes.title: Woodstone's Hottest Couple
episodes.overview: When teen ghost Stephanie, who lives in the attic, awakens to find that her crush Trevor is now dating Hetty, she decides to sabotage all the relationships at Woodstone.

episodes.title: Whodunnit
episodes.overview: Sam, Jay and the ghosts go into detective mode when Sam’s podcast editor gives her one last episode to wrap up Alberta’s murder. Also, Trevor, Flower and Pete discover an email from a Nigerian prince asking for help.

episodes.title: The Heir
episodes.overview: When a woman shows up claiming to be the rightful heir to Woodstone Mansion, Sam and Jay enlist the help of a lawyer. Meanwhile, Isaac tries to decide how to spend half of Sam’s advance on his autobiography. Also, a surprise event takes place that could dramatically change life at the manor.

episodes.title: The Owl
episodes.overview: Sam, Jay and the remaining ghosts unravel the mystery of which ghost passed into the afterlife. Also, Sam and Jay must relocate an owl in order to do construction on the barn to turn it into Jay's restaurant.

episodes.title: Man of Your Dreams
episodes.overview: Sam learns that one of the ghosts' powers is to enter the dreams of the livings and influence their decisions. Also, two of the ghosts think they've learned the secret to moving on.

episodes.title: He Sees Dead People
episodes.overview: When Jay's sister, Bela, and her boyfriend, Eric, visit Woodstone Mansion, Eric reveals a major change that took place after his near-death experience there over Christmas.

episodes.title: Halloween 3: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
episodes.overview: Pete's ex-wife, Carol, shows up at Woodstone Mansion during Sam and Jay's Halloween party, where they're trying to impress some cool friends. Also, the ghosts hope to bring Flower back with a séance.

episodes.title: The Silent Partner
episodes.overview: A big investor backs out of Sam and Jay's restaurant, leaving them to turn to the one ghost who has money - Isaac.

episodes.title: Hello, Brother
episodes.overview: Trevor's brother, Jeremy, checks into Woodstone after discovering a loophole in the Woodstone Rewards Points program.

episodes.title: The Polterguest
episodes.overview: Alberta hits it off with a poltergeist who is attached to a newly arrived Woodstone guest. Also, Isaac and Nigel have separate bachelor parties.

episodes.title: Holes Are Bad
episodes.overview: When Sam and Jay leave the ghosts home alone for the weekend in an attempt to have a romantic getaway, shocking revelations are made about two of Woodstone's beloved spirits.

episodes.title: The Traveling Agent
episodes.overview: Pete discovers a power that he never knew he had – one that brings him closer to his buddy Jay (and further apart).

episodes.title: Isaac's Wedding
episodes.overview: Isaac's wedding day jitters are exacerbated by the arrival of a surprise guest.

episodes.title: Patience
episodes.overview: While Sam and the ghosts race to find him, Isaac comes face to face with Puritan ghost Patience for the first time since she was lost in the dirt.

episodes.title: Sam's Dad
episodes.overview: When Sam's dad comes to Woodstone for a visit, Patience puts their father-daughter relationship to the test. Also, Isaac must deal with the fallout from his breakup with Nigel, and Thor and Flower handle an awkward situation with Nancy.

episodes.title: Halloween 4: The Witch
episodes.overview: The Ghosts seeking some excitement during a low key Halloween join Patience in putting Sam on a witch trial.

episodes.title: The Work Retreat
episodes.overview: Trevor, who has catfished his way into a remote financial analyst job, is in hot water when he's summoned to a mandatory in-person work retreat. Also, Hetty and Sass start a rumor about Pete.

episodes.title: A Star Is Dead
episodes.overview: Alberta offers to help Sam prepare for an audition for a community theater production. Also, Sass finds a new reason to interfere in Jay's dreams.

episodes.title: The Primary Source
episodes.overview: When Sam's book publisher requires source material for her biography on Isaac, she and Jay take a field trip to find a diary he claims he hid when he was alive.

episodes.title: Sad Farnsby
episodes.overview: When Sam accidentally creates a rift between Sam and Jay's neighbors, the Farnsbys, Henry Farnsby moves into Woodstone B&B. Also, Isaac and Nigel battle over a belated wedding present.

episodes.title: A Very Arondekar Christmas (1)
episodes.overview: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

episodes.title: A Very Arondekar Christmas (2)
episodes.overview: A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, difficult-to-impress mom and sister Bela.

episodes.title: The Not-So-Silent Partner
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay are forced to cover when Mark demands to meet the silent investor in Jay's restaurant who has been holding up construction.

episodes.title: Thorapy 2: Abandonment Issues
episodes.overview: Thor returns to therapy to work through his angst over being abandoned by his Viking shipmates. Also, Jay's sister, Bela, attempts to help him with the restaurant.

episodes.title: It's the End of the World as We Know It and What Were We Talking About?
episodes.overview: Flower interferes with the opening of Jay's restaurant based on a prophecy from her old cult leader.

episodes.title: Ghostfellas
episodes.overview: Jay angers a local restaurateur when he uses a recipe at his restaurant that was given to him by Pete.

episodes.title: Alexander Hamilton and the Ruffle Kerfuffle
episodes.overview: When Jay becomes obsessed with the success of a fellow chef, Isaac serves up a cautionary tale about his own rivalry with Alexander Hamilton; Elias Woodstone returns from hell with a limited-time offer for the ghosts.

episodes.title: The Bachelorette Party
episodes.overview: When Alberta's descendant hosts a bachelorette party at Woodstone Mansion, Alberta becomes suspicious of her fiancé; Jay is excited about a positive review on his restaurant.

episodes.title: St. Hetty's Day
episodes.overview: Hetty's ghost power is revealed when Jay's cousin Sunil visits Woodstone Mansion on St. Patrick's Day.

episodes.title: His Girl Shiki
episodes.overview: Pete makes good on his promise to find someone for Sasappis by bringing in a wisecracking 1940s screenwriter who also has the ability to roam.

episodes.title: Smooching and Smushing
episodes.overview: Jay, Sam and the ghosts attempt to fix the ghost trap in hopes of getting Sasappis across the ghost boundary to visit his longtime crush, Shiki.

episodes.title: Pinkus Returns
episodes.overview: When Trevor's former co-worker Pinkus and his daughter Abby show up at Woodstone Mansion, Trevor gets the surprise of his afterlife.

episodes.title: I Know What You Did Thirty-Seven Summers Ago
episodes.overview: When Sam and Jay host a fundraiser for the mayor to earn a favor for Jay's restaurant, they learn of his bizarre connection to one of Woodstone's ghosts.

episodes.title: Kyle
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay's relationship is tested when Kyle, a handsome living who shares Sam's ability to see ghosts, arrives at Woodstone B&B.

episodes.title: The Devil Went Down to Woodstone
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay host a big party for the launch of Sam and Isaac's vampire book.

episodes.title: Soul Custody
episodes.overview: Sam, Jay and the ghosts attempt to extricate Jay from his deal with Elias Woodstone, the devil. Also, Isaac helps Patience through a crisis of confidence and Pete and Alberta navigate the fallout from their kiss.

episodes.title: Viking Wedding
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay try to impress their trendy city friends while a misplaced bookcase threatens Thor's ability to deliver an important speech. Also, Isaac rallies the ghosts to help the couple navigate a tough customer service ordeal.

episodes.title: Halloween 5: The Mummy
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay's Halloween takes a spooky turn when they accidentally unleash a mummy ghost.

episodes.title: Bring Your Daughter to Work Day
episodes.overview: Trevor finds a way to spend more time with his newly discovered daughter, Abby, by getting her at job at Jay's restaurant.

episodes.title: T-Daddy
episodes.overview: Trevor's relationship with his daughter is strained when he pushes her to follow a career in finance over poetry. Meanwhile, Jay confronts labor unrest at the restaurant.

episodes.title: Planes, Shanes, and Automobiles
episodes.overview: Sam and Pete get on each other's nerves during a book tour road trip and things reach a breaking point when an airline strike threatens their ability to get home in time for Thanksgiving.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.overview: Sam helps Eric plan the perfect proposal for Bela, until an encounter with Sasappis plants doubt in Bela's mind. Meanwhile, Isaac tries to prove he's "just one of the basement ghosts".

episodes.title: The Life and Times of Esther Greene
episodes.overview: Now a successful podcaster, Todd Pearlman returns to profile Sam and Isaac's book, but becomes obsessed with Jay. Meanwhile, Pete tries to get to the bottom of why Alberta changed her name, forcing her to admit a hidden truth.

episodes.title: It’s A Wonderful Christmas Carol (1)
episodes.overview: Sam’s big Christmas Eve TV interview with Walter Storm takes an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Trevor and Patience bond over their mutual disinterest in celebrating Christmas.

episodes.title: It’s A Wonderful Christmas Carol (2)
episodes.overview: Sam gets a glimpse of what her life would be like if she could never see the ghosts.

episodes.title: The Others
episodes.overview: Sam and the ghosts face The Others, a new group of spirits from one ghost's past. Meanwhile, Trevor tries to deal with a demanding Patience, who seeks a committed relationship in the wake of their holiday hookup.

episodes.title: The List
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay work to secure Woodstone B&B a coveted spot on a prestigious luxury hotel list, only to face unexpected chaos when a vengeful newly discovered bunker ghost disrupts a crucial visit. Meanwhile, Flower and Thor clash over who gets to call the shots in their relationship.

episodes.title: St. Hetty's Day 2: The Help
episodes.overview: A St. Patrick's Day staffing emergency gives Hetty the chance to step into an unlikely role at the restaurant as she regains her once-a-year ability to be seen and heard by the living. Meanwhile, Kyle returns to watch over the ghosts and finds himself caught in an amusing supernatural dynamic.

episodes.title: The Water Heater
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay try to replace their broken water heater, but Isaac turns the upgrade into a campaign issue in his bid to represent the basement ghosts. Meanwhile, Kyle attempts to make Bela jealous by pretending he’s dating Hetty.

episodes.title: Michael Jackson Goes to HR
episodes.overview: Trevor lands himself in trouble when an inappropriate gift to a co‑worker forces him into an HR meeting only Jay can handle. Meanwhile, Pete unintentionally sparks drama with Alberta after casually mentioning a surprise visit to his ex.

episodes.title: Woodstone Royale
episodes.overview: Needing to raise a large sum of money to pay the IRS, Sam and Jay agree to host a high-stakes poker game at the mansion. Meanwhile, in an act of generosity, Isaac gifts Jay's recliner to the basement ghosts.

episodes.title: The Investor
episodes.overview: When a promising opportunity to save Woodstone is threatened by a personal conflict, Sam and Jay are forced into a difficult choice. Meanwhile, election day arrives as Flower and Isaac go head‑to‑head to become Ghost Representative.

episodes.title: Under New Management
episodes.overview: When new pressures threaten Sam and Jay's control over Woodstone, they're forced to navigate unexpected challenges to protect its future. Meanwhile, a long-absent ghost returns, reopening emotional connections that complicate new relationships.

episodes.title: Gate-gate
episodes.overview: When an emotion‑driven decision puts Woodstone at risk, Sam and Jay step up to defend what they've built. Meanwhile, Isaac struggles to adjust to new surroundings, only to realize that some connections are too important to leave behind.

episodes.title: Polar Opposites
episodes.overview: When a Hollywood producer comes to scout Woodstone as a filming location, Sam is prompted to take a creative leap that draws unexpected support from the ghosts. Meanwhile, changing roles among the ghosts spark a heartfelt effort to honor someone special.

episodes.title: Up The Creek (1)
episodes.overview: When Woodstone's future is put in jeopardy, Sam and Jay join forces with the ghosts to protect the mansion by securing its place in history.

episodes.title: Across The Pond (2)
episodes.overview: A trip abroad could determine Woodstone's fate. Meanwhile, a major career opportunity takes Sam out of town, leaving others to step in and help with the ghosts.

series.title: Graveyard
series.overview: Police Commissioner Önem leads a special investigations unit that solves tough cases involving violence against women.

cast.name: Hakan Meriçliler
cast.character: İl Emniyet Müdür Yardımcısı Haluk Ata

episodes.title: Silent Devil (1)
episodes.overview: A swanky garden party is cut short when a pregnant woman is found dead in her home. It is assumed to be an act of suicide, but Önem knows better.

episodes.title: Silent Devil (2)
episodes.overview: The Graveyard continues to search for the father of Yasemin’s baby, using the narrative of a fictional — but familiar — story left on her laptop.

episodes.title: Bella Donna (1)
episodes.overview: A doctor is stabbed after a brawl breaks out with the family of a chronically ill girl. But with an eyewitness to the murder, is it a cut and dry case?

episodes.title: Bella Donna (2)
episodes.overview: The unit finds links between the missing test results from Aycan’s hospital and a nearby holistic healing scheme, fronted by a cocky spiritual leader.

episodes.title: The Inauspicious Island (1)
episodes.overview: When a mysterious icebox containing the leg of a deceased woman shows up at the Graveyard, Önem and her team begin their hunt for her body… and her killer.

episodes.title: The Inauspicious Island (2)
episodes.overview: Crazed superfans and jealous girlfriends are added to the list of suspects, after the dismembered body of the actress is finally uncovered.

episodes.title: Nostos Algos (1)
episodes.overview: Chief Inspector Hasan begins to reconnect with his son, but struggles to balance his duty for justice with his emotional ties to his family.

episodes.title: Nostos Algos (2)
episodes.overview: New information around Bülent’s whereabouts on the night of Seher’s murder throws all suspicions out, but the truth has a funny way of coming to light.

series.title: Haunted Hotel
series.overview: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Undervale
episodes.overview: Desperate to attract paying customers, Katherine hires an exorcist to get rid of the hotel's ghosts. Ben finds an unexpected soul mate.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: Katherine is concerned that a rebellious ghost is a bad influence on Esther. A power outage sends Nathan, Ben and Abaddon into the woods.

episodes.title: Randy Slasher
episodes.overview: While Katherine summons the courage to go out on a date, the rest of the crew deals with a creepy killer who targets lusty teens.

episodes.title: How to Train Your Demon
episodes.overview: Abaddon struggles to control his instincts, Katherine bumps into a business rival, and Nathan, Ben and Esther investigate a possible werewolf.

episodes.title: Rollyfluffs
episodes.overview: Esther's plan to become more popular backfires when she starts a dangerous new trend at school. The hotel's honeymoon suite turns on the charm.

episodes.title: Ghost Hunters!
episodes.overview: A ghost-hunting reality show films an episode at the Undervale. Ben opens up to an enchanted diary and shares all his relationship drama.

episodes.title: Seven Deadly Bens
episodes.overview: Ben's desire to be more confident spawns multiple personalities. Meanwhile, Nathan keeps falling through floors... but why?

episodes.title: Aunt Rose
episodes.overview: A curmudgeonly relative comes to visit — with no plans to leave. Abaddon is outsmarted by a doorstop, and Esther experiments with raising the dead.

episodes.title: The Esthercist
episodes.overview: Esther takes charge when soul-sucking demons invade the hotel. Katherine shares a painful truth with Nathan about his death.

episodes.title: The Acolytes of Abaddon
episodes.overview: The good news? There's a busload of red-cloaked customers who want to stay at the Undervale. The bad news? They might be part of a world-ending cult.

series.title: HELL MODE: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
series.original_title: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～ はじまりの召喚士
series.overview: Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode"—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential. Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him.

episodes.title: BORN AGAIN AT BOTTOM-TIER
episodes.overview: A hardcore gamer is reborn when he chooses to play on Hell Mode difficulty. Now he needs to figure out how his summoning skills work. While still a baby.

episodes.title: THE APPRAISAL CEREMONY
episodes.overview: Little does Allen know that the Appraisal Ceremony will expose the brutal reality of playing on Hell Mode.

episodes.title: TROUBLE
episodes.overview: Allen experiments with his Summoner abilities, unaware that a coming crisis will remind him that the world he treats as a game is a harsh reality for others.

episodes.title: ALLEN SPILLS THE BEANS
episodes.overview: Allen decides to tell his parents about his abilities.

episodes.title: A SUMMONER'S POTENTIAL
episodes.overview: Allen's hunting strategies have paid off, but the fledgling summoner still has a long way to go. Especially when he must now deduce the purpose of his new storage skill.

episodes.title: OUTWARD BOUND
episodes.overview: The baron wishes to observe Allen's boar hunts firsthand. If he's impressed, there may even be a reward; one that could change both Allen and his family's life forever.

episodes.title: LIFE WITH THE GRANVELLES
episodes.overview: Allen begins his new life as a manservant of the Gravelle Family. Fortunately for him, that doesn't mean the end of a life of monster hunting.

episodes.title: HUNTSMAN
episodes.overview: Allen's uncanny ability to hunt monsters earns him a promotion, and the baron's family awaits a visit from the eldest son. Life is good. For now.

episodes.title: THE MURDERGALSH
episodes.overview: Allen realizes he's still got a long way to go after a B-rank monster attacks the city. If he wants to face the challenges ahead, he must unlock his class's true potential.

episodes.title: THE NOBLE'S DUTY
episodes.overview: Allen may have figured out his class, but that doesn't mean he's figured out the world.

episodes.title: SNEAK ATTACK
episodes.overview: Allen merely sees the Armored Ant colony as a test of his abilities. He has no idea that victory could lead to political consequences.

episodes.title: THE ESCAPE
episodes.overview: Allen and Cecil have a long, dangerous road ahead of them. Reaching safety means facing more than just one threat.

episodes.title: OFF TO ACADEMY CITY!
episodes.overview: Allen’s new life in Academy City begins, but an appraisal ceremony unexpectedly puts him on Helmios the Hero’s radar.

episodes.title: A NEW FRIEND
episodes.overview: The No-Life Gamers are off to a good start, but they face a few setbacks: their healer can't join full-time and Krena doesn't know how to use skills.

episodes.title: CONQUER THE DUNGEON
episodes.overview: Keel officially joins the No-Life Gamers as they tackle a B-rank dungeon. But as they grow stronger, Allen uncovers a concerning issue regarding his new friend.

episodes.title: AN ORDER FROM THE PRINCE
episodes.overview: A-rank dungeons are dangerous for a reason, as the No-Life Gamers quickly learn. But that's not the only challenge awaiting them.

episodes.title: THE SOVEREIGN OF SPIRITS' PROPHECY
episodes.overview: A new school year brings big changes as three new members join the No-Life Gamers.

episodes.title: SHOWDOWN AT THE ACADEMY TOURNAMENT!
episodes.overview: Allen faces off against the hero. If he wants to win, he’ll have to use his new summoning abilities.

episodes.title: ONWARD TO ROHZENHEIM
episodes.overview: As the Demon Lord's army lays waste to the Elven Kingdom of Rozenheim, Allen and his friends must find a way to repel the invasion before it's too late.

episodes.title: THE BATTLE OF TIAMO
episodes.overview: Allen has an unusual request for the Sovereign of Spirits: he wants all of his friends switched over to Hell Mode.

episodes.title: THE DEMONS OF LAPOLKA
episodes.overview: The No-Life Gamers must hold the line at Tiamo. But the longer the fighting drags on, the fewer magic stones remain at Allen's disposal.

series.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN
series.tagline: A boy fights... for "the right death."
series.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

episodes.title: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.overview: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

episodes.title: For Myself
episodes.overview: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.overview: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

episodes.title: Curse Womb Must Die
episodes.overview: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

episodes.title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
episodes.overview: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

episodes.title: After Rain
episodes.overview: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.overview: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

episodes.title: Boredom
episodes.overview: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

episodes.title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
episodes.overview: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

episodes.title: Idle Transfiguration
episodes.overview: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

episodes.title: Narrow-minded
episodes.overview: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

episodes.title: To You, Someday
episodes.overview: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
episodes.overview: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
episodes.overview: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
episodes.overview: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
episodes.overview: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

episodes.title: Sage
episodes.overview: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

episodes.title: Black Flash
episodes.overview: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

episodes.title: Nonstandard
episodes.overview: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

episodes.title: Jujutsu Koshien
episodes.overview: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

episodes.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
episodes.overview: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

episodes.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
episodes.overview: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

episodes.title: Accomplices
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory
episodes.overview: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory 2
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory 3
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory 4
episodes.overview: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

episodes.title: Premature Death
episodes.overview: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

episodes.title: It's Like That
episodes.overview: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

episodes.title: Evening Festival
episodes.overview: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident
episodes.overview: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
episodes.overview: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

episodes.title: Pandemonium
episodes.overview: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

episodes.title: Seance
episodes.overview: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

episodes.title: Dull Knife
episodes.overview: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

episodes.title: Red Scale
episodes.overview: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

episodes.title: Fluctuations
episodes.overview: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

episodes.title: Fluctuations (2)
episodes.overview: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

episodes.title: Thunderclap
episodes.overview: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

episodes.title: Thunderclap (2)
episodes.overview: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong
episodes.overview: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong (2)
episodes.overview: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong (3)
episodes.overview: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.overview: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis (2)
episodes.overview: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
episodes.overview: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.overview: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

episodes.title: One More Time
episodes.overview: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

episodes.title: About the Culling Game
episodes.overview: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

episodes.title: Perfect Preparation
episodes.overview: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

episodes.title: Passion
episodes.overview: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

episodes.title: Cog
episodes.overview: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1
episodes.overview: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (2)
episodes.overview: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (3)
episodes.overview: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (4)
episodes.overview: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (5)
