episodes.overview: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

episodes.title: Sendai Colony
episodes.overview: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

series.title: Lanterns
series.tagline: Only one can wear the ring.
series.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a fatal shooting, Green Lantern Hal Jordan and new recruit John Stewart set out to prove it was an extraterrestrial event.

episodes.title: Trust Fall
episodes.overview: While John's middling errand ultimately proves eventful, Hal makes waves in Rushville – which only inspires him to dig deeper.

series.title: Leanne
series.overview: When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.

episodes.title: The Important Stuff
episodes.overview: Facing the abrupt end of her marriage, Leanne leans on her sister Carol, concocts cover stories and confronts the prospect of starting over in her 50s.

episodes.title: The Healing Magic of Family
episodes.overview: When Mama Margaret suffers a health scare, Leanne scrambles to keep the family from upsetting her by spilling the beans about Bill.

episodes.title: Oh, Knoxville
episodes.overview: It's ladies' night as Carol whisks Leanne out of her comfort zone and into a local hotspot for a crash course in confidence.

episodes.title: Smooth Like a Dolphin
episodes.overview: With a lawyer in one ear and Carol in the other, Leanne considers a fresh look and a new ride. An unwanted guest threatens to spoil game day.

episodes.title: A Plumber Sent from Heaven
episodes.overview: Leanne sets out to get fit, but temptation is hard to shake — especially after discovering that Carol has a midnight snack of her own.

episodes.title: Too Much Wedding Ring
episodes.overview: A visit from a charismatic law enforcement officer sets off sirens for Leanne. Daddy John finds a gender reveal party to be anything but a piece of cake.

episodes.title: Please Be a Lizard
episodes.overview: Leanne's routine gyno exam gets shaken up by a surprise encounter in the waiting room. Carol and Bill mellow out after sampling some enhanced goodies.

episodes.title: Muscle Memory
episodes.overview: Leanne gets hot and bothered — but not in the way she'd hoped. Carol and Tyler join their elders for an unexpectedly lively night at the movies.

episodes.title: Chipmunk in the Drywall
episodes.overview: A stack of treasured heirlooms resurfaces old sibling tensions. To keep an embarrassing truth under wraps, Mary agrees to mop up Carol's mess.

episodes.title: Apology Pie
episodes.overview: Concerned that Andrew's poker face might be masking something deeper, a suspicious Leanne ropes Carol into an undercover investigation.

episodes.title: Dog Day Afternoon
episodes.overview: As Leanne readies for an exciting step forward, Carol looks back — and realizes her love life could use some serious quality control.

episodes.title: The Queen's Dilemma
episodes.overview: When Leanne's off-the-cuff speech at a local book club is caught on video, her empowering words turn out to be more powerful than anyone expected.

episodes.title: Don't Dangle a Dream
episodes.overview: Leanne vows to fulfill Mama Margaret's decades-old dream of a perfect wedding day. But when her rushed plans go off the rails, she'll have to improvise.

episodes.title: Gomez Is a Woman
episodes.overview: When a long-distance farewell hits close to home, Leanne finds herself rattled by a surprise introduction that stirs up insecurities — and jealousy.

episodes.title: Spiritual Airbags
episodes.overview: After a brush with fate, Leanne decides to tie up loose ends, Carol experiments with her softer side and Sunday service gets an unexpected reboot.

episodes.title: Having Big Feelings
episodes.overview: Whisked away for a surprise weekend of sun and sand, Leanne faces her first big relationship test. But an even bigger surprise awaits back at home.

episodes.title: The Big Hm-Hm
episodes.overview: On the eve of her birthday, Leanne must step in to help Mama Margaret and Daddy John after their forgetfulness leads to an alarming mishap at home.

episodes.title: A Prison of Love
episodes.overview: Leanne struggles to set boundaries as Mama Margaret and Daddy John begrudgingly stay at her house. A spilled secret throws Bill's life into chaos.

episodes.title: The Old Cat Had Her Reasons
episodes.overview: As her relationship takes a surprising turn, Leanne questions her own desires — and the women at her book club chime in with conflicting advice.

episodes.title: Fit as a Fiddle
episodes.overview: A trip to the doctor forces Leanne and Daddy John to have an overdue chat about the future — and helps Carol and Mama Margaret bond like never before.

episodes.title: Big Hammer Energy
episodes.overview: While Bill helps remodel her parents' kitchen, Leanne wrestles with her feelings. A garden project digs up trouble between Carol and Mama Margaret.

episodes.title: An Enhancement... Or Two
episodes.overview: After an awkward encounter, Leanne and Carol hit the road with Mary to recapture some of their youthful glow. Daddy John deals Bill in on poker night.

episodes.title: Pickles Are Forever
episodes.overview: Daddy John and Leanne butt heads during a visit to the estate lawyer. After exceeding expectations, Bill makes a case to continue remodeling the house.

episodes.title: Have a Rocky Top Day
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest visits Leanne, raising questions about love and second chances. Mama Margaret arranges a date for Carol with an eligible stranger.

episodes.title: Three Degrees of Southern Women
episodes.overview: At long last, Leanne starts speaking her mind — much to Mama Margaret's dismay. Bill tries to help Daddy John tune up his driving knowledge.

episodes.title: Bang Me
episodes.overview: As Leanne reaches the one-year mark of her separation, a heart-to-heart with her stylist helps reframe her perspective on the past and present.

series.title: LINK CLICK
series.tagline: Past or future, just let them be.
series.overview: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!

seasons.name: Link Click
seasons.overview: At Time Photo Studio, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang use their complementary powers to enter photographs and fulfil their clients’ unresolved requests. Each mission draws them into lives shaped by regret, loss and difficult choices, while Cheng’s compassion repeatedly tests the rule against changing the past. When their cases become connected to a dangerous mystery, the consequences reach the studio itself.

episodes.title: Emma
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang accept a job requiring them to uncover financial information hidden in a photograph. Entering the past through the body of overworked employee Emma, Cheng must follow Lu Guang’s instructions and avoid altering events, but experiencing her loneliness and family struggles makes remaining detached increasingly difficult.

episodes.title: Secret Recipe
episodes.overview: Restaurant owner Yu Xia hires Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to recover a secret recipe kept by Lin Zhen, her former friend and business partner. With few useful clues available, Cheng dives into an old photograph and witnesses the history behind their successful restaurant, uncovering a deeply personal conflict beneath their bitter separation.

episodes.title: To Lose, Not To Win
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi enters a photograph from client Chen Xiao’s high-school days to deliver words he never shared with his basketball teammates. When an accident forces him into a crucial match that could determine the club’s future, Cheng must resist his competitive instincts and obey Lu Guang’s strict instruction: lose the game, no matter what.

episodes.title: Confess
episodes.overview: After accidentally changing the outcome of Chen Xiao’s basketball game, Cheng Xiaoshi continues delivering his client’s long-unspoken messages to friends and family. As the mission proceeds almost too smoothly, a troubling realization about the date reveals that something far more serious is approaching.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.overview: Knowing that a devastating earthquake is approaching, Cheng Xiaoshi desperately tries to warn Chen Xiao’s friends and the surrounding villagers, but no one believes him. Refusing to give up, he asks Lu Guang to help save Chen Xiao’s mother as the two confront the painful limits of changing the past.

episodes.title: Search of the Child
episodes.overview: A desperate father asks the Time Photo Studio to investigate the disappearance of his young son, Doudou, who vanished three years earlier. Despite the emotional toll of his previous mission, Cheng Xiaoshi enters surveillance footage from the day of the abduction and attempts to trace the child without disturbing the past.

episodes.title: Aunt May
episodes.overview: After losing sight of Doudou during their first attempt, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang discover a photograph taken by the child on the day he vanished. Entering Doudou’s body, Cheng experiences the abduction firsthand and must identify the kidnapper and uncover his location before the twelve-hour limit expires.

episodes.title: Lost Signal
episodes.overview: Xu Shanshan asks the studio to recover what her longtime friend Dong Yi told her during a drunken university gathering. While reliving the night through her photograph, Cheng Xiaoshi notices something unsettling and becomes distracted from the original assignment, drawing him into a mystery that may be more dangerous than it first appears.

episodes.title: Consequence of Goodwill
episodes.overview: After a disturbing call from Xu Shanshan’s phone leaves her unreachable, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling fear she may be in danger. While Lu Guang seeks help from the police, Cheng discovers a photograph connected to the case and impulsively dives into it alone, hoping to uncover the truth before it is too late.

episodes.title: Trap
episodes.overview: With Xu Shanshan still missing, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Qiao Ling begin searching for clues on their own. When a photograph connected to her disappearance offers a possible lead, Cheng ignores Lu Guang’s warning and enters the image, determined to uncover what happened before the situation grows even more dangerous.

episodes.title: Pinnacle of Light
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi puts a dangerous plan into motion to expose the person threatening those around the studio. As the confrontation unfolds, Emma’s unresolved fate continues to haunt him, leading him back into the past for one final attempt to reach her—while an unseen danger remains closer than anyone realizes.

seasons.name: Link Click 2
seasons.overview: Following the attack on Time Photo Studio, Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling become entangled in a dangerous investigation while Lu Guang fights to recover. As a mysterious enemy uses photographs to control others, the group uncovers a tragic family history and a conspiracy surrounding their powers, forcing them into a desperate struggle to protect one another and expose the mastermind behind the escalating violence.

episodes.title: Falling
episodes.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi returns to the photo studio to find Lu Guang critically wounded and Qiao Ling under the control of a mysterious enemy. Desperate to save them both, he tries to discover how to break the possession, but the arrival of the police leaves him detained as the investigation takes a troubling new direction.

episodes.title: Night Raid
episodes.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi and the others investigate the mysterious enemy’s connection to photographs, Officer Chen Bin suddenly disappears along with a crucial piece of evidence. Meanwhile, Qian Jin pays an unexpected visit to Chen Bin’s home, while a coordinated nighttime assault places Lu Guang and those guarding him in immediate danger.

episodes.title: Two Funerals
episodes.overview: Following the hospital attack, Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling struggle with its emotional aftermath while Captain Xiao faces growing pressure surrounding the investigation. As two funerals bring grief, suspicion and unresolved questions to the surface, Cheng considers using his abilities to offer comfort to those left behind.

episodes.title: Them In The Photo
episodes.overview: As Captain Xiao reveals a troubling incident from Qian Jin’s past, the group learns that a mysterious visitor left Lu Guang a photograph bearing a cryptic message. Hoping it will provide clues about their enemy, Cheng Xiaoshi enters the image and finds himself experiencing the unfamiliar life of a young girl.

episodes.title: Last Supper
episodes.overview: While exploring the photograph left behind for the group, Cheng Xiaoshi experiences the difficult childhood of two siblings and searches their family life for clues. As tensions build around an evening meal, he struggles to remain detached from events that may hold the key to the mystery unfolding in the present.

episodes.title: Li Tianxi
episodes.overview: After witnessing the twins’ traumatic childhood, Cheng Xiaoshi is abruptly pulled out of the photograph and returns to the present. At the police station, he meets a mysterious witness connected to the investigation, hoping their conversation will clarify the growing threat surrounding the studio and reveal what truly happened to Li Tianxi.

episodes.title: Urban Warfare
episodes.overview: When Li Tianxi takes Cheng Xiaoshi from the police station, Captain Xiao and Qiao Ling race through the city to find him, only to be confronted by Qian Jin’s men. Meanwhile, Lu Guang disappears from his guarded hospital room, as the pursuit erupts into a dangerous battle across the streets.

episodes.title: Hostage
episodes.overview: Lu Guang’s unexpected intervention prevents Cheng Xiaoshi from being taken away, but the rescue places him in danger instead. As Cheng and the others regroup, Captain Xiao reveals new information connecting Qian Jin to the twins’ tragic past, giving their investigation an increasingly personal and dangerous direction.

episodes.title: Three Stories
episodes.overview: As Cheng Xiaoshi’s journey through the past continues, three interconnected stories reveal the events that brought Qian Jin and the Li twins together. Each account sheds new light on the tragedies and choices that shaped them, while Cheng faces a crucial decision that could change the course of the present.

episodes.title: Improvise
episodes.overview: After learning more about the twins’ abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and his allies devise a risky plan to rescue Lu Guang from Qian Jin and Li Tianchen. As both sides prepare for a hostage exchange, Cheng must adapt quickly when their carefully arranged strategy begins to unravel.

episodes.title: Confrontation
episodes.overview: During the tense hostage exchange, Cheng Xiaoshi’s carefully prepared rescue plan collides with Qian Jin’s countermeasures. Separated from his allies and drawn deeper into the theatre, Cheng faces a dangerous demand involving his powers and Qian Jin’s past, while the confrontation pushes everyone toward a decisive final clash.

episodes.title: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
episodes.overview: As the confrontation reaches its climax, Cheng Xiaoshi, Lu Guang and Captain Xiao fight to stop Qian Jin, while the Li twins face the consequences of their painful past. With loyalties shifting and unexpected powers entering the struggle, everyone must decide how far they will go to protect the person they cannot bear to lose.

seasons.name: Bridon Arc
seasons.overview: When a photograph connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents is discovered, he and Lu Guang travel to Bridon in search of answers. Their investigation leads them into the aftermath of a devastating academy fire and the lives of several strangers hiding conflicting motives. As buried connections gradually emerge, Lu Guang quietly struggles against the fate he fears may be awaiting Cheng.

episodes.title: So Time Begins to Flow Again
episodes.overview: Following a devastating attack, Lu Guang returns to the time when he first met Cheng Xiaoshi, determined to prevent the future he witnessed. As he relives the beginning of their friendship, a series of seemingly ordinary encounters begins setting their shared destiny in motion once again.

episodes.title: Prelude
episodes.overview: While Liu Xiao becomes trapped in a dangerous wager at a Bridon bar, Cheng Xiaoshi discovers a photograph apparently sent by his missing father. Believing it may provide a clue about his parents, he decides to travel to Bridon, despite Qiao Ling’s strong objections.

episodes.title: Them
episodes.overview: Following clues connected to Cheng Xiaoshi’s missing parents, he and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon and visit a bar popular with football supporters. There they meet the friendly Xia Fei, but an impulsive celebration provokes a rival group and draws the three into a dangerous chase through the city.

episodes.title: And Then There Were None
episodes.overview: After Xia Fei’s enigmatic boss, Vein, rescues the group from their pursuers, Lu Guang becomes suspicious of their new ally. Cheng Xiaoshi later returns to the bar seeking information about BAHATI, where he uncovers a connection to a language school destroyed in a devastating fire ten years earlier.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang search for anyone who survived the disaster. Their investigation leads Cheng into a photograph belonging to Wang Qing, a gifted student trapped in a difficult situation, where he uncovers a personal connection that may bring him closer to the truth about his father.

episodes.title: Puzzle
episodes.overview: To earn Vein’s help in locating Wang Qing, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang agree to replace a missing model at a photo shoot. Their unusual payment leads them to Wang Qing’s mental health clinic, where her psychological tests begin raising unsettling questions about the people and hidden motives surrounding their investigation.

seasons.name: Link Click 3
seasons.overview: After the Li Tianchen incident came to an end, the Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial calm. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again plunged everyone into the crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case. Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seemed to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao, from a mysterious organization, begins his actions, and the intervention of Bridon police officer Jae adds uncertainty to this quest for the truth.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Past
episodes.overview: An adoptive father, an old photo, and the day two powers first crossed paths.

episodes.title: The Caged Beast
episodes.overview: Searching for Xia Fei means going where no one looks. That has never stopped Cheng Xiaoshi.

episodes.title: Bloodbath in Laos
episodes.overview: Faced with a crisis, can Cheng Xiaoshi save Xia Fei, or will help come from someone else?

episodes.title: Jae
episodes.overview: A mysterious visitor from Bridon disrupts the photo studio's peace. What has he come for?

series.title: Lucky
series.overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

episodes.title: No Shortcuts
episodes.overview: After a wild night in Vegas, Lucky wakes up to discover her world has been turned upside down.

episodes.title: Make 'em Dance
episodes.overview: Seeking shelter, Lucky takes refuge with an unsuspecting family. Priscilla visits Lucky's father.

episodes.title: Read the Room
episodes.overview: Lucky tries to track down Cary—and her money. Agent Rand investigates Lucky's moves.

episodes.title: Too Close to See It
episodes.overview: As Lucky confronts betrayal, old grudges take a back seat to a deadly chase.

episodes.title: Are We Bad People?
episodes.overview: On the run again, Lucky makes a lucrative discovery. Agent Rand devises a plan.

episodes.title: Wherever You Go, There You Are
episodes.overview: Lucky must face her past while planning for her future.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.overview: Everything is on the line as Lucky navigates an explosive confrontation.

series.title: Meet the Owens
series.overview: Forget everything you think you know about Michael Owen. This is an action-packed and unexpectedly hilarious year in the life of the footballer-turned-Horse-Racing-Stable-owner & his famous family. Michael juggles a business on the edge with a chaotic home life, while daughter Gemma swaps social media for the saddle to become a jockey. Funny, warm… and far from boring.

episodes.title: A Stable Family
episodes.overview: In the doghouse after a heavy night out, Michael heads off to Manor House to meet Jamie Carragher and try to secure investment in the Stables, before a crucial season-ending race meeting at Chester. Meanwhile, Gemma comes to her Dad for some TV advice to try and overcome her nerves ahead of a first-ever presenting job.

episodes.title: A Winter's Tale
episodes.overview: It's Christmas time in the Owen household, where Gemma has decided to embark on a new challenge to become a jockey. Michael arranges for her to have a go on one of the horses at Manor House - the only issue is that it belongs to his old boss, Sir Alex Ferguson. Meanwhile, the off-season means Michael is off to the Auctions to take a huge risk, spending millions on new horses for next year.

episodes.title: Taking the Reigns
episodes.overview: As Michael looks to the future of Manor House Stables, he decides to teach his son James the ropes to get him more involved in the family business. James' first test is to entertain owners at a race out in Bahrain, but a degenerative eye condition complicates his potential role in the business.

episodes.title: New Pastures
episodes.overview: Michael & Louise prepare for an empty nest as their youngest children near the end of school, leaving Louise with an identity crisis for the next chapter of her life as a mum. Meanwhile, Michael is seeking redemption as a season opener at the Chester May Festival approaches. Following an embarrassing defeat 6 months ago, can Manor House regain local pride in front of their demanding owners?

episodes.title: Unbridled Confidence
episodes.overview: It's Royal Ascot & a chance for Michael to 'mix it with the big boys' on the biggest stage of all… but when his star horse fails to perform in training, dreams of the Winners Enclosure look shaky. Gemma's own gruelling training schedule steps up a gear as her race approaches, while Emily takes a big step towards being the first Owen to go to university.

episodes.title: Final Furlong
episodes.overview: It's Gemma's race at Glorious Goodwood but a disastrous accident in training threatens to derail everything. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Jessica takes her biggest step yet towards her dream of being an Olympic showjumper - at considerable cost to Michael, who is trying to balance the books at Manor House Stables.

series.title: Mousetrap
series.tagline: Prove I'm real or I'm the imposter.
series.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While hiding from society, a reclusive genius novelist Je Moon-jae falls victim to identity theft — only to be confronted by his doppelganger.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Noja uncovers the world of identity laundering after Moon-jae escapes his grip. Meanwhile, Detective Park Sun-yong pieces together the link between them.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Suspicious but intrigued, Noja takes Moon-jae on as both a client and a hostage. Their uneasy alliance leads them to setting up a carefully planned trap.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Moon-jae suspects The Rat may be a figure from his past. Following his newly recovered memory, he and Noja head to the island where the man once stayed.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A shocking tie surfaces between Noja and The Rat, while Sun-yong closes in on crucial evidence. Later, The Rat appears publicly, cornering Moon-jae.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Moon-jae reaches out to his longtime editor, hoping she can vouch for him. Lost in confusion, a text from Noja becomes his only lifeline.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After barely escaping, Moon-jae joins a frantic race for someone who can reveal his identity. Later, Sun-yong discovers a shocking truth about his past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Moon-jae sinks deeper into trouble. Sun-yong heads to a nursing home for answers — only to find his witness gone. Later, Noja's past buries him alive.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Moon-jae evades police to meet The Rat where it all began. Noja leaves him with heartfelt advice as Sun-yong continues to pursue a key witness.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Moon-jae stands at the center of a trap a lifetime in the making. Every lie and stolen identity surfaces as he questions: Is he the predator or the prey?

series.title: Mr. Fanboy
series.original_title: รักสุดใจนายแฟนบอย
series.overview: Cast in a BL drama with his idol, devoted fanboy Wan finds his heart pulled in a shocking new direction by the idol's protective partner, Third.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Cast in a BL drama with his idol, devoted fanboy Wan finds his heart pulled in a shocking new direction by the idol's protective partner, Third.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Wan's dream of meeting his idol turns into chaos when he's mistaken for a sasaeng and unexpectedly recruited to audition.

series.title: Mystic Nine
series.overview: Mystic Nine follows Zhang Qishan as he joins forces with Wu Laogou, alongside Huo Xiangu and the other members of the Mystic Nine, when turmoil returns to Changsha. The mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a century-old secret. Faced with life-and-death choices, bound by brotherhood, responsibility to their sects, and devotion to their country, they risk everything to protect their home and overcome the crisis.

series.title: NCIS
series.overview: From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, a team of special agents investigates any crime that has any connection to Navy and Marine Corps personnel, regardless of rank or position.

episodes.title: Yankee White
episodes.overview: While on Air Force One, a Navy commanding officer dies. Agents from the Navy NCIS decide to take the investigation into their own hands and also force a Secret Service Agent to help. Now the NCIS team has to figure out if the Navy officer's death was of natural causes or not.

episodes.title: Hung Out to Dry
episodes.overview: During a training exercise, a Marine's parachute fails to open and he crashes into a parked car. The NCIS team head to the scene and have to determine if the Marine's death was accidental or a murder.

episodes.title: Seadog
episodes.overview: When a Navy commander's body washes up on shore along with the bodies of two drug runners, Gibbs refuses to believe that the sailor who was killed was dirty.

episodes.title: The Immortals
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigate when a seaman's body is found at the bottom of the sea in his dress whites, with a ceremonial sword. They discover that he was addicted to an MMORPG. Now, the team must figure out how involved he was in the game and how far he would go to get revenge on his arch enemy, another sailor.

episodes.title: The Curse
episodes.overview: A Navy Lieutenant who was reported missing nearly ten years ago has been found by a deer hunter. When the NCIS team arrive at the scene to investigate, they see that his remains have been mummified.

episodes.title: High Seas
episodes.overview: An NCIS agent who used to work under Gibbs asks for the team's help investigating a case where sailors on an aircraft carrier are dying of a drug overdose, but have no history of any kind of drug abuse.

episodes.title: Sub Rosa
episodes.overview: A decomposed body is discovered in a tub of acid at a Naval base and Ducky and Abby learn that the victim was a submariner. However, there have been no reports of a sub crewmember missing.

episodes.title: Minimum Security
episodes.overview: The NCIS team head to Cuba to investigate a Navy translator's connection to smuggling at a detention center after he suddenly dies at the wheel of his car when returning to the U.S. from Guantanamo Bay.

episodes.title: Marine Down
episodes.overview: After a Marine widow receives a call from her dead husband, the NCIS team take on the case and have to exhume the body to deduce whether the call was a prank or not.

episodes.title: Left for Dead
episodes.overview: After being buried alive, a woman comes out of the grave with amnesia and the only thing she remembers is that there is a bomb aboard a Navy ship. While trying to help Jane Doe recover her identity, the team find out that not everything is what it first seemed.

episodes.title: Eye Spy
episodes.overview: When a Navy commander, who was a technical advisor to a civilian contractor for a Navy weapon, is found dead on the beach, the NCIS team investigate the murder using satellite technology.

episodes.title: My Other Left Foot
episodes.overview: The NCIS team are called in when a severed leg bearing a Marine tattoo is found in a trash bin, leading them to a small town where a murder scheme is afoot.

episodes.title: One Shot, One Kill
episodes.overview: The team investigate when a Marine recruitment officer is found shot to death by a sniper with a grudge, who leaves a white feather behind.

episodes.title: The Good Samaritan
episodes.overview: A Navy dentist stops near a parked car to help a stranded motorist who pulls out a gun. The team investigate a murder with the help from a local sheriff, Charley, when they find out about the similar murder of the Navy civilian employee.

episodes.title: Enigma
episodes.overview: Gibbs risks his career when his former commanding officer is accused of stealing funds.

episodes.title: Bête Noire
episodes.overview: A terrorist holds Ducky, Gerald, and Kate hostage while NCIS investigate how exactly the terror organization member got a job at a Navy base.

episodes.title: The Truth Is Out There
episodes.overview: When the body of a sailor is found after a party in an illegal night club, the team investigate a number of possible leads - including blackmail and accidental death.

episodes.title: UnSEALed
episodes.overview: The team are looking for an ex-SEAL who escaped from prison in search of revenge. He is determined to find the real murderer of his wife.

episodes.title: Dead Man Talking
episodes.overview: An NCIS agent has been murdered while investigating a case and the team's job is to find out what happened.

episodes.title: Missing
episodes.overview: A Marine goes missing after a date with a reporter. During the investigation, the team discover that three former members of his unit are dead and suspect the unit commander to be a serial killer.

episodes.title: Split Decision
episodes.overview: When a body of a murdered Marine is found in the forest, the investigation leads to the local militia and a weapon deal gone wrong.

episodes.title: A Weak Link
episodes.overview: Gibbs' team investigate the death of a SEAL during a training exercise, and come to suspect that it wasn't an accident, but a murder.

episodes.title: Reveille
episodes.overview: The terrorist from Bête Noire returns with a plan to attack the President. Gibbs and his team follow the clues to reveal his identity and find Kate who is kidnapped.

episodes.title: See No Evil
episodes.overview: The wife and nine-year-old blind daughter of a Navy captain are kidnapped and the captain is a hostage in his own office, communicating with the kidnapper, who watches his every step via computer camera.

episodes.title: The Good Wives Club
episodes.overview: A mummified remains of a woman are found in an abandoned compound. The team discover that the woman was missing for several months, was wearing a wedding dress when she died, and might have been a victim of a serial killer.

episodes.title: Vanished
episodes.overview: The NCIS team are called in to investigate when a perfectly functioning Marine helicopter is found in the middle of a crop circle.

episodes.title: Lt. Jane Doe
episodes.overview: A body of a woman in a Navy uniform is found by two sailors. Ducky links the murder to an unsolved case from ten years ago, and the team searches for a serial killer who left a note promising to return.

episodes.title: The Bone Yard
episodes.overview: NCIS discover that an area in a Marine's bombing range is where mafia has been dumping bodies for a while. One of the victims is an undercover FBI agent. The team set out to find a mole.

episodes.title: Terminal Leave
episodes.overview: The team must protect an Iraq veteran due to the threats made by terrorists. While trying to convince FBI Agent Lina Reyes to help them, the team are convinced that they have discovered the bomber.

episodes.title: Call of Silence
episodes.overview: Ernie Yost, an elder Marine veteran confesses to murdering his best friend almost 60 years ago in a war battle. The NCIS's job is to solve the secrets and save Ernie from prison.

episodes.title: Heart Break
episodes.overview: A strange case for Gibbs and his team opens when a Navy Commander dies after successful surgery. While researching the commander's past, the team find out that he collected a lot of enemies lately.

episodes.title: Forced Entry
episodes.overview: Laura Rowen, a Marine's wife, shoots an intruder in self defense when he is about to rape her. The team take on the case and find out that the wife is leading a double life while her husband is serving overseas.

episodes.title: Chained
episodes.overview: Tony disappears while doing an undercover operation as an escaped prisoner who is forced to stick to a convict that owns a key to an expensive ancient Iraqi sculpture. The GPS locator that Abby planted on Tony stops working and the team are forced to find Tony before he gets murdered by the thief.

episodes.title: Black Water
episodes.overview: A dead body of a two-year-missing Navy officer appears on the bottom of a lake. The team investigate the case with a help of a private detective.

episodes.title: Doppelgänger
episodes.overview: The team take on another strange case when a telemarketer reports a possible murder of a Petty Officer who appeared to be dying over the phone.

episodes.title: The Meat Puzzle
episodes.overview: A "meat puzzle" starts when Ducky identifies the pieces of three bodies that were stuffed inside a barrel a few months ago. They turn out to be bodies of a judge, prosecutor, and jury foreman that worked with Ducky on a rape case ten years ago.

episodes.title: Witness
episodes.overview: Erin Kendall claims to have seen a murder of a sailor in an apartment across from hers. Gibbs assigns the case to McGee who believes that he can resolve it himself. However, due to the lack of physical evidence, McGee turns to the team to help him.

episodes.title: Caught on Tape
episodes.overview: The team take on a case of a dead Marine who recorded his death while falling off a cliff. The prime suspects are his wife and his best friend with whom he had a picnic in the camp. Gibbs finds out they had an affair behind the dead man's back.

episodes.title: Pop Life
episodes.overview: NCIS start an investigation after Petty Officer Manda King is found dead in a bartender's bed. The suspect is the owner of a competing club where Manda's sister sings.

episodes.title: An Eye for an Eye
episodes.overview: When a sailor officer receives a pair of blue eyeballs, the NCIS team start investigating the case. Gibbs traces an ex-Navy agent that does illegal work.

episodes.title: Bikini Wax
episodes.overview: A Petty Officer that just returned to her job is found dead in the backstage of a bikini contest. The team find out that she possibly had a stalker behind her back.

episodes.title: Conspiracy Theory
episodes.overview: The team investigate a suicide case, believing that the main reason of her death is a nervous breakdown, but Ducky believes that she was actually murdered. FBI Special Agent Fornell helps them in the investigation. The team discover that the dead woman was involved in a love triangle and that this may have contributed to her death.

episodes.title: Red Cell
episodes.overview: After a Marine is murdered in a school campus the team discover a possible suspect for his murder, but they soon find the suspect murdered. Tim and Abby discover a trace to a "Red Cell" in the e-mails and the team believe that maybe the Marine was involved in a serious game.

episodes.title: Hometown Hero
episodes.overview: A young Marine is killed in Iraq, but he was investigated by police for a murder on a young girl in his hometown. While going through his personal belongings, they find the body of that girl. The local police believe that the corpsman murdered the girl, but Gibbs believes that he is innocent and he will try to prove it with a help of Faith Coleman.

episodes.title: SWAK
episodes.overview: When Tony opens a mysterious letter thinking it's for him, a small puff of white powder comes out and releases a possible deadly virus. Soon Kate and Tony are isolated in a bio-hazard isolation room for precaution. McGee and Gibbs work to discover who sent the envelope and how to cure their friends before it's too late for them.

episodes.title: Twilight
episodes.overview: A group of serial terrorists seek revenge and send Ari on an assignment to kill Gibbs. The NCIS team go on a hunt after him, but when they discover that Ari has a bigger plan, it is already too late.

episodes.title: Kill Ari (1)
episodes.overview: After the terrorist's attack, the NCIS team are shocked and are trying to cope with Kate's sudden death, each in their own way. Now, their mission is to collect all the possible info on Ari and find a way to stop him before he does any more damage.

episodes.title: Kill Ari (2)
episodes.overview: Still stressed over Kate's death, Gibbs is even more hurt when Ari kidnaps Ducky and decides to play with his mind. Gibbs sends Tony to follow Ziva, and after Jenny and Gibbs are almost shot to death, he is even more determined to finish once and for all with Ari, and Ziva's strange connection to Ari will be just the help that he needs.

episodes.title: Mind Games
episodes.overview: Gibbs is ordered to talk to a convict that is about to be executed, in order to discover information about the place where he hid his victims, but when the plan doesn't work, the team must solve the case in their own way.

episodes.title: Silver War
episodes.overview: When a corpse of a man is found inside a tomb that comes from the Civil War, the team discover that the victim, a Sergeant, was buried alive. During the investigation, Abby tracks down the last phone call of the victim.

episodes.title: Switch
episodes.overview: When an officer is shot to death on the freeway, the NCIS team take on the investigation. The first lead, a fact that the victim was leading a double life, take them to a possible solution of the crime, but the tables are turned when the victim's dying message is discovered and it leads them to a totally different clue.

episodes.title: The Voyeur's Web
episodes.overview: The NCIS team take up a strange case - a Marine's wife was murdered live on the Internet. The investigation reveals that two housewives were running a live Internet sex site and now they are both missing. While looking for them, the team will try to track down the webmaster and solve the alleged murder case.

episodes.title: Honor Code
episodes.overview: When a six-year-old boy informs the NCIS team that his father was kidnapped, the team discover that the missing father is actually a Lt. Commander working on a secret project named Honor, and that he is the only one who has the code that can open the project.

episodes.title: Under Covers
episodes.overview: When bodies of two hired assassins are delivered to the NCIS team, Ziva and Tony go undercover assuming the victim's identities in order to find the person who hired the assassins for their mission. Gibbs discovers that his team are not the only ones working on the case.

episodes.title: Frame-Up
episodes.overview: Tony is accused of murdering a woman whose body was found at Quantico and the team must prove his innocence.

episodes.title: Probie
episodes.overview: While on duty, McGee kills a man who is later discovered to be an undercover police officer. When Jen decides to approve the investigation on McGee, the NCIS team are forced to prove that McGee is not guilty, pushing Gibbs' relationship with Jen to the limit.

episodes.title: Model Behavior
episodes.overview: A supermodel dies while filming a reality show on a Marine base, and the NCIS team must discover who is the model's murderer. They discover a love triangle between the model and three other men, all suspects.

episodes.title: Boxed In
episodes.overview: While looking for smuggled weapons at a shipyard, Tony and Ziva disappear and it's up to NCIS to find them. Abby tries to find them by tracking down their GPS chips, but they seem to be out of reach.

episodes.title: Deception
episodes.overview: When a Lt. Commander in charge of a shipment of fuel rods for nuclear power stations disappears, the NCIS team are called in. The team must solve the case in time, before the person who kidnapped the Commander finds out the secret location of the fuel rods or harms the Commander.

episodes.title: Light Sleeper
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigate the murder of two Marine wives, and must find the murderers before they attack their next target, another woman.

episodes.title: Head Case
episodes.overview: While discovering an illegal automotive chop shop, the NCIS team stumble upon a severed head of a Marine, hidden in one of the cars from the shop. When they find possible suspects, the team will have to find the rest of the body and find the murderer.

episodes.title: Family Secret
episodes.overview: When an ambulance explodes while carrying the remains of a Marine's body that was killed in a car crash, the NCIS team are called in to investigate what actually happened. The investigation leads them to some sudden discoveries - the DNA of the victim found in the ambulance doesn't match the Marine's DNA, the ambulance was set up to explode, and the family of the dead Marine is hiding a very important secret.

episodes.title: Ravenous
episodes.overview: When Marine dog tags are found in a national forest by a group of teens, the NCIS team are called in to investigate. While searching for the campsite of the Marine, the team find out that there was another person, possibly a woman, with him. The investigation takes them to an even more higher discovery - there could be a serial killer killing women in the national forest.

episodes.title: Bait
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must stop a teenage student from detonating a bomb attached to his body, while he's taking the other students hostage at a Quantico base high school. Gibbs tries to stop him when he enters the classroom, only to realize that there may be someone else controlling the teenage student from the outside.

episodes.title: Iced
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team are called in when a couple of kids stumble upon the body of a missing Marine in a frozen lake. As the NCIS team search the frozen lake bed for clues, they come across three more bullet-ridden bodies.

episodes.title: Untouchable
episodes.overview: When a Pentagon cryptographer is found dead, the NCIS team have to discover whether she was or wasn't a Pentagon mole, and if she committed suicide. As the investigation continues, the team discover that the cryptographer wasn't alone when she died.

episodes.title: Bloodbath
episodes.overview: While working on a regular murder case with the rest of the NCIS team, Abby is almost killed by evidence from the case. Soon it becomes clear that the murder was staged, and that someone wants Abby dead. The team discover some enemies from Abby's past, and they must find out who is the person, before they kill Abby.

episodes.title: Jeopardy
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must protect Ziva when a suspect dies in custody, and her tactic might be the reason why the person died. Things become much more dangerous when the suspect's brother kidnapps Jenny, and demands the release of his brother in exchange for Jenny, but he has no idea that his brother is dead.

episodes.title: Hiatus (1)
episodes.overview: While working on an assignment, Gibbs is seriously injured in an explosion, and taken to a hospital, where he recalls his painful past, which he has always hidden from others. The rest of the team must proceed with the investigation and put their feelings towards Gibbs' injury aside.

episodes.title: Hiatus (2)
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must work on an assignment against a terrorist group without Gibbs, who is still recovering from the explosion. Gibbs has to fight with memory loss, while he's visited by his mentor and his former boss. Gibbs' help is needed, especially when the team discover that he is the only person who has information about the terrorists' plans.

episodes.title: Shalom
episodes.overview: When Ziva is framed for a political assassination, she must avoid the FBI and deal with the consequences without Gibbs' help, who is now enjoying his retirement.

episodes.title: Escaped
episodes.overview: Gibbs is forced to come back out of his retirement to help Fornell, who is being threatened by a convict that escaped from prison. Gibbs and the NCIS team re-open the convict's old robbery case.

episodes.title: Singled Out
episodes.overview: An abandoned car, registered to a missing Navy Lieutenant, is found with blood stains inside. The NCIS team learn that the missing Lieutenant was profiling men, trying to find a perfect man for herself.

episodes.title: Faking It
episodes.overview: After police pull over a driver and arrest him for a concealed weapon, a car crashes into their patrol car with a dead man behind the wheel. The arrested man turns out to be Russian and Homeland Security claim he was working for them.

episodes.title: Dead and Unburied
episodes.overview: When a missing Lance Corporal is found dead in a vacant house, the NCIS team discover that he was buried in the backyard and then exhumed. They learn about his identity and that he was to be deployed to Iraq, but he never showed up for duty.

episodes.title: Witch Hunt
episodes.overview: It's Halloween and the NCIS team are busy investigating a ransom case. A Marine's daughter has been kidnapped after the Marine was attacked in his home. The investigation leads them to a fact that the couple has been separated.

episodes.title: Sandblast
episodes.overview: When a Marine Colonel dies in an explosion at a military golf course, the NCIS team must investigate a suspected terrorist attack with the help from the Army Criminal Investigative Division.

episodes.title: Once a Hero
episodes.overview: When an honored Marine veteran is found dead in a hotel, the NCIS team must find out what happened to him. Soon they realize that the Marine didn't commit suicide and that he was a homeless man.

episodes.title: Twisted Sister
episodes.overview: McGee breaks the rules, risking his NCIS job, to help his sister Sarah, who shows up disoriented and bloodied. While he works on figuring out what happened to his sister, the NCIS team are investigating a case of a Navy sailor, who is somehow connected to Sarah.

episodes.title: Smoked
episodes.overview: When a burnt and mummified body of a missing and wanted person is found in a furnace on a Marine base, NCIS must work with the FBI. The burnt man turns out to be a serial killer.

episodes.title: Driven
episodes.overview: When a robotic vehicle named "Otto," a part of a high-level project of the Department of Defense, causes a death of a Navy Lieutenant, and later almost kills Abby, the NCIS team must find out who sabotaged the vehicle and murdered the Lieutenant.

episodes.title: Suspicion
episodes.overview: When a high-level Marine intelligence officer is found murdered in a small motel room, the NCIS team must find the person who murdered her. After discovering that she was already dead for three days, and that the town authorities already "investigated" the crime, Gibbs is determined to solve the case.

episodes.title: Sharif Returns
episodes.overview: When the NCIS team learn that a missing ten kilograms of highly toxic chemical weapons are now in the hands of Mamoun Sharif, a wanted terrorist, they will have to find a way to find the man and stop him before it's too late.

episodes.title: Blowback
episodes.overview: After catching an international arms dealer, the NCIS team learn that the Navy's highly classified weapons system will be sold to arms dealer La Grenouille. To stop the transaction, the team send Ducky undercover.

episodes.title: Friends and Lovers
episodes.overview: When a dead body of a sailor is found in an abandoned part of the town, all the evidence seem to point that the person died from a drug overdose, but when the team uncover more evidence, it turns out to be a murder.

episodes.title: Dead Man Walking
episodes.overview: When a Navy Lieutenant becomes the victim of radiation poisoning, the NCIS team must find the person who's behind the crime. The Lieutenant, who is working for the International Atomic Energy Agency, claims that only his two colleagues knew about his assignment, and whoever it was, the person tried to stop the Lieutenant's next investigation.

episodes.title: Skeletons
episodes.overview: When an explosion at a military cemetery mausoleum reveals a crypt full of a mixture of body parts, the NCIS team must inform the families of the victims, hoping to find a connection and narrow down the suspects to find out who is behind the hideous crime.

episodes.title: Iceman
episodes.overview: When a supposedly frozen to death Marine turns out alive on Ducky's autopsy table, the NCIS team have to find out about the victim's movements in the last few days to uncover what happened to him and who left him for dead.

episodes.title: Grace Period
episodes.overview: When a weekend call to the NCIS tip line from an unknown source about possible terrorist activity results in the death of two agents sent into a trap, the NCIS team will have to find out who were the people responsible with the help from Agent Paula Cassidy, who holds herself responsible for the tragedy.

episodes.title: Cover Story
episodes.overview: McGee is under high pressure during the murder investigation of a Petty Officer based on the character for his latest book, with very little information to go on.

episodes.title: Brothers in Arms
episodes.overview: Director Shepard makes a huge mistake by meeting a man alone to inform her about La Grenouille, as their meeting turns into a murder of the informant. Now the NCIS team must gather all the existing info and try to finally hunt down their enemy.

episodes.title: In the Dark
episodes.overview: When a blind photographer shoots the body of a Petty Officer on film, the NCIS team use his special insight to investigate the crime.

episodes.title: Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: When Jenny has to attend an overseas conference, Gibbs is made acting director, but he prefers to ignore his duties and lead the investigation of the murder of a man, who was found dead in a taxi headed to the NCIS headquarters.

episodes.title: Angel of Death
episodes.overview: When Jenny returns from her European trip, the entire NCIS team will be forced to take a Homeland Security polygraph test, and the deepest secrets of each agent are about to be revealed. Plus, an unarmed Tony and Jeanne are held hostage by a ruthless drug dealer.

episodes.title: Bury Your Dead
episodes.overview: The NCIS team uncover a huge secret, as their mission to capture La Grenouille comes to an explosive and deadly conclusion.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.overview: During an autopsy, Ducky makes a startling discovery that turns a murder of a Petty Officer into a search for a missing infant.

episodes.title: Ex-File
episodes.overview: Lt. Colonel Mann joins Gibbs in an investigation of the murder of a Marine Captain who had access to highly classified information. Things get very personal for Gibbs when one of the witnesses in the case turns out to be one of his ex-wives.

episodes.title: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: When Ducky realizes that one of his cadavers used for research is actually a victim of murder, the NCIS team identify him as a criminal genius who is capable of deleting the past.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.overview: The NCIS team are called in to stop a Naval officer from committing suicide by jumping off a rooftop, but when the suicide attempt turns into a murder, the NCIS team will have to find out who did it.

episodes.title: Chimera
episodes.overview: While investigating a mysterious death on a top-secret Naval research ship at sea, the NCIS team board the abandoned ship and find a deadly secret that may cost them their lives.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.overview: Gibbs finds himself emotionally challenged when he agrees to investigate a crime connected to a friend of his daughter, who passed away years ago, and the investigation leads to a shocking conclusion.

episodes.title: Designated Target
episodes.overview: A murder investigation of a Navy Admiral takes a shocking turn when a woman, a political refugee, returns home to search for her husband.

episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.overview: The NCIS team have to babysit a nine-year-old son of a missing man, a survivalist who is somehow connected to a cold case murder. The investigation leads the team into the wilderness, where they discover a shocking truth about the man's past.

episodes.title: Corporal Punishment
episodes.overview: While trying to track down a delusional and violent Marine who thinks he's still in Iraq, the NCIS team learn that the man has been the subject of a secret experiment - and it comes with a high price to pay.

episodes.title: Tribes
episodes.overview: After a young Muslim Marine is murdered near his Mosque, Ducky refuses to perform an autopsy due to his religious beliefs. The NCIS team try to talk to the father of the deceased, and they send McGee to plant a bug in the Mosque, only to discover that the FBI already planted their own bug.

episodes.title: Stakeout
episodes.overview: The NCIS team go on a stakeout in a warehouse to catch a suspected thief of a high-tech Naval radar, but they accidentally end up witnessing a murder.

episodes.title: Dog Tags
episodes.overview: When a dog owner is found murdered, the NCIS team must determine if his dog committed the murder or not, and Abby decides to fight for the dog's life by trusting her instinct about the dog's innocence.

episodes.title: Internal Affairs
episodes.overview: The dead body of La Grenouille surfaces and the entire NCIS is put under investigation by the FBI, with Jenny as the prime suspect for his murder.

episodes.title: In the Zone
episodes.overview: Two members of the NCIS team are sent to Baghdad to investigate a mortar attack that turned into a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Recoil
episodes.overview: While on an undercover mission, Ziva's life is put in grave danger when the serial killer she's been tracking becomes suspicious of her.

episodes.title: About Face
episodes.overview: Palmer is put in grave danger when he becomes the target of an anonymous murderer, whom only he can recognize.

episodes.title: Judgment Day (1)
episodes.overview: When a former NCIS agent is found dead, the entire team is put in danger as they hunt after the killer.

episodes.title: Judgment Day (2)
episodes.overview: When one of their own is killed, the team must find the killer before they get to another member of the team, Gibbs. In an emotional investigation, the team tries to stay together, against the wishes of Assistant Director Vance.

episodes.title: Last Man Standing
episodes.overview: When a Petty Officer is found murdered, Gibbs learns about the mysterious connection between the disbanding of his team and the case.

episodes.title: Agent Afloat
episodes.overview: DiNozzo's investigation into a Navy Lieutenant's apparent suicide takes a surprising and deadly turn when it seems that it might have a connection to a larger, deadly scheme.

episodes.title: Capitol Offense
episodes.overview: A distinguished senator asks Gibbs for help in solving the murder of a young female Naval officer.

episodes.title: Heartland
episodes.overview: When a murder investigation leads the team to Gibbs' hometown, secrets about his past are revealed.

episodes.title: Nine Lives
episodes.overview: Gibbs' hunt for the killer of a Marine puts him on a collision course with an old friend.

episodes.title: Murder 2.0
episodes.overview: Gibbs and his team are searching for a cyber serial killer who takes videos of his victims. The team quickly finds out that the videos of the dead victims are false.

episodes.title: Collateral Damage
episodes.overview: A Navy bank has been robbed and NCIS is responsible for the investigation. One of the new recruits assigned to the fraud unit, Special Agent Dwayne Wilson, joins the team to help.

episodes.title: Cloak
episodes.overview: A strange delivery in a box arrives at a Navy facility. The delivery driver and a Navy MP officer discover it is a sailor's corpse.

episodes.title: Dagger
episodes.overview: The team is forced to rely on information from questionable sources while trying to stop a criminal bent on stealing government secrets.

episodes.title: Road Kill
episodes.overview: The team investigates the death of a Petty Officer and discovers he may have been leading a violent secret life.

episodes.title: Silent Night
episodes.overview: During the week of Christmas, the NCIS team is forced to work overtime when they discover their prime suspect had been dead for 17 years.

episodes.title: Caged
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must uncover the truth behind the murder of a jail guard which resulted in a prison riot and McGee being held captive by the inmates.

episodes.title: Broken Bird
episodes.overview: Secrets from Ducky's clandestine past come to the forefront after he's attacked at a crime scene.

episodes.title: Love and War
episodes.overview: The team discovers a link between a sergeant's murder and his possibly treasonous private life.

episodes.title: Deliverance
episodes.overview: Demons of the past come back to haunt Gibbs when he finds a cryptic message waiting for him at a crime scene.

episodes.title: Bounce
episodes.overview: A murder prompts the reopening of one of Tony's old investigations, leading Gibbs and DiNozzo to reverse roles to solve the case.

episodes.title: South by Southwest
episodes.overview: When a fellow agent is murdered, the NCIS team head into the desert to locate a woman who might hold the answer to the mystery murder.

episodes.title: Knockout
episodes.overview: The death of a boxer leads Vance to borrow the NCIS team and start investigating his death, while Gibbs digs into Vance's past.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: When a young boy finds a murder weapon, the team must trace ownership of the gun to find who used it last and who was murdered.

episodes.title: Dead Reckoning
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team must work with the shady Trent Kort to put away one of NCIS's most wanted.

episodes.title: Toxic
episodes.overview: When a government scientist goes missing, Abby is recruited to carry on his work, but the team worries that she may meet the same fate as her predecessor.

episodes.title: Legend (1)
episodes.overview: The body of a Marine leads Gibbs and McGee to the NCIS OSP division in Los Angeles, where a murder investigation quickly climbs to a matter of national security.

episodes.title: Legend (2)
episodes.overview: With the appearance of Mossad agent Michael Rivkin, Tony is forced to question Ziva’s loyalty to NCIS.

episodes.title: Semper Fidelis
episodes.overview: After a security breach at the SecNav's residence leads to the death of an ICE agent, Gibbs and the team are forced to work with ICE and the FBI to find his killer.

episodes.title: Aliyah
episodes.overview: Ziva's homecoming to Israel with Gibbs and the team is not a happy reunion with her father, the enigmatic and powerful head of Mossad. As tensions rise, Gibbs is forced to make a decision that sends shock waves through NCIS.

episodes.title: Truth or Consequences
episodes.overview: As the hunt for Ziva's replacement begins, Gibbs and his remaining team members must head back to work with the past still weighing heavily on their minds.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.overview: The team discovers the bizarre death of a Marine and his two friends may be linked to their past, but it's Gibbs who ends up taking a trip down memory lane.

episodes.title: The Inside Man
episodes.overview: The team must take a second look into the death of a Lieutenant after the blogger who accused them of a cover-up ends up dead.

episodes.title: Good Cop, Bad Cop
episodes.overview: When a Marine's body surfaces halfway around the world, the investigation forces Ziva to dig up a buried chapter of her life.

episodes.title: Code of Conduct
episodes.overview: When a Marine known for his practical jokes is found dead on Halloween Eve, the NCIS team discovers that the victim's "good-natured" pranks may have inspired ghoulish retribution.

episodes.title: Outlaws and In-Laws
episodes.overview: A murder investigation prompts Gibbs and the team to play family counselor to his former mentor, Mike Franks, in the hopes of preventing a bloody international conflict.

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.overview: With the team's help, Vance faces his demons while uncovering a complex relationship with a killer that puts his whole family in danger.

episodes.title: Power Down
episodes.overview: The team literally finds themselves in the dark when the investigation into the death of a Lieutenant is connected to a city-wide blackout.

episodes.title: Child's Play
episodes.overview: A dead Marine's day job at a government think tank leads Gibbs and the team into the life of a 12-year-old prodigy who may be the killer's next target.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.overview: The body of the son of a retired Colonel-turned-preacher is found and the team have their suspicions that he may be the victim of a hate crime.

episodes.title: Ignition
episodes.overview: When a Navy pilot is found dead under strange circumstances in a secluded area, the team finds themselves battling a no-nonsense attorney with a hidden agenda.

episodes.title: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: Gibbs is worried about Tony's ability to handle his job when Tony's father turns out to be linked to their newest investigation, an assassination attempt on a foreign prince.

episodes.title: Jet Lag
episodes.overview: While on the flight back from Paris, Tony and Ziva realize that their assignment to protect a government witness in an embezzlement case is in great danger when they learn that an assassin is located on the same flight.

episodes.title: Masquerade
episodes.overview: The team finds themselves in a race against time when a terrorist group threatens to detonate a "dirty bomb" in the D.C. area.

episodes.title: Jack-Knife
episodes.overview: When a Marine is found dead, Gibbs, Fornell, and the team hit the open road to bust an illegal trucking operation.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.overview: Secrets arise when Gibbs' former mother-in-law surfaces as a witness in a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Double Identity
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team investigate the shooting of a Marine and uncovers more to his life than anyone would have ever imagined.

episodes.title: Jurisdiction
episodes.overview: The team discovers striking similarities between themselves and their CGIS (Coast Guard Investigative Services) counterparts when a Navy diver seeking sunken treasure is found dead.

episodes.title: Guilty Pleasure
episodes.overview: The death of a Navy officer leads Gibbs and the team into the world of high-priced call girls, relying on D.C. Madam Holly Snow to help them catch a killer.

episodes.title: Moonlighting
episodes.overview: When an NCIS polygraph specialist's night job takes a dangerous turn, Gibbs, Fornell, and the team have to uncover the truth.

episodes.title: Obsession
episodes.overview: DiNozzo finds himself increasingly captivated by a woman he's never met while investigating the murder of her brother.

episodes.title: Borderland
episodes.overview: The team tries to track down a serial killer, while Abby heads south of the border to give a speech with McGee in tow.

episodes.title: Patriot Down
episodes.overview: When a colleague's murder sends shockwaves through the team, Gibbs uncovers a surprising link to the crime.

episodes.title: Rule Fifty-One
episodes.overview: Gibbs heads to Mexico to face his demons and make a startling decision.

episodes.title: Spider and the Fly
episodes.overview: Gibbs must take desperate measures to protect his loved ones with Paloma Reynosa still on the loose.

episodes.title: Worst Nightmare
episodes.overview: The NCIS team has to find a young girl that was kidnapped, but their investigation turns into something else when her grandfather gets way too involved.

episodes.title: Short Fuse
episodes.overview: The team investigates a bomb tech's guarded personal life after she is attacked.

episodes.title: Royals and Loyals
episodes.overview: The team hopes to avoid an international incident when an American officer is killed on a British ship.

episodes.title: Dead Air
episodes.overview: The team uncovers a sinister plan when a controversial DJ and a Naval officer are shot to death.

episodes.title: Cracked
episodes.overview: Abby becomes fixated on solving a murder, while DiNozzo's latest fling leads to an interesting Halloween.

episodes.title: Broken Arrow
episodes.overview: The team is surprised when Gibbs asks Tony's father to join them in a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Enemies Foreign (1)
episodes.overview: The team is assigned to protect Ziva's father, when his attendance at a NCIS conference leads to some unexpected surprises.

episodes.title: Enemies Domestic (2)
episodes.overview: The team scrambles for answers after a shocking ambush reveals a new twist to their current investigation.

episodes.title: False Witness
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates the disappearance of a Petty Officer who is the sole witness in an upcoming murder trial.

episodes.title: Ships in the Night
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the NCIS team partner with a Coast Guard Investigative Service (CGIS) Agent to solve the murder of a Marine gunned down on a dinner boat.

episodes.title: Recruited
episodes.overview: A Petty Officer's recruitment session at a college fair comes to a fatal end, prompting the NCIS team, accompanied by Dr. Mallard's predecessor, to solve his murder.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.overview: The NCIS team springs into action to find the assailant responsible for beating a Marine to death in his own backyard.

episodes.title: A Man Walks Into a Bar ...
episodes.overview: The NCIS team undergoes mandatory psych evaluations while investigating the death of a Naval Commander.

episodes.title: Defiance
episodes.overview: A botched assassination attempt in Belgravia forces NCIS to protect the Defense Minister's daughter, who is studying in the U.S. and smitten with McGee.

episodes.title: Kill Screen
episodes.overview: The dismembered fingertips and teeth of a murdered Marine are discovered in the stolen purse of a pickpocketer, launching NCIS on a mission to find a cold-blooded killer.

episodes.title: One Last Score
episodes.overview: NCIS discovers that one of its former investigative assistants found brutally stabbed to death was selling details for how to rob a warehouse full of valuable possessions belonging to a woman convicted of fraud.

episodes.title: Out of the Frying Pan...
episodes.overview: Gibbs questions Vance's motives when he is asked to interrogate a teenage boy accused of killing his retired Marine father.

episodes.title: Tell-All
episodes.overview: NCIS connects a message in blood left by a murdered Navy commander to a manuscript that may contain classified military information.

episodes.title: Two-Faced
episodes.overview: To Gibbs' displeasure, Special Agent E.J. Barrett returns to lead the investigation of a seaman's death that may be connected to a series of port-related murders.

episodes.title: Dead Reflection
episodes.overview: The NCIS team tracks a Navy Lieutenant's killer after a Pentagon security camera reveals a Petty Officer committing the crime.

episodes.title: Baltimore
episodes.overview: After Tony's ex-partner, Danny Price, appears to be the Port-to-Port Killer's latest victim, he revisits his days as a detective in Baltimore, including his first encounter with Gibbs.

episodes.title: Swan Song
episodes.overview: After new evidence reveals that the Port-to-Port Killer has infiltrated the agency, the NCIS team chases every lead in a race to track him down.

episodes.title: Pyramid
episodes.overview: The lives of NCIS members are in jeopardy when they come face-to-face with the infamous Port-to-Port Killer.

episodes.title: Nature of the Beast
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the NCIS team have to find answers regarding Tony's months-long assignment when an NCIS agent is found dead.

episodes.title: Restless
episodes.overview: The NCIS team uncovers a startling surprise after a young Marine shows up to his homecoming party with a fatal stab wound.

episodes.title: The Penelope Papers
episodes.overview: The line between McGee's personal and professional life is blurred when NCIS uncovers a connection between his grandmother and the murder of a Navy Lieutenant.

episodes.title: Enemy on the Hill
episodes.overview: The NCIS team searches for the person and motive behind a contract killer targeting a Navy Lieutenant Commander.

episodes.title: Safe Harbor
episodes.overview: When a coast guard officer is gunned down on a cargo vessel, the NCIS team searches for the killer, but finds a Lebanese family seeking refuge on American soil.

episodes.title: Thirst
episodes.overview: An NCIS case changes from accidental death to murder when evidence reveals that a Navy Lieutenant died of forced over-hydration.

episodes.title: Devil's Triangle
episodes.overview: The NCIS team searches for answers when the current husband of both Gibbs' and Fornell's ex-wife is suspiciously kidnapped.

episodes.title: Engaged (1)
episodes.overview: The NCIS team uncovers a discrepancy with DNA remains when investigating the crash of a military plane that had been transporting caskets.

episodes.title: Engaged (2)
episodes.overview: As the NCIS team continues its search for a missing Marine, Gibbs and Ziva travel to her last known whereabouts in Afghanistan.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.overview: After Anthony DiNozzo, Sr. is found in a car with a dead body in the trunk and no memory of the previous night, the NCIS team must figure out if he is capable of murder.

episodes.title: Newborn King
episodes.overview: When a Navy Captain is killed in a hotel room, NCIS must track down and protect his very pregnant companion from unknown assailants.

episodes.title: Housekeeping
episodes.overview: An investigation into the murder of a Navy Commander leads the NCIS team to E.J. Barrett’s whereabouts.

episodes.title: A Desperate Man
episodes.overview: When a Navy Lieutenant Commander is found dead in a building under construction, NCIS must search for a killer while dealing with interruptions from her distraught detective husband.

episodes.title: Life Before His Eyes
episodes.overview: During a routine stop for his morning coffee, Gibbs finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun, forcing him to question choices he has made in the past and present.

episodes.title: Secrets
episodes.overview: When a Navy Captain is found dead with an unusual costume hidden under his uniform, NCIS uncovers a secret society of real-life super heroes and must track down the villain.

episodes.title: Psych Out
episodes.overview: Gibbs clashes with Dr. Samantha Ryan over the truth behind a Navy reservist's possible suicide.

episodes.title: Need to Know
episodes.overview: Top-secret clearance from a Naval research laboratory is jeopardized when the murder of a Chief Petty Officer is connected to an international arms dealer.

episodes.title: The Tell
episodes.overview: The Secretary of the Navy partners Gibbs with Dr. Samantha Ryan after top secret information is leaked by someone on the inside.

episodes.title: The Good Son
episodes.overview: A case hits close to home when the lead suspect in the murder of a Petty Officer is Director Vance's brother-in-law.

episodes.title: The Missionary Position
episodes.overview: Following the murder of a Marine, Tony and Ziva join Ziva’s longtime friend and mentor in Columbia in a search for a missing Marine Lieutenant and Navy Chaplain.

episodes.title: Rekindled
episodes.overview: After a warehouse fire reveals missing Navy documents, posing a potential threat to national security, the NCIS team joins the Baltimore P.D. investigation, reuniting Tony with a boy from his past.

episodes.title: Playing with Fire
episodes.overview: The NCIS investigation of a fire on a Navy vessel reveals evidence that elevates security at all U.S. Navy facilities worldwide.

episodes.title: Up in Smoke
episodes.overview: The NCIS team analyzes what secrets could be in the hands of a terrorist targeting the Navy when a high-tech bug is found inside a probationary agent’s tooth.

episodes.title: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes.overview: Terrorism shakes the foundations of the Navy and NCIS to such an extent that Gibbs and the team face surprises that will devastate them.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Despite a bomb attack on Gibbs and the team, duty continues to call for these special agents as they try to regroup and put the pieces back together.

episodes.title: Extreme Prejudice
episodes.overview: With NCIS headquarters damaged by the bomb, Gibbs goes on the hunt for Harper Dearing to bring him down once and for all.

episodes.title: Recovery
episodes.overview: When the body of a missing NCIS facilities manager is found four months after disappearing on the day of the Navy Yard bombings, the NCIS team is assigned to investigate the strange case for one of their own.

episodes.title: Phoenix
episodes.overview: While on medical leave, Ducky orders the exhumation of a Navy Commander's body from a case closed 12 years ago. As a result, Gibbs tasks Ducky with a slightly different role on the investigation.

episodes.title: Lost at Sea
episodes.overview: When a helicopter crew is adrift at sea and later discovered on shore, the NCIS team must determine the cause of the crash and locate the missing pilot.

episodes.title: The Namesake
episodes.overview: A Petty Officer is gunned down in a billionaire’s Ferrari and the investigation leads the NCIS team to discover a link to a man Gibbs was named after.

episodes.title: Shell Shock (1)
episodes.overview: When a Navy Lieutenant who recently returned home from the Middle East is found dead from a brutal attack, the NCIS team questions the victim’s friend, Marine Captain Joe Wescott.

episodes.title: Shell Shock (2)
episodes.overview: Gibbs continues to work with Captain Wescott while he retraces his steps in order to help the NCIS team track down a terrorist.

episodes.title: Gone
episodes.overview: As the NCIS team investigates a teenage girl’s abduction, Ziva and Abby work closely with her young friend who witnessed the kidnapping. As the investigation unfolds, Gibbs seeks help from a past contact, Miranda Pennebaker, a well-connected woman with questionable morals.

episodes.title: Devil's Trifecta
episodes.overview: Gibbs teams up with FBI Agent Fornell on a joint NCIS/FBI investigation after Fornell becomes the target of a shooting, but they face an unexpected twist in the case when their mutual ex-wife, Diane Sterling, gets involved.

episodes.title: You Better Watch Out
episodes.overview: It’s Christmas time and Tony DiNozzo can’t decide if he’ll be naughty or nice when his dad, Anthony DiNozzo, Sr., comes to town for a visit.

episodes.title: Shabbat Shalom
episodes.overview: While the NCIS team investigates the link between a dead journalist and a Petty Officer, Ziva is taken aback by the sudden emotional visit by her father, who she hasn't seen in more than two years.

episodes.title: Shiva
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of an event that strikes close to home, the NCIS team unites to seek answers and demand justice in order to protect their most vulnerable colleagues.

episodes.title: Hit and Run
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates a Marine’s car accident and ignites some upsetting past memories for Abby as a young girl on the trail of her first “case”.

episodes.title: Canary
episodes.overview: The NCIS team takes on a renowned hacker who could hold the key to tracking down the most-wanted cyber-terrorist in the world.

episodes.title: Hereafter
episodes.overview: On leave from NCIS while still grieving the loss of his wife and his kids’ mother, Director Vance discovers unexpected personal information that causes him to question everything.

episodes.title: Detour
episodes.overview: The NCIS team races to track down Ducky and Jimmy after the two disappear while transporting a body from a crime scene.

episodes.title: Prime Suspect
episodes.overview: A media frenzy surrounding an unidentified criminal prompts Gibbs’ barber to question his son’s involvement and ask for Gibbs’ help in ruling out his son as a prime suspect.

episodes.title: Seek
episodes.overview: A widowed Marine wife, whose husband was seemingly killed by a Taliban sniper, asks Gibbs for help to find out the truth.

episodes.title: Squall
episodes.overview: The team investigates death of a Navy medical officer aboard a ship that went through a storm.

episodes.title: Chasing Ghosts
episodes.overview: While the team takes a missing person case, Tony is disturbed by Ziva's way of coping with her father's death.

episodes.title: Berlin
