episodes.overview: Ziva continues to pursue revenge against Eli's killer, Ilan Bodnar, and Vance continues to endorse her actions despite orders from Homeland Security to rein them in.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.overview: In retaliation for the murders of Eli David and Jackie Vance, the NCIS team feverishly searches for Bodnar despite orders from Homeland Security to relinquish the case.

episodes.title: Double Blind
episodes.overview: The team examines whether a Petty Officer is suffering from paranoia or if his claims of being followed are tied to a matter of national security.

episodes.title: Damned If You Do
episodes.overview: The international manhunt for Eli David's killer turns into a federal witch hunt against Gibbs and the team, which questions their unconventional methods and threatens their future at the agency.

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: When Season 10 ended in the series' biggest cliffhanger, the NCIS was virtually disbanded and Gibbs was aiming a rifle at the FBI agent responsible.

episodes.title: Whiskey Tango Foxtrot
episodes.overview: An explosion at a D.C. event that results in a casualty connected to the agency changes Parsons’ perspective on Gibbs and the NCIS team.

episodes.title: Past, Present, and Future
episodes.overview: Determined to locate Ziva, Tony chases leads in Israel in search of her current whereabouts. Meanwhile, Gibbs and the team continue the hunt for Parsa and his growing terrorist ring.

episodes.title: Under the Radar
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must rely on Twitter for a case involving a missing Navy Lieutenant.

episodes.title: Anonymous Was a Woman
episodes.overview: Gibbs and McGee travel to Afghanistan when a murder case leads them to an Afghan women’s shelter that Mike Frank secretly supported for years.

episodes.title: Once a Crook
episodes.overview: DiNozzo returns to his Baltimore Police Department days when he sees a felony suspect from a 15-year-old case at the NCIS crime scene of a murdered Petty Officer.

episodes.title: Oil & Water
episodes.overview: The Coast Guard Investigative Service works with the NCIS team when an explosion occurs on an oil rig.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.overview: After Gibbs leaves mid-case to help his father reconnect with a former war pilot, Tony and McGee argue over who should run lead on the team’s investigation into the murder of a Marine Sergeant.

episodes.title: Alibi
episodes.overview: The team is forced to take another look at a hit-and-run murder case.

episodes.title: Gut Check
episodes.overview: After discovering the Secretary of the Navy was bugged during a confidential briefing, NSA Analyst Eleanor Bishop, who predicted the security breach in exact detail two years ago, partners with the NCIS team on the case.

episodes.title: Devil’s Triad
episodes.overview: Complications arise when the NCIS team discovers a link between a murder victim and the current boyfriend of Gibbs and Agent Fornell’s ex-wife.

episodes.title: Homesick
episodes.overview: After a mysterious illness strikes children from military families, Gibbs and the team investigate the cause. Abby and Jimmy partner with the Naval Medical Research Center to determine the strain of illness, all in hopes of delivering a cure before the holidays.

episodes.title: Kill Chain
episodes.overview: When a stolen drone is linked to the elusive terrorist Parsa, the NCIS team partners with the Department of Defense, including Gibb’s former girlfriend Hollis Mann, to track down the device before it is used for a large scale attack.

episodes.title: Double Back
episodes.overview: In an effort to find the terrorist Parsa, Gibbs and the NCIS team track down one of his cohorts using evidence from the drone attack.

episodes.title: Monsters and Men
episodes.overview: A port authority officer's murder reveals a possible location for Parsa, while Bishop reveals a past connection to the terrorist.

episodes.title: Bulletproof
episodes.overview: After uncovering faulty bulletproof vests in a truck filled with stolen U.S.M.C. merchandise, the NCIS team attempts to locate both the source and any vests that had been shipped to military personnel overseas.

episodes.title: Dressed to Kill
episodes.overview: Someone winds up dead when DiNozzo confronts a man impersonating a Navy officer.

episodes.title: Rock and a Hard Place
episodes.overview: After a bomb detonates in the dressing room at a military charity concert, the NCIS team must determine if the target was a washed-up 1980s rocker or if the bomb was part of a larger scheme.

episodes.title: Crescent City (1)
episodes.overview: When a former NCIS agent's body washes ashore in New Orleans, Gibbs reunites with NCIS Special Agent Dwayne Cassius Pride to determine if the murder was politically motivated or related to a well-known case.

episodes.title: Crescent City (2)
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Special Agent Pride chase leads in New Orleans after evidence points to a copycat of the infamous Privileged Killer. DiNozzo, McGee, and the FBI continue to track political connections to the case from D.C.

episodes.title: Page Not Found
episodes.overview: After returning to her job at the Department of Defense, McGee’s girlfriend Delilah finds a break in a controversial case, prompting her to turn to the NCIS team for help.

episodes.title: Alleged
episodes.overview: After a Navy officer is found dead on a rural road, the NCIS team must ascertain if his death was the result of a bar fight or because he knew too much about an attack on a fellow female officer.

episodes.title: Shooter
episodes.overview: When a Marine photographer disappears prior to providing his testimony in an Army court-martial hearing, the NCIS team investigates both the murder he witnessed, as well as his current piece on military veterans who are homeless in the D.C. area.

episodes.title: The Admiral's Daughter
episodes.overview: Director Vance gives DiNozzo a special assignment to bring home an Admiral’s daughter from Paris, but he must turn to his NCIS team for help after he enters a controversial crime scene.

episodes.title: Honor Thy Father
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates whether a fire on a U.S. Navy ship that served as a secret detention site for indicted terrorists was accidental or an intentional diversion for an escape.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: In Season 12, Gibbs and McGee travel to Russia to retrieve a computer expert and get into an ongoing battle with mercenary Sergei Mishnev.

episodes.title: Twenty Klicks
episodes.overview: Gibbs and McGee travel to Russia to safely escort home an NCIS computer engineer with classified intel, but their mission is compromised and they are forced to go off the grid while hunted by a mercenary group.

episodes.title: Kill the Messenger
episodes.overview: When a Navy Lieutenant is killed on his way to a private meeting with the President, the NCIS team must determine if the murder was part of a recent stream of muggings in the area or a targeted hit to keep intel secret.

episodes.title: So It Goes
episodes.overview: Flashbacks into his past help tell the tale for Dr. Mallard as he and Bishop travel to England in search of answers to find out why an Englishman murdered in the United States would have a list of deceased Navy men on his person.

episodes.title: Choke Hold
episodes.overview: The Secretary of the Navy assigns the NCIS team to a joint terrorism task force after a Naval research scientist is murdered and the lead suspect is wanted by the Russian government.

episodes.title: The San Dominick
episodes.overview: During a joint Coast Guard and NCIS training exercise at sea, Gibbs and CGIS Agent Borin spot a deceased man overboard, who is discovered to be a missing crew member from a ship 60 nautical miles away.

episodes.title: Parental Guidance Suggested
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must determine if the murder of a Navy Commander's wife is linked to her profession as a therapist or an act of terrorism after finding the Commander's name on a Jihadist target list.

episodes.title: The Searchers
episodes.overview: After investigating the murder of a retired Master Sergeant, the NCIS team uncovers a fraudulent charity that preys on those searching for missing military personnel.

episodes.title: Semper Fortis
episodes.overview: Gibbs searches for a way to clear a Navy Hospital Corpsman after she's indicted for illegally providing medical aid to the victims of a hit and run accident.

episodes.title: Grounded
episodes.overview: While stuck at the Dulles airport due to inclement weather, DiNozzo, Bishop, and her husband Jake work an NCIS case involving an elevated terrorist threat at Northeast airports during the Thanksgiving travel surge.

episodes.title: House Rules
episodes.overview: The NCIS team consults with three cyber-terrorists they imprisoned after a city-wide Internet shutdown the week before Christmas.

episodes.title: Check
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates copy-cat crime scenes while Gibbs navigates two ex-wives relentlessly trying to get his attention.

episodes.title: The Enemy Within
episodes.overview: The NCIS team searches for a home-grown terrorist after a rescue mission in Syria reveals an American was involved in the capture of a social worker.

episodes.title: We Build, We Fight
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team investigate when a Navy Lieutenant who is set to be the first openly gay service member to receive the Medal of Honor is murdered.

episodes.title: Cadence
episodes.overview: DiNozzo returns to the military academy he attended as a teen after a murdered Marine, who was an alumnus of the school, is found clutching the photo of a current student.

episodes.title: Cabin Fever
episodes.overview: The NCIS team suspects Gibbs' arch-nemesis is behind an explosion at a global terrorism summit.

episodes.title: Blast from the Past
episodes.overview: A covert identity created for one of Gibbs’ undercover cases from 20 years ago resurfaces when a murder victim is found living under the alias.

episodes.title: The Artful Dodger
episodes.overview: Evidence in an NCIS murder case reveals a rare painting on loan had been swapped for a fake, prompting DiNozzo, Sr. to share his knowledge and contacts of the black market art world with the team.

episodes.title: Status Update
episodes.overview: After the body of a thief is found in a Marine’s house, NCIS discovers the calling card of a terror group Delilah and the Department of Defense have been tracking.

episodes.title: Patience
episodes.overview: The murder of a Petty Officer sparks a lead in a 40-year-old airport bombing cold case that Gibbs and DiNozzo have been assigned to for the past two years.

episodes.title: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: DiNozzo is partnered with his girlfriend ATF Special Agent Zoe Keates after evidence reveals that the murder weapon in an NCIS case was originally purchased for the controversial ATF sting operation “Operation Fast and Furious.”

episodes.title: Lost in Translation
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Bishop travel to Afghanistan after the murder of a Marine in D.C. is linked to a terror group holding another Marine hostage overseas.

episodes.title: Troll
episodes.overview: Special Agent Ned Dorneget from NCIS cyber operations assists the team when a Navy ensign who worked in the Office of Naval Intelligence is murdered.

episodes.title: The Lost Boys
episodes.overview: The NCIS cyber case turns into a united global effort after evidence confirms “The Calling,” an international terrorist group that recruits children through the internet, has been purchasing S-bombs off the black market.

episodes.title: Neverland
episodes.overview: NCIS feverishly investigates a global terrorist group that is recruiting teens via the Internet, following a deadly bombing overseas that results in an emotional and surprising loss for the team.

episodes.title: Stop the Bleeding
episodes.overview: After being shot, Gibbs fights for his life aboard a Navy hospital ship, while DiNozzo and Joanna travel to Shanghai to try and take down the Calling.

episodes.title: Personal Day
episodes.overview: Gibbs calls on the team to assist DEA Agent Luis Mitchell with a case that keeps going cold, but DiNozzo discovers there is more to Gibbs’ personal connection to the agent and his desire to help him succeed.

episodes.title: Incognito
episodes.overview: After a Marine is found murdered in Quantico hours after calling Gibbs to discuss a possible case, Bishop and McGee go undercover as a married couple to run surveillance on a Marine Lieutenant and his wife.

episodes.title: Double Trouble
episodes.overview: Vance partners with Gibbs and returns to field duty when a murder case is connected to a former NCIS agent he locked up for stealing evidence.

episodes.title: Lockdown
episodes.overview: While visiting a pharmaceutical lab on a murder case, Abby is trapped with no communication to the outside world after armed men take over the building and hold everyone hostage.

episodes.title: Viral
episodes.overview: When a Petty Officer’s murder matches the M.O. of a local serial killer, the NCIS team must determine if this is the killer’s latest victim or the work of a copycat.

episodes.title: 16 Years
episodes.overview: The NCIS murder case of a retired Navy Lieutenant Commander forces Ducky to reveal his participation in a secret society that solves cold cases.

episodes.title: Saviors
episodes.overview: DiNozzo is reunited with his ex-girlfriend, Jeanne Benoit, when insurgents in Sudan attack a group of volunteer doctors, including her husband.

episodes.title: Day in Court
episodes.overview: In order to clear his name, a Petty Officer volunteers to be court-martialed if NCIS agrees to conduct its own investigation after his murder case is dismissed due to a mishandled warrant.

episodes.title: Blood Brothers
episodes.overview: The Secretary of Defense calls on NCIS to help a sailor who is battling leukemia to locate a donor for a bone marrow transplant, after two of his siblings are killed in the line of duty.

episodes.title: Spinning Wheel
episodes.overview: After Ducky is attacked by a man claiming to have information about his half-brother who died decades ago, the NCIS team searches for the perpetrator.

episodes.title: Sister City (I)
episodes.overview:
The passengers and crew of a private plane traveling from New Orleans to Washington, D.C., are poisoned and the evidence points to Abby's brother, the aircraft's missing chef.

The episode continues on NCIS: New Orleans S2E12 Sister City (II).

episodes.title: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: While investigating the murder of a seaman who was set to testify before a grand jury, the NCIS team uncovers the resurgence of an international human-trafficking ring.

episodes.title: Decompressed
episodes.overview: Four deep sea divers stay inside a diving chamber with a deceased body in order to decompress. The dead body belongs to a retired Petty Officer who died in mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: React
episodes.overview: When Secretary of the Navy Sarah Porter learns her daughter has been kidnapped, the NCIS team partners with the FBI to track the case, determine a motive and bring her home.

episodes.title: Loose Cannons
episodes.overview: Doctor Cyril Taft experiences the rush of an NCIS case after he is assigned surgical duty to Gibbs’ suspect and finds key evidence.

episodes.title: After Hours
episodes.overview: The NCIS agents’ personal plans are interrupted when each of them catches errors in a seemingly cut-and-dried case.

episodes.title: Scope
episodes.overview: The NCIS team re-examines an ambush on a group of Special Ops snipers in Iraq after an American couple is attacked in the same area six months later.

episodes.title: Reasonable Doubts
episodes.overview: A Navy Public Affairs officer is murdered, and the victim's wife and mistress accuse each other of the crime.

episodes.title: Charade
episodes.overview: Tony's identity is stolen by multiple perpetrators who go on to blackmail politicians.

episodes.title: Return to Sender
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Senior FBI Agent T.C. Fornell unite after two British prisoners, including a former spy, escape and arrive stateside via a shipping container.

episodes.title: Homefront
episodes.overview: When a 14-year-old foils a home invasion, Gibbs suspects the teenager is withholding pertinent details.

episodes.title: Dead Letter
episodes.overview: The NCIS team, alongside the FBI and MI6, continue an international manhunt for an escaped British spy who has left one colleague fighting for their life in ICU.

episodes.title: Family First
episodes.overview: NCIS, the FBI, and MI6 continue an international manhunt for an escaped British spy who is targeting current and former agents.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: Following the unexpected departure of a key member, the NCIS team regroups and recruits several new faces, including a former MI6 operative.

episodes.title: Rogue
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates a deadly car explosion in D.C. that connects to NCIS Special Agent Nicholas “Nick” Torres, who disappeared six months ago while on a deep undercover assignment in Argentina.

episodes.title: Being Bad
episodes.overview: NCIS uncovers a bomb plot and a long-running theft ring while investigating a death at a Quantico reunion.

episodes.title: Privileged Information
episodes.overview: When the NCIS team investigates a Marine Sergeant’s tragic fall from a building, her doctor confides in Gibbs and suggests he treat it as a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Love Boat
episodes.overview: After the body of a Navy Lieutenant is discovered aboard a destroyer during a tiger cruise, when civilian guests are allowed to spend the night on the ship, Gibbs, Quinn, and Palmer travel out to sea to investigate.

episodes.title: Philly
episodes.overview: When a missing MI6 officer is linked to a murdered Petty Officer, Gibbs sends Quinn and Bishop to Philadelphia to work with MI6 Officer Clayton Reeves.

episodes.title: Shell Game
episodes.overview: After a kidnapped Petty Officer escapes her captor, NCIS uncovers a connection to her missing husband.

episodes.title: Home of the Brave
episodes.overview: Torres boldly breaks protocol when he learns a witness in an NCIS case is wanted by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

episodes.title: Enemy Combatant
episodes.overview: After NCIS Agent Bishop is sent to Gitmo to gather evidence for a Navy chaplain murder case, she questions her previous work at the NSA.

episodes.title: Pay to Play
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates a series of escalating threats against congresswoman Jenna Flemming, while Director Vance oversees her temporary protection detail.

episodes.title: The Tie That Binds
episodes.overview: After the NCIS team tracks evidence from the murder of a Navy captain to Ducky’s deceased mother, Ducky looks back and questions a pivotal life choice he made 37 years ago.

episodes.title: Willoughby
episodes.overview: NCIS searches for new leads after an undercover operation to apprehend a businessman who uses acts of terror to manipulate the stock market is compromised.

episodes.title: Off the Grid
episodes.overview: When Gibbs spots the brother of an "NCIS Most Wanted" suspect, he takes the opportunity to assume his former alias and go undercover with their infamous anti-government militia.

episodes.title: Keep Going
episodes.overview: During an NCIS hit-and-run investigation, Palmer joins a stranger on the outside ledge of a building in an attempt to save his life.

episodes.title: Nonstop
episodes.overview: The murder of a Petty Officer in a small town outside D.C. prompts NCIS to once again work with "The Sherlocks," a privately funded investigative team that includes their newest member, Anthony DiNozzo, Sr.

episodes.title: Pandora's Box (I)
episodes.overview:
After Abby's homeland security think tank is compromised and she is found in possession of a real bomb, the NCIS team discovers the leader of the group has been murdered and a theoretical terror playbook has been stolen.

The crossover continues on NCIS: New Orleans S03E14 Pandora's Box (II).

episodes.title: A Many Splendored Thing
episodes.overview: Bishop is more determined than ever to seek revenge for the murder of Qasim, her late boyfriend, after Gibbs and the team find a new lead in the Chen case.

episodes.title: What Lies Above
episodes.overview: McGee discovers his apartment has been torn apart by a robber trying to locate an item of great value hidden somewhere by the convicted criminal who previously owned the unit.

episodes.title: M.I.A.
episodes.overview: To carry out a sailor's dying wish, Gibbs and the NCIS team reinvestigate a murder case that was originally ruled an accidental death.

episodes.title: The Wall
episodes.overview: The team must rely on an irritable Vietnam War veteran to solve a Marine's murder.

episodes.title: A Bowl of Cherries
episodes.overview: A Vice Admiral tasks McGee with tracking down the hackers who infected his laptop with ransomware before the virus wipes out all his data. The cyberterrorism escalates when the virus spreads to the whole NCIS office.

episodes.title: One Book, Two Covers
episodes.overview: A Marine's murder has connections to a dirt bike gang that Torres joined while on an old undercover operation.

episodes.title: Beastmaster
episodes.overview: A Gunnery Sergeant's murder in a national park leads the team to join forces with the mounted police. While investigating the clues, they uncover a disturbing smuggling ring.

episodes.title: Something Blue
episodes.overview: The team suspects foul play when a healthy, young Petty Officer mysteriously dies in his sleep aboard a Navy destroyer.

episodes.title: Rendezvous
episodes.overview: When a Navy SEAL vanishes during  an unsanctioned trip, Gibbs, McGee, and Torres travel to an unpopulated area in Paraguay that's teeming with violent rebels.

episodes.title: House Divided
episodes.overview: The NCIS team tirelessly search for Gibbs and McGee two months after they were last seen fighting an elusive group of rebels in a Paraguay jungle.

episodes.title: Twofer
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates when the body of a murdered Navy Lieutenant, who disappeared over a year ago, is found by a cemetery grounds crew while relocating caskets on the property.

episodes.title: Exit Strategy
episodes.overview: Torres' partner mysteriously vanishes during a stakeout with Metro P.D. The investigation uncovers new evidence from a decade-old murder case.

episodes.title: Skeleton Crew
episodes.overview: NCIS Special Agent Jacqueline Sloane, a forensic psychologist, joins the team just as a horrific storm shuts down Washington, D.C. During the power outage, a sailor is kidnapped, and Torres and Bishop go out to sea to track evidence.

episodes.title: Fake It ‘Till You Make It
episodes.overview: Reeves sees his friend get kidnapped and the investigation reveals the primary suspect disappeared two days earlier with confidential military information.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.overview: A Petty Officer is found murdered on a golf course, and McGee spends hours on the victim’s ham radio trying to locate a key witness.

episodes.title: Burden of Proof
episodes.overview: A convicted felon claims NCIS framed him for murder a decade ago, so Gibbs investigates and asks Ducky to conduct a new autopsy. Senior FBI agent Fornell joins the probe, since he was the lead investigator in the original joint FBI and NCIS case.

episodes.title: Voices
episodes.overview: An NCIS person of interest in a bribery and fraud case is found murdered after a runner is led to his body by a strange voice.

episodes.title: Ready or Not
episodes.overview: The team tracks an elusive international arms dealer who recently murdered an MI6 officer.

episodes.title: Double Down
episodes.overview: As Torres and Sloane run protection detail for U.S. Senator John Phillips in Afghanistan for the holidays, they must urgently return to the States after hearing the senator’s son is in the ICU.

episodes.title: High Tide
episodes.overview: Torres and Bishop go undercover as a criminal couple available for hire, during an NCIS sting operation tracking illegal drug-running out of the Norfolk civilian marina.

episodes.title: Dark Secrets
episodes.overview: After a seemingly happy and successful Navy Lieutenant appears to have taken her own life, Gibbs and the team conduct a thorough investigation, interviewing family and friends from her past and present.

episodes.title: Family Ties
episodes.overview: After McGee and Torres visit the home of a high schooler who witnessed a hit-and-run, her parents flee with their daughter, leaving NCIS in the lurch.

episodes.title: Keep Your Friends Close
episodes.overview: After the body of a missing Navy commander is found, Vance orders Gibbs and the team to work with former FBI Agent Tobias "T.C." Fornell, the private investigator who was hired to locate him.

episodes.title: Keep Your Enemies Closer
episodes.overview: NCIS strikes a deal with convicted murderer Paul Triff, giving him a 48-hour furlough at his former residence, now McGee's home, in exchange for information that can convict his former cellmate, Gabriel Hicks, the murderer who deceived Gibbs and Fornell.

episodes.title: Handle with Care
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team work to clear the name of retired Marine Sergeant John Ross when cyanide is found in one of the hundreds of care packages he sends to active-duty Marines.

episodes.title: One Man's Trash
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Ducky are watching TV when they see the host handling a 200-year-old war stick that could be a match from a decade-old cold case.

episodes.title: Death from Above
episodes.overview: The NCIS headquarters are evacuated after the team discovers a body as well as bomb materials on the roof of the squad room.

episodes.title: The Numerical Limit
episodes.overview: Gibbs is granted protective custody of a ten-year-old orphaned refugee, Elena, when an NCIS case reveals she is the target of a violent gang.

episodes.title: Sight Unseen
episodes.overview: NCIS searches for a Petty Officer suspected of assault who escapes when the sheriff transporting him crashes into a lake.

episodes.title: One Step Forward
episodes.overview: Sara Carter begs Gibbs to investigate her mother's murder - she believes the wrong man was convicted.

episodes.title: Two Steps Back
episodes.overview: When evidence reveals an NCIS team member is a hitman’s latest target, the team must search through old case files to determine who is seeking vengeance.

episodes.title: Fallout
episodes.overview: While Gibbs attends the memorial service for a friend who was lost at sea, he discovers that the deceased, Navy Captain Phillip Brooks, has been hiding in a fallout shelter after his boat was attacked and he swam to shore.

episodes.title: Date with Destiny
episodes.overview: Sloane is adamant that a man who held her hostage and tortured her years ago in Afghanistan, and was believed to have been killed following her rescue, is alive and in D.C.

episodes.title: Destiny's Child
episodes.overview: One month after Director Vance was kidnapped, Gibbs is assigned the role of acting director in his absence while the team searches worldwide for his whereabouts.

episodes.title: Love Thy Neighbor
episodes.overview: After a Navy Lieutenant is found murdered in his hot tub, the team interviews several families in the victim’s peculiar neighborhood.

episodes.title: Boom
episodes.overview: One of the NCIS agents is starstruck after the team investigates an explosion outside the home of Navy Petty Officer First Class Todd Nicholas and his wife, popular reality TV star Sheba Nicholas.

episodes.title: Third Wheel
episodes.overview: Gibbs’ quiet vacation at his remote cabin is interrupted by a surprise visit from Tobias Fornell and Navy Captain Phillip Brooks, as well as a call from NCIS asking for his help locating a robber hiding in the woods near him.

episodes.title: Fragments
episodes.overview: After a 50-year-old tape recording left by a murder victim is found, the NCIS team tries to exonerate Ray Jennings, the Marine serving a life sentence for the crime.

episodes.title: Beneath the Surface
episodes.overview: After NCIS arrives at a Halloween crime scene, Torres recognizes the victim as a friend from federal law enforcement training.

episodes.title: A Thousand Words
episodes.overview: After a mural by a street artist and activist is stolen, the NCIS investigation leads to a conspiracy regarding a Navy contractor and the safety of ocean mammals.

episodes.title: Friendly Fire
episodes.overview: McGee and Bishop travel to Afghanistan after a murder case in the States is linked to a string of soldiers killed by friendly fire overseas.

episodes.title: Tailing Angie
episodes.overview: When the lead suspect of an unsolved and high-profile robbery case is released from prison, the NCIS team resumes their investigation with an undercover stakeout.

episodes.title: What Child Is This?
episodes.overview: The team’s holiday plans are put on hold when the murder investigation of a Navy veteran includes the discovery of a newborn baby who has no identification and no apparent ties to a family.

episodes.title: Toil and Trouble
episodes.overview: United States Secretary of Defense Wynn Crawford shuts down Gibbs' murder investigation and demands that Special Agents McGee and Torres be arrested for their actions in the case.

episodes.title: The Last Link
episodes.overview: An old family friend, Army Corporal John Sydney, beseeches Gibbs to join him on a road trip to search for a missing military I.D. bracelet. Also, a Navy Lieutenant in NCIS protective custody is poisoned by an infamous drug dealer.

episodes.title: She
episodes.overview: After a malnourished and confused 9-year-old is found hiding in a storage unit, NCIS reopens an old missing persons case when the girl is believed to be the daughter of a Navy recruit who disappeared 10 years ago. Also, Bishop discovers notes that Special Agent Ziva David kept on the case long after NCIS officially stopped investigating.

episodes.title: Once Upon a Tim
episodes.overview: McGee reluctantly visits his high school after the unique computer password he used as a teenager is linked to the murder of a department of defense contractor. The case escalates when an intruder breaks into McGee’s home in an attempt to steal his archaic high school computer.

episodes.title: Crossing the Line
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates a man overboard fatality from a Navy destroyer at sea. Also, Torres is frustrated with Vance’s assignment to mentor three high school students.

episodes.title: Bears and Cubs
episodes.overview: Jimmy is torn between family and work after his father-in-law, Ed, asks him to tamper with evidence from NCIS’ current murder investigation. Also, Ed’s poker buddy, Anthony DiNozzo, Sr., offers to help with the case.

episodes.title: Silent Service
episodes.overview: Director Vance is notified by the Pentagon that the nuclear submarine Gibbs and Bishop are aboard to conduct a murder investigation has gone radio silent.

episodes.title: Mona Lisa
episodes.overview: Torres relies on his team's investigative skills after he wakes up on a dilapidated fishing boat and is covered in blood and unable to remember the last 12 hours.

episodes.title: Perennial
episodes.overview: Following an active shooter lockdown at a Naval hospital, the team searches for a suspect who fled the scene.

episodes.title: Hail & Farewell
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the murder of a Marine Major believed to have been killed in the 9/11 attack on the Pentagon after human remains are discovered at a construction site.

episodes.title: Judge, Jury...
episodes.overview: After entering cold case DNA into the system, Kasie solves a 30-year-old murder case, but a loophole in the legal system may set the suspect free.

episodes.title: ...and Executioner
episodes.overview: After NCIS finds a secret government bank account that’s funding a nationwide network of vigilante justice, the team must determine who is acting as judge and jury.

episodes.title: Lost Time
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a Marine Sergeant in the States who was hailed as a war hero for his efforts overseas.

episodes.title: Daughters
episodes.overview: Former FBI Agent Tobias Fornell pleads with Gibbs to do whatever is necessary to take down drug dealers and suppliers in the area after his daughter, Emily Fornell, is hospitalized from an opiate overdose.

episodes.title: Out of the Darkness
episodes.overview: Ziva surprises Gibbs with a cryptic warning, prompting him to question why she remained underground for years while being presumed dead by family and friends, and what led to her return.

episodes.title: Into the Light
episodes.overview: With their lives in danger, Gibbs and Ziva’s rogue investigation takes an unexpected turn when a possible terrorist plot is revealed.

episodes.title: Going Mobile
episodes.overview: After the body of a Marine Lieutenant is found hidden under an 18-wheeler, the NCIS team tracks the vehicle’s previous locations to pinpoint the crime scene and suspect.

episodes.title: Someone Else's Shoes
episodes.overview: The NCIS team links a bizarre crime scene at Arlington National Cemetery to a string of attacks on homeless veterans.

episodes.title: Wide Awake
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates Marine Corporal Laney Alimonte after evidence suggests she murdered her neighbor while being treated for insomnia by a hypnotherapist.

episodes.title: Institutionalized
episodes.overview: After a Petty Officer’s son is found murdered at his “welcome home from prison” party, evidence suggests Kasie’s lifelong best friend, Dante Brown, is the suspect.

episodes.title: No Vacancy
episodes.overview: While investigating a Marine’s murder, the NCIS team uncovers a labyrinth of live-streaming spy cameras hidden in the rooms of a Virginia motel.

episodes.title: Musical Chairs
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates the murder of a musician in the Navy’s most elite band that performs at diplomatic events around the world.

episodes.title: IRL
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates a Petty Officer's murder that was livestreamed on a popular gaming app.

episodes.title: The North Pole
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the team help Ziva with the "one thing" she said she'd take care of before returning to her family.

episodes.title: In the Wind
episodes.overview: Gibbs must face the consequences of helping Ziva with "the one thing" she said she'd take care of before returning to her family.

episodes.title: Flight Plan
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates an F-18 crash and the subsequent disappearance of the pilot.

episodes.title: Sound Off
episodes.overview: After a body is found at an unmanned aerial vehicle testing site, the NCIS team must determine if the death was murder or an accident.

episodes.title: On Fire
episodes.overview: After Torres and Bishop are victims of a hit-and-run, Torres fights for his life in the Intensive Care Unit.

episodes.title: Lonely Hearts
episodes.overview: The lead suspect in an NCIS murder investigation is a woman Gibbs' friend, Phillip Brooks, met on a dating site.

episodes.title: Ephemera
episodes.overview: While investigating the suicide of a retired Navy officer who left a rare, valuable - and possibly stolen - coin to the National Museum of the Navy, the team imagines themselves in his life story in order to piece together how the coin ended up in his possession.

episodes.title: In a Nutshell
episodes.overview: As the NCIS team investigates the death of a Navy officer murdered the same way as his parents a decade ago, they stumble across a storage container filled with dollhouses that display recreations of murder scenes.

episodes.title: Schooled
episodes.overview: The team searches for answers when the body of a well-regarded Navy technician in the Reserves is found floating in a lake where a popular community event is being held.

episodes.title: Blarney
episodes.overview: When Kasie and Jimmy are held hostage in a diner after a jewelry store robbery goes awry, they attempt to keep the other customers safe from the thieves.

episodes.title: The Arizona
episodes.overview: The team tries to verify the identity of Joe Smith, who claims he served on the U.S.S. Arizona during the attack on Pearl Harbor, and wants to be buried there upon his death.

episodes.title: Sturgeon Season
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Fornell attempt to track down the leader of a drug ring who supplied drugs to Fornell's daughter.

episodes.title: Everything Starts Somewhere
episodes.overview: Flashbacks reveal the murder case that first introduced young Gibbs to NCIS and his introduction to young, new-to-America Ducky.

episodes.title: Blood And Treasure
episodes.overview: The discovery of two dead bodies leads the NCIS team into the wild world of modern-day treasure hunting.

episodes.title: Sunburn
episodes.overview: McGee and his wife Delilah's Bahamian vacation turns into a high-stakes mission when a case NCIS is tracking of a dead escape room manager has ties to the island.

episodes.title: Head of the Snake
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Fornell's crusade to find the head of the drug ring responsible for Fornell's daughter Emily's overdose comes to a climax.

episodes.title: 1mm
episodes.overview: Following a tip about smuggled weapons, Bishop and Torres engage in a shootout in a former sheriff's residence that's now a historical site, only to find themselves locked in abandoned jail cells there.

episodes.title: The First Day
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the murder of a Navy officer who was killed while driving home a recently released inmate.

episodes.title: True Believer
episodes.overview: When Sloane’s name is discovered in Afghanistan at the site of an abandoned bus with a dead driver, Gibbs accompanies her on a trip to find a group of girls who were kidnapped from the bus.

episodes.title: Winter Chill
episodes.overview: NCIS dives into the competitive world of food trucks after finding a man frozen to death in the back of one.

episodes.title: Watchdog
episodes.overview: NCIS uncovers a secret dogfighting ring, which leads to an unexpected move by one of the team members.

episodes.title: Gut Punch
episodes.overview: Vance assigns McGee, Torres, and Bishop to Covid compliance duty at a foreign affairs summit, where they discover a link to another NCIS team's murder case.

episodes.title: Sangre
episodes.overview: Evidence from the stabbing of a Marine Sergeant leads Torres to meet his father who left when he was a child.

episodes.title: Misconduct
episodes.overview: The team investigates a cyclist killed in a hit and run. Gibbs prepares to testify against a financial advisor who stole millions from his Navy clients.

episodes.title: Unseen Improvements
episodes.overview: NCIS tracks a stolen laptop to the uncle of a young boy, Phineas, Gibbs’ former neighbor.

episodes.title: Blown Away
episodes.overview: When members of an NCIS Regional Enforcement Action Capabilities Training Team (REACT) are killed during an explosion, NCIS Special Agent Jessica Knight, the lone surviving member, helps crack the case using high tech body armor.

episodes.title: Rule 91
episodes.overview: While pursuing a dangerous arms dealer, the team is shocked when Bishop is implicated in an old NSA leak while Gibbs and Marcie realize the killer they've been tracking may be onto them.

episodes.title: Blood in the Water
episodes.overview: As the NCIS team searches for Gibbs after wreckage from his boat is discovered, they find out he was tracking a serial killer with journalist Marcie Warren, who wrote an exposé on him.

episodes.title: Nearly Departed
episodes.overview: While trying to find the serial killer Gibbs was after, the NCIS team discovers another person has been tracking the case as well.

episodes.title: Road to Nowhere
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Parker go on a road trip to find one of the serial killer's victims. Also, Agent Knight goes undercover at a large manufacturing company with ties to the murders.

episodes.title: Great Wide Open
episodes.overview: Gibbs and McGee head to Alaska while the team works at home to uncover the conspiracy behind the serial killer.

episodes.title: Face the Strange
episodes.overview: The NCIS team investigates the death of a Navy officer whose body suddenly explodes before Jimmy can examine it.

episodes.title: False Start
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the death of a beloved Navy commander who trained some of the top athletes in the country.

episodes.title: Docked
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the death of a man on a cruise ship whose body is discovered in the ship's sauna by none other than McGee's mother-in-law, Judy.

episodes.title: Peacekeeper
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy reservist whose body is found in a beat-up car at the end of a gun range.

episodes.title: Collective Memory
episodes.overview: When a hotshot financial advisor is found shot at a Naval station, NCIS investigates the case by interviewing the victim’s three-dimensional hologram of herself, which she created before her death.

episodes.title: Pledge of Allegiance
episodes.overview: NCIS is called in when Navy Chief Warrant Officer Rafi Nazar is suspected of trying to sell stolen classified Navy software used to pilot combat drones.

episodes.title: All Hands
episodes.overview: After a civilian research vessel in the North Atlantic picks up a small boat of wounded Navy officers, NCIS arrives on the ship and is forced to hide after discovering terrorists on board.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.overview: When the body of a Navy Lieutenant is discovered missing an eye, the NCIS investigation leads to the world of cage fighting.

episodes.title: The Helpers
episodes.overview: While investigating the death of an intruder at Quantico, Jimmy and Kasie are exposed to a deadly biotoxin. The NCIS team calls on Dr. Carol Wilson for help as they race to find the antidote.

episodes.title: First Steps
episodes.overview: As NCIS investigates the cause of death of a reservist Navy SEAL surgeon, they're forced to bring Vance's daughter to help with a highly dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Thick as Thieves
episodes.overview: Parker's delinquent past resurfaces when NCIS is called to Philadelphia to investigate the death of a Petty Officer.

episodes.title: The Wake
episodes.overview: A gruesome mishap at a Petty Officer’s gender-reveal party leads NCIS to the case of a missing teacher that was popularized on a true crime podcast.

episodes.title: Starting Over (I)
episodes.overview:
NCIS investigates the apparent suicide of a retired Navy officer who was in Palmer and Knight's grief group; Torres gets a call from NCIS Special Agent Jane Tennant to come to Hawai'i.

The crossover continues on NCIS: Hawai'i S01E18 T'N'T (II).

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.overview: When an infamous arms dealer, Reymundo Diaz, is released from prison and bodies start piling up, Torres is forced to face the repercussions of his actions during an undercover operation he worked on years ago.

episodes.title: The Brat Pack
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates a ring of clever teenage partygoers when a string of break-ins takes place at Marine Base Quantico.

episodes.title: All or Nothing
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the unexpected death of a Navy reservist who was an investigative journalist.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.overview: When Agent Parker is framed for murder, the team puts their jobs and lives on the line to buy time and uncover the truth.

episodes.title: A Family Matter (I)
episodes.overview:
Special Agent Alden Parker is still on the run with his ex-wife Vivian, so the team investigates who from his past might have a personal vendetta against him in hopes of clearing Parker's name.

The crossover continues on NCIS: Hawai'i S02E01 Prisoners' Dilemma (II).

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.overview: McGee’s personal life and professional life intersect when a dad from his children’s school is linked to a break-in at a government storage bunker.

episodes.title: Unearth
episodes.overview: When a dead body is found at an ancient burial site that is thought to be cursed, the team tries to determine the motive and the symbolism behind the crime.

episodes.title: Leave No Trace
episodes.overview: Agent Knight's past resurfaces when her ex-boyfriend, a National Parks Service agent, teams up with NCIS to investigate a campsite murder.

episodes.title: Guardian
episodes.overview: Agent Parker steps up to protect Director Vance after a terrifying home invasion.

episodes.title: The Good Fighter
episodes.overview: When an NCIS agent turns up dead and Kasie goes unaccounted for, the team must work quickly to find the killer.

episodes.title: Love Lost
episodes.overview: NCIS must investigate the Secretary of the Navy when her husband claims she tried to murder him.

episodes.title: Turkey Trot
episodes.overview: After an unknown shooter causes chaos at an annual Thanksgiving 5K, time is of the essence for the NCIS team to find the culprit.

episodes.title: Higher Education
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the death of a college student who was killed while running across the street and had connections to McGee’s wife, Delilah.

episodes.title: Too Many Cooks (I)
episodes.overview:
NCIS agents from Washington, D.C., Los Angeles and Hawai’i, all in D.C. to attend the retirement party of a beloved Federal Law Enforcement Training Center (FLETC) professor, find themselves jointly investigating his shocking suicide.

The crossover continues on NCIS: Hawai'i S02E10 Deep Fake (II) and NCIS: Los Angeles S14E10 A Long Time Coming (III).

episodes.title: Bridges
episodes.overview: Parker discovers he's a victim of identity theft while investigating the unusual murder of a Navy ensign.

episodes.title: Big Rig
episodes.overview: When an old pal of Torres’ comes to him, disheveled and bloodied for guidance amidst an undercover FBI operation and then disappears, NCIS helps track him down.

episodes.title: Evil Eye
episodes.overview: In preparation for a role, a world-renowned actress shadows the NCIS team as they investigate a decapitation case.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.overview: Parker grapples with his emotions when a conman from his past turns up as a prime suspect in the murder of a Navy officer transporting millions of dollars’ worth of opioids.

episodes.title: Unusual Suspects
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the death of a ride-share driver who was found after a car accident.

episodes.title: Butterfly Effect
episodes.overview: The NCIS team jumps into motion to investigate who is responsible for a potential bioterror attack at a strip mall parking garage.

episodes.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
episodes.overview: NCIS works to solve the murder of a Marine private who appears to have been killed for helping an Afghan refugee.

episodes.title: Head Games
episodes.overview: The NCIS team digs deep to investigate a Navy Lieutenant who’s accused of trying to murder her husband but has no memory of the attack.

episodes.title: In the Spotlight
episodes.overview: Agent Knight goes viral for saving a mother and child from a potentially fatal car accident.

episodes.title: Second Opinion
episodes.overview: NCIS works to solve the murder of a senator’s daughter who has a rebellious reputation and large online following.

episodes.title: Kompromat
episodes.overview: When a suspicious murder occurs in the classified section of the National Archive, NCIS must investigate a string of Russian spy encounters that may be linked to the crime.

episodes.title: Black Sky
episodes.overview: Agent Torres finds himself in prison as the team tries to stop an impending terror attack on U.S. soil.

episodes.title: Algún Día
episodes.overview: The NCIS team must help Torres when he puts his future at stake by confronting the man who tormented his family when he was a child.

episodes.title: The Stories We Leave Behind
episodes.overview: As NCIS mourns the loss of Ducky, the agents find comfort in working on one of his unfinished cases involving a woman whose father was dishonorably discharged from the Marines.

episodes.title: Lifeline
episodes.overview: When the NCIS team engages in Walk-a-Mile day to gain a new perspectives on different departments, things take a turn when Kasie receives a distress call from a mysterious man.

episodes.title: Left Unsaid
episodes.overview: The NCIS team is in a race against time to find a missing officer who disappeared during his wedding proposal.

episodes.title: The Plan
episodes.overview: With the help of Knight's dad, NCIS works to unravel the mystery of a recently used service weapon belonging to a missing agent.

episodes.title: Strange Invaders
episodes.overview: After discovering a Navy pilot's body riddled with unusual wounds, NCIS' investigation draws the team into the rabbit hole of UFO conspiracy theories.

episodes.title: A Thousand Yards
episodes.overview: NCIS comes under attack by a mysterious enemy from the past.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.overview: The NCIS team looks for a motive behind the kidnapping and death of a famous heart surgeon.

episodes.title: Prime Cut
episodes.overview: After discovering the remains of a Marine captain, the NCIS team travels to Texas to interrogate the suspected killer.

episodes.title: Reef Madness
episodes.overview: Parker and Knight discover three bodies on an old Navy ship that's about to be sunk and turned into an artificial reef, when they're suddenly locked inside by a mysterious figure.

episodes.title: Empty Nest
episodes.overview: NCIS searches for a missing undercover agent in the midst of an active hostage situation.

episodes.title: Foreign Bodies
episodes.overview: As Vance prepares to host diplomatic talks with Venezuela, the team is called in to investigate the dead body of one of his inside men.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Hal
episodes.overview: NCIS is called in to investigate when a Lieutenant returns home on the eve of Halloween to find a surprise party being thrown for someone else at his place.

episodes.title: Sticks & Stones
episodes.overview: After receiving intelligence on deadly threats to multiple locations that could lead to a catastrophic war, NCIS is called in to try to neutralize the danger.

episodes.title: In from the Cold
episodes.overview: NCIS works with the CIA to discover what secrets are being kept by Captain Butler, an elderly former spy with dementia.

episodes.title: Knight and Day
episodes.overview: Things become tense when Knight is assigned to protect his wife after the home of a high-level defense contractor is attacked.

episodes.title: Hardboiled
episodes.overview: Torres receives intel from a confidential informant regarding top secret Naval information that's at risk of being sold.

episodes.title: Out of Control
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates a murder related to a car that begins driving on its own.

episodes.title: Humbug
episodes.overview: When a shocking tell-all threatens to ruin Christmas for a decorated Marine, NCIS must uncover the truth and deliver a holiday miracle - before the book hits shelves and turns a hero's legacy into a holiday disaster.

episodes.title: Baker's Man
episodes.overview: After NCIS learns that the owner of Parker's favorite bakery is being blackmailed, they hatch a plan to save her from the perpetrators.

episodes.title: For Better or Worse
episodes.overview: NCIS stages a fake wedding for two of its own in an attempt to take down the mob.

episodes.title: Fun and Games
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the fatal poisoning of one of Kasie's forensic scientists.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: NCIS investigates the case of a Navy Lieutenant found dead at a blood donation bank.

episodes.title: Close to Home
episodes.overview: When Torres receives a text from Jimmy's daughter saying she has discovered a large sum of money near a Naval library, the team works together to investigate.

episodes.title: Moonlit
episodes.overview: After a Navy Lieutenant's death reveals ties to Special Agent Sawyer, Torres and Knight uncover a murder linked to a wealthy family.

episodes.title: Ladies' Night
episodes.overview: A girls' night out takes an unexpected turn when NCIS is called to investigate the motive of a possible arsonist.

episodes.title: Killer Instinct
episodes.overview: After NCIS captures the hitman known as "The Poet," the team races to uncover who ordered the assassination of a Navy chief.

episodes.title: After the Storm
episodes.overview: When a trio of combat vets are found murdered in a D.C. motel room, NCIS tracks down a suspect who refuses to talk to anyone but Sam Hanna.

episodes.title: Irreconcilable Differences
episodes.overview: McGee's career and credibility are on the line when he investigates the Deputy Director for corruption.

episodes.title: Nexus
episodes.overview: As NCIS investigates a dangerous connection between the Nexus cartel and Parker's longtime nemesis, mob boss Carla Marino, the team uncovers a high-stakes plot involving stolen nuclear material.

episodes.title: Prodigal Son (1)
episodes.overview: Reeling from his father’s murder, Parker goes to extreme lengths to hunt down the woman he holds responsible, mob boss Carla Marino, jeopardizing not only his own future but the team’s.

episodes.title: Prodigal Son (2)
episodes.overview: Parker’s pursuit of vengeance for his father’s murder could have deadly consequences, while his sister, Navy vice admiral Harriet Parker, faces an impossible choice.

episodes.title: The Sound and the Fury
episodes.overview: When a petty officer’s death is connected to a blackmail investigation, the team is forced to work with Special Agent Sawyer on the case, which takes a terrifying turn for Torres. Meanwhile, Knight is offered an opportunity to train with NCIS Elite.

episodes.title: Gone Girls
episodes.overview: The team investigates a U.S. marine who is believed to have kidnapped a man's wife.

episodes.title: Now and Then (II)
episodes.overview:
The cold case of a small-town death of a naval officer in the ‘90s is unexpectedly re-opened in the present day, sending the team on a manhunt for justice.

The crossover starts on NCIS: Origins S02E05 Funny How Time Slips Away (I).

episodes.title: Page-Turner
episodes.overview: When McGee is kidnapped while promoting his latest book in the Deep Six crime series, the team investigates his self-professed “#1 fan” – and a potential link to a murder case involving stolen classified documents.

episodes.title: God Only Knows
episodes.overview: A kidnapped teen leads the team to a Navy SEAL who survived captivity by the Taliban but may have committed murder after returning home. Also, Jimmy finally shares his findings about the mysterious death of Parker’s mother with his boss.

episodes.title: Stolen Moments
episodes.overview: When a man is shot by the Secret Service outside the vice president’s official residence, NCIS is aided in the case by a new member of the team: an AI chatbot being beta-tested by the Department of Justice.

episodes.title: Heaven and Nature
episodes.overview: McGee and Torres try to recover a stolen truck filled with toys for the Navy’s annual Christmas drive while the truth about Parker’s mother is finally revealed. Also, Knight is given her first NCIS: Elite mission, which involves tracking down a former member of the team.

episodes.title: Her
episodes.overview: On her first NCIS: Elite mission, Knight is given orders to hunt down and arrest Eleanor Bishop after the former member of the NCIS team is designated a wanted cyber-terrorist. In need of someone to trust, Bishop turns to Torres, and the two come face to face for the first time since she abruptly left nearly five years ago.

episodes.title: Army of One
episodes.overview: When a desperate man barricades himself inside an ammo warehouse, Knight is the only negotiator he’ll talk to, claiming she once saved him before. As explosives tick and trust frays, Knight clashes with the CID officer running the standoff, each convinced theirs is the only way out.

episodes.title: In Too Deep
episodes.overview: A murdered drone pilot leads the team to a missing woman from McGee’s past and a relationship he thought was long behind him. But as the case deepens, McGee realizes her reappearance could unravel more than an investigation, it could change the course of his life.

episodes.title: All Good Things
episodes.overview: When the son of a Marine that Gibbs once helped comes to NCIS in desperation, the fractured team reunites off the books; chasing justice without a badge may cost them more than their careers.

episodes.title: Fleeting
episodes.overview: Navy Week turns electric when a stolen squad car flips and reveals a sailor stabbed in the trunk; as D.C. spirals into chaos, the team chases a killer while carrying the weight of recent events.

episodes.title: Knick-Knack
episodes.overview: A murder aboard a museum ship becomes a cryptic treasure hunt when a dying Navy captain leaves a final clue; to solve it, the team must decode what was worth killing -- and dying -- for.

episodes.title: S.O.S.
episodes.overview:
S.O.S.

A Navy lieutenant resurfaces a year after her plane vanished with a story that doesn’t quite add up. As the team peels back the mystery of a crash that was anything but accidental, every answer sparks a new twist.

episodes.title: Reboot (1)
episodes.overview: With most of NCIS away and the mainframe shut down for a midnight upgrade, Kasie and a skeleton crew are left in a darkened building when someone begins hunting from inside. What starts as a routine reboot becomes a high-stakes game of cat and mouse through powerless hallways until an unexpected ally, Sam Hanna, steps into the fight.

episodes.title: Bad Impressions (2)
episodes.overview: The team races to help one of their own who has been framed for murder and caught in a widening conspiracy that could compromise national security.

episodes.title: Deal with the Devil
episodes.overview: As a secret immunity deal threatens to let a man walk free, Parker fights to keep the case alive. But when his estranged sister suddenly appears – and buried family wounds resurface – the battle for justice becomes deeply personal.

episodes.title: Sons and Daughters
episodes.overview: One year after a deadly coffee shop bombing, a new explosion proves the attack wasn’t the work of a lone wolf – a case that forces the team to confront legacy and loyalty.

series.title: One Piece
series.overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

seasons.name: East Blue
seasons.overview: Monkey D. Luffy meets the Red Hair Pirates as a young boy living in East Blue, swearing becoming the next Pirate King. 10 years later, Luffy sets sail and experiences first adventures, recruiting the first members of the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
episodes.overview: A group of pirates lead by Alvida plunder a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a mission to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Coby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro
episodes.overview: Luffy and Coby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

episodes.title: Morgan VS Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?
episodes.overview: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Coby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

episodes.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-haired Shanks appears
episodes.overview: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

episodes.title: Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!
episodes.overview: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs Luffy!
episodes.overview: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

episodes.title: Grand Duel! Zoro the Swordsman vs Cabaji the Acrobat!
episodes.overview: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

episodes.title: Who Will Win? Showdown Between the True Powers of the Devil!
episodes.overview: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

episodes.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
episodes.overview: Nami form an alliance becoming the navigator of the crew, but not a full member yet. They arrive in Syrup Village looking for a suitable ship. On this island they know the liar Usopp, who also has ties to the Shanx.

episodes.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
episodes.overview: When trying to convince his rich friend, Kaya, to give the Straw Hats a ship, Usopp is told to stay away from her by her caretaker, Klahadore. However, when Usopp and Luffy later see him conversing with a strange man, they learn of a plot to kill Kaya.

episodes.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
episodes.overview: After learning of Captain Kuro's evil plan, Usopp runs back to the village to warn Kaya, only to find that after all his years of lying no one believes him.

episodes.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
episodes.overview: Usopp resolves to keep his story of pirates attacking the town a lie by making sure none reach it. Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp then try to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

episodes.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats manage to take out most of the opposing Black Cat Pirates, so Jango orders the Nyaban Brothers to attack. Meanwhile, after getting hypnotized by Jango, Luffy gets himself stuck under the collapsed mast of the Black Cat Pirates' ship.

episodes.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
episodes.overview: Captain Kuro himself arrives at the scene, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy being incapacitated, and the other two being too weak to handle him, things seem hopeless. However, Kaya herself appears to bargain with Kuro.

episodes.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
episodes.overview: Zoro and Buchi (of the Nyaban Brothers) face off once again as Luffy and Kuro begin their fight. Usopp orders the Usopp Pirates to run away with Kaya, but Jango goes after them. A flashback reveals how Captain Kuro faked his death with Captain Morgan and how he became Kaya's butler.

episodes.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
episodes.overview: As the fight between Luffy and Kuro is close to an end, the Usopp Pirates do their best to avoid Jango.

episodes.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
episodes.overview: Kuro's ultimate attack, "Shakushi", attacks everything in the area, whether friend or foe, and Luffy becomes enraged by his lack of regard for his crew. Will Luffy's determination overcome Kuro's sheer speed?

episodes.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
episodes.overview: With Usopp now in the crew and a new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure, only to encounter a strange man stuck in a treasure box that has also been looking for this treasure.

episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
episodes.overview: While Usopp & Luffy fool around with the ship's cannon one day, Zoro dreams about his childhood and the promise he made to Kuina.

episodes.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
episodes.overview: The crew meets Johnny and Yosaku, Zoro's former companions, and they set sail for the Baratie restaurant in search of a cook.

episodes.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
episodes.overview: Sanji, a cook at the Baratie, helps a starving pirate named Gin. Luffy begins his job as a waiter to pay for the damage he did to the Baratie, and tries to convince Sanji to join his crew.

episodes.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
episodes.overview: Gin returns to the Baratie with his also-starving captain, Don Krieg, to whom Sanji once more gives food, but Don Krieg betrays the cook once he regains his energy.

episodes.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
episodes.overview: It is revealed that Chef Zeff was a great pirate known as Red Leg Zeff. Gin explains the catastrophe the fleet met in Grand Line when they encountered Hawk-Eyes Mihawk, and Krieg attempts to take control of the Baratie.

episodes.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
episodes.overview: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Mihawk has returned to finish the job, but Zoro challenges him to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

episodes.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
episodes.overview: Mihawk leaves after defeating Zoro, so Krieg continues his invasion and has Pearl, one of his stronger crewmates, attack, and Sanji reveals his fighting skills. Meanwhile Johnny and Yosaku leave with Usopp and the wounded Zoro to go after Nami.

episodes.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
episodes.overview: With Zeff held captive by Gin, Sanji has no choice but to take Pearl's hits, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

episodes.title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
episodes.overview: Gin finishes off Pearl, claiming that he wants to kill Sanji himself. Still wounded, Sanji faces Gin while Luffy attacks Don Krieg.

episodes.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!
episodes.overview: When Gin refuses to kill Sanji, Krieg uses a poison gas on him. Luffy seems to have the advantage in the fight until Krieg pulls out his explosive Battle Spear.

episodes.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!
episodes.overview: Even after taking several hits from the Battle Spear, Luffy refuses to give up.

episodes.title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets Off With Luffy!
episodes.overview: After the battle, Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg despite still being poisoned, and Sanji makes the difficult decision on whether to stay or to go with Luffy just as Yosaku comes back with news that he knows where Nami is.

episodes.title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!
episodes.overview: The crew chases after Nami, who stole their ship, and Yosaku takes time during the trip to explain about Arlong and his Fishmen to Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro arrive at the island Nami docked at.

episodes.title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!
episodes.overview: Zoro is captured by the fishmen after Usopp and Johnny ditch him, and it's revealed that Nami was part of Arlong's crew the entire time. When a group of Fishmen attack Cocoyashi Village, Usopp comes to the rescue.

episodes.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
episodes.overview: After Zoro escapes with Nami's help, she tries to prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates by appearing to kill Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finally arrives at the island.

episodes.title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!
episodes.overview: Johnny tells the others about Nami killing Usopp, and Luffy does not believe them until Nami appears herself and confirms it. She tells them to stay out of her business and leave without her, but Luffy stubbornly decides to stay on the island. Usopp returns, revealing that Nami only pretended to kill him, and Nami's sister, Nojiko, starts to explain why Nami is acting the way she is.

episodes.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!
episodes.overview: Nojiko starts her story about Nami's childhood and their adopted mother, Bellemere. Despite being poor and none of them being related by blood, they had a happy life.

episodes.title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!
episodes.overview: Nojiko continues her story, explaining how their life was ruined when the Arlong Pirates first took over the village.

episodes.title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!
episodes.overview: When a marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami stole over the years, in order to one day buy the village from Arlong, the villagers decide that enough is enough and fight back, despite Nami's pleads that they do not and that they'd all be killed. Upon seeing Nami's sorrow, the Straw Hats head for Arlong Park.

episodes.title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. The Luffy Pirates!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats face the Fishmen themselves as the villagers watch from the sidelines.

episodes.title: Luffy Submerged! Zoro vs. Hatchan the Octopus!
episodes.overview: Arlong has trapped Luffy in the ocean and Zoro faces the six-sword wielding octopus Hatchan.

episodes.title: Proud Warriors! Sanji and Usopp's Fierce Battles!
episodes.overview: With Hatchan defeated, two of the fishmen battle Sanji and Usopp. Things look grim for Sanji as he attempts to face Kuroobi underwater, and Usopp gets the chance to prove that he too is a brave warrior.

episodes.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!
episodes.overview: Arlong's officers have been defeated, but Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong in their current state. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may be able to defeat the "most wicked man in the East Blue". Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.

episodes.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault From the Sea!
episodes.overview: Luffy returns to the fight, and the battle with Arlong versus Luffy begins.

episodes.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
episodes.overview: The battle spreads into Arlong Park itself and Arlong is no longer holding back.

episodes.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
episodes.overview: Arlong's reign of terror is over, and no one has anything on their mind except to party. As the crew celebrates, Nami reflects on her hometown and decides to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.

episodes.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!
episodes.overview: As a result of defeating Buggy, Krieg and Arlong, Luffy now has the highest bounty in all of East Blue. News quickly spreads to Shanks, who celebrates Luffy's arrival into the world of pirates by partying with Mihawk, despite already being severely hungover.

episodes.title: Chase Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure!
episodes.overview: After his fight with Luffy, Buggy was sent flying to another island with several body parts missing. Thus, Buggy begins his journey to find his crew and his body parts, making some unlikely friends.

episodes.title: The Wait is Over! The Return of Captain Buggy!
episodes.overview: With Buggy assumed to be dead, his crew fights over who will be the new captain, only to be captured by a tribe of cannibals.

episodes.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End! Landfall at Logue Town!
episodes.overview: The crew arrives at the last large town before the entrance to the Grand Line--Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed, where they stock up on supplies and sightsee. As Luffy heads for the execution platform where Roger was killed, old enemies are searching for him.

episodes.title: Zoro's New Swords and the Woman Sergeant Major!
episodes.overview: While searching for new swords to replace the ones shattered by Mihawk, Zoro meets a woman named Tashigi, who looks exactly like an older Kuina, who then helps him look.

episodes.title: Usopp vs. Daddy the Parent! Showdown at High!
episodes.overview: Usopp manages to anger the daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father, and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he challenges him to a duel.

episodes.title: Fiery Cooking Battle? Sanji vs. The Beautiful Chef!
episodes.overview: In order to win a rare fish, Sanji enters a cooking contest and faces a woman named Carmen.

episodes.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man Who Smiles On the Execution Platform!
episodes.overview: Luffy arrives at the execution platform only to be caught in a trap by Buggy and Alvida.

episodes.title: The Legend Has Started! Head for the Grand Line!
episodes.overview: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown, only for Zoro to be stopped by Tashigi and Luffy to be stopped by Captain Smoker.

episodes.title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!
episodes.overview: On a stormy night a girl called Apis escapes from the Marines and arrives at Straw hat's ship, but the girl upon knowing that they are pirates begins to hide some of the reasons which she is being wanted by the Marines. As the Straw Hats escape from the Marines, they get caught in the Calm Belt.

episodes.title: Miraculous Creature! Apis's Secret and The Legendary Island!
episodes.overview: After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!

episodes.title: Eric Attacks! Great Escape From Warship Island!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats want to return Apis's dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it's time for another daring escape!

episodes.title: A Solitary Island in the Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island!
episodes.overview: Even for Nami, finding the dragon's lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.

episodes.title: Showdown in the Ruins! Tense Zoro vs. Eric!
episodes.overview: Zoro is left fighting with Eric while Luffy and the gang run to the ship in order to get to Lost Island, but only find more problems.

episodes.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Commodore Nelson's Secret Strategy!
episodes.overview: At last Admiral Nelson has seen through the ambitions of Eric, but takes it a little too personally and now the mystical dragon's life is in danger.

episodes.title: Through the Sky They Soar! The 1000 Year Legend Lives Again!
episodes.overview: With his last breath, Ryuuji calls all his fellow dragons, and the Lost Island re-surfaced. Meanwhile Luffy takes out Admiral Nelson and his gang.

episodes.title: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!
episodes.overview: After leaving Warship Island the Going Merry is now towards the Grand Line, and the crew now returns to the Great Adventure.

seasons.name: Whiskey Peak & Little Garden
seasons.overview: The season follows Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates as they enter the Grand Line. After encountering the giant whale Laboon and his caretaker Crocus, they meet Princess Nefertari Vivi and become involved in the conflict against the criminal organization Baroque Works, led by the Warlord Sir Crocodile. Along the way, they also befriend the giants Dorry and Broggy on Little Garden.

episodes.title: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
episodes.overview: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.

episodes.title: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
episodes.overview: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.

episodes.title: A Town that Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!
episodes.overview: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.

episodes.title: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
episodes.overview: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.

episodes.title: All Out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
episodes.overview: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.

episodes.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
episodes.overview: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.

episodes.title: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!
episodes.overview: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.

episodes.title: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
episodes.overview: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.

episodes.title: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
episodes.overview: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.

episodes.title: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Broggy!
episodes.overview: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.

episodes.title: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
episodes.overview: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

episodes.title: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
