episodes.overview: Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido. As the Straw Hats approach the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima, they are attacked out of the blue.

episodes.title: Kaido’s Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
episodes.overview: To Law and the others’ surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido’s formidable subordinates, the Tobi Roppo, are called in.

episodes.title: The Samurai Warriors’ Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.

episodes.title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido’s Banquet!
episodes.overview: Eustass Kid and his clan start heading for Kaido's castle head on waving Luffy off. Luffy and Zoro go after them to stop them from causing trouble, but they happen to step into Kaido’s banquet. Meanwhile, Kanjuro loses his way to Kaido in underground passages with Momonosuke who he kidnapped in tow.

episodes.title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy’s Furious Strike!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Zoro each witness Kaido’s subordinates waste food at the banquet and make fun of the poor people in the Land of Wano. Thinking of Otama, a small girl who liked red-bean soup so much, both Luffy and Zoro become infuriated and create turmoil.

episodes.title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
episodes.overview: After making a scene at the Golden Festival, Luffy and Zoro try to get away, but Queen announces to his subordinates that anyone who catches them will be rewarded with a position in the Tobi Roppo. Scratchmen Apoo stands in Luffy and Zoro’s way and with his ability to use music as a weapon, he launches unpredictable attacks which corner Luffy and Zoro.

episodes.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
episodes.overview: Haccha, a supergiant Number, joins in and the pursuit of Luffy and the others becomes even more intense. Meanwhile, Kin’emon changes his strategy and his group tries to infiltrate the castle from its side, but there is an unexpected change of the floor plan which coincidentally makes Sanji excited.

episodes.title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes.overview: Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and all the others are trying to infiltrate Kaido’s castle from all sides. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children are climbing up the waterfall towards Onigashima again, but this time, Marco the Phoenix appears from nowhere and stands in their way!

episodes.title: The Pact Between Men! The Fierce Fighting of Brachio Tank!
episodes.overview: The furious Big Mom chases Brachio Tank driven by Chopper and Usopp, but they bravely fight back! Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes the battered and bruised Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi, then breaks the news to them about Oden’s retainers who were thought to be dead.

episodes.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido’s Son!
episodes.overview: Luffy runs into Ulti and Page One, members of the Tobi Roppo from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Hearing that he aims to become the King of the Pirates, the brother and sister duo become infuriated and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.

episodes.title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
episodes.overview: Evading Ulti and Page One, strong members of the Tobi Roppo, Luffy tries to find out what Kaido’s son Yamato’s motive is. However, the two get in a fight. Taking Luffy’s punishing attacks, Yamato remembers someone he fought against in the past.

episodes.title: Desire to be Oden! Yamato’s Dream!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya members who were on board Law’s Polar Tang finally reach Onigashima and see someone who they didn’t expect. Kaido’s son Yamato starts telling his story to Luffy, shares his passion, and reveals what’s behind his mask!

episodes.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs that Shackle Yamato’s Freedom!
episodes.overview: At the back entrance of Onigashima, the Akazaya members try to get inside the gate, but they’re blocked by their former colleague Kanjuro. Meanwhile, as Kaido’s son Yamato shows Luffy the handcuffs that have restricted his freedom for years, they hear Kaido making a speech on his grand plan.

episodes.title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
episodes.overview: Kaido’s plan to obtain the great treasure infuriates Orochi, but his unexpected violent move silences everyone. Meanwhile at the back entrance of Onigashima, Kikunojo squares off against Kanjuro and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.

episodes.title: Raid! Inheriting Oden's Will!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya members start charging towards Kaido from the back of Onigashima. Meanwhile, at the Performance Floor, Kaido closes in on Momonosuke shivering in terror and asks him the ultimate question which will determine his fate.

episodes.title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy’s All-Out War Begins!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya members deliver a crushing blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to back them up, but Ulti stands in their way and Big Mom spots Luffy. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot free themselves from their enemies and move on to take back Zeus!

episodes.title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
episodes.overview: The Animal Kingdom Pirates gasp with surprise to see thousands of samurai warriors coming into the castle. In his dragon form, Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazaya members under the moon. However, the Akazaya members have secret weapons to use against him

episodes.title: Zeus’ Treason?! The Cornered Nami!
episodes.overview: Shinobu tries to rescue the weakened Momonosuke but is found by King and attacked. On the other hand, Nami takes back Zeus from Big Mom and runs away but loses him again and gets chased by Zeus who is ordered to kill to her by Big Mom

episodes.title: I’ll Protect You! Yamato Meets Momonosuke!
episodes.overview: Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato, the self-proclaimed Oden, finally meets his son Momonosuke.

episodes.title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
episodes.overview: As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin’emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks! Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help Kin’emon and the others, but Queen and King get in their way.

episodes.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
episodes.overview: Who’s-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.

episodes.title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
episodes.overview: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp’s practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.

episodes.title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
episodes.overview: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.

episodes.title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden’s Secret Swordplay!
episodes.overview: While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido. Hearing Kaido jeering at them for being weak, the samurai retainers attack him relentlessly, remembering the day Oden told them to master his sword skill.

episodes.title: The Power of Ice Oni! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
episodes.overview: Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji, who are on their way to the rooftop, run into another Headliner with a special ability.

episodes.title: I Won’t Forgive Him! Chopper’s Determination!
episodes.overview: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen’s Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.

episodes.title: Zoro’s Pursuit! Ice Oni Tag!
episodes.overview: Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.

episodes.title: Nami Surrenders?! Ulti’s Fierce Headbutt!
episodes.overview: Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy’s declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

episodes.title: Sasaki’s Onslaught! Armored Division vs. Yamato!
episodes.overview: Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.

episodes.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper’s Fire Trick!
episodes.overview: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei, and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop where the Akazaya members’ tough battle against Kaido rages on.

episodes.title: It’s Not Okay! The Spider Lures Sanji!
episodes.overview: Sanji hears a woman’s scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it’s a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.

episodes.title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
episodes.overview: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.

episodes.title: Yamato’s Past! The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea!
episodes.overview: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido’s head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

episodes.title: Marco’s Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes.overview: The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro’s way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro’s determination and tries to pave the way for him.

episodes.title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
episodes.overview: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

episodes.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
episodes.overview: Luffy’s strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he’s ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls “heaven.”

episodes.title: Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
episodes.overview: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

episodes.title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
episodes.overview: Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.

episodes.title: Otama’s Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
episodes.overview: After watching the Straw Hats’ departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she’s here on Onigashima, it’s time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

episodes.title: Sanji’s Scream! An SOS Echoes Over the Island!
episodes.overview: Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.

episodes.title: Spank Strikes! Sanji's Woman-trouble!
episodes.overview: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.

episodes.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
episodes.overview: Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.

episodes.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
episodes.overview: Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.

episodes.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
episodes.overview: That unparalleled laugh! The Akazaya regain hope upon witnessing Oden's return. They failed in their attempt to take down Kaido, but after twenty years, they team up with Oden again to finish the job!

episodes.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors’ Deadly Attack!
episodes.overview: The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.

episodes.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
episodes.overview: The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.

episodes.title: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law’s Sword Technique!
episodes.overview: Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.

episodes.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
episodes.overview: Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.

episodes.title: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired’s Daughter Uta!
episodes.overview: A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group.

episodes.title: A Pledge for the New Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens.

episodes.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
episodes.overview: Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.

episodes.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano! The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
episodes.overview: Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.

episodes.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
episodes.overview: Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.

episodes.title: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
episodes.overview: Luffy is pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in a fight between Big Mom and Nami’s group and stands up for the one who he wants to save. On the Performance Floor, Chopper is in a fierce battle against Queen.

episodes.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
episodes.overview: While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.

episodes.title: Fight Against the Dark Night! The Commander-in-chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off!
episodes.overview: Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!

episodes.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance’s Counterattack Begins!
episodes.overview: Momonosuke and Shinobu face Kaido while Kid and Law challenge Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami, heading towards the stage on the Performance Floor along with Usopp and Tama, hears a strange voice.

episodes.title: Nami’s Lethal Attack! Otama’s Desperate Challenge!
episodes.overview: Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters shows up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command!

episodes.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
episodes.overview: Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.

episodes.title: The Pride of a Helmsman! The Enraged Jimbei!
episodes.overview: Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.

episodes.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
episodes.overview: To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.

episodes.title: The Predator’s Trap - Black Maria’s Temptation!
episodes.overview: Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.

episodes.title: Slash the Nightmare! Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
episodes.overview: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.

episodes.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
episodes.overview: Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.

episodes.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
episodes.overview: Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.

episodes.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
episodes.overview: Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.

episodes.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
episodes.overview: Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.

episodes.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen’s Pledge
episodes.overview: The battle between Kaidou and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.

episodes.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
episodes.overview: Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.

episodes.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke’s Determination!
episodes.overview: Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.

episodes.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy’s Fist Roars in the Sky
episodes.overview: Yamato helps Momonosuke conquer his fear of flying and the two take on the most important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaidou clash which parts the heavens. The clear skies help Inuarashi and Nekomamushi finally defeat their foes.

episodes.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
episodes.overview: Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.

episodes.title: Sanji's Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
episodes.overview: Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.

episodes.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble!
episodes.overview: Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.

episodes.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
episodes.overview: Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.

episodes.title: Strike Back! Law and Kid's Counterattack Alliance
episodes.overview: Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.

episodes.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
episodes.overview: Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.

episodes.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close in
episodes.overview: The chaos within the floating island of Onigashima rages on to seemingly no end. Kazenbo, Kajuro's creation, is wreaking havoc all throughout the Skull Dome in the name of vengence for the Kurozami. The rampage causes panic among Beasts Pirates and samurai, alike. As Orochi watches on, he hears a sound that reminds him of his past love.

episodes.title: Zoro's Hardship - A Monster! King the Wildfire
episodes.overview: Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.

episodes.title: Secrets of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
episodes.overview: Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.

episodes.title: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
episodes.overview: Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.

episodes.title: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King
episodes.overview: Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.

episodes.title: Luffy is on the Move! A Turning Point of a New Era!
episodes.overview: Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.

episodes.title: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
episodes.overview: In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.

episodes.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire up, the Will of the New Generation!
episodes.overview: With the ongoing battles in various parts of Onigashima, everyone is reaching their limits. In the face of Big Mom, Law and Kid are exhausted and deeply wounded. Mocking them, Big Mom tries to head for the rooftop.

episodes.title: Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism!
episodes.overview: Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.

episodes.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
episodes.overview: Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.

episodes.title: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
episodes.overview: Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.

episodes.title: There is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
episodes.overview: On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.

episodes.title: Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
episodes.overview: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.

episodes.title: Luffy's Peak - Attained! Gear Five
episodes.overview: As Luffy's heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.

episodes.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
episodes.overview: Bouncing on the ground and becoming a giant, Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power while Kaido is bewildered and can’t make sense of it. Meanwhile, Kid, Law, and Luffy’s other allies continue the fight down below against flames and enemies alike, waiting for Luffy to emerge victorious.

episodes.title: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima
episodes.overview: As Luffy and Kaidou continue their battle, Raizo and Jinbe utilize their plan to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima. Meanwhile, Yamato warns Momonosuke of the danger Onigashima will face if he does not act soon to create new flame clouds to keep it from crashing into the Flower Capital.

episodes.title: I Trust Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
episodes.overview: Momonosuke struggles to create Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima which is in free fall. In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is ending with people flying their Sky Boats in the air. To fulfill the promise to free the Land of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.

episodes.title: 20 Years' Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano!
episodes.overview: When Oden died 20 years ago, Orochi took over the Land of Wano. People were separated from their loved ones, forced into labor, and starved. Now they pray that Kaido will vanish as Luffy’s battle against him reaches a climax.

episodes.title: The World That Luffy Wants!
episodes.overview: Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.

episodes.title: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!
episodes.overview: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.

episodes.title: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
episodes.overview: The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.

episodes.title: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!
episodes.overview: The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.  Momonosuke announces to the citizens his victory and the return of the Kozuki Family. Tama remembers her childhood, and Yamato asks to join Luffy's crew.

episodes.title: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
episodes.overview: The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him. The reason behind his action surprises Luffy

episodes.title: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
episodes.overview: As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano

episodes.title: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
episodes.overview: Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.

episodes.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
episodes.overview: Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.

episodes.title: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
episodes.overview: An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.

episodes.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
episodes.overview: Angered by Luffy's attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.

episodes.title: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
episodes.overview: Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island,　Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

episodes.title: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
episodes.overview: Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting Hancock.

episodes.title: Luffy's Dream
episodes.overview: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

seasons.name: Egghead
seasons.overview: The aftermaths of both the Levely and the Raid on Onigashima, as well as the erasure of the Lulusia Kingdom, cause major shifts across the world that could lead to global war. The Straw Hat Pirates, following their Log Pose, arrive at the mysterious, futuristic island Egghead where the super genius Dr. Vegapunk resides. However, after being tipped off about Vegapunk's research into the Void Century, the World Government decides to dispatch a CP0 team to assassinate Vegapunk. Betrayal and intrigue on all sides leads to a Marine siege on the island that will escalate into an incident that will shock the world.

episodes.title: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
episodes.overview: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

episodes.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
episodes.overview: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

episodes.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
episodes.overview: A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy’s group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.

episodes.title: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
episodes.overview: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
episodes.overview: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

episodes.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they've never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

episodes.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
episodes.overview: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

episodes.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
episodes.overview: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

episodes.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
episodes.overview: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

episodes.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

episodes.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
episodes.overview: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

episodes.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
episodes.overview: Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.

episodes.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
episodes.overview: Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

episodes.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.

episodes.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
episodes.overview: CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

episodes.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
episodes.overview: The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.

episodes.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy
episodes.overview: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

episodes.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
episodes.overview: CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.

episodes.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
episodes.overview: Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.

episodes.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim's Rebellion!
episodes.overview: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

episodes.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
episodes.overview: Lucci and Kaku from CP-0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.

episodes.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats and CP-0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.

episodes.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
episodes.overview: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

episodes.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
episodes.overview: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

episodes.title: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
episodes.overview: Perona breaks into the Blackbeard Pirates' prison to rescue her captain, Gecko Moria, and frees Koby, who then helps free other prisoners. Koby, now with a high bounty, distracts a mob of pirates to protect the others. He recalls Blackbeard's plan to trade him for Hachinosu's entry into the World Government. The pirates face attacks from clay golems, SWORD member Kujaku, and a Marine force led by Garp and Tashigi.

episodes.title: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
episodes.overview: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack on top of it to save his pupil Koby. Koby almost reaches the ship with Navy HQ Commander Hibari running by his side.

episodes.title: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
episodes.overview: Kuzan, a former Navy Admiral, stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp’s pupil but is now a member of the Blackbeard Pirates. What happened to him after he was defeated by Sakazuki is now revealed.

episodes.title: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
episodes.overview: Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

episodes.title: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
episodes.overview: Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.

episodes.title: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
episodes.overview: In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

episodes.title: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra’s Resolve
episodes.overview: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.

episodes.title: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
episodes.overview: Vivi tries to escape the Holy Land Mary Geoise with Wapol while the injured Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra’s message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

episodes.title: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
episodes.overview: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.

episodes.title: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited
episodes.overview: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

episodes.title: The World Shakes! The Straw Hats' Hostage Situation
episodes.overview: As the news about Garp’s disappearance and Luffy’s hostage situation spreads, a mysterious earthquake suddenly shakes the entire world. Meanwhile, a huge Navy fleet led by Admiral Kizaru surrounds Egghead and listens in as York contacts Mary Geoise to negotiate a deal.

episodes.title: Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes.overview: In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.

episodes.title: A Clash of Two Men's Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru
episodes.overview: Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk’s bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.

episodes.title: Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru's Depressing Mission
episodes.overview: Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.

episodes.title: Luffy vs. Kizaru!  A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle
episodes.overview: A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can’t help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.

episodes.title: The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn
episodes.overview: Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.

episodes.title: Kuma's Past - Better Off Dead in This World
episodes.overview: Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.

episodes.title: A History Erased! God Valley of Despair
episodes.overview: The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.

episodes.title: A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny
episodes.overview: Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.

episodes.title: A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
episodes.overview: Two years after Ginny’s abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.

episodes.title: To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist
episodes.overview: By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government’s eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.

episodes.title: Cruel Fate - Kuma's Decision as a Father
episodes.overview: Taking advantage of Kuma’s love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney’s treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.

episodes.title: To the Sea Where My Father Is! The Future Bonney Chooses
episodes.overview: Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

episodes.title: Kuma's Life
episodes.overview: Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.

episodes.title: I'm Sorry, Dad - Bonney's Tears and Kuma's Fist
episodes.overview: The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn’s grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father’s transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.

episodes.title: Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma's Warm Embrace
episodes.overview: Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.

episodes.title: Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call Is Invoked
episodes.overview: As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.

episodes.title: An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney
episodes.overview: Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It’s the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.

episodes.title: Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!
episodes.overview: The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

episodes.title: Come In, World - Vegapunk's Message
episodes.overview: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

episodes.title: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
episodes.overview: Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

episodes.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
episodes.overview: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

episodes.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
episodes.overview: Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St. Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

episodes.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
episodes.overview: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

episodes.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
episodes.overview: Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

episodes.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.

episodes.title: The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
episodes.overview: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

episodes.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
episodes.overview: Vegapunk’s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

episodes.title: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
episodes.overview: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

episodes.title: Her Father and Mother's Legacy! Bonney's Nika Punch
episodes.overview: Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.

episodes.title: The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy
episodes.overview: Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike.

episodes.title: The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory
episodes.overview: Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

episodes.title: The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph!
episodes.overview: York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk’s Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.

seasons.name: Elbaph
seasons.overview: After a daring escape from the Future Island Egghead, the Straw Hat Crew set their course for a legendary destination. Joined by the mighty Giant Warrior Pirates, they finally reach Elbaph, the long-awaited Land of Giants. New encounters with Giants, and long hoped-for reunions unfold. A colossal new chapter begins as the crew heads into an adventure unlike anything before, all in the pursuit of the ultimate treasure, the "One Piece!"

episodes.title: The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!
episodes.overview: After leaving Egghead, the Straw Hats and the Giant Pirate Crew celebrate their reunion with a big banquet.

episodes.title: Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
episodes.overview: Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.

episodes.title: A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
episodes.overview: Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.

episodes.title: Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!
episodes.overview: Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy’s fists.

episodes.title: An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince
episodes.overview: Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy
episodes.overview: Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.

episodes.title: A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
episodes.overview: As the Great Erik, carrying Robin and the others, reaches the island of Elbaph, a breathtaking rainbow stretches out before them. Yet even greater astonishment awaits them in the direction the ship is traveling.

episodes.title: I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
episodes.overview: Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.

episodes.title: Saul's Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara
episodes.overview: Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.

episodes.title: A Welcome with Friends' Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
episodes.overview: Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.

episodes.title: Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Amidst the roaring banquet with the Giants, Luffy hears the legend of the Sun God passed down in Elbaph and learns why Loki is being held captive. In the Underworld, two mysterious guests appear before Loki, expressing their desire to recruit him into their order of knights.

episodes.title: Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Luffy and some of his companions snuck out of the banquet to explore the deceased king's castle.

episodes.title: Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph
episodes.overview: Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.

episodes.title: The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater
episodes.overview: While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.

episodes.title: Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban
episodes.overview: Gaban challenges Luffy to try to take the key from him. Luffy goes for it, only to be overpowered by Gaban's sheer force. Meanwhile, Shamrock and Gunko summon reinforcements and plot a detailed strategy to disorient the Giants.

episodes.title: The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!
episodes.overview: While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph's weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.

episodes.title: Monsters Appear in Elbaph - "What I Fear Most"
episodes.overview: A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.

episodes.title: A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God
episodes.overview: Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school’s emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.

episodes.title: Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
episodes.overview: As monsters assault villages throughout Elbaph, the Giants scramble to hold them back. Meanwhile, as the sleeping children get closer to the fire, Saul tries everything to stop them, but suddenly, he finds his efforts stymied.

episodes.title: Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe's Shoulder Throw Explodes!
episodes.overview: In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.

episodes.title: The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats

series.title: Outer Banks
series.overview: On a North Carolina island of haves and have-nots, John B and his tight-knit crew of friends find mystery and adventure while hunting for lost treasure.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a hurricane, John B, JJ, Pope and Kiara plunge headlong into danger and adventure when they find a mysterious sunken wreck.

episodes.title: The Lucky Compass
episodes.overview: Convinced that the clue found onboard the boat connects to his missing father, John B leads his friends on an increasingly frantic search for answers.

episodes.title: The Forbidden Zone
episodes.overview: As the gang hatches an illicit scheme to get to the bottom of the deep-sea mystery, John B confronts Sarah while Pope jumps at the chance for revenge.

episodes.title: Spy Games
episodes.overview: When John B's supervision-free home life catches up to him, he receives a well-timed assist — and some spiffing up — from the last person he expects.

episodes.title: Midsummers
episodes.overview: John B believes he's made a breakthrough in the hunt for the gold, but his desire to include Sarah in the quest causes friction among the friends.

episodes.title: Parcel 9
episodes.overview: A spooky island legend, a broken friendship and John B's new living situation keep the crew on their toes as they search high and low for the treasure.

episodes.title: Dead Calm
episodes.overview: JJ's reckless behavior ramps up when the friends try to score some quick cash. Meanwhile, John B grows closer to Sarah — and makes her dad suspicious.

episodes.title: The Runway
episodes.overview: John B finally learns the truth about his dad — and sets off a chain of events that jeopardizes everything he and his friends have fought to accomplish.

episodes.title: The Bell Tower
episodes.overview: With his options dwindling and enemies closing in, John B looks for an exit plan. Sarah feels pressured to pick a side. Pope lets his emotions out.

episodes.title: The Phantom
episodes.overview: An island crawling with law enforcement and a looming tropical storm are just two of the obstacles facing John B as he tries to make his escape.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With a fortune in gold at stake and their futures on the line, the Pogues rush headlong into danger and a fresh mystery as they face foes old and new.

episodes.title: The Gold
episodes.overview: John B tries to evade capture as he zeroes in on the gold, but a promise to Sarah could derail his plans. Back home, his friends face life without him.

episodes.title: The Heist
episodes.overview: With time running out, John B and Sarah strike an uneasy bargain, while Kiara, JJ and Pope search for evidence that could implicate Ward and Rafe.

episodes.title: Prayers
episodes.overview: A desperate scramble for help lands John B and Sarah in questionable surroundings. Pope receives a mysterious summons to an out-of-town meeting.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Low on gas and strapped for cash, John B and Sarah run into trouble. Pope's appointment in Charleston takes an ominous turn over a proposed trade.

episodes.title: The Darkest Hour
episodes.overview: JJ cooks up a risky plan to help out John B. Pope hunts down information about the key. Kiara and Sarah both deal with family fallout over the Pogues.

episodes.title: My Druthers
episodes.overview: John B bristles when Sarah reconnects with a former flame. Ward's web of lies starts to unravel. Pope discovers a shocking family secret.

episodes.title: The Bonfire
episodes.overview: Reeling from Ward's actions, Sarah finds her loyalties to John B and the Pogues put to the test. At the annual bonfire, jealousies and tempers flare.

episodes.title: The Cross
episodes.overview: Armed with new clues, the group braves perilous roads and swampland as they race to keep part of Pope's history from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: Trapped
episodes.overview: The Pogues deal with a slew of setbacks — a medical emergency, a nosy neighbor, parental ultimatums — as they attempt to save Pope's family legacy.

episodes.title: The Coastal Venture
episodes.overview: John B, Pope, JJ and Kiara brace for a showdown on board the ship, while Sarah realizes the harsh truth of her distressing family situation.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: New adventures take the Pogues to the Caribbean and far beyond as the friends are pulled into a dangerous rival's hunt for a legendary lost city.

episodes.title: Poguelandia
episodes.overview: An unexpected rescuer takes the Pogues from a remote island to Barbados, where they encounter a powerful treasure hunter with his own agenda.

episodes.title: The Bells
episodes.overview: As her friends mount a rescue attempt, Kiara agrees to an uneasy truce with Rafe. A familiar sound grabs John B's attention.

episodes.title: Fathers and Sons
episodes.overview: Big John and John B pick up where they left off — for better or worse. Cleo and Pope form a new club. Rafe reconnects with Ward.

episodes.title: The Diary
episodes.overview: An emotional homecoming is easier for some than others. Big John searches for the diary. Ward's plans for a prized possession don't sit well with Rafe.

episodes.title: Heists
episodes.overview: Sarah convinces an old friend to help with a high-risk, high-reward mission. Looking to access a museum collection, John B and his dad get creative.

episodes.title: The Dark Forest
episodes.overview: Secrets threaten to drive a wedge between John B and his friends. Sarah revisits a past life. Pope reaches a breaking point.

episodes.title: Happy Anniversary
episodes.overview: With Singh on the move, John B and JJ scramble to catch him. Pope makes a breakthrough. Sarah questions where her loyalties lie.

episodes.title: Tapping the Rudder
episodes.overview: Rafe lays his cards on the table and Sarah calls in two favors. JJ's unorthodox plan to get to South America lands John B in hot water.

episodes.title: Welcome to Kitty Hawk
episodes.overview: With their ride to Orinoco waiting on the tarmac, Kiara and JJ run into several complications. Rafe has a change of heart.

episodes.title: Secret of the Gnomon
episodes.overview: The Pogues' search for El Dorado brings them deep into the jungle, where John B and Sarah face the ultimate test of their courage and family bonds.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The Pogues return home and start living their best life, but it's not long before they're back to doing what they do best: hunting for treasure.

episodes.title: The Enduro
episodes.overview: Flush with success, the Pogues have big plans to invest in their future. But when their fortunes take a turn, will a bold gamble pay off?

episodes.title: Blackbeard
episodes.overview: A strange tale of a family curse makes the Pogues think twice about accepting a lucrative offer to search for an amulet linked to Blackbeard.

episodes.title: The Lupine Corsairs
episodes.overview: The sheriff grills the Pogues about their dealings with Wes Genrette. JJ and Kiara have another close call. Pope gets wind of a mysterious artifact.

episodes.title: The Swell
episodes.overview: Tensions rise along with the waves when the Pogues and the Kooks hit the beach for the year's best swell. As Pope digs for info, Cleo faces down danger.

episodes.title: Albatross
episodes.overview: The Pogues scramble when the sheriff turns up at the worst possible time. JJ receives a mysterious letter. The amulet's clues point to Charleston.

episodes.title: The Town Council
episodes.overview: JJ learns about his past. The Pogues rally support for a zoning meeting that will decide their fate. Sarah and John B suss out a theory about the scroll.

episodes.title: Mothers and Fathers
episodes.overview: As a confrontation on Goat Island turns perilous, Sarah confirms a suspicion while searching for JJ, Pope's future falters, and Topper taunts John B.

episodes.title: Family Plot
episodes.overview: While JJ heads out on a grim mission with Groff, Sarah reveals her big news, Pope faces a moment of truth, and Rafe helps the sheriff connect the dots.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.overview: Pursued by police, the Pogues embark on the next stage of their mission with help from an unexpected source. Tensions flare when John B confides in JJ.

episodes.title: The Blue Crown
episodes.overview: The hunt for Groff heats up in Morocco. In a deadly race to claim the crown, loyalties are tested — and a moment of treachery changes everything.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Season 5 finds the Pogues at their absolute breaking point following the tragic loss  in Morocco. Stranded far from home and mourning the heart of their crew, they’ve lost the Blue Crown and continue to face a gauntlet of familiar threats. With Chandler Groff still at large, Dalia and the Corsairs closing in, and the Kooks ensuring the Pogues have no home to return to, John B, Sarah, Kiara, Pope, and Cleo must rely on their scrappy instincts—and an uneasy alliance with Rafe—to keep from falling apart for good. Their mission is now a desperate race to reclaim their future and finally win the freedom they’ve been chasing since the beginning. It’s the Pogues against the world as they seek to avenge their best friend and bring it on home…one final time.

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.overview: Devastated by a loss and stranded in Morocco, the Pogues navigate a treacherous border crossing as they race to intercept Groff — and the Blue Crown.

episodes.title: The Crown
episodes.overview: With her quest for vengeance hanging in the balance, Kiara strikes an uneasy deal with a rival. Groff's scheme to get rich goes sideways in Dubrovnik.

episodes.title: The Square Grouper
episodes.overview: The crew hits rock bottom with a hostile homecoming to the OBX, but the tide begins to turn when John B snags a lucrative catch.

episodes.title: Inside Job
episodes.overview: With Sarah's life at stake, Rafe runs interference at a Kook golf tournament while John B attempts a brazen heist in the heart of Figure 8.

episodes.title: The Scytale
episodes.overview: Kiara and Pope search for a mysterious artifact that could unlock the Blue Crown's powers. Rafe faces mounting pressure to sell Tannyhill to developers.

episodes.title: The Big Easy
episodes.overview: Sarah and John B hit the road to pursue a fresh lead in New Orleans, where Sarah comes face-to-face with a figure from her past.

episodes.title: Bal des Sauvages
episodes.overview: The Pogues infiltrate a glitzy masquerade party, where Kiara angles for access to the scytale drawings — and crosses paths with a murderous enemy.

episodes.title: The Runway (2)
episodes.overview: The friends get crafty to decode the scytale's secrets. Rafe becomes a wanted man when a violent mistake catches up to him. Cleo makes an explosive move.

episodes.title: Arise, Arise
episodes.overview: A mission to Azerbaijan gets rocky when Pope engineers a daring ambush. Kiara rushes to outpace the Corsairs and test the Crown's powers of resurrection.

episodes.title: The Storm and What Came After
episodes.overview: As a raging hurricane lashes Kildare, the Pogues race to save their loved ones and settle the score before a life-changing treasure slips away — again.

series.title: PAW Patrol
series.overview: Marshall, Rocky, Rubble, Zuma and Skye are doing their best to protect the people of their town. Led by Ryder, a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy, each of them is equipped with special equipment and together they help anyone who finds themselves in trouble. No task is too big for them and no puppy is too small.

cast.name: Majestie lewton ll
cast.character: Skye in great British version season 14 and onwards

episodes.title: Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe
episodes.overview: A kitten named Precious is floating out to sea, and the PAW Patrol must rescue her, but that's not all. The PAW Patrol must also act fast to find her owner before the mischievous kitten gets into big trouble.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Train
episodes.overview: The train that Katie and Cali are on is stuck on a bridge because of a rock slide. The PAW Patrol must act fast since the broken bridge beam can't hold the train for long!

episodes.title: Pup Pup Boogie
episodes.overview: A train car falls off the tracks and also breaks some rails. A train is coming later with important packages in it, with the all new Pup Pup Boogie 2.0 dance game. The PAW Patrol tries to fix the tracks, but how will they fix the tracks when Rubble sprains his paw and can't work? Can Chase save the day?

episodes.title: Pups in a Fog
episodes.overview: While the pups are having a sleepover, the Lighthouse light runs out of power. Cap'n Turbot, the one who monitors the Lighthouse light, is out at sea.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Sea Turtles
episodes.overview: Baby sea turtles were hatching at the other side of the road near the beach. They can't get to the beach without crossing the street, there are cars, skateboarders, scooters and all the hungry naughty seagulls around, not to mention Alex's rambunctious antics.

episodes.title: Pups and the Very Big Baby
episodes.overview: A baby whale has beached herself. The PAW Patrol has to rescue her and make sure her mother doesn't get too close. Can they save her and reunite her with her mother?

episodes.title: Pups Save the Circus
episodes.overview: Ellie, the baby elephant from the Circus train, has escaped and is loose in Adventure Bay!

episodes.title: Pup a Doodle Do
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway's purse chicken, Chickaleta, is on the loose and the PAW Patrol must find her before it's too late for Mayor Goodway and Chickaleta to host Hello, Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Pup Pup Goose
episodes.overview: When a flock of migrating geese stops in Adventure Bay, Marshall bonds with Fuzzy, the gosling of the flock.

episodes.title: Pup Pup and Away
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway has entered the Mayor's Hot Air Balloon Race, and she wants to beat the arrogant Mayor Humdinger of Foggy Bottom, but her balloon has a hole in it.

episodes.title: Pups Pit Crew
episodes.overview: The pups help a young boy named Alex fix his broken tricycle and teach him a valuable lesson of taking new things slow.

episodes.title: Pups Fight Fire
episodes.overview: The pups helps Marshall prepare for a firefighting obstacle course to win the fastest fire pup trophy.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Bunnies
episodes.overview: A bunch of adorable bunnies have come to Farmer Yumi's carrot patch. The PAW Patrol must catch them all and relocate them to a perfect new home.

episodes.title: Pup-Tacular
episodes.overview: While the rest of the PAW Patrol are out to rescue Mayor Goodway and Chickaleta and checking the trucks, Rocky must face his hydrophobia so that Katie can enter him in the Pup-Tacular Show.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Bay
episodes.overview: There's an oil spill in the bay, and a Baby Whale swam into the oil. The PAW Patrol must clean up the Baby Whale and the oil spill before more animals living in Adventure Bay are harmed by it.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Goodway
episodes.overview: It's Great-Great-Great-Great-Grandpa Grover Day, and Mayor Goodway has been planning anxiously for today's celebration.

episodes.title: Pups Get a Rubble
