episodes.overview: This episode is a flashback story of how Rubble joined the PAW Patrol. Rubble must help Jake when he gets trapped in an Avalanche.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Walrus
episodes.overview: The playful walrus, Wally, was performing tricks for Cap'n Turbot, but he eventually gets himself tangled in a fishing net during one of his tricks.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Treats
episodes.overview: On a snow and icy day, Mr. Porter's van ends up sliding on ice. If the ice cracks, it will fall into the bottom of the bay, and inside of the truck has all the pups' treats and food in it!

episodes.title: Pups Get a Lift
episodes.overview: Katie and Cali are stuck on Jake's Mountain. Rubble wants Ryder to pick him but he picks Marshall and Rocky.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Hoedown
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol are having a great time at the Adventure Bay Hoedown, but trouble starts to brew when Farmer Al's cows get spooked out and are on the loose in Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Pups Save Alex
episodes.overview: While Cali is playing with her favorite toy on Farmer Yumi's farm, she gets stuck on the top of the silo, which is not safe.

episodes.title: Pups and the Ghost Pirate
episodes.overview: A Halloween party turns into a spooky time when there's a ghostly figure roaming around on a ship. Can the PAW Patrol solve the paranormal mystery and save the Halloween party?

episodes.title: Pups Save a School Day
episodes.overview: It's Alex's first day of school, but he has lost his backpack! So the PAW Patrol agrees to help him find it.

episodes.title: Pups Turn On the Lights
episodes.overview: It's Chase's birthday and the other pups and Katie are setting up Chase's surprise birthday party at Katie's Clinic.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Pool Day
episodes.overview: It's a hot day and the pups head for the water park, but the pool is empty! The water tower that pumps water into the pool is tilted and has a bent pipe.

episodes.title: Circus Pup-formers
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol, for the first time, must all work together to help Eunice and Ellie save the circus when most of the performers are late.

episodes.title: Pups Make a Splash
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot got The Flounder stuck on some rocks. If the PAW Patrol doesn't save him, The Flounder will sink to the bottom of the bay!

episodes.title: Pups Fall Festival
episodes.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol have to save Farmer Yumi's fruit before an early snowfall comes. Everyone has a job to do to help, except for Chase.

episodes.title: Pups Save Christmas
episodes.overview: Santa's sleigh crashes and breaks in a snow storm on Christmas Eve, and all the presents are strewn across Adventure Bay. It's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the sled, collect the reindeer, find the gifts, find the magic star, and most importantly, save Christmas for Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Pups On Ice
episodes.overview: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

episodes.title: Pups and the Snow Monster
episodes.overview: The pups find strange footprints in the snow on the mountain outside Adventure Bay. Everyone thinks it's a "snow monster" and it's scaring the skiers away.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Super Pup
episodes.overview: Rubble is pretending to be a super pup and tries to handle a rescue all by himself, but soon, Ryder and the Paw Patrol have to save Rubble.

episodes.title: Pups Save Ryder's Robot
episodes.overview: When Ryder's Robot Pup breaks and starts going wild around Adventure Bay, it takes the whole Paw Patrol to help Ryder find it.

episodes.title: Pups Go All Monkey
episodes.overview: An escaped baby monkey named Mandy leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay, when she steals Mr. Porter van full of bananas.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Hoot
episodes.overview: Chase befriends a baby owl and with the PAW Patrol helps rescue its mother who is trapped in the knothole of a fallen tree.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Bat
episodes.overview: A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell and Mayor Goodway can't ring it. Ryder and the Pups attempt to rescue the bat quietly so it doesn't wake up, but it does and causes trouble around town. It's up to Ryder and the Pups to get the Bat and return her to her Bat cave.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Toof
episodes.overview: Alex is afraid to go to the dentist, so Chase and the PAW Patrol work together to show Alex that fears can be overcome.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Easter Egg Hunt
episodes.overview: It’s Adventure Bay’s annual Easter Egg Hunt and the pups are helping Mayor Goodway with the egg decorating. The hunt for a very special egg leads Ryder and the PAW Patrol on an exciting adventure.

episodes.title: Pups and the Lighthouse Boogie
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot has accidentally locked himself inside the lighthouse, so it is up to the pups to rescue a rowboat drifting out to sea.

episodes.title: Pups Save Ryder
episodes.overview: When Ryder and a goat named Garbi are trapped on a ledge at Big View Trail, it is up to the pups to save them.

episodes.title: Pups Great Race
episodes.overview: It's Adventure Bay Race Day and the pups are about to race each other all across the town to see who is the fastest pup. One other competitor unexpectedly shows up though, Alex in his super trike!

episodes.title: Pups Take the Cake
episodes.overview: Mr.Porter enters a cake competition and needs Ryder and the pups to help him bake the biggest and tastiest cake. The race is on to get their cake baked and to the competition on time!

episodes.title: Pups and the Beanstalk
episodes.overview: Rubble has a wondrous dream, similar to Jack and the Beanstalk, where Marshall grows a giant beanstalk and Alex is a giant. However, when giant Alex starts to cause havoc, Ryder and the PAW Patrol must keep him occupied.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Turbots
episodes.overview: When Cap'n Turbot needs to get a picture of the rare Blue Footed Booby Bird when his French cousin, Francois Turbot, decides to help but gets caught on a cliff! It's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue him and bring the two cousins together again.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Camping Trip
episodes.overview: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

episodes.title: Pups and the Trouble with Turtles
episodes.overview: Tons of baby turtles are popping up all over the town. Can the PAW Patrol help get them back to their homes before they get hurt?

episodes.title: Pups Save the Space Alien
episodes.overview: An alien lands on Earth at Farmer Yumi's place, and the gang try to repair his spaceship so he can return home.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Flying Frog
episodes.overview: Marshall gets a pet frog, and it jumps into a helicopter prior to a big frog-jumping competition.

episodes.title: Pups and the Pirate Treasure
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot accidentally stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout. When the PAW Patrol rescues him, they find an incomplete treasure map. The adventure is on as the pups follow clues to find the missing map pieces, and eventually to an amazing sunken pirate treasure!

episodes.title: Pups Save the Penguins
episodes.overview: The pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Dolphin Pup
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

episodes.title: Pups Save Jake
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Parade
episodes.overview: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Diving Bell
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Beavers
episodes.overview: When a storm washes away Chompy the Beaver's dam, he starts chomping wood all over town.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Ghost
episodes.overview: A mysterious Ghost is causing havoc around the Lookout at night. The Pups and Chase in his new SPY GEAR set up a stakeout to bust it.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Show
episodes.overview: The Pups are going to put on a Medieval play in town square, but Cap'n Turbot's castle stage prop ends up collapsing and trapping him!

episodes.title: Pups Save an Ace
episodes.overview: Skye's favorite stunt pilot, Ace Sorensen, is heading to Adventure Bay to put on a fantastic air show. Just before arrival she runs into engine trouble!

episodes.title: Pups Save a Wedding
episodes.overview: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi are getting married! Farmer Yumi's barn is being decorated for the big day and all the pups are helping, but a big storm blows in and takes down a wall of the barn!

episodes.title: The New Pup
episodes.overview: An Arctic storm picks up, but Jake finds help from a brave mountain ranger pup named Everest!

episodes.title: Pups Jungle Trouble
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol heads to the Jungle in the PAW Patroller to meet Ryder's 10 year old pen-pal, Carlos.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Herd
episodes.overview: Chase is taking part in a herding competition and starts to herd people around town as practice which causes more trouble than good.

episodes.title: Pups and the Big Freeze
episodes.overview: A wintertime storm causes trouble all over Adventure Bay.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Basketball Game
episodes.overview: Marshall is nervous about playing in the PAW Patrol basketball team. Chase lets Marshall sit out, but when Zuma and Rocky get injured, Marshall is forced to take over.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Talent Show
episodes.overview: It's Adventure Bay Talent Show Day! Mayor Goodway is excited but afraid there won't be enough acts! Ryder's super talented pups can definitely help out.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Corn Roast
episodes.overview: Ryder and the Pups help Farmer Al prepare his annual Corn Roast, complete with a Corn Field Maze! Bettina accidentally tips over some hot BBQ coals onto the piles of corn that begin to pop, pop, POP into piles of POPCORN!

episodes.title: Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone
episodes.overview: Ryder and the Pups head out for a day of Parachute training, but Marshall decides to stay back because of his fear of heights.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Deer
episodes.overview: Cap'n Turbot goes out ice fishing and finds a family of Deer stuck on the slippery ice! They must have tried to get across the frozen Bay for food! Ryder and the PAW Patrol to the rescue!

episodes.title: Pups Save a Friend
episodes.overview: Feeling like his clumsy ways are constantly messing up his friends' fun, Marshall decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off into the woods. Once the pups notice Marshall is gone, they jump to action to find him and bring him back to the Lookout.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Stowaway
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol is on another road trip--this time to the icy tundra to help Jake count penguins.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Parrot

episodes.title: Pups Save the Queen Bee

episodes.title: Pups Save the Hot Springs
episodes.overview: When Rubble's cousin Mix comes to town to paint a mural, Humdinger steals the paint and careens through the countryside.

episodes.title: Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem
episodes.overview: Before Chickaletta's playdate with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap - and gets stuck!

episodes.title: Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
episodes.overview: When Mayor Humdinger loses his voice on the day of the Annual Adventure Bay Sing-Off, a competition to find the best singer in town, someone else steps up to replace him.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Orienteers
episodes.overview: Things go wrong for Mr. Porter and Winnie Winnington at the orienteering relay in Yellowbone National Park.

episodes.title: Pups Save Teatime
episodes.overview: Mayor Goodway invites her friend Helga Humdinger, and her rival Mayor Humdinger, to City Hall for afternoon tea.

episodes.title: Pups and the Alien Grandpa

episodes.title: Pups Save a Lemon-Loving Duckling
episodes.overview: A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Hum-Kicker
episodes.overview: Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the 'Hum-Kickers', and starts wrecking the town!

episodes.title: Pups Save the One-Man Band

episodes.title: Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree

episodes.title: Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck
episodes.overview: When the freezer in Mr. Porter's new Ice Cream Truck breaks, it's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the freezer before everything melts!

episodes.title: Pups Save a Woodland Walrus
episodes.overview: After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse! It's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him.

episodes.title: Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit
episodes.overview: After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a bouncy safety suit for him to wear. But when Danny bounces away, the PAW Patrol have to find him.

episodes.title: Pups Put a Mouse on the Move

episodes.title: Pups Save a Solar System
episodes.overview: Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star. But when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Suitcase
episodes.overview: Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom. But when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

episodes.title: Fire Rescue: Pups and the Missing Water Mystery
episodes.overview: When Mr. Park's rooftop garden accidentally catches fire, the Fire Rescue Pups make a terrible discovery: there's no water in Adventure Bay! Marshall and Skye go in search of a solution to the missing water mystery before the flames start to spread.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
episodes.overview: A trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin. Now it's up to Everest and the pups to rescue Jake and find a way to get his home back.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: The PAW Patrol is on a roll with adventures that take the pups from the prehistoric wilds of Dino Island to the rock-climbing heights of Rescue Mountain. Along the way, they’ll team up with new friends–from a speedy racing pooch to the legendary Abominable Snow Pup–proving that for this team, no job is too big, no pup is too small!

episodes.title: Pups Stop the Garboni
episodes.overview: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the PAW Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Porcupine
episodes.overview: The PAW Patrol have to catch a trouble making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

episodes.title: Pups and the Ace of the Skies
episodes.overview: Ace's plane gets stuck in the mountains while giving pilot lessons to Skye and it's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue the stranded pilots.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Babysitter
episodes.overview: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the PAW Patrol when animal hijinks ensue.

episodes.title: Pups Save a Splashy Bottom

episodes.title: Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide
episodes.overview: The Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.

episodes.title: Pups Save the Farm Festival

episodes.title: Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!
episodes.overview: Rocky falls asleep while avoiding a bath at the Pet Parlor and dreams of a sudsy adventure.

series.title: Pull Strings
series.overview: Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

series.title: Pursuit of Jade
series.overview: This drama follows Fan Changyu, a butcher’s daughter, and Xie Zheng, a fallen noble seeking revenge. Their fake marriage turns into true love, but war tears them apart. Determined, Fan Changyu wields her butcher’s knife on the battlefield, searching for justice and her husband. Meanwhile, Xie Zheng reclaims his title, fighting to protect his country and love. Reunited in battle, they stand together, defying fate, uncovering the truth, and returning home without forgetting their vows.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu rescues Xie Zheng in the snow and evades the soldiers searching for him. In the turmoil, their fates become closely entwined.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu reopens the family pork shop and displays an unusual talent for business. To save her home, she asks Xie Zheng to marry into the family.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu and Xie Zheng face a crisis, stirring Zheng's emotions. Meanwhile, Qi Shu wistfully recalls playing chess with a mysterious figure.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng and Fan Changyu grow closer through hardship, and finally consummate their marriage. Qi Shu, under the alias An Xu, enters Luyuan Academy.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Changyu is upset about the hairpin and the betrothal letter. Gongsun Yin discovers Princess Qi Shu's identity but allows her to stay and study.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng starts wondering who the Fan family really are. Fan Changyu appears in court over Fan Da's property case, which takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu escapes from prison to find someone and fights alongside Xie Zheng. Gongsun Yin saves Xie Zheng, and Changyu is set free.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu learns from Gongsun Yin that Xie Zheng will eventually leave, which upsets her. She teams up with Yu Qianqian to sell braised meat.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Wei assassins strike again at night. Li Huai'an finds the Fan shrine to the Marquis of Wu'an. Wei Xuan orders He Jingyuan to send troops to Chongzhou.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.overview: At court, Wei Yan suppresses Grand Tutor Li to consolidate his power. Fan Changyu reopens her braised meat stall, and business booms.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu is attacked by a butcher. Li Huai'an returns for a date with the Grand Princess. Yu Qianqian is pestered by a mysterious merchant.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Fan Changning meets Yu Bao'er at a tavern. Xie Zheng finds Zhao Xun and Qi Min stockpiling grain. Yu Qianqian gets Xie Zheng to pose as her husband.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Qi Min discovers Xie Zheng's true identity. On New Year's Eve, the Fan and Zhao families share a celebratory meal and a drunk Changyu tries to confess.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Qi Min learns Yu Bao'er's true birth date. On the night of the festival, Fan Changyu exposes Song Yan in public. Xie Zheng receives some urgent news.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu learns the truth about her origins from her grandfather. Yixiang Tower is framed. Yu Qiangian is arrested, and the county yamen office is captured.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu sneaks into the yamen and fights Sui Yuanqing to free the magistrate. Xie Zheng saves her in time. They later meet at the ferry.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu and Xie Zheng argue fiercely, parting on bad terms. Yu Qiangian decides to head south to avoid trouble, but is ambushed by bandits.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Bloodshed erupts in Lin'an as Fan Changyu lures the bandits away. Xie Zheng rushes over to help, only to find her badly wounded and unconscious.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng vows to marry Fan Changyu, who's still unconscious. When Changning goes missing, Changyu resolves to search for her sister.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Fan Changyu keeps searching for her sister Changning. With the battle and a rescue operation looming, Xie Zheng and He Jingyuan devise a plan.

episodes.title: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Grand Tutor Tao schemes to get Fan Changyu to safety. Xie Zheng confronts Sui Yuanging, who takes Fan Changning hostage.

episodes.title: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng pulls off a battlefield miracle, but the tide turns. Fan Changyu weeps with joy on learning that Changning is safe. Shi Yue hatches a plan.

episodes.title: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Qi Shu discovers he has been unrealistic. Fan Changyu is reunited with her long-lost sister. Gongsun Yin gives Xie Zheng a warning.

episodes.title: Episode 25
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng and Fan Changyu grow closer. Fan Changyu foils Shi Yue's plan. Xie Zheng pretends to punish Changyu for breaking army rules.

episodes.title: Episode 26
episodes.overview: Before the battle, Qi Shu and Gongsun Yin reveal their feelings for each other. Fan Changyu goes to her husband's place, and kills Shi Hu.

episodes.title: Episode 27
episodes.overview: Changyu goes looking for someone. Xie Zheng sends Xie Qi to protect her in secret. Xie Zheng saves Zhao Xun, who reveals his true identity.

episodes.title: Episode 28
episodes.overview: Changyu goes looking for someone. Xie Zheng sends Xie Qi to protect her in secret. Xie Zheng saves Zhao Xun, who reveals his true identity.

episodes.title: Episode 29
episodes.overview: Yu Qianqian escapes and meets Changyu outside the city. As the fighting intensifies, Fan Changyu turns back and leads the locals into battle.

episodes.title: Episode 30
episodes.overview: He Jingyuan dies in battle. His last letter reveals who Fan Changyu's biological father is. Qi Min asks Sui Yuanqing to avenge his father.

episodes.title: Episode 31
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng and Fan Changyu's relationship is at an impasse. Wei Xuan is removed from office. Li Huai'an apologizes, and reconciles with Changyu.

episodes.title: Episode 32
episodes.overview: Li Huai'an claims Fan Changyu as his sworn sister to quell rumors. Xie Zheng guesses Qi Min faked his death and suspects there is a mole in the army.

episodes.title: Episode 33
episodes.overview: Li Huai'an learns of Sui Yuanqing's escape and confronts Xie Zheng. Tutor Li's plan fails. Qi Shu returns. Fan Changyu gets closer to Xie Zheng.

episodes.title: Episode 34
episodes.overview: Li Huai'an learns of Sui Yuanqing's escape and confronts Xie Zheng. Tutor Li's plan fails. Qi Shu returns. Fan Changyu gets closer to Xie Zheng.

episodes.title: Episode 35
episodes.overview: Qi Min conspires with Grand Tutor Li, who suggests hosting a banquet. Qi Sheng intends to use the banquet to win over, or eliminate, Xie Zheng.

episodes.title: Episode 36
episodes.overview: Xie Zheng's public declaration of love causes a stir. He seeks the truth behind a palace coup from long ago. Yu Qiangian steals the tiger tally.

episodes.title: Episode 37
episodes.overview: Though ill, Tutor Li attends the event and clashes with Wei Yan. A fire breaks out at Qingyuan palace and Gongsun Yin risks his life to save Qi Shu.

episodes.title: Episode 38
episodes.overview: Intrigue swirls at court and in the martial world. Fan Changyu vows to clear her father's name. Xie Zheng exposes Wei Yan's role in Jinzhou's fall.

episodes.title: Episode 39
episodes.overview: Qi Min leads rebels into the palace, where he confronts Wei Yan. Xie Zheng defeats Wei Yan, who reveals the truth about what happened 17 years ago.

episodes.title: Episode 40
episodes.overview: Wei Yan kills himself to quell the rebellion. Qi Min dies. The young emperor ascends to the throne. Xie Zheng becomes regent, Fan Changyu a general.

series.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
series.original_title: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
series.tagline: Racing through the journey of memories——
series.overview: Natsuki Subaru, an ordinary high school  student, is on his way home from the convenience store when he finds  himself transported to another world. As he's lost and confused in a new  world where he doesn't even know left from right, the only person to  reach out to him was a beautiful girl with silver hair. Determined to  repay her somehow for saving him from his own despair, Subaru agrees to  help the girl find something she's looking for.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Natsuki Subaru is summoned to a parallel world on his way home from the convenience store. He's entranced at first by the fantasy world suddenly stretching before his eyes, but the cute girl he believes summoned him is nowhere to be found, and soon enough he's utterly lost. Then a gang of punks surrounds him, but he quickly learns that he doesn't have any of the powers that he thought all people transported to a parellel world should have. Just when he's about to be beaten senseless, a girl appears...

episodes.title: Reunion with the Witch
episodes.overview: After being attacked by someone the first time, sliced open by Elsa the second time, and stabbed in the back by punks the third time, Subaru should have been dead, but found himself back where he started in the same parallel world every time. He finally realizes he’s acquired the power to go back to the time and place he started from, which he calls “Return by Death.” In hopes of changing the fate awaiting Felt, Satella, Old Man Rom, and himself, Subaru takes off for the fourth time.

episodes.title: Starting Life from Zero in Another World
episodes.overview: Subaru attempts to buy the insignia from Felt and return it to Satella before Elsa arrives at the loot house…but Satella arrives before the negotiations are complete, and Elsa still attacks them.

episodes.title: The Happy Roswaal Mansion Family
episodes.overview: After being badly wounded by Elsa, Subaru somehow survived and awoke in the mansion of Margrave Mathers, in the Kingdom of Lugunica.

episodes.title: The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant
episodes.overview: Subaru now lives and works in Roswaal’s mansion, working with Ram and Rem, and finally getting Emilia to agree to a date with him. But the day of their promised date never comes as Subaru keeps going back to the day he first awoke in the mansion. He’s confused at the thought that he Returned by Death despite having no memory of experiencing anything deadly, but he’s determined to repeat his previous actions up to the point of fulfilling his promise with Emilia.

episodes.title: The Sound of Chains
episodes.overview: Subaru’s first day at the Roswaal mansion begins for the third time. The first time, he grew weak and died of unknown reasons in his sleep, and the second time, he was killed by an attacker. The sound of chains that he heard as he died the second time replays in his mind, waking him in a terrified, cold sweat. He has no idea what the killer is after, let alone who it is, so he makes a plan to leave the mansion on the fourth night and watch for the attack to happen.

episodes.title: Natsuki Subaru’s Restart
episodes.overview: Standing before Subaru is someone he never expected. The truth of the attacker’s identity leaves him bewildered, and he feels everything crumbling around him as he dies yet again. Then, for the fourth time, he awakes on his first day at the Roswaal mansion. This time, the night of the fourth day passes without incident, and Subaru is stunned as he greets the morning of the fifth day…but then the situation takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.title: I Cried, Cried My Lungs Out, and Stopped Crying
episodes.overview: Subaru’s first day in Roswaal’s mansion begins for the fifth time. Determined to save everyone this time, he makes it a point to keep his best smile on his face in order to earn the trust of the mansion’s staff. But although he works his hardest to make them like him, his body begins to have trouble keeping up with his heart’s intentions. Soon Emilia is unable to bear the sight of him struggling any longer and takes an unexpected action…

episodes.title: The Meaning of Courage
episodes.overview: The scattered pieces of the puzzle finally come together, and Subaru realizes for certain that the shaman who cursed him is in the village at the foot of the mountains. He heads there with Ram and Rem and makes sure all the villagers touch him so that he can find out, with Beatrice’s help, who cast the curse. But the truth he finds is not what he expected, and he finds himself rushing toward the village again…

episodes.title: Demonically Inspired Methods
episodes.overview: Subaru risked his life to save the children from a pack of Ulgarm, but he was so powerfully cursed that there could be no saving him. Even Beatrice is unable to undo the complex web of curses on him, and says he’ll grow weak and die within half a day. The only way he can survive is if the entire Ulgarm pack is defeated, but time is not on his side. Subaru is ready to give up when he learns that Rem has gone into the forest by herself…

episodes.title: Rem
episodes.overview: Knocked unconscious by Subaru’s attack, Rem dreams of an event in her past that she and Ram would rather forget…a sin for which Rem feels she can never be forgiven. After waking up, she tells Subaru that she’s just committed the same sin again. When the three of them are moments from being cornered by the Ulgarm pack, Subaru takes off to draw their attention so Ram and Rem can escape.

episodes.title: Return to the Capital
episodes.overview: At the order of the council of elders that manages Lugunica in the king’s absence, Wilhelm and Felix visit Roswaal’s mansion as emissaries. Emilia is required in the imperial capital right away, so Subaru asks her to take him along. Emilia tells him this won’t be a pleasure trip, but a push from Rem and Roswaal ends in her agreement, so Emilia and Subaru head to the capital. Now all of the candidates to be Lugunica’s next king are gathered, and the royal selection is underway.

episodes.title: Self-Proclaimed Knight Natsuki Subaru
episodes.overview: As Emilia joins Priscilla, Crusch, and Anastasia in a meeting of the royal selection participants, Reinhard enters the hall with Felt. According to a new prophecy seen on the Dragon Stone, there are five priestesses with the potential to be the kingdom’s next ruler. Reinhard announces that Felt is the fifth priestess, meaning it’s time to formally begin the royal selection, but Felt refuses to have any part in it.

episodes.title: The Sickness Called Despair
episodes.overview: “I just wanted to protect her. That feeling wasn’t a lie. Where did I go wrong?” Rejected by the one who meant more to him than anything, Subaru is still unable to recognize that he may have done something irreversible. He then finds out that some disturbing movement has been detected within Roswaal’s domain, where Emilia and the others are. He’s certain that he can save them somehow, so in spite of Rem and Crusch’s opposition, Subaru makes his way back to Emilia…

episodes.title: The Outside of Madness
episodes.overview: Upon returning to Roswaal’s mansion, Subaru is greeted by an unbelievable sight and wails that this was not what he wanted to happen. Stricken with despair, everything before Subaru starts to go white as, finally, he hears a voice: “You were too late.”

episodes.title: A Pig's Greed
episodes.overview: Subaru wakes up in front of the appa shop once again. Feeling boxed in on all sides due to his own lack of power to change the situation, he seeks the help of others. First, he seeks the help of Crush, who flatly declines any further involvement passed her contractual obligation of healing Subaru. His requests to Anastasia and Priscilla similarly go unanswered despite his pleas. Having wasted too much time, Subaru decides to at least try to get Emilia away from Roswaal’s mansion as early as possible. He then takes a dragon car back home with Rem.

episodes.title: Disgrace in the Extreme
episodes.overview: A mysterious figure appears before Subaru and his traveling companions. As the looming beast attacks with a deafening bellow amidst the darkness and fog, Rem determines that it will be too difficult to escape…

episodes.title: From Zero
episodes.overview: Subaru laments that he could not do anything or save anyone, and has no options left. Exhausted, he suddenly takes off running at full speed as if he’s made a decision…

episodes.title: Battle Against the White Whale
episodes.overview: To save Emilia, Subaru approaches Crusch to negotiate the formation of an alliance. His terms are a bit difficult for Crusch to believe, but she can see that Subaru isn’t lying.

episodes.title: Wilhelm van Astrea
episodes.overview: Subaru has devoted everything he had, and done all he could do. His passion has captured Crusch’s heart, as well as Anastasia’s cooperation, and they all enter into the battle against the White Whale together.

episodes.title: A Wager That Defies Despair
episodes.overview: Subaru and Rem are at a loss for words. The battle against the White Whale, which seemed to be going in their favor through attrition, suddenly took on completely different proportions. With their tactical superiority and advantage quickly dwindling, the combined forces all but get tangled up in the threads of despair. That’s when Subaru decides to yell out his next move…

episodes.title: A Flash of Sloth
episodes.overview: With the battle against the White Whale now over, the mercenary force setting up the blockade of the road comes back, Julius at the lead. His arrival gives rise to mixed feelings for Subaru, but after Julius sincerely thanks him for ridding the world of the monster, Subaru finds it in himself to apologize for his past behavior. The group now looks forward, ready to enter the Mathers domain…

episodes.title: Nefarious Sloth
episodes.overview: The group is making its way in the Mathers domain when suddenly everyone but Subaru disappears and a strange, suffocating atmosphere seeps through the forest. He quickly figures out it is nothing but an illusion, and with help from Julius on the other side, dispels the barrier for everyone caught in it. However, arriving at the village doesn’t make convincing the residents to evacuate easy. Time is running out, and the invisible hand of sloth makes its presence at the back of Subaru’s mind more and more nefarious.

episodes.title: The Self-Proclaimed Knight and the Greatest of Knights
episodes.overview: Subaru devises a new plan to correct the mistake of the blank letter sent to the manor, encourage the evacuation of the villagers and move Emilia away from her current location. With these preparations complete, he enacts the second part of his plan designed to cut off the Fingers before severing the Unseen Hand once and for all.

episodes.title: That’s All This Story Is About
episodes.overview: Emilia is hurriedly ushered to the capital along with the villagers under the orders of a mysterious benefactor while escorted by a rag-tag group of individuals from various and opposing factions. She has but one question on her mind: who could this man be and why would he go so far? Meanwhile, Subaru and Julius face off against the Archbishop of Sin Betelgeuse for the ultimate time. Unfortunately, he is very persistent even beyond death, belying his nature of Sloth. Subaru is relentlessly chased while he catches up to Emilia to save her one last time and answer her question.

episodes.title: Each One's Promise
episodes.overview: Amid dying countless times, Subaru finally led the troops to victory against the White Whale and struck down the schemes of the Sin Archbishop of Sloth. After overcoming a painful ending to his these ordeals, he was reunited at last with his beloved Emilia…only to learn that Rem’s existence had been erased from the world, wiped out by the White Whale somewhere in the middle of his death loop. And now that the White Whale is defeated, Subaru and the others face a crisis no one could have expected.

episodes.title: The Next Location
episodes.overview: After concluding their talks with Crusch, Subaru and Emilia return to the village of Arlam, intending to report to Roswaal and discuss what to do next. But they find Arlam deserted and learn that the villagers who had taken refuge in the Sanctuary with Ram have not yet returned. When Subaru and Emilia arrive back at Roswaal’s mansion to find out where the Sanctuary is, they are greeted by Frederica, a young woman who used to work as one of Roswaal’s maids.

episodes.title: The Long-Awaited Reunion
episodes.overview: On the way to the Sanctuary, Subaru unwittingly finds himself invited to a witch’s tea party, where the hostess introduces herself as Echidna, the Witch of Greed. Subaru is alarmed, but Echidna encourages him to sit and drink his tea before it gets cold. When he somehow makes it back outside after a conversation with Echidna, he finds Otto lying on the ground, battered and beaten. Then, before he even has a moment to assess the situation, Subaru himself is attacked.

episodes.title: Parent and Child
episodes.overview: It’s supposed to be his own room, a place he’s supposed to be used to seeing, but Subaru can’t shake the feeling that something is off. He’s overcome by an indescribable sense of uneasiness, but being caught in his father Kenichi’s armlock shakes it away. Subaru is stunned, but retaliates with a wrestling move of his own. As the two of them carry on, Subaru’s mother, Nahoko, informs them that she’s hungry and they should all eat breakfast together. Subaru meets his parents again during the trial offered by the greed witch.

episodes.title: A Step Forward
episodes.overview: Having reached a place he can’t return from, Subaru realizes just how much he has been given and how little he can do to repay any of it. After remembering what he must do, he says goodbye to Kenichi and Nahoko and heads to the school. Steeling his resolve, Subaru opens the door to the classroom, where he’s greeted by Echidna in a school uniform. When Echidna says he arrived much sooner than she expected, Subaru responds that she looks good in the uniform.

episodes.title: The Maiden's Gospel
episodes.overview: After dying to Elsa’s blade in Roswaal’s mansion, Subaru awakens back in the graveyard, in the moment immediately after he passed the trial that required him to face his past. Just like the first time he returned there, he wakes Emilia and holds her to comfort her, then returns to Ryuzu and the others. He tells them that he passed the trial himself and suggests that he could complete the remaining stages of the trial in Emilia’s place, but Garfiel is opposed.

episodes.title: Friend
episodes.overview: Subaru had reached for the door, determined to save Rem from harm even if his current world would soon end. But instead of Rem, he found himself staring at Beatrice’s library. Beatrice had remained silent throughout Elsa’s attack and saved Subaru’s life just moments before Elsa could claim it. Subaru shouts at Beatrice, demanding to know why she didn’t help before everyone else was killed, and an intense argument ensues. Then Subaru catches sight of a familiar-looking book…

episodes.title: The Value of Life
episodes.overview: Subaru was caught and confined by Garfiel, but Otto shows up to rescue him. Garfiel can’t leave the graveyard while Emilia is undergoing the trial, so Otto says this is their chance to get outside the barrier, but Subaru doesn’t agree. However, after he learns that Ram will be helping them—that she has been ordered by Roswaal to help him, in fact—Subaru puts his escape on hold to have a talk with Roswaal.

episodes.title: Love Love Love Love Love Love You
episodes.overview: After being eaten alive by a herd of unknown creatures resembling rabbits, Subaru awakens in a half-maddened state next to Emilia in the graveyard. As he pounds his head against the rocky ground over and over in anguish, he finds himself invited once again to a witch’s tea party. There, he tells Echidna about his Return by Death ability, something he has never been able to tell anyone before. Echidna then begins to tell Subaru about the witch who gave him this power and set him on this agonizing path.

episodes.title: I Know Hell
episodes.overview: Subaru exits the graveyard to find the surroundings engulfed in deep black shadows. With the sudden appearance of the Witch of Envy, everything is swallowed up by darkness. After Garfiel rushes in to save him, Subaru tries to find a way to get them out of danger, but the Witch of Envy is relentless in her pursuit. Subaru finally offers himself as bait to stall her so Garfiel can intercept and attack, but he’s helpless against the Witch of Envy, and everything continues to be engulfed by her shadows.

episodes.title: The Taste of Death
episodes.overview: Subaru heads to Roswaal’s mansion in hopes of finding out what’s going on there and how he can fix it. He has Frederica and Petra evacuate to Arlam Village to protect them from Elsa’s attack, then heads to Beatrice’s forbidden library. He tries to get Beatrice out of the library, but her wishes don’t align with his plans, and their discussion goes nowhere. Then, against all logic, Elsa finds her way into the forbidden library…

episodes.title: The Witches’ Tea Party
episodes.overview: Subaru awakens in the graveyard with Emilia lying nearby. This time, he makes up his mind to save not only Emilia, but everyone in the Sanctuary and Roswaal’s mansion from the threats that hang over them. Roswaal makes it clear that he will use Subaru’s power to keep starting over by force if he has to, if it will allow him to achieve his own goal. What is driving Roswaal to go to such lengths? In search of the answer to this and many other questions, Subaru goes to see Echidna once again.

episodes.title: The Sounds That Make You Want to Cry
episodes.overview: Subaru is shown several visions of events previously unknown to him during the second phase of the trial. When he feels as if he’s worn away to nearly nothing, the one to stir him is the one who loves him more than anyone else…and is tougher on him than anyone else. When he awakens to see Echidna extending a hand to help him, he tells her he’ll never accept it. Then the Witch of Envy appears, clad in a veil of darkness, and extends her hand to him as well. Subaru refuses again, screaming that he’ll solve everything on his own without any of their help.

episodes.title: Straight Bet
episodes.overview: Tragedy strikes the Sanctuary, and Elsa takes aim at both Roswaal’s mansion and the village of Arlam. After being told that all these threats are cruel traps, Subaru can’t help but give in to despair. While he’s stuck questioning himself and unable to come up with a way out of the dilemma closing in on him, Otto shows up and punches him. Thanks to the many feelings packed in Otto’s fist, Subaru finds his hope again.

episodes.title: Otto Suwen / A Reason to Believe
episodes.overview: Having been born with the “soul of language” divine protection that allows him to converse with non-human creatures, Otto Suwen’s life has truly had its ups and downs. After being run out of his hometown because of his ability, he found his independence as a merchant, was attacked by the Witch’s Cult, met Subaru…and now, his life is literally on the line in a deadly game of tag. To fulfill his part of the plan, Otto must evade Garfiel’s vicious attacks in a desperate effort to buy time.

episodes.title: Nobody Can Lift a Quain Stone Alone
episodes.overview: The missing Emilia was in the graveyard all along, her lost memories beginning to return due to Puck’s disappearance. Confused and losing heart over the realization that she’s forgotten such important memories, she tries her hardest to convey her feelings to Subaru. When the two of them leave the graveyard, they’re awaited by Garfiel, who’s been battered and beaten by Otto and Ram. He tries to prevent the Sanctuary’s liberation by closing off the graveyard himself, but Subaru won’t let him have his way without a fight.

episodes.title: A Journey Through Memories
episodes.overview: As she attempts the first trial, Emilia finds herself in Elior Forest, where she lived when she was younger. Echidna snidely remarks on her audacity to set foot here after so thoroughly disgracing herself before, but Emilia responds with a bold smile and tells her she won’t cave to the malice of a fellow witch. As they proceed deeper into the forest, they come upon a massive tree towering over its surroundings. At its base is a small, barred door, which Emilia identifies as the Princess Room where she was often sent to play as a child.

episodes.title: The Day Betelgeuse Laughed
episodes.overview: Despite a few inconveniences, like being unable to go outside when she wanted, young Emilia lived a happy life in a settlement of elves with Fortuna, whom she lovingly called “Mother.” However, their peace was threatened by the arrival of the Sin Archbishop of the Witch’s Cult representing Greed, Regulus Corneas. In the present, Shima appears before Subaru and the others as they wait outside the graveyard for Emilia to complete the trial, and she tells them of the events leading up to the birth of the Sanctuary.

episodes.title: The Permafrost of Elior Forest
episodes.overview: Pandora, the Witch of Vanity, stands before Geuse and Fortuna. They both face her with all the strength they have. Meanwhile, young Emilia runs toward the place where the seal is, believing that everyone will be saved if she gives Pandora what she wants. But when she arrives, Pandora is already there, insisting that she hand over the key to opening the seal.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the Sanctuary and the Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: When Roswaal happily tells the story of how his romance with Echidna began 400 years ago, Beatrice rebukes him for casually calling it a “romance.” Ryuzu interrupts to comment that Echidna saved her, as well. The one thing these three very different people share is their gratitude toward Echidna. But their days spent in both amicable and argumentative conversation about Echidna are brought to an end by one man’s arrival.

episodes.title: Reunion of Roars
episodes.overview: Subaru tries to prevent the attack on the mansion by talking to Roswaal, but Roswaal refuses to let go of the wish he has clung to for 400 long years. Subaru takes Garfiel and Otto along as he hitches up the carriage to Patrasche and heads for the mansion as quickly as he can. Meanwhile, now that Emilia has completed the first trial, Ram asks her for a favor. Touched by the strength of Ram’s feelings, Emilia reaches out to help her.

episodes.title: Happiness Reflected on the Water's Surface
episodes.overview: Frederica is gradually backed into a corner by Elsa’s attacks. Then Garfiel rushes to the scene with a silver shield on each arm. The siblings’ reunion after so many years is cut short when Elsa’s knife violently clashes against Garfiel’s shield. Meanwhile, Subaru heads to the forbidden library where Beatrice is. She’s surprised when he enters the library and tells her that, after she spent 400 years there under a contract that might as well have been a curse, he’s going to get her out.

episodes.title: Love Me Down to My Blood and Guts
episodes.overview: After witnessing an unrealized present, Emilia completes the second trial and begins the third and final one. Ram and Puck are fighting their hardest to stop Roswaal. Each of them is doing it all for the sake of realizing their own goals. The battle between Garfiel and Elsa at Roswaal’s mansion is also growing more and more intense. As Subaru is being chased by a guiltylowe, he declares that it’s time to make use of his unparalleled knowledge of the modern world and lures it into a closet…

episodes.title: Choose Me
episodes.overview: After completing the final trial, Emilia emerges from the graveyard into a blizzard heavy enough to block her vision. The people of the Sanctuary and the villagers of Arlam huddle together behind a giant wall of ice, created to shield them from the bitter cold by none other than the great spirit who was once contracted to Emilia. When Emilia touches the ice wall, something flows into her from within it. With a nod of acknowledgement to the voice she hears, she finally takes action.

episodes.title: Offbeat Steps Under the Moonlight
episodes.overview: The magic Roswaal is using to control the weather generates enough mana to attract the Great Rabbit, which draws closer to the Sanctuary in a massive horde. Emilia takes Roswaal and Ram to shelter in the graveyard with everyone else, but the Great Rabbit horde has already grown enough to engulf their surroundings. Just when all hope seems lost, Subaru and Beatrice appear before Emilia. So begins Subaru and Beatrice's first battle against the Great Rabbit, one of the Three Great Mabeasts.

episodes.title: Theatrical Malice
episodes.overview: A year has passed since the battle at the Sanctuary, and Subaru has been spending fulfilling days united with Emilia's camp. However, his peaceful everyday life ends with the arrival of a single letter.

episodes.title: A Showdown of Fire and Ice
episodes.overview: Subaru desperately tries to fend off the attack from Sin Archbishop Sirius. But then, other Archbishops appear...

episodes.title: Gorgeous Tiger
episodes.overview: After the incident in the main square, Priestella has fallen into chaos and Emilia has been kidnapped. Now it's up to Subaru and the others to rescue Emilia and the city.

episodes.title: Operation: Take Back the Government Office
episodes.overview: Subaru and his comrades find themselves in a dire situation after the city was taken over by the Sin Archbishops. Now, they are devising a plan to first reclaim the city hall...

episodes.title: A Dark Torrent
episodes.overview: The attack on the city hall enters its second phase. Subaru and Crusch breach the interior, but there they are awaited by Capella, who has some sneaky tricks up her sleeve...

episodes.title: Conditions of the Knight
episodes.overview: Bishop Regulus of the Seven Deadly Sins wants to force Emilia to marry him, even though he already has hundreds of wives. While he is having the wedding hall prepared, Subaru and the others are planning to rescue Emilia and reclaim the city...

episodes.title: The Newest of Heroes and the Most Ancient of Heroes
episodes.overview: Through a Witch's Cultist's conference mirror, Emilia tells Al where the Sin Archbishops are and asks him to protect Beatrice. Al relays Emilia's message to Subaru, and the gang begins to devise a strategy to win back the control towers.

episodes.title: The One I'll Love Someday
episodes.overview: Subaru and the others hold a meeting in the city hall to develop a strategy against the four Sin Archbishops. However, Emilia is slowly running out of time...

episodes.title: City Scramble
episodes.overview: While the others deal with the other Archbishops, Subaru puts his plan to stop Regulus into action.

episodes.title: The Plan to Conquer Greed
episodes.overview: Subaru thinks long and hard about how Regulus's Authority should work...

episodes.title: Liliana Masquerade
episodes.overview: Liliana gives the performance of her lifetime to help Priscilla defeat the Sin Archbishop of Wrath.

episodes.title: Regulus Corneas
episodes.overview: Emilia seeks the aid of Regulus's wives in dethroning the little king once and for all.

episodes.title: The Warrior's Commendation
episodes.overview: Capella uses Al's admiration for Priscilla against him, and Garfiel fights the legendary "Eight-Arms" Kurgan.

episodes.title: Theresia van Astrea
episodes.overview: Wilhelm finds himself face to face with his beloved wife who died years ago.

episodes.title: A Hideous Dinner Party
episodes.overview: While battling Lye Batenkaitos, Otto discovers the secret to the Sin Archbishop's power.

episodes.title: The Result of the Battle for Priestella
episodes.overview: Otto and Beatrice battle Gluttony, the last of the Sin Archbishops terrorizing Priestella.

episodes.title: The Reason I'm Taking You with Me / Gorgeous Tiger Reloaded
episodes.overview: Subaru sets out for the Pleiades Watchtower in hopes of saving his friends and the people of Priestella.

episodes.title: Overcome Sand Time
episodes.overview: Subaru and company struggle to cross the Auguria Dunes on the way to the Pleiades Watchtower.

episodes.title: The Keeper of the Watchtower
episodes.overview: The party is separated just before reaching the Pleiades Watchtower. Subaru awakens to find he's underground.

episodes.title: A White Sky Asterism
episodes.overview: Subaru and company meet Shaula, keeper of the Pleiades Watchtower, who leads them to the first of its trials.

episodes.title: Stick Swinger
episodes.overview: The Great Pleiades Library doesn't seem to have the answers Subaru seeks, so he decides they must go further.

episodes.title: Julius Juukulius
episodes.overview: Subaru and crew attempt to get past the second floor of the tower, but its examiner poses a tough challenge.

episodes.title: Walking Out of the Convenience Store and into a Wondrous World
episodes.overview: Julius overhears Anastasia and Subaru talking about Anastasia's current condition.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: Subaru wakes up in the green room, remembering absolutely nothing about the world he is in.

episodes.title: Empty Shell
episodes.overview: Maddened by fear and distrust, Subaru attempts to escape the watchtower... only to end up lost underground.

episodes.title: Murder Is a Habit
episodes.overview: Shortly after Subaru discovers Meili's corpse, Beatrice finds a book with Meili's name on it in the archive.

episodes.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
episodes.overview: Subaru tries desperately to convince the others that he's lost his memories, but they aren't convinced.

episodes.title: From Now On
episodes.overview: After waking up without his memories yet again, Subaru makes up his mind to save Meili this time.

episodes.title: Stand Up
episodes.overview: Subaru decides to read Reid's book of the dead in hopes of finding a way to defeat him.

episodes.title: Five Obstacles
episodes.overview: Subaru returns from the corridor of memories to find the tower under attack by mabeasts.

series.title: Remnants of Gold
series.overview: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.

series.title: Silo
series.tagline: The key to the future lies in the past.
series.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a bleak dystopian future, humanity clings to survival deep underground within the confines of a colossal silo. Juliette, an engineer tasked with unraveling the mystery behind the death of a colleague, uncovers startling secrets that threaten the very fabric of their enclosed world.

episodes.title: Freedom Day
episodes.overview: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

episodes.title: Holston's Pick
episodes.overview: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

episodes.title: Machines
episodes.overview: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.overview: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

episodes.title: The Janitor's Boy
episodes.overview: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

episodes.title: The Relic
episodes.overview: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

episodes.title: The Flamekeepers
episodes.overview: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

episodes.title: Hanna
episodes.overview: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

episodes.title: The Getaway
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

episodes.title: Outside
episodes.overview: Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Stranded outside her silo with a failing suit, Juliette Nichols races against time, stunned to find another silo nearby that could be her only hope for survival. Meanwhile, unrest brews inside her original silo as Bernard Holland rallies citizens to maintain order amid rising questions about their world. As Juliette faces unexpected dangers near the new silo, hidden truths about the silos’ origins and the world beyond begin to surface, deepening the mystery.

episodes.title: The Engineer
episodes.overview: Juliette finds sanctuary in a silo long ago destroyed by war, thinking she's alone.

episodes.title: Order
episodes.overview: In Silo 18, shock and unrest take hold in the wake of Juliette doing what no one's done before.

episodes.title: Solo
episodes.overview: Bernard turns to Judge Meadows for help. Billings begins to wonder if he's being lied to. Juliette finally meets the man in the vault.

episodes.title: The Harmonium
episodes.overview: Juliette sets out on a dangerous quest to retrieve a suit so she can return home and save her silo. Mechanical plans a meeting with Judge Meadows.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.overview: Sims finds himself with a new position. Juliette learns Solo isn't being honest. Bernard and Lukas make an important discovery.

episodes.title: Barricades
episodes.overview: Bernard enacts a plan to root out Knox, Shirley, and Walker. Billings takes a stand. Solo saves Juliette's life and wants something in return.

episodes.title: The Dive
episodes.overview: Lukas is assigned a mission. Mechanical sends a powerful message. Juliette embarks on a perilous descent—and confronts a new danger.

episodes.title: The Book of Quinn
episodes.overview: Juliette discovers something's happened to Solo. Bernard makes an offer to Walker. Lukas meets with Salvador Quinn's descendants.

episodes.title: The Safeguard
episodes.overview: Billings' faith is shaken. Lukas heads to the down deep. Knox identifies the traitor. Juliette uncovers the truth about Solo's past.

episodes.title: Into the Fire
episodes.overview: The rebels make their move—and so does Juliette.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: New mayor Juliette can't remember anything from her time outside—or her past.

episodes.title: It's All Good
episodes.overview: Billings investigates a disappearance. Daniel Keene has a run-in with a reporter.

episodes.title: A Dark Web
episodes.overview: Juliette takes control of her recovery process. Helen suffers consequences of her investigation.

episodes.title: Whatever You Do, Don't Go Home
episodes.overview: The race to evade Camille leads Juliette to a shocking discovery. Daniel seeks help from a friend.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.overview: The events following Juliette's return come to light—and unexpected allies are made.

episodes.title: The Drive
episodes.overview: Billings and Hank stumble on a new mystery. Daniel and Helen receive a surprising proposition.

episodes.title: Radio
episodes.overview: Juliette sends Lukas and Kennedy on a mission, as a desperate Camille threatens Robert to tell the truth.

episodes.title: Gray Goo
episodes.overview: Knox's father Gus comes clean about a secret. Charlotte makes a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Farewell
episodes.overview: The entire silo is stunned by an announcement from Camille. Daniel and Helen attend a special event.

episodes.title: Troy
episodes.overview: A leader wakes to a new world.

series.title: Slow Horses
series.tagline: They finally made the hit list.
series.overview: Follow a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb—as they navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a young man is kidnapped and threatened with beheading, the slow horses find themselves unexpectedly embroiled in a dangerous case that forces them to prove their worth.

episodes.title: Failure's Contagious
episodes.overview: River Cartwright is ousted from MI5 and finds himself in a place worse than purgatory: Slough House, dumping ground for failed spies.

episodes.title: Work Drinks
episodes.overview: River and Sid join forces. A misfired gun has dire consequences.

episodes.title: Bad Tradecraft
episodes.overview: Slough House is the unlikely venue for a secret romance, but events take a dark turn when a dangerous encounter becomes deadly.

episodes.title: Visiting Hours
episodes.overview: Taverner sends the Dogs to hunt down Lamb and the Slow Horses. River holds the secret to saving the gang.

episodes.title: Fiasco
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses must disappear to avoid capture by MI5. Lamb and River head to The Park to outwit Taverner.

episodes.title: Follies
episodes.overview: Taverner and the Slow Horses attempt different approaches to locate the kidnappers and Hassan. Ho makes a shocking discovery about Sid.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Long-buried Cold War secrets emerge which threaten to bring carnage to the streets of London. When a liaison with Russian villains takes a fatal turn, our hapless heroes must overcome their individual failings and raise their spy game in a race to prevent a catastrophic incident.

episodes.title: Last Stop
episodes.overview: Jackson Lamb is on high alert after a former spy is found dead. Min and Louisa are tempted by an offer from outside Slough House.

episodes.title: From Upshott with Love
episodes.overview: Lamb liaises with a Russian defector who may hold a clue to sleeper agents. River is on the trail of a ruthless assassin.

episodes.title: Drinking Games
episodes.overview: River gets cozy in the Cotswolds while searching for a sleeper agent. Min discovers Russian drinking games are the most brutal of all.

episodes.title: Cicada
episodes.overview: Louisa makes her move on Pashkin. Catherine makes moves of a different kind when she plays high-stakes chess with a sinister stranger.

episodes.title: Boardroom Politics
episodes.overview: Lamb orders his Slow Horses to walk into traps. River believes something alarming is heading toward London.

episodes.title: Old Scores
episodes.overview: Lamb and Katinsky go head-to-head. Ho finds himself trapped on a train with a Russian assassin.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A romantic liaison in Istanbul threatens to expose a buried MI5 secret in London. When Jackson Lamb and his team of misfits are dragged into the fight, they find themselves caught in a conspiracy that threatens the future not just of Slough House but of MI5 itself.

episodes.title: Strange Games
episodes.overview: A romantic relationship in Istanbul ends badly. Lamb hits the panic button when one of his Slow Horses fails to show up for work.

episodes.title: Hard Lessons
episodes.overview: River has to steal something out of the Park to save a life. Lamb realizes a stranger game is afoot.

episodes.title: Negotiating with Tigers
episodes.overview: Marcus and Shirley face Lamb's wrath. River discovers revenge is a dish best served cold.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests
episodes.overview: Tearney makes a bold move. The Slow Horses assist the Tiger Team, unaware of their hidden agenda. Lamb and Ho take a road trip.

episodes.title: Cleaning Up
episodes.overview: Taverner and Tearney face off for control of MI5. River and Louisa find themselves caught in the crossfire.

episodes.title: Footprints
episodes.overview: The Slow Horses fight for their lives. Lamb shares some devastating truths with Catherine.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: In season 4, a bombing detonates personal secrets, rocking Slough House's already unstable foundations.

episodes.title: Identity Theft
episodes.overview: A London bombing puts Taverner under pressure. When River grows concerned for his grandfather, Louisa encourages him to go for a visit.

episodes.title: A Stranger Comes to Town
episodes.overview: A naive agent makes a discovery about the Westacres bomber. Lamb suspects that David knows more than he's letting on.

episodes.title: Penny for Your Thoughts
episodes.overview: River is trapped in France. Back at Slough House, the Dogs have come for Lamb.

episodes.title: Returns
episodes.overview: Taverner is desperate to hide dangerous secrets. River seeks answers at his grandfather's house.

episodes.title: Grave Danger
episodes.overview: Lamb questions David about France as River comes face to face with the enemy.

episodes.title: Hello Goodbye
episodes.overview: Impossible decisions are faced and sacrifices are made.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In season five, everyone is suspicious when resident tech nerd Roddy Ho has a glamorous new girlfriend. When a series of increasingly bizarre events occur across the city, it falls to the Slow Horses to work out how everything is connected. After all, Lamb knows that in the world of espionage, the London Rules — cover your back — always apply.

episodes.title: Bad Dates
episodes.overview: A mass shooting rocks London, intensifying a testy mayoral race. Shirley believes one of the Slow Horses was the target of an attempted hit.

episodes.title: Incommunicado
episodes.overview: Lamb intercepts an assassin. Taverner receives a key piece of intel about the Abbotsfield shooting.

episodes.title: Tall Tales
episodes.overview: An act of sabotage grinds London to a halt. Taverner interrogates Roddy. Coe is convinced a destabilization strategy is at play.

episodes.title: Missiles
episodes.overview: Flyte sets out to find Roddy's girlfriend. The gang is dispatched to two different campaign events to prevent another attack.

episodes.title: Circus
episodes.overview: Lamb debriefs River and Coe. Roddy is pulled in to help decipher a piece of code as the destabilization strategy nears its final stage.

episodes.title: Scars
episodes.overview: It's up to the Slow Horses to stop Farouk's team from completing its mission in a final act of mass carnage.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

episodes.title: Circle of Life
episodes.overview: River braces for his grandfather’s funeral. Lamb looks into the death of an ex–Slow Horse.

episodes.title: Daddy Issues
episodes.overview: The reemergence of Frank Harkness and a suspicious string of murders put Lamb and team on high alert.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Ex–Slow Horses return to the fold as assassins close in. Taverner faces the fallout of her TV interview.

episodes.title: Lost & Found
episodes.overview: Lamb tries figuring out who Frank is working for. Sid, River, and Coe do everything to evade the hit squad.

episodes.title: Sayonara
episodes.overview: River goes after Sid. Lamb sets his sights on Cantor. Taverner carries on with a treacherous deal.

episodes.title: Judgement Day
episodes.overview: Season finale. The safe house becomes unsafe as Lamb and Taverner finally join forces.

series.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
series.original_title: スーパーの裏でヤニ吸うふたり
series.overview: Sasaki is an overworked salaryman drifting through the corporate grind, sustained by cigarettes and the cheerful service and smile of Yamada, the clerk at his favorite supermarket. But one night after a grueling shift, he arrives late to find Yamada nowhere to be seen. With nowhere left to smoke, his spirits sink—until a pierced young woman calls out to him: “You can smoke here.”

episodes.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Sasaki has a cigarette and nowhere to smoke it—until a pierced stranger calls out to him in the night.

episodes.title: Cheering Up Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Between cigarettes, Tayama and Sasaki share the problems they've had at work.

episodes.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You and More
episodes.overview: Between cigarettes, Tayama gives Sasaki a gift, and Sasaki decides to return the favor.

episodes.title: Learning Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Between cigarettes, Sasaki learns to use a smartphone and gets to know Tayama better.

episodes.title: Hanging Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Poor Sasaki endures 15 grueling days at work and barely gets to see Tayama.

episodes.title: Lingering Scent Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Between cigarette and cigarette, Sasaki has a health check and is concerned about the results.

episodes.title: The End of Summer Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Gotou tells Yamada to take an exam as summer bows out along with its associated shenanigans.

episodes.title: Searching Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.overview: Tayama has lost something dear to her, and it has to be found in secret!

series.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
series.overview: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: These are the moments that turned SpongeBob from a cartoon into a worldwide phenomenon! Meet Bikini Bottom's denizens of the deep, learn the technique to blow the perfect bubble, sing "The F.U.N. Song," ride the hooks, turn a gum wrapper into a gold mine of entertainment, and so much more!

episodes.title: Help Wanted
episodes.overview: SpongeBob goes to the Krusty Krab to apply for the new fry cook job. Against the advice of Squidward, Mr. Krabs, the owner of the restaurant decides to give SpongeBob a chance. Can SpongeBob find the spatula needed for the job and serve all the hungry customers?

episodes.title: Reef Blower
episodes.overview: Squidward and SpongeBob are cleaning up their yards with their reef blowers. When one person ends up cleaning their yard, the others gets ruined. Who will get the clean yard in the end?

episodes.title: Tea at the Treedome
episodes.overview: SpongeBob meets a land squirrel named Sandy. He is invited to come over to her house, but he finds out that it is full of air. SpongeBob holds out for as long as he can, which isn't a very long time.

episodes.title: Bubblestand
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick are blowing bubbles. Squidward thinks it is a simple task, but he can't blow one single bubble. SpongeBob and Patrick need to teach him the proper bubble blowing technique.

episodes.title: Ripped Pants
episodes.overview: While at Goo Lagoon, SpongeBob accidentally rips his pants while trying to impress Sandy, causing everyone to laugh.

episodes.title: Jellyfishing
episodes.overview: To make Squidward feel better after a biking accident, SpongeBob and Patrick take him to go Jellyfishing.

episodes.title: Plankton!
episodes.overview: Plankton is always trying to steal the secret Krabby Patty formula, but his tiny size gets in his way. In Plankton's latest scheme, he controls SpongeBob's brain to try and steal the Krabby Patty recipe.

episodes.title: Naughty Nautical Neighbors
episodes.overview: Squidward is having a peaceful day, until he hears giggling from next door. He gets SpongeBob and Patrick to believe that they hate each other, but now they want to be his best friend.

episodes.title: Boating School
episodes.overview: SpongeBob is going to take a driving test, a synonym for disaster. This time is a little different, as SpongeBob gets some help from Patrick.

episodes.title: Pizza Delivery
episodes.overview: A customer calls and asks the Krusty Krab to deliver him some pizza. Mr. Krabs orders SpongeBob and Squidward to deliver it. SpongeBob will stop at nothing to get the pizza to the customer, even if that means getting lost.

episodes.title: Home Sweet Pineapple
episodes.overview: One night, some nematodes feast on SpongeBob's pineapple house. All that is left is a tiny pebble. Now, SpongeBob must live with his parents! How will he get a new house?

episodes.title: Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick find that their television heroes, Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy, are retired old people. SpongeBob and Patrick try to get them back into Superhero business again.

episodes.title: Pickles
episodes.overview: SpongeBob gives an incomplete Krabby Patty to Bubble Bass for the first time. SpongeBob goes crazy, and forgets how to do everything, including his job.

episodes.title: Hall Monitor
episodes.overview: SpongeBob is finally given the chance to be a hall monitor at his boating school, but he wastes the school day giving a speech and doesn't get to do anything. That doesn't mean he can't be a Hall Monitor outside of school, right?

episodes.title: Jellyfish Jam
episodes.overview: A wild jellyfish follows SpongeBob home, so he decides to keep it. The jellyfish loves to party and dance. Unluckily, SpongeBob's house turns into a party overnight with more jellyfish coming by the second.

episodes.title: Sandy's Rocket
episodes.overview: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally launch Sandy's rocket, and land back in Bikini Bottom. They think they've landed on the moon and that everyone in Bikini Bottom are aliens.

episodes.title: Squeaky Boots
episodes.overview: Mr. Krabs gives SpongeBob a pair of "special" boots because he bought them for Pearl, but she didn't want them. SpongeBob loves them, but the squeaking drives Mr. Krabs crazy.

episodes.title: Nature Pants
episodes.overview: SpongeBob wants to give up his current life to live with the jellyfish against the wishes of all his friends. But, SpongeBob learns that a jellyfish life is not an easy one.

episodes.title: Opposite Day
episodes.overview: Squidward gets so mad at SpongeBob and Patrick, he decides to sell his house. Squidward needs to get rid of his annoying neighbors so he can sell his house. He tells SpongeBob and Patrick that it is "Opposite Day." Squid hopes that they will act the opposite of what they usually are, annoying. Of course, it doesn't work out as planned.

episodes.title: Culture Shock
episodes.overview: A talent show is taking place at the Krusty Krab to get more customers and more money, and Squidward is in charge. He will do anything to prevent SpongeBob from doing participating in it.

episodes.title: F.U.N.
episodes.overview: SpongeBob thinks that Plankton is evil only because he is lonely and has no friends. SpongeBob becomes Plankton's friend and plays with him. But, Mr. Krabs is convinced that Plankton is evil and that SpongeBob should not be hanging around with him.

episodes.title: MuscleBob BuffPants
episodes.overview: SpongeBob thinks he can get more attention if he becomes physically fit. But he soon finds that exercise is hard work, and orders "anchor arms," which he inflates with air, and looks buff. Everyone finds out how fake he is when Sandy signs him up for the annual anchor toss competition at Muscle Beach.

episodes.title: Squidward the Unfriendly Ghost
episodes.overview: SpongeBob thinks he accidentally killed Squidward, so Squidward decides to use it for his advantage. Threatening to haunt them for the rest of their lives, Squidward makes SpongeBob and Patrick his servants.

episodes.title: The Chaperone
episodes.overview: SpongeBob takes Pearl to the prom because her previous prom date dumped her, and she is very emotional about it. SpongeBob and Pearl cause all kinds of mischief, and they eventually get thrown out of the prom.

episodes.title: Employee of the Month
episodes.overview: SpongeBob must try to uphold his position as "Employee of the Month," which he has won for 27 months in a row. But, when Squidward tells him the award is a scam, SpongeBob starts to tease Squidward by saying he could never be "Employee of the Month." Squidward challenges SpongeBob, and then make a mess of everything.

episodes.title: Scaredy Pants
episodes.overview: It's Halloween and SpongeBob tries to scare some kids as "The Flying Dutchman," but the kids just laugh at his silly costume. SpongeBob gets Patrick to shave his head round, so he will look more like a ghost. He goes to the Krusty Krab to show off his costume, but everyone is more afraid of what is inside the costume.
