episodes.overview: Marge starts a business selling healing crystals to the naive mothers of Springfield when Homer’s work cuts children’s health-care benefits, leading Marge to use the crystals as a cheaper solution for Bart’s ADD.

episodes.title: The Winter of Our Monetized Content
episodes.overview: When a video of Bart and Homer fighting goes viral, they begin a journey as social media celebrities; Lisa battles the school's new industrialized detention system.

episodes.title: Go Big or Go Homer
episodes.overview: Homer must supervise interns, among whom is a go-getter who asks Homer to be his mentor.

episodes.title: The Fat Blue Line
episodes.overview: During the San Castellanta street festival, much of the town finds their wallets have been pickpocketed; after the state investigator puts the wrong man in jail, Chief Wiggum sets out to catch the real criminal and show he's still up for police work.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXX
episodes.overview: The 666th episode of the Simpsons parodies the Omen and Stranger Things, not to mention a little Crazy Rich Aliens.

episodes.title: Gorillas on the Mast
episodes.overview: After a trip to Aquatraz Water Park, Lisa becomes determined to set free Springfield's most vicious animals in captivity. Meanwhile, Homer fulfills a lifelong dream of buying a boat, and quickly realizes boat ownership sucks.

episodes.title: Marge the Lumberjill
episodes.overview: When Marge realizes that everyone views her as boring, she takes up competitive lumber-jacking as a hobby (and has a real gift for it). The circuit of competitive timbersports takes her on a month-long retreat to Portland with her trainer, Paula, whom Homer worries is going to steal her away forever

episodes.title: Livin La Pura Vida
episodes.overview: The Simpsons join other Springfield families on the Van Houten's annual trip to Costa Rica, which they obviously can't afford. While there, Homer befriends Patty's new girlfriend, Evelyn, and Lisa tracks down the real reason the Van Houtens can go on this trip every year

episodes.title: Thanksgiving of Horror
episodes.overview: The Simpsons face various Thanksgiving nightmares, including the first Thanksgiving, an A.I. mishap and a dangerous space mission complicated by a sentient cranberry sauce.

episodes.title: Todd, Todd, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
episodes.overview: Todd blames God for the death of his mother and rejects his faith, so Ned sends him to live with the Simpsons, hoping they can scare him into believing in God again.

episodes.title: Bobby: It's Cold Outside
episodes.overview: Sideshow Bob gets contracted as this year’s mall Santa. Meanwhile, someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people’s front porches.

episodes.title: Hail to the Teeth
episodes.overview: Homer and Marge attend Artie Ziff’s wedding and become quite uncomfortable when they realize that his bride-to-be is a clone of Marge. Meanwhile, Lisa grapples with the misogynistic implications of the immediate popularity she receives after getting her new Invisalign braces.

episodes.title: The Miseducation of Lisa Simpson
episodes.overview: Marge recruits Chrissy Teigen and John Legend for an education-based proposal.

episodes.title: Frinkcoin
episodes.overview: Lisa decides to do an essay on Professor Frink just as the scientist invents a new cryptocurrency. When this makes him the richest man in Springfield, Mr. Burns sees red and he starts plotting against Frink in order to restore his former status, while Frink learns who his real friends are.

episodes.title: Bart the Bad Guy
episodes.overview: Bart accidentally sees a new superhero movie one month before its intended release, and uses his knowledge to terrorize the other fans. Two executive producers of the film attempt to prevent Bart from leaking any more news to the public.

episodes.title: Screenless
episodes.overview: When Marge implements a screen time limit for the family, she realizes that she is the one addicted.

episodes.title: Better Off Ned
episodes.overview: Bart bonds with Ned Flanders, which leaves Homer jealous, so he retaliates by mentoring Nelson Muntz; a heroic act by Homer makes Bart look up to him again.

episodes.title: Highway to Well
episodes.overview: When Maggie goes to preschool, Marge decides to get a job to pass the time and ends up working at an upscale weed dispensary; Homer decides to open his own dispensary that mimics a sketchy drug deal, putting their two businesses at odds.

episodes.title: The Incredible Lightness of Being a Baby
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns tasks Homer with swindling Cletus Spuckler out of his newfound helium fortune. Meanwhile, Maggie is reunited with Hudson from Playdate with Destiny again, only for Marge to tear them apart after his mother annoys her.

episodes.title: Warrin' Priests (1)
episodes.overview: Helen Lovejoy's request for a youth pastor is answered by Bode Wright, a charismatic young preacher from Michigan. When Bode quickly has the Springfield congregation enamored by his easy-going and liberal approach to religion, an outcast and suspicious Reverend Lovejoy decides to look into the newcomer's past.

episodes.title: Warrin' Priests (2)
episodes.overview: While Bode has won over most of Springfield, he finds one churchgoer he can't sway in Ned Flanders. Meanwhile in Michigan, Reverend Lovejoy finds the ammunition he needs to get rid of his replacement.

episodes.title: The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
episodes.overview: After severing her sibling ties with Bart, Lisa attends a sleepover at her new friend Addy's house, only to discover that Addy's clique are a group of cruel snobby rich girls that taunt her. Meanwhile, Homer takes Marge on a sunset cruise for the evening and finds himself at odds with the boat's cover band.

episodes.title: The Way of the Dog
episodes.overview: Santa's Little Helper nips at Marge, causing the family to reflect on the difficult life that the dog led prior to being adopted by the family. They end up reuniting him with his mother to avoid having to euthanize him.

episodes.title: Undercover Burns
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

episodes.title: I, Carumbus
episodes.overview: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

episodes.title: Now Museum, Now You Don't
episodes.overview: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXI
episodes.overview: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

episodes.title: The 7 Beer Itch
episodes.overview: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

episodes.title: Podcast News
episodes.overview: Grampa Simpson is accused of a crime; Kent Brockman questions his career.

episodes.title: Three Dreams Denied
episodes.overview: Bart becomes a voice-over actor; Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con; Lisa is set up for a fall.

episodes.title: The Road to Cincinnati
episodes.overview: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first?

episodes.title: Sorry Not Sorry
episodes.overview: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

episodes.title: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
episodes.overview: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

episodes.title: The Dad Feelings Limited
episodes.overview: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate about having a baby and we learn about his awesome origin story.

episodes.title: Diary Queen
episodes.overview: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

episodes.title: Wad Goals
episodes.overview: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

episodes.title: Yokel Hero
episodes.overview: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

episodes.title: Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
episodes.overview: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

episodes.title: Manger Things
episodes.overview: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

episodes.title: Uncut Femmes
episodes.overview: It is discovered that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

episodes.title: Burger Kings
episodes.overview: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

episodes.title: Panic on the Streets of Springfield
episodes.overview: Lisa gets a new imaginary friend - a depressed British singer from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a truck guy.

episodes.title: Mother and Child Reunion
episodes.overview: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

episodes.title: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
episodes.overview: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

episodes.title: The Last Barfighter
episodes.overview: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

episodes.title: The Star of the Backstage
episodes.overview: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

episodes.title: Bart's in Jail
episodes.overview: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXII
episodes.overview: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

episodes.title: The Wayz We Were
episodes.overview: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

episodes.title: Lisa's Belly
episodes.overview: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

episodes.title: A Serious Flanders (1)
episodes.overview: When a ruthless debt collector come to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artificial world of prestige TV.

episodes.title: A Serious Flanders (2)
episodes.overview: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this 'Simpflix' prestige crime thriller.

episodes.title: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
episodes.overview: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

episodes.title: Mothers and Other Strangers
episodes.overview: In a flashback, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to find his mother.

episodes.title: A Made Maggie
episodes.overview: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

episodes.title: The Longest Marge
episodes.overview: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

episodes.title: Pixelated and Afraid
episodes.overview: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

episodes.title: Boyz N the Highlands
episodes.overview: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

episodes.title: You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About -- Act Three Will Shock You!
episodes.overview: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

episodes.title: Bart the Cool Kid
episodes.overview: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

episodes.title: Pretty Whittle Liar
episodes.overview: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love ... of learning.

episodes.title: The Sound of Bleeding Gums
episodes.overview: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

episodes.title: My Octopus and a Teacher
episodes.overview: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

episodes.title: Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
episodes.overview: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

episodes.title: Marge the Meanie
episodes.overview: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

episodes.title: Meat Is Murder
episodes.overview: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

episodes.title: Poorhouse Rock
episodes.overview: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

episodes.title: Habeas Tortoise
episodes.overview: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

episodes.title: One Angry Lisa
episodes.overview: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

episodes.title: Lisa the Boy Scout
episodes.overview: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

episodes.title: The King of Nice
episodes.overview: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is!

episodes.title: Not It
episodes.overview: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
episodes.overview: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

episodes.title: From Beer to Paternity
episodes.overview: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

episodes.title: Step Brother from the Same Planet
episodes.overview: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

episodes.title: When Nelson Met Lisa
episodes.overview: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

episodes.title: Game Done Changed
episodes.overview: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

episodes.title: Top Goon
episodes.overview: Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery.

episodes.title: My Life as a Vlog
episodes.overview: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

episodes.title: The Many Saints of Springfield
episodes.overview: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse.

episodes.title: Carl Carlson Rides Again
episodes.overview: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

episodes.title: Bartless
episodes.overview: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

episodes.title: Hostile Kirk Place
episodes.overview: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

episodes.title: Pin Gal
episodes.overview: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

episodes.title: Fan-ily Feud
episodes.overview: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

episodes.title: Write Off This Episode
episodes.overview: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

episodes.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillars
episodes.overview: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet… spending time in lockdown with each other.

episodes.title: Clown v. Board of Education
episodes.overview: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

episodes.title: Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
episodes.overview: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

episodes.title: Homer's Crossing
episodes.overview: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

episodes.title: A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
episodes.overview: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

episodes.title: McMansion & Wife
episodes.overview: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works - but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

episodes.title: Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
episodes.overview: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
episodes.overview: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

episodes.title: Iron Marge
episodes.overview: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

episodes.title: It's a Blunderful Life
episodes.overview: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

episodes.title: AE Bonny Romance
episodes.overview: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

episodes.title: Murder, She Boat
episodes.overview: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

episodes.title: Do the Wrong Thing
episodes.overview: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

episodes.title: Frinkenstein's Monster
episodes.overview: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every word... causing Frink to fear he's created a monster.

episodes.title: Lisa Gets an F1
episodes.overview: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

episodes.title: Clan of the Cave Mom
episodes.overview: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

episodes.title: Night of the Living Wage
episodes.overview: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she (collectively) bargained for.

episodes.title: Cremains of the Day
episodes.overview: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

episodes.title: The Tell-Tale Pants
episodes.overview: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

episodes.title: The Tipping Point
episodes.overview: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

episodes.title: Bart's Brain
episodes.overview: Bart makes a new friend.

episodes.title: Bart's Birthday
episodes.overview: Bart celebrates the most shocking birthday party of his entire life — one that might just change everyone in Springfield forever.

episodes.title: The Yellow Lotus
episodes.overview: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

episodes.title: Desperately Seeking Lisa
episodes.overview: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

episodes.title: Shoddy Heat
episodes.overview: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s… as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
episodes.overview: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called… Denim.

episodes.title: Women in Shorts
episodes.overview: Girls just want to have funny.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
episodes.overview: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

episodes.title: Convenience Airways
episodes.overview: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

episodes.title: Homer and Her Sisters
episodes.overview: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

episodes.title: The Man Who Flew Too Much
episodes.overview: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

episodes.title: Bottle Episode
episodes.overview: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

episodes.title: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
episodes.overview: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

episodes.title: The Last Man Expanding
episodes.overview: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

episodes.title: P.S. I Hate You
episodes.overview: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

episodes.title: Abe League of Their Moe
episodes.overview: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

episodes.title: Stew Lies
episodes.overview: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food... with some help from the mob.

episodes.title: Full Heart, Empty Pool
episodes.overview: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off the team.

episodes.title: Estranger Things
episodes.overview: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!

episodes.title: Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
episodes.overview: When Lisa starts wearing Marge's "vintage" clothes from the 90's, she's welcomed into the school's super-elite fashion club. But as they run out of retro looks, the funky fashionistas become obsessed with getting more... by hook or by crook.

episodes.title: Keep Chalm and Gary On
episodes.overview: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge mutated snails that produce valuable slime launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

episodes.title: Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
episodes.overview: Springfield is threatened by a mysterious killer monster emerging from the sewers, Krusty welcomes a demonic guest to his Halloween special, and the action moves a thousand years into the future in a post-apocalyptic, plastic version of the city.

episodes.title: Men Behaving Manly
episodes.overview: Springfield's men are in crisis.

episodes.title: Bad Boys... for Life?
episodes.overview: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

episodes.title: Bart 'N' Frink
episodes.overview: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

episodes.title: Sashes to Sashes
episodes.overview: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan... and about the Simpsons.

episodes.title: The Day of the Jack-Up
episodes.overview: After a mysterious buyer purchases every ticket for the KPOP concert Lisa wants to go to, the Simpsons have to figure out the identity of this evil ticket reseller. Or do they? (Yes, they do).

episodes.title: Aunt Misbehavin'
episodes.overview: Patty and Bart team up for the ultimate prank: getting Homer declared legally dead. To their chagrin, Homer loves being officially dead - which leads to Patty and Selma having a huge fight and Patty moving away to "Palm Springfield.

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Skinner
episodes.overview: When Principal Skinner discovers that one of his students is a runaway who has been living in the school library, he has to take the snarky, difficult kid into his home and is forced into a role he never expected or wanted - being a parent.

episodes.title: Parahormonal Activity
episodes.overview: Set in the near future, Marge is competently coping with the hormonal onslaught hitting her now teenage kids when she's suddenly struck by a big life change of her own, leaving Homer as the last sane person in the house... or is he?

episodes.title: ¡The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!
episodes.overview: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting.

episodes.title: Seperance
episodes.overview: Homer's enthusiasm skills land him a job at a secretive company with a mind-altering agenda.

episodes.title: Irrational Treasure [800th episode]
episodes.overview: Marge's crusade to get the family dog in better shape leads to her entering Santa's Little Helper in canine agility competitions and a trip to the National Dog Show in Philadelphia. There, Marge and Homer suddenly find themselves - and the dog - mixed up in a historical conspiracy adventure worthy of a "National Treasure" movie.

episodes.title: Homer? A Cracker Bro?
episodes.overview: Homer strikes up an unlikely friendship with Kirk Van Houten, which leads to them launching a hugely successful business venture together - a "crumbless" cracker that sweeps the nation. But when Kirk's darkest secrets are revealed, Homer has to choose between his family and his fortune... and may just end up going in jail.

episodes.title: The Children's Book Job
episodes.overview: A British children's book author comes to Springfield to give a talk at Springfield Elementary School. Homer is tasked with picking her up from the airport, but things go bad from there.

series.title: The Terminal List
series.tagline: Somewhere a true believe is training to kill you.
series.overview: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military's command structure, Reece applies the lessons he's learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.

episodes.title: The Engram
episodes.overview: In the wake of a disastrous mission overseas, Navy SEAL Commander James Reece returns home with conflicting memories of the op and questions about his own culpability.

episodes.title: Encoding
episodes.overview: Reece locks onto his first potential target, enlisting Ben's help. With his mental health in question, Katie and Reece strike up an uneasy but mutually beneficial partnership to find answers.

episodes.title: Consolidation
episodes.overview: Reece is drawn deeper into a complex conspiracy and puts a new name on his list. Meanwhile, Secretary of Defense Lorraine Hartley announces a drastic policy overhaul to help Special Operators. And Katie discovers the truth of what's going on in Reece's head.

episodes.title: Detachment
episodes.overview: With the help of his closest friends, Reece travels to Mexico to locate the triggerman who killed his family. Katie continues her research from a remote location. Steve Horn takes steps to preserve Capstone's deals, and the San Diego FBI Fugitive Task Force led by Tony Layun enters the fray in pursuit for rogue SEAL James Reece.

episodes.title: Disruption
episodes.overview: Reece travels to San Francisco to seek answers on a drug that may have started this all. Katie attempts to turn Mike Tedesco in an effort to blow up Capstone's plans for Nubellum. Tony and his team stick close to Horn, hoping to intercept Reece before he kills his next target.

episodes.title: Transience
episodes.overview: The FBI's manhunt intensifies as they close in on Reece. Without the medications, Reece's physical and mental symptoms escalate. Surrounded by law enforcement, a man hellbent on his mission must escape without taking innocent lives.

episodes.title: Extinction
episodes.overview: Reece returns to Coronado to bring the hammer down on the people who betrayed him the most. Back within the walls of his family home, fragmented memories surface. Katie plays ball with the FBI in order to finish her story.

episodes.title: Reclamation
episodes.overview: A showdown brews at Secretary of Defense Hartley's Orcas Island estate as Reece, Katie, Ben and Tony's paths and objectives collide.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Based on the book, True Believer, Season Two finds James Reece searching for a new purpose after finishing his list. But when the CIA corners him, Reece must clear his name by stopping a resurgent terrorist group that has turned an ally to their cause. In this globe-trotting espionage thriller, Reece will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, even to his own family's history.

series.title: The Trembling of Cicada
series.overview: Three legal professionals with troubled pasts become entangled in complex criminal cases, where psychological warfare, hidden agendas, and long-buried secrets blur the line between hunter and prey.

series.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
series.overview: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Maggie and Negan travel to post-apocalyptic Manhattan - long ago cut off from the mainland. The crumbling city is filled with the dead and denizens who have made it a world full of anarchy, danger, beauty, and terror.

episodes.title: Old Acquaintances
episodes.overview: Maggie finds Negan, and they travel to Manhattan; a marshal named Armstrong follows Negan; we meet a quiet young girl named Ginny.

episodes.title: Who's There?
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan encounter native New Yorkers; Armstrong revisits a trauma; Ginny attempts to adapt to change.

episodes.title: People Are a Resource
episodes.overview: Dark instincts reveal themselves as Maggie and Negan form a strategy; Armstrong is tested; Ginny embarks on a daring journey.

episodes.title: Everybody Wins a Prize
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan carry out an attack, but not everything unfolds according to plan; Ginny and Armstrong each make unexpected contact with others.

episodes.title: Stories We Tell Ourselves
episodes.overview: Truths are unearthed and motives are revealed as Maggie, Negan and the others travel further into the city's depths.

episodes.title: Doma Smo
episodes.overview: Tensions between Maggie and Negan come to a head; Ginny's search continues; questions arise around Armstrong's path forward.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, in the growing war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides. As their paths intertwine, they come to see that the way out for both is more complicated and harrowing than they ever imagined.

episodes.title: Power Equals Power
episodes.overview: In the war for control of Manhattan, Maggie and Negan find themselves trapped on opposite sides.

episodes.title: Another Shitty Lesson
episodes.overview: Maggie begins a treacherous journey back to the island. Negan reluctantly joins the fight.

episodes.title: Why Did the Mainlanders Cross the River?
episodes.overview: Negan tries something new with The Croat. Maggie travels into a dangerous, surprising place.

episodes.title: Feisty Friendly
episodes.overview: Maggie uncovers surprising information. Negan attempts to outmaneuver a slippery foe.

episodes.title: The Bird Always Knows
episodes.overview: Negan makes some big moves, while Maggie takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Bridge Partners Are Hard to Come By These Days
episodes.overview: Maggie considers making an alliance as the outcome of Negan's actions comes to a head.

episodes.title: Novi Dan, Novi Početak
episodes.overview: Negan and Maggie go on harrowing journeys and face unexpected challenges.

episodes.title: If History Were a Conflagration
episodes.overview: Maggie makes a painful choice, while Negan puts on a show.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In season three, Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?

episodes.title: Trillium
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan are caught in a treacherous situation that challenges their newfound alliance.

episodes.title: Haven
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan deal with old enemies and confront new challenges.

episodes.title: Emigrants
episodes.overview: Maggie, Negan and their new community receive an unexpected overflow of survivors.

episodes.title: Found/Lost
episodes.overview: Maggie and Luis look for valuable resources, while Negan and Renata protect the city.

episodes.title: Imperialis
episodes.overview: Maggie, Negan, Dillard, and Renata go on a hunt to resupply their dwindling resources.

episodes.title: Genesis
episodes.overview: Maggie and Negan find themselves in different circumstances, wrestling with their purposes.

series.title: The Westies
series.overview: As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.

episodes.title: The Troubles
episodes.overview: The Westies' fragile deal with the Italians unravels after a reckless kidnapping. Flanagan is released from Bellevue and rejoins Roarke's crew, Keenan is pulled onto an FBI task force, and Bridget receives a dangerous assignment from an old IRA contact.

episodes.title: The Houdini
episodes.overview: Roarke and the Westies hide the body of a dead Italian mobster and stage crimes to cover up the murder before Gotti retaliates. Polk pressures Keenan to dig into Sweeney's Mafia ties, while Bridget uncovers more of Cahill's plot.

episodes.title: The Starship
episodes.overview: Sweeney strikes a deal with Castellano: rob a Colombian disco and Flanagan walks free. Bridget seeks counsel about Cahill, while Keenan investigates the killing of a cop in Boston.

episodes.title: Favours and Funerals
episodes.overview: Roarke clashes with Sweeney over selling stolen cocaine, but Sweeney has his own agenda; as he receives a Hibernian Society award, Gotti orders a hit; Bridget learns Cahill's target is someone from her past; Keenan struggles to help his son.

episodes.title: A Right Rose Tree
episodes.overview: Sweeney lets Roarke sell cocaine only if he sources it himself, putting him in Gotti's crosshairs as Gotti suspects the Westies are defying Castellano; Bridget helps Cahill secure explosives for their IRA plot; Polk pressures Keenan to wear a wire.

episodes.title: Rad Tad
episodes.overview: Roarke gets a risky loan from Ruby Stein to fund a cocaine deal with a silver-spooned hotshot from downtown, only for the deal to implode; Keenan targets an older Westie to pressure Sweeney, while Bridget and the IRA cell move on Colonel Markham.

episodes.title: A Boy Made of Trouble
episodes.overview: Tensions between Sweeney and Roarke erupt when one of the Westies is busted; Keenan uses the case to pressure Sweeney and earn Polk's trust; Flanagan's personal life unravels; Bridget pushes deeper into her mission as Cahill's motives blur.

episodes.title: The Irish Goodbye
episodes.overview: Roarke and Sweeney's fallout splits the Westies, pitting old guard against young; Bridget pushes ahead with the mission but faces shattering truths; Polk increases pressure on Sweeney and Gotti, while Keenan wrestles with guilt.

series.title: Trying
series.overview: All Nikki and Jason want is a baby—the one thing they can't have. So they decide to adopt. With their dysfunctional friends, screwball families, and chaotic lives, will the adoption panel agree that they're ready to be parents?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Series 1 starts with Nikki and Jason becoming devastated when they're told they'll never conceive a child.

episodes.title: Nikki and Jason
episodes.overview: When they learn that another round of IVF would be too expensive and unlikely to succeed, Nikki and Jason start exploring

episodes.title: The Ex-Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Jason gets in touch with an ex before social services interviews her. Nikki goes out with her sister, Karen, and her unpleasant boyfriend

episodes.title: Tickets for a Queue
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason go to a picnic with other potential adopters—and get intimidated by the quality of their competition.

episodes.title: Rainbow Castle People
episodes.overview: After a wild night out with Erica and Freddy, Nikki and Jason are faced with potentially disastrous consequences the next morning.

episodes.title: Someone Else's Kids
episodes.overview: Deciding that they need more hands-on experience looking after kids, Nikki and Jason agree to babysit their friends' children for a day.

episodes.title: Show Me the Love
episodes.overview: Jason starts getting cold feet about the whole process after a mandatory training session. Karen tells Nikki some bad news.

episodes.title: Good Old Family Map
episodes.overview: Nikki grows paranoid about Jason after reading a suspicious text on his phone. A family gathering takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.title: We Know the Way Out
episodes.overview: Despite the added irritation of a new roommate, it's time for Nikki and Jason to face the adoption panel.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Having been approved by the adoption panel, Nikki and Jason now find that matching with a child is not as easy as they thought...

episodes.title: A Nice Boy
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason have been approved to adopt, but they're finding the matching process a challenge. Social worker Penny has a plan.

episodes.title: The Sun on Your Back
episodes.overview: Penny sends Nikki and Jason to a fancy-dress party that could change their lives. Nikki helps her sister, Karen, choose a wedding dress.

episodes.title: Big Heads
episodes.overview: Jason's ex threatens to come between him and Nikki at a family funeral. Karen struggles to get Scott involved in their wedding planning.

episodes.title: Helicopters
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason make a hopeful visit on their adoption journey. Nikki sets Erica up with Jason's friend. Karen is drawn to Deven, a single dad.

episodes.title: Maddest Sweetest Thing
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason search for a bigger, child-friendly flat. Nikki fights for a promotion at work. Karen is tempted to cheat.

episodes.title: A Long Way Down
episodes.overview: Jason plays detective after a problem is revealed at Ben and Denise's party. Freddy struggles in his relationship.

episodes.title: Lift Me Up
episodes.overview: Planning Scott's stag night is a headache for Jason. Karen shares a secret with Nikki. Erica and Freddy's relationship begins to blur.

episodes.title: I'm Scared
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason must make a huge decision in a small amount of time.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Nikki and Jason wake up as new parents to two children they are still getting to know. Now they just have to keep hold of them, which proves to be trickier than they initially thought. Thrown straight into the parental deep end, Nikki and Jason’s relationships with each other and with their nearest and dearest are tested as they desperately try to navigate the ups and downs of parenting — while hanging onto their kids, and their sanity.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: Jason and Nikki wake up as the new parents of two kids they've barely met. But will they be able to keep both?

episodes.title: The Circle
episodes.overview: Jason worries that Tyler will be bullied at school. Nikki has to fire someone at work. Bad news from the landlord forces Jason to take a big gamble.

episodes.title: Capture the Flag
episodes.overview: On a camping weekend, Nikki and Jason try to bond with the kids. At home, Karen faces an existential crisis and Freddy realizes he's lonely.

episodes.title: Little Steps
episodes.overview: Planning Tyler's birthday party proves trickier than Nikki and Jason expected—especially when Karen shares some difficult news.

episodes.title: Pick a Side
episodes.overview: Jason makes a huge sacrifice for Tyler. Nikki attempts some tough love with Princess. Freddy tries a different sort of group therapy.

episodes.title: Feelings Are the Worst
episodes.overview: Jason and Nikki's future with the kids appears to be in jeopardy after a mistake. Tyler says goodbye to a friend. Scott lands a book deal.

episodes.title: What a Banker
episodes.overview: Scott's book launch doesn't go according to plan. Jason struggles with his new job. Nikki finally masters tough love.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning
episodes.overview: As Nikki and Jason prepare to find out if they can keep the kids forever, they make an impulsive decision that requires their family's help.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: We fast-forward six years to discover that Nikki and Jason are experienced adopters who have built a lovely little nuclear family, enriched by an extraordinary support network. However, as their teenage daughter, Princess, starts to yearn for a connection with her birth mother, Nikki and Jason find themselves confronted with the ultimate test of their parenting skills.

episodes.title: The Send-Off
episodes.overview: A loss brings the family together—and also threatens to tear it apart.

episodes.title: Ghosting
episodes.overview: Nikki's impulsiveness sparks an unexpected night out with Jason and a mystery man.

episodes.title: Murder at Slaughterbridge Manor
episodes.overview: A family party leads to a life-changing decision for the birthday boy.

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.overview: On a mission to help Tyler fit in, Jason starts a junior soccer team. Nikki, Karen, and Princess travel to Brighton—and one of them has a secret.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.overview: A celebratory spa visit is surprisingly stressful. Jason's plan to bond his team spins out of control.

episodes.title: Airport Run
episodes.overview: Jason and Nikki's good intentions are derailed by old friends while, unbeknownst to them, their family is about to be rocked.

episodes.title: White Lies
episodes.overview: Nikki looks for answers in Spain. Back at home, Jason has to call in reinforcements to avert a disaster.

episodes.title: Scott of the Atlantic
episodes.overview: Scott reaches the point of no return. Jason and his team face a moment of truth. Princess makes a huge discovery.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Nikki and Jason find themselves dealing with the consequences of Princess and Tyler's biological mother Kat turning up at their doorstep, and the whirlwind of chaos she brings into their settled family life.

episodes.title: Rollercoaster
episodes.overview: The fallout from Nikki's lie continues, as Kat's arrival threatens Nikki and Jason's family dynamic.

episodes.title: First Days
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason start new chapters in their lives. Karen makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: The Mousetrap
episodes.overview: While Jason recaptures his youth, Nikki meets a new coworker. Karen learns the cost of keeping a secret.

episodes.title: The Hurricane
episodes.overview: A natural disaster brings the family together.

episodes.title: Ick
episodes.overview: Jason and Nikki each must face reality. Vic crumbles under the pressure of his own success.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.overview: Nikki and Jason's date night is derailed by suspicion, as Princess' night spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Tuscany
episodes.overview: When Nikki and Jason escape to Tuscany, nothing goes as expected—at home or abroad.

episodes.title: WoodScott
episodes.overview: Truths begin to emerge at a family festival.

series.title: Widow's Bay
series.tagline: Welcome to the island, please enjoy your stay. Just don't ask too many questions.
series.overview: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Widow's Bay is a quaint island town 40 miles off the coast of New England. But something lurks beneath the surface. Mayor Tom Loftis is desperate to revive his struggling community. There's no Wi-Fi, spotty cellular reception and he must contend with superstitious locals who believe their island is cursed. He wants these people to respect him. They don't. They think he is soft and cowardly. And he is. But Loftis is determined to build a better future for his teenage son and turn the island into a tourist destination. Miraculously, he succeeds: tourists are finally coming. Unfortunately, the locals were right. After decades of calm, the old stories that seemed too ludicrous to be true start happening again.

episodes.title: Welcome to Widow's Bay!
episodes.overview: We hope you enjoyed the three-hour ferry to New England's best-kept secret! Ignore the warnings about the fog. Everything's fine.

episodes.title: Lodging
episodes.overview: Cherish the historical charm of our local inn, which Mayor Loftis will prove is safe by spending a night there alone.

episodes.title: The Inaugural Swim
episodes.overview: It's time for the annual beach opening. Lay out a towel as the mayor "tests the waters." Unrelated: Do not pick up hitchhikers.

episodes.title: Beach Reads
episodes.overview: Make sure you pack a good read for the beach! (We do not recommend self-help books on the island.)

episodes.title: What to Expect on Your Trip
episodes.overview: We apologize for the curfew. Please remain calm as we determine what's happening. On a separate note, keep your teenagers inside after dark.

episodes.title: Our History
episodes.overview: The history of Widow's Bay is a beautiful tale of marriage, loyalty, and a love that endures beyond lifetimes. That's all.

episodes.title: Seasickness
episodes.overview: Set out to sea with Mayor Loftis and cherished local figure, Wyck! They are attending to some business—best to simply enjoy the voyage.

episodes.title: Your Baggage
episodes.overview: Don't worry about misplaced luggage. Old baggage always resurfaces in Widow's Bay.

episodes.title: Emergency Shelter
episodes.overview: Please seek shelter should a centuries-old storm rage toward the island and plunge us into darkness. Enjoy a card game.

episodes.title: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!
episodes.overview: We understand that hard choices had to be made and we may never be the same, but we hope you'll visit again!

episodes.overview: When Magneto is forced by the UN to stand trial, a group of anti-mutant rioters test his resolve.

episodes.overview: After E-Day, a covert paramilitary force rises to try to fill the void left by the X-Men.

episodes.title: Rise of Apocalypse (1)
episodes.overview: The plan to rescue the team from Ancient Egypt is turned upside-down by an unexpected visitor.

episodes.title: Rise of Apocalypse (2)
episodes.overview: An alliance between the X-Men and En Sabah Nur starts to crack when Rama-Tut seeks ultimate power.

episodes.overview: Wolverine, Morph, and a motley crew of old rivals face off against Weapon X's latest experiment.

episodes.title: The Dead Man's Hand
episodes.overview: The X-Men confront a ghost from their past.

episodes.title: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.overview: The X-Men are pushed to their limits as their past comes back to haunt them.

series.title: You Maniac

series.overview: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.
